rgyud/ a/ (35)0698 sgrub pa'i thabs mdor byas pa/ 3slob dpon chen po klu sgrub kyis mdzad/rgya gar gyi mkhan po ā tsārya shradhā ka ra warma dang /zhu chen gyi lo tsā ba bande rin chen bzang pos bsgyur cing zhus te gtan la phab/bsdur mchan/(25) bsdur 'bras re'u mig(27)0699 rnal 'byor chen po'i rgyud dpal gsang ba 'dus pa'i bskyed pa'i rim pa bsgom pa'i thabs mdo dang bsres pa zhes bya ba 28mdo dang barṣa pa rgyas par bstan pa/ 28dang po'i sbyor ba zhes bya ba'i ting nge 'dzin dang po bstan pa/ 281

dkyil 'khor gyi mchog ces bya ba'i ting nge 'dzin gnyis pa bstan pa/ 35las kyi mchog ces bya ba'i ting nge 'dzin gsum pa bstan pa/ 36mdor bsdus nas bshad ba/ 38slob dpon chen po klu sgrub kyi zhal snga nas mdzad/rgya gar gyi mkhan po snyarma shrī bha dra dang lo tsā ba dge slong rin chen bzang pos bsgyur cing zhus te gtan la phab/bsdur mchan/(39) bsdur 'bras re'u mig(40)0700 dpal gsang ba 'dus pa'i dkyil 'khor gyi cho ga zhes bya ba/ 41dang po/ sa ——nga ba:re cho ga 43gnyis pa/ sa gzhi byin gyis brlab pa'i cho ga 45gsum pa/ sa yongs su gzung ba'i cho ga 45bstuno pa/ sa bsdogang ba6) ཿdza ga ༷ 47lnga pa/ sa'i lha mo sta gon du gnas pa'i cho ga 47drug pa/ dkyil 'khor gyi lha sta gon du gnas pa'i cho ga gyebadun pa/ bum pa sta gon la gnas pa'i cho ga ༷ gobargyad pa/ slob ma sta gon la gnas pa'i cho ga 50dasdo/ pa/ thig gdab palnga/ mdza ga 56bcu pa/ rdul tshon dgye ba'i cho ga 60bcu gcig pa/ dkyil 'khor byin gyis brlab pa'i cho ga 62bcu gnyis pa/ mchod pa'i bye brag gi cho ga 63bcu gsum pa/ slob dpon 'jug pa'i cho ga 64bcu bzhi pa/ slob ma gzhug pa'i cho ga 65bco lnga pa/ bum pa'i dbang gi cho ga 682

bcu drug pa/ gsang ba'i dbang bsgur ba'i cho ga 75bcu bdun pa/ shes rab ye shes kyi dbang bsgur ba'i cho ga 78bco brgyad pa/ dbang bzhi pa yon dang bcas nga/'i cho ga 79jubasres tshod/thu nga / /gricad byesabaka :go ཿdza bka 833) 〈thu ngas/ zangapa bkakhyedathag /) ཿdza bka 90slo ba dpon klu sgru ba kyi zhal snga nas mdzad/rgya gar gyi mkhan po su bhā rṣa ta dang / zhu chen gyi lo tsā ba dke slong rin chen bzang ngo/sa bsgyur cing zhus rte gten la phab/bsdur mchan/(92) bsdur 'bras re'u mig(97)0701 dbang bstuno pa:re za ba /nge dre)da pa/ 98slo ba dpon nā gārdzu nas mdzad/rgya gar gyi mkhan ngo/ shārnyi gasgo dang bod kyi lo tsā ba 'bos lhas btsas kyis bsgyur/bsdur mchan/(106) bsdur 'bras re'u mig(107)0702 byang chub sems kyi 'grel pa zhes bya ba/ 108slo ba dpon bdag nyid chen ngo 'phasas pa/ klu sgru ba kyis mdzad/rgya gar gyi mkhan po gu ṇa ā sa ra dang / lo tsā ba rab 'i bshes gnyen kyis bsgyur cing zhus/sla da kyi rgya sar gyi mkhan ngo/ 7 na 7 warma dang / bod kyi lo tsā ba pa/ tshab nyi ma grags kyis bcos/bsdur mchan/(119) bsdur 'bras re'u mig(120)3

0703 rngamang chub sems kyi 'grel pa/ ༷ ༷ ༷ 121slob dpon klu sgrub kyis mdzad/kha tsho paṇḍi ta dza ya a nasnya dang /bod kyi lo tsā ba khu mdo sde 'bar gyis bsgyur/bsdur mchan/(128) bsdur 'bras re'u mig(128)0ba)0zheg (sde/ma /ba /lnga /pa/ 129dang po/ rdo rje bzlas pa'i rim pa 129slob dpon klu sgrub kyi zhal snga nas mdzad/gnyis pa/ bla na med pa'i dgongs pa zhes bya ba thams cad dag cing rnam tshosazeng tshodatha/ 25/re 1sdecapa tshon 136slob dpon shākya bshes gnyen gyis mdzad/gsum pa/ bdag la byin gyis brlab pa'i rim pa 145slob dpon klu sgrub kyi zhal snga nas mdzad/bzhi pa/ mchog tu gsang ba'i bde ba mngon par byang chub pa'i rim pa/ 150slob dpon klu sgrub kyi zhal snga nas mdzad/lnga pa/ zung du 'jug pa'i rim pa 154slob dpon klu sgrub kyi zhal snga nas mdzad/rgya gar gyi mkhan po ā tsārya shrasgyu ka ra warma dang /zhu chen gyi lo tsā ba bande rin chen bzang pos bsgyur cing zhus/slad kyi rgya gar gyi mkhan po ka ma la gupta dang /lo tsā ba rin ra bzang pos yul dbus kyi dpe dang yang gtugs te gtan la phab/bsdur mchan/(158) bsdur 'bras re'u mig(160)0705 rjesad pa bsdus pa'i sgon ma/ ༷ ༷ ༷ 1614

le'u dang po/ spyod pa bsdus pa las the tshom yongs su gcod pa/ 161le'u gnyis pa/ lus rnam par dben pa bsdus pa'i the tshom gcod pa/ 171le'u gsum pa/ ngag rnam par dben pa bsdus pa'i the tshom gcod pa/ 186le'u bzhi pa/ sems rnam par dben pa bsdus pa'i the tshom gcod pa/ 205le'u lnga pa/ las kyi mtha' rnam par 'byed pa'i bsdus pa'i the tshom gcod pa/ 220le'u drug pa/ kun rdzob kyi bden pa bsdus pa'i the tshom gcod pa/ 228le'u bdun pa/ rnal 'byor gnyis rnam par dag pa la dga' ba rnams kyi mngon par byang chub pa'i rim pa don dam pa'i bden pa bsdus pa'i the tshom sgyunacotshod /ba/ 23kyi le'u brgyad pa/ mi gnas pa'i mya ngan las 'das pa'i khams bsdus pa'i the tshom gcod pa/ rten4rtenale'u dgu pa/ byang chub sems dpa' sems dpa' chen po'i spyod pa chos 'byung ba'i mngon par byang chub pa'i spros pa dang bcas pa bsnyus pa'i the tshom gcod pa/ rtenag 1le'u bcu pa/ spros pa med pa'i spyod pa bsdus pa'i the tshom gcod pa/ 268le'u bcu gcig pa/ shin tu spros pa med pa'i spyod pa bsdus pa'i the tshom gcod pa/ rtenarte /4slob dpon chen po ārya de ba'i zhal snga nas kyis mdzad/rgya gar gyi mkhan po shra— ka ra warma dang /zhu chen gyi lo tsā ba dge slong rin chen bzang pos bsgyur cing zhus te gtan la phab/bsdur mchan/(283) bsdur 'bras re'u mig(290)0706 sems kyi sgrib pa rnam par sbyong ba zhes bya ba'i rab tu byed 5

pa 291slo ba dpon ārya de bas mdzad/ā tsārya tshwa na ka ra dang lo tsā ba tshul khrims rgyal bas bsgyur/bsdur mchan/(304) bsdur 'bras re'u mig(305)༷7༷7 bdag byin gyis brlab pa'i rim pa rnam par dbye ba/ 306slo ba dpon ārya de bas mdzad/bsdur mchan/(312) bsdur 'bras re'u mig(313)0708 mngon par byang chub pa'i rim pa'i man ngag 314slo ba dpon 'phags pa lhas mdzad/rgya gar gyi mkhan po shrand+ra ka ra barma dang /lo tsā ba dbee slo nga rin chen bzang pos bsgyur cing zhus te gtan la phab/bsdur mchan/(320) bsdur 'bras re'u mig(321)0709 ro bsreg pa'i cho ga 322'phabs pa lhas mdzad/rgya bar gyi ma/khan po shrand+ra khre ra warma dang /bod kyi lo tsā ba dashe rlo nga rin chen bzang pos bsgyur cing zhus te gtan la phab/bsdur mchan/(326) bsdur 'bras re'u mig(327)0710 dpal gsang ba 'dus pa'i rdzogs rim mthar phyin pa bzhugs / 328slo ba dngo na ārya de bas mdzad/

bsdur mchan/(335) bsdur 'bras re'u mig(336)0711 'dus pa'i sgrub pa'i thabs rnam par gzhag pa'i rim pa zhes bya ba 337dang po/ rnam par dgod pa bstan pa'i rim par phye ba/ 337gnyis pa/ sku'i dkyil 'khor rnam par gzhag pa bstan pa'i rim par phye ba 346gsum pa/ sku'i dkyil 'khor las phyung ba'i dkyil 'khor gyi rim pa bstan pa'i rim par phye ba/ 3gobazhi pa/ don dam pa'i dkyil 'khor gyi rnam par gzhag pa bstan pa'i rim par phye ba/ 357grub pa'i slob dpon klu'i blo'i zhal snga nas mdzad/bsdur mchan/(361) bsdur 'bras re'u mig(363)0712 dpal gsang ba 'dus pa'i dkyil 'khor gyi cho ga nyi shu pa zhes bya ba/ 364dang po/ sa sbyang ba'i cho ga 364gnyis pa/ sa yongs su gzung ba'i cho ga 366gsum pa/ bgegs nye bar zhi ba'i cho ga ༷ ༷ 367bzhi pa/ thod le kor gyis thig gdab pa'i cho ga 370lnga pa/ sa'i lha mo dang bum pa lhag par gnas pa'i cho ga 372drug pa/ gsol ba gdab pa'i cho ga 373bdun pa/ slob ma lhag par gnas pa'i cho ga 374brgyad pa/ nam mkha' la thig gdab pa'i cho ga 3777

tshad/ku nga / ཿdzacad /rdo /snga/re —— bka 379bcu pa/ 11na rtsi 'gyed pa'i cho ga 379bcu gcig pa/ lha rnams spyan drang ba'i cho ga na80bcu gnyis pa/ slob ma gzhug pa'i cho ga 383bcu gsum pa/ khrus kyi dkyil 'khor gyi cho ga ༷ 389bcu bzhi pa/ phyag mtshan gyi dbang bskur ba'i cho ga 389bco lnga pa/ lha la yon 'bul ba'i cho ga 395bcu drug pa/ bla ma la yon dbul ba'i cho ga 396bcu bdun pa/ slob ma la rjes su gnang ba sbyin pa'i cho ga 397bco brgyad pa/ nye bar bsdu ba'i cho ga 398bcu dgu pa/ phur bu dbyung ba'i cho ga 398nyi shu pa/ gsol ba 'debs pa'i cho ga 399slob dpon klu'i byang rga kyis mdzad/shud kyi ston pa dar ma rdo rjes zhus nas rgya gar gyi mkhan po paṇḍi ta chen po ti la ka ka la sha dang bod kyi sgra bsgyur gyi lo tsā ba chen po bande pa tsha nyi ma grags kyis bsgyur/bsdur mchan/(400) bsdur 'bras re'u mig(403)0713 las kyi mtha' rnam par 'byed pa zhes bya ba/ 404rje btsun 'phags pa klu'i blo'i zhabs kyis mdzad/rgya gar gyi mkhan po bla ma rje btsun ma ṇi ka shrī tshwa na dang /bla ma rje btsun rṣa po re bend+ra'i zhal snga nas gus par mnyan nas chag lo tsā ba shākya'i dge slong chos rje dpal gyis bsgyur cing zhus te gtan la 8

phab/bsdur mchan/(408) bsdur 'bras re'u mig(408)0714 rim pa khongs su bsdu ba'i man ngag ces bya ba'i rab tu byed pa— 409slob dpon rsā po klu'i blo rig pa 'dzin pa'i dngos grub brnyes nas da dung dpal gyi ri la bzhugs pa'i zhal snga nas mdzad/rgya gar gyi mkhan po ā laṅka ka la sha'i zhal snga nas dang / bod kyi sgra bsgyur gyi lo tsā ba bande nyi ma grags kyis bsgyur/bsdur mchan/(414) bsdur 'bras re'u mig(414)0715 rim pa lnga'i don mdor bshad pa rnal 'byor pa'i yid 'phrog ces bya ba/ 415mdor byas kyi rim pa'i don mdor bshad pa/ 415rdo rje bzlas pa'i rim pa'i don mdor bshad pa/ 462bdag byin kyis brlab pa'i rim pa'i don mdor bshad pa/ go0'od gsal gyi rim pa'i don mdor bshad pa/ 507zung du 'jug pa'i rim pa'i don mdor bshad pa/ 521yul ma ga dhwa pa'i paṇḍi ta thub pa dpal bzang pos mdzad/dbeel lo tsā ba chos kyi bzang po'i phyag dpe'i rgya dpe las bod kyi skad du/ dge slong rin chen grub kyis bsgyur cing zhus te gtan la phab—/bsdur mchan/(526) bsdur 'bras re'u mig(536)

0716 rdo rje sems dpa'i sgrub thabs zhes bya ba/ 537slob dpon zla ba grags pas mdzad/paṇḍi ta mkhas pa ra po ta thā ga ta rakṣi ta'i zhal snga nas dang /lo tsā ba klog skya gzhon nu 'bar gyis bsgyur/slad kyi rgya gar gyi mkhan po mkhas pa chen po dri paṃ kā ra rakṣi ta dang / khams pa dge slong lo tsā ba ba ris bcos shing bshad de zhus nas gtan la phab/bsdur mchan/(558) bsdur 'bras re'u mig(560)0717 rdo rje sems dpa'i sgrub thabs kyi 'grel pa/ 561lī la badzra zhabs kyis mdzad/bi khyu ti tsand+ra'i rgya dpe la bltas nas dge slong rin ra grub kyis bsgyur/yi ge pa ni dge slong rin wo rgyal mtshan no—//bsdur mchan/(571) bsdur 'bras re'u mig(572)0718 bdud rtsi 'khyil pa'i sgrub thabs/ 573slob dpon zla ba grags pas mdzad/slob dpon shrasgyu ka ra warma dang / lo tsā ba rin rṣa bzang pos bsgyur/bsdur mchan/(577) bsdur 'bras re'u mig(577)0719 gsang ba 'dus pa'i mngon par rtogs pa'i rgyan gyi 'grel pa 578tshad/pa ——/ (basbub /ban spyod/ba/ 57810

gcig lam dngos bshad pa/ 578smin par byed pa'i lam bshad pa/ 578bum pa'i dbang bskur ba ba da pa/ 578gsang ba'i dbang bskur ba bshad pa/ 594shes rab ye shes kyi dbang bskur ba bshad pa/ 601dbang bzhi pa basbur ba bshad pa/ 607grol bar byed pa'i lam bshajapa/ 612bskyed pa'i rim pa bshad pa/ 612rdzogs pa'i rim pa bshad pa/ 616gnyis/ de'i grogs spyod pa bshad pa/ 630gnyis pa/ 'bras bu bshad pa/ 631slob dpon zla ba grasas pas mdzad/bsdur mchan/(634) bsdur 'bras re'u mig(638)0720 zung du 'jug pa gsal ba zhes bya ba'i dbang gi bya ba/ 639bum pa lhag par gnas pa'i cho ga ༷ ༷ 640slob ma lhag par gnas pa'i cho ga 643me tog dor ba:re cho ga 648dkyil 'khor du 'jug pa'i cho ga 652khrus kyi dkyil 'khor gyi cho ga 655/thuzug thab/re tshod/bapa / 655rjes su gnang ba'i cho ga sogs/ 663gsang ba'i dbang bskur ba/ 666shes rab ye shes kyi dbang bskur ba/ 668:cog gi dbang bskur ba/ 670mkhas pa chen ngo/ sgra sacan 'dzin dpal 1/

bshes gnyen gyis mdzad/mkhas pa chen po bsod snyoms pa shākya shrī bha dra'i zhal snga nas dang / shākya'i dge slong kun dga' rgyal ma— dpal bzang pos bsgyur cing gtan la phab/bsdur mchan/(674) bsdur 'bras re'u mig(677)0721 dpal gsang ba 'dus pa'i dkyil 'khor gyi cho ga 678sngon du bsnyen pa'i cho ga 678sa (1nga ba:re ཿdza ga 679sa gzung ba'i cho ga 680lha sta gon du gnas pa'i cho ga 682ye shes kyi thig gdab pa'i cho ga 683ཿdzan tshodabye) ba:re ཿdza ga 685bum pa sta gon la gnas pa'i cho ga 687slob ma sta gon la gnas pa'i cho ga 688slob dpon 'jug pa'i cho ga 691me tog dor ba:re ཿdza ga 694/dethag nga 6) ཿdza rngon 696slob dpon gyi dbang bskur ba'i cho ga 697gsang ba'i dbang bskur ba'i cho ga 703shes rab ye shes kyi dbang bskur ba'i cho ga 704slob dpon nag po pa'i zhal snga nas bla ma'i man ngag la brten te mdzad/rgya gar gyi mkhan po nag po pa'i zhal snga nas dang / bod kyi lo tsā ba wo po 'gos lhas btsas kyis bsgyur/12

bsdur mchan/(706) bsdur 'bras re'u mig(708)0722 rdo rje sems dpa' mchod pa'i cho ga 709slob dpon ra po nag po pa'i zhal snga nas bla ma'i man ngag las bzung ste mdzad/rgya gar gyi mkhan po slob dpon nag po pa'i zhal snga nas dang / bod kyi lo tsā ba 'gos khug pa lhas btsas kyis bsgyur/bsdur mchan/(717) bsdur 'bras re'u mig(718)0723 gtozab skyab:re ཿdza ga ba(nugs/ 719slob dpon nag pos mdzad/bsdur mchan/(722) bsdur 'bras re'u mig(722)0724 rab tu gnas pa'i cho ga'i rim pa 723dang po/ lngas pa'i tshig bstan pa/ 723gnyis pa/ rnam par dbye ba/ 724tha :de ——zug ngasazab tshodabyebye pas/ 72zhesasgrub thabs rnam par dbye ba/ 724gsum pa/ cho ga'i rim pa bstan pa/ 724(1thab pazang ba/gan pa/ 724bsdus pazang bstan pa/ 734slob dpon nag po pas mdzad/de nyid dang 'gos lhas btsas kyis bsgyur/bsdur mchan/(735) bsdur 'bras re'u mig(736)13

0725 rdo rje 'chang chen po'i lam gyi rim pa'i man ngag bdud rtsi gsang ba/ 77tsho rten/yan lag dang po/ lus rnam par dben pa'i gzhi bshad pa/ 737yan lag gnyis pa/ 'u/sa rnam par dbeen pa bshad pa/ 741yan nga ga gsum pa/ ngag rnam par dbeen pa bshad pa/ 743yan 'a ga bzhi pa/ sems rnam par dbeen pa bshad pa/ 747yan lag lnga pa/ bden gnyis dang zung 'jug gi ting nge 'dzin bshad pa/ 752kun rdzob kyi bden pa bshad pa/ 752don dam pa'i bden pa bshad pa/ 754zung 'jug gi ting nge 'dzin bshad pa/ 760yan lag drug pa/ lhun gyis grub pa'i lam bshad pa/ 762slo ba dngo na chen ngo sgra dbyangs bcu gcis pas mdzad/rgya gar gyi mkhan ngo darmā shrī lha dra dang /lo tsā ba dase slo nga rin chen bzang ngo sa bsgyur cing zhus te gtan la phab/basbur mchan/(766) bsdur 'bras re'u mig(768)0726 rnal 'byor chen po'i rgyud dpal gsang ba 'dus pa'i gtor skyab//sde ཿco bka shegabs (ṣṭha thab/ 769za hor gyi mkhan po chen po shārtse de bas mdzad/pa ṇḍi ta de nyid dang lo tsā ba 'bos kyis bsgyur/bsdur mchan/(772) bsdur 'bras re'u mig(772)1 /

0727 /byecad rjesasgyun 1go ces sgyun 773rgya gar gyi mkhan po shra— ka ra warma dang /dharma shrī bha dra dang /lo tsā ba dge slong rin phi bzang pos bsgyur cing zhus te gtan la phab/bsdur mchan/(787) bsdur 'bras re'u mig(789)rgyud/ 9) (36)༷728 mdor bsdus pa'i sgrub thabs kyi 'grel pa rin chen phreng ba/ 793dang po'i sbyor ba'i ting nge 'dzin bstan pa/ 793dkyil 'khor rgyal ba mchog gi ting nge 'dzin bstan pa/ 899yan lag bcu gnyis pa las kyi rgyal ba mchog gi ting nge 'dzin bstan pa/ 947slob dpon rin chen 'byung banas bee ba'i zhal snga nas mdzad/rgya gar gyi mkhan po karma badzra nyid kyis bsgyur cing satan la phab/bsdur mchan/(1009) bsdur 'bras re'u mig(1027)0729 sgrub pamadze ——da pa 'ab sharajugag pa/ 1028le'u dang po/ bla ma dang slob ma'i tshul bstan pa/ 1028le'u gnyis pa/ 'chi bdag gzhom pa bstan pa/ 1041le'u gsum pa/ lha la sogs pa'i bdud gzhom pa bstan pa/ 1045le'u bzhi pa/ gnas pa'i le'u las gnas pa dang po bstan pa/ 105115

le'u lnga pa/ bsam gtan gyi lha'i gnas pa bstan pa/ 1067le'u drug pa/ tshad med pa'i gnas pa bstan pa/ 1068le'u bdun pa/ rnam par thar pa bstan pa/ 1069le'u brgyad pa/ stong pa nyid bstan pa/ 1069le'u dgu pa/ 'od gsal ba dang zung du 'jug pa bstan pa/ 1071le'u bcu pa/ bdud phyir bzlog pa'i rim pa sgrub pa'i spyod pa la 'jug pa (5 ba/stespyad ngas ba/gcad pa/ 1072slob dpon chen po dpal tshwa na badzras mdzad/rgya gar gyi mkhan po dge bsnyen rṣa po ku mā ra dang / bod kyi lo tsā ba lha btsun pas bsgyur cing zhus/bsdur mchan/(1074) bsdur 'bras re'u mig(1079)0730 dpal gsang ba 'dus pa'i dkyil 'khor gyi lha'i sku la bstod pa zhes bya /ba/ 1080rnal 'byor gyi dbang phyug mi gnas rdo rjes mdzad/rgya gar gyi mkhan po ā tsārya sha— ka ra warma dang / zhu chen gyi lo tsā ba banee rin chen bzang pos bsgyur/bsdur mchan/(1085) bsdur 'bras re'u mig(1085)0731 byang chub sems kyi 'grel pa'i rnam par bshad pa/ 1086——tshor thab/rna/ 1086bajus don/ 10sa rte/byus ba'i don gyi bsdus don/ 108716

'grel pa'i don gyi bsdus don/ 1087(byetha tshabar tshabashatshad tshab/ 1089byus nga :re mdocad ngab44tshod nga / 1089don dam pa'i byang chub kyi sems bstan pa/ 1089de bsgom pa dam bca' ba 1092kun rdzob byang chub kyi sems bstan pa/ 1095de gnyis rtogs par bya ba'i thabs 1097'grel pa'i don bshad pa/ ༷ ༷ 1098/sgob/ pa zhes95 ngas 1098dbu zhabs kyi don/ 1100bshad pa dam bca' ba ༷ 1100don dam pa'i byang chub kyi sems cher ga'ag pa'i don/ 1100dngos po thams cad dang bral ba 'grel pa'i don/ 1102phung po la sogs pa spangs pa 'grel pa/ 1106chos bdag med pa mnyam pa nyid 'grel pa/ 1112rang gi sems ma skyes pa la sogs pa'i 'grel pa/ 1120kun rdzob byang chub kyi sems cher gzhag pa'i don/ 1130ma bsgral ba bsgral ba'i don bshad pa/ 1134ma grol ba dgrol ba'i 'grel pa'i don bshad pa/ ༷ 1136dbugs dbyung ba'i don 'grel pa/ 1137yongs su mya ngan las 'das pa'i don 'grel pa/ ༷ 1140byang chub kyi sems rnam pa gnyis kyi yon tan gsungs pa/ 1142tshod(go thab thab/sngo thab/ 11'jugag slo ba dpon klu sgrub kyis mdzad/rgya gar gyi mkhan po smṛ ti dzñā na tīrtis bsgyur cing bshad nas gtan la phab/bsdur mchan/(1146) bsdur 'bras re'u mig(1152)17

0732 rim pa lnga pa'i dka' 'grel don gsal ba zhes bya ba/ 1153bstan brtsas kyi lus bshadapa/ ༷ 1154bshad pa'i rim pa rnam par bzhag pa/ 1155rim pa dang po/ rdo rje'i bzlas pa'i 'grel pa/ 1155rim pa gnyis pa/ bla na med pa'i dgongs pa'i 'grel pa/ 1203rim pa gsum pa/ bdag nyid byin gyis brlab pa'i 'grel pa/ 1222rim pa bzhi pa/ mngon par rdzogs par byang chub pa'i 'grel pa/ 1228rim pa lnga pa/ zung du 'jug pa'i 'grel pa/ 1234slob dpon chen po brtson 'grus bzang pos mdzad/rgya gar gyi mkhan po paṇḍi ta bīrya bha dra dang /lo tsā ba 'bro dge bsnyen chen po shes rab brtson 'grus kyis bsgyur cing zhus te satan la phab/bsdur mchan/(1241) bsdur 'bras re'u mig(12sa)0733 rim pa lnga pa'i dgongs 'grel zla ba'i 'od zer zhes bya ba/ 12go34mdor bsdus pa:re dbo/ngas pa gre'ab/ 12'dzardo rje bzlas pa'i rim pa'i dgongs 'grel/ 1257bla na med pa'i dgongs pa'i dgongs 'grel/ 1273bdag byin gyis brlab pa'i dgongs 'grel/ 1283zung du 'jug pa'i dgongs 'grel/ 1298paṇḍi ta 'jigs med 'byung gnas sbas pas mdzad/shar phyogs dza sa ta la'i paṇḍi ta bi byu ti tsand+ras bsgyur/bsdur mchan/(1305) bsdur 'bras re'u mig(1310)18

0734 sgrub thabs mdor byas kyi dka' 'grel/ 1311paṇḍi ta bi bhū ti tsand+ras mdzad/shākya'i dge slo nga rin chen grub kyis bsgyur/bsdur mchan/(1323) bsdur 'bras re'u mig(1324)0735 rim pa lnga'i don gsal bar byed pa zhes bya ba/ 1325—sdeskyab pa tshodang nges:re bshatshod pa/ 13251sdeskyab pa ba/3)bsgyu nga :re ba44pa/ nga / 13571sdeskyab pa gasdosaskyab pa:re btsanapa/ pa/ 1376rim pa bzhi pa'i bshad pa/ 13851sdecas/ nga /snga ngas:re thabasdonatshod nga / 1391slob dpon klu'i byang chub kyis mdzad/bsdur mchan/(1396) bsdur 'bras re'u mig(1401)0736 spyod pa bsdus pa'i sgron ma zhes bya ba'i rgya cher bshad pa/ 1402le'u dang po/ the tshom yongs su gcod pa/ 1402le'u gnyis pa/ lus rnam par dbeen pa bsdus pa'i the tshom gcod pa/ 1421le'u gsum pa/ ngag rnam par dbeen pa bsdus pa'i the tshom gcod pa/ 1425le'u bzhi pa/ sems rnam par dbeen pa bsdus pa'i the tshom gcod pa/ 1454le'u lnga pa/ las kyi mtha' rnam par 'byed pa'i bsdus pa'i the tshom gcod pa/1472le'u drug pa/ kun rdzob kyi bden pa bsdus pa'i the tshom gcod pa/ 1484le'u bdun pa/ don dam pa'i bden pa bsdus pa'i the tshom gcod pa/ 1go3le'u brgyad pa/ mi gnas pa'i mya ngan las 'das pa'i khams bsnyus pa'i 1— ces(ma can—5tshod thab/ 1zheg9shes rab mchos dang lda na pa 'i slo ba dngo/na shākya bshes banyen gyis mdzad/19

basbur mchan/(1507) bsdur 'bras re'u mig(1514):rdo byeje (sde /re /re /kye0737 casab pa/nga/ (1ngab nga/ thapa/ba ngabadza pa/ nga// 1515slob dpon ta thā ga ta rabi tas mdzad/rgya gar gyi mkhan po mkhas pa chen po dī paṃ ka ra rakṣi ta dang / khams pa ba ri lo tsā bas bsgyur/bsdur mchan/(1527) bsdur 'bras re'u mig(1528)0738 bsdogs paḍire —sdecas paḍire 2)ma/shar sha bye/'ab/ 1529slob dpon sgeg pa'i rdo rjes mdzad/bal po'i dge bsnyen su'o 'di ta dang /dge slong lo tsā ba blo ldan shes rab kyis bsgyur/bsdur mchan/(1579) bsdur 'bras re'u mig(1683)0739 pa/2) nga/ byas ngab stunab (1 pas6) pa//ste2) nga// 1584rgya gar gyi mkhan po pradzñā shrī gupta dang /lo tsā ba bande rin chen bzang pos bsgyur cing zhus te gtan la phab/bsdur mchan/(1590) bsdur 'bras re'u mig(1591)— jakar chag gi zur mchan/ chos tshan (༷719)'di'i dbur smigapar byed pa ni gnyis te/ smin pa ra byed pa/ dngos dang de'i grogs spyod pa'o thes 'khod kyang / don du de'i grogs spyod pa thes pa'i sa bcad 'di gro' ba'i lam gyi rjes su bstan 'dug pas/ 'di'i dkar chag tu'ang lam la lam dngos bshad pa dang de'i grogs spyo da pa bshad pa 'es sa bcad gnyis su phyes te bsgrigs pa dang / chos tshan (0728)'di'i dang po'i sbyo ra ba'i ting nge 'dzin dang dkyil 'khor rgyal ba mchog gi ting nge 'dzin gnyis kyi dbye mtshalas mi gsal bas 'dir dpe sgris pas gsar du phyes te bsgrigs yod/20

༄༅/ /sgrub pa'i thabs mdor byas pa/2༄spro/ /rgya gar skad du/ piṇḍa bi dhi sā dha rnakye/ bod skad du/sgrub pa'i thabs mdor byas pa/ 'jam dpal gzhon nur gyur pa la phyag 'tshal lo / /khams gsum spyod pa las grol mkha' dang mnyam gyur dngos po'i ngo bo nyid—/ /dag cing zhi la rnam dbeen mchog zhi rang bzhin rnal 'byor pa nyid yul/ /rtogs dka' brtag par dka' la bdag gzhan rab phan khyab cing mtshan ma med//rgyal ba'i bde ba mnyam med mnyam sku mi rtog ṭutshul gcig la phyag 'tshal/ /dpal ldan 'dus pa'i rgyud kyi ni/ /mdor ④bsdus rtogs par bya ba'i phyir/ /sems can kun la phan bskyed phyepa'i/ /mdor bsdus bdag gis bshad par bya/ /rnam rtog bag chags nyes pa yis/ /'gro ba gsum po rnam rmongs la/ /blo dang ldan pas legs bltas te/ /rnal 'byor rgyud kyis sbyang bar bya/ /'dod pa lnga ni yongs spangs nas/ /dka' thub kyis ni gdung med par/ /rnal 18—3

'byor rgyud kyi rjes 'brangs la/ /bde bas byang chub bsgrub par bya/ /des na 'di na sdom gnas yin/ /rtag tu mi phyed brtul zhugs gang / /sgu gsung thugs kyi rdo rje yi/ /sgrub pa dag kyang brtsam par bya/ / dgon pa kyechen po'i sa phyogs ni/ /me tog 'bras bu sogs kyis brgyan/ /ri bo dbeen pa dag tu ni / /dngos grub thams cad bsdus pa bsgrub/ /'jam pa'i stan la 'dug nas ni/ /sems dpa'i skyil 3krung legs gnas te/ /zhe sdang rdo rje'i ting 'dzin gnas/ /gnas bsrung ba ni bsam par bya/ /'bar ba'i 'od 'phro 'jigs par byed/ /nyi ma la gnas hūṃ las byung / /g.yon brkyang pa yi gnas pas gnas/ /khro bo bcu ni spro bar bya/ /phyogs bcu'i dkyil 'khor rtse mo ni/ /rim pa bzhin du bsam par bya/ /bgegs kun rnam par gzhig pa'i phyir/ /gnod mdzes bka' stsal phur bus gdab/ /oṃ sumbha ni sumbha hūṃ/kṛṇḍa kṛṇḍi hūṃ/ kṛttha pa ya kṛsnra pa ya hūṃ/ ā na ya ho/ bha ga bān bibyā rā sne dza hūṃ phaṭa/ khro bo'i gzugs can 'di yis ni/ /bgegs kyi dbang po nyid bkug nas/ /blo dang ldan pas spyor ba yis/ /cho ga bzhin du phur bus gdab//rdo rje bdud rtsi rgyal po che/ /utpal sngon po 'dab ma'i mdog /'bar phreng 'khrigs pa'i 'od ldan pa/ /rdo rje phur bu rnam par bsgom/ /lte ba'i phyogs nas smad kyi cha/ /rtse mo lta bur rnam par bsam/ /stod ni khro bo'i dbyebs can te/ /zhal gsum phyag drug lta bur bsgom/ /de yi gsang sngags legs brjod la/ /bgegs kyi tshogs la 'og gzigs pas/ /rdo rje phur bu des btab na/ /bgegs kyi lus ni mi g.yo 'gyur/ /oṃ gha gha ghā ta ya ghā ta ya/sarba dubye 4phaṭa phaṭa/ shī la ya shī la ya/ sarba pā paṃ phaṭa phaṭa hūṃ hūṃ hūṃ/18—4

badzra tī la ①ya/ badzra dha ro ādzñā zhupa ya ti/ sarba bispyon/ kā ya wāka tsitta/badzra ③tī la ya hūṃ hūṃ hūṃ phaṭa phaṭa/ rdo rje tho ba phyag bsnams pa'i/ /gnod mdzes rgyal po rnam par bsam/ /rdo rje me yis kun du ni/ /rnam par 'phro bas nges par bsgom/ /gdug pa tshig pa phan tshun du/ /'bros par gyur par ④rnam par bsam/ /phyogs bcur phyephur bus btab nas ni/ /steng 'og yang dag byin gyis brlab/ /dam pa'i don du dngos po rnams/ /srid gsum dngos po med par bsgom/ /dngos po med la bsgom pa'i dngos/ /bsgom par bya ba bsgom pa min/ /de ltar dngos po dngos med pas/ /bsgom pa dmigs su med pa'o/ /tshigs bcad 'di yis rgyu mi rgyu'i/ /bdag nyid can rnams stong par bsgom/ /cho ga'i sbyor ba 'di yis ni/ /ye shes sa gzhir byin gyis brlab/ /nam mkha' dbyings kyi dbus gnas par/ /hūṃ gnyis sa bon yi las byung / /rdo rje gnyis dang yang dag ldan/ /rlung gi dkyil 'khor bsgom par bya/ /hūṃ gnyis sa bon re las byung / /rdo rje gnyis dang yang dag ldan / /me yi dkyil 'khor nyid kyang ni/ /de yi steng du rnam par bsam /hūṃ gnyis sa bon baṃ las byung / /rdo rje gnyis dang yang dag ldan/ /chu yi dkyil 'khor nyid kyang ni/ /de yi steng du rnam par bsam/ /hūṃ gnyis sa bon lam̐ las byung / /rdo rje gnyis dang yang dag ldan/ /sa yi dkyil 'khor nyid dang thoni/ /de yi steng du rnam par bsam/ /dkyil 'khor bzhi po yang dag bsdu/ /rdo rje sa yi dkyil 'khor la/ /der ni zlo ④las byung ba yi/ /gzhal yas khang ni rnam par bsgom/ /zur bzhi dang ni sgo bzhi dang / /rta babs bzhi yis mdzes byas pa/ /thig bzhi dang ni yang dag ldan/ /ka ba 18—5

brgyad kyis yang dag mdzes/ /dra ba dra ba phyed pa dang / /rdo rje nor bu zla phyed brgyan/ /grwa yi mtshams ni thams cad dang / /sgo dang sgo khyud mtshams rnams su/ /rdo rje rin chen rnams kyis spras/ /hūṃbum pa ka ba rdo rje che/ /bye la phreng bar ru7rim bzhin gnas/ /ba dan dril bus zumadzes byas la/ /rnga yab sogs kyis rnam par brgyan/ /bdag nyid phyag rgyar ldan pa ni/ /zhal gsum phyag drug rnam pa can/ /ind+ra nī la'i 'od mnyam pa/ /dkyil 'khor dbus su bsgom par bya/ /rnam snang mdzad dang rin chen dang / /'od dpag med dang las kyi rgyal/ /zhal gsum phyag drug lta bur ni/ /shar la sogs pa'i phyogs su bsam/ /gti mug dga' sogs lha mo rnams/ /zhal gsum phyag drug rnam pa can/ /me yi phyogs nas brtsams nas su/ /rim pa ji bzhin nges par dgod/ /de bzhin gzugs rdo rje la sogs/ /phyi yi mtshams bee rnam pa bzhir/ /reg bya rdo rje nyid kyang ni/ /rdo rje sems dpa' dang ldan gnas / /byams pa sa yi snying po dag /shar gyi snam bur dgod par bya/ /phyag na rdo rje mkha' snying po/ /brtul zhugs can gyis ④lho ru dgod/ /'jig rten dbang phyug 'jam pa'i dbyangs/ /nub tu yang ni dgod par bya/ /sgrib pa mas cad rnam sel dang / /kun du bzang po byang phyogs su/ /gshin rje gshed ni shar gyi sgor/ /gzhan gyis mi thub lho phyogs su/ /nub phyogs su ni rta mgrin te/ /bdud rtsi 'khyel pa byang du'o/ /mi g.yo 'dod pa'i rgyal po dang / /dbyug sngon dang ni stobs po che/ /shar lho mtshams sogs nas brtsams te/ /rim pa ji bzhin bsgom par bya/ /gnod mdzes rgyal po khro bo che//de yi 'og tu rnam par bsam/ /gtsug tor 'khor los sresgyur rgyal yang / /de 18—6

bzhin steng du rnam par bsgom/ /cho ga ji bzhin dkyil 'khor pa/ /de ltar lhag par mos bsams nyunas/ /slar yang kha sbyar sbyor ba yis/ /rang gi lus la de rnams gzhug /lus kyi 'khor lo rdzogs sangs rgyas/ /rim pa ji bzhin yang dag bsam/ /don dam pa yi rdo rje yis/ /de bzhin nyid la gzhug bya bas—/ /de bzhin gshegs pa'i tshogs bsad na/ /dngos grub rab mchog thob par 'gyur/ /'di don rdo rje phreng ba las/ /gsal bar ji bzhin rnam phye ste/ /gzugs phung rtog 1dang me long dang / /sa khams mig gi dbang po dang / /gzugs dang rnam lngar gyur pa ste/ /khro bo gnyis dang yang dag ldan/ /tshor ba'i phung po mnyam nyid dang / /chu khams rna ba'i dbang po dang / /sgra dang rnam lngar gyur pa ste/ /khro bo gnyis dang yang dag ldan/ /'du shes so sor rtog pa dang / /byin za sna yi dbang po dang / /dri dang rnam lngar gyur pa ste—/ /khro bo gnyis dang yang dag ldan/ /'du byed bya ba grub pa dang / /rlung khams lce yi dbang po dang / /ro dang rnam lngar gyur pa ste/ /khro bo gnyis dang yang dag ldan/ /steng 'og khro bo shin tu bcas/ /rang bzhin gyis ni snang ba nyid/ /rnam shes phung por zhugs pa ste/ /rnam shes kyang ni 'od gsal ba'o/ /mya ngan 'das bcas kun stong dang / /chos kyi skur yang bshad pa yin/ /brtan par bya ba'i don du ni/ /gsang sngags 'di ni brjod par bya//oṃ shu n+ya tā dzñā na badzra swa bhā wa ātpa kolhahaṃ/ 'di ni don dam dkyil 'khor te/ /snang ba med cing mtshan nyid med/ /don dam bden pa zhes bya ba/ /de bzhin gshegs pa kun gyi gnas/ /'od gsal bar ni rab zhugs nas/ /ldang ba yang ni bstan par bya/ /sngags kyi sku yi thrur ba yis/ /lha yi gzugs 18—7

la dmigs par 'gyur/ /nam mkha'i sne dbyings kyi dbus gnas par/ /nyi ma'i dkyil 'khor bsgom par bya/ /sngags pas de yi steng du yang / /zla ba'i dkyil 'khor rnam par bsam/ /der ni padma 'dab ma brgyad/ /kha dog dmar po bsgom par bya/ /padma'i steng du sngags chen po/ /yi ge gsum ni de nas bsam/ /sngags dang padma nyi ma dag /zla ba'i dkyil 'khor la zhugs pas—/ /zla ba'i dkyil 'khor kun rdzogs 'gyur sno/ /byang chub sems su rnam par brtag /rgyu dang mi rgyu thams cad kyang / /de nyid du ni rnam bsam zhing / /brtan par bya ba'i don du ni/ /gsang sngags 'di ni brjod par bya/ /oṃ dharma dhā tu swa bhā wa a byeko3haṃ/ de ltar spyor ba dmigs nas su/ /rjes su spyor ba brtsam par bya/ /rnal 'byor pa yis ④yig gsum yang / /zla ba'i dbus su rnam par bsam/ /de nas yig gsum las byung ba/ /kun da zla ba dkar dang mtshungs/ /dang po mgon po bsams nas kyang / /shin tu sbyor ba yang dag brtsam/ /mi bskyod pa phyani rjes zhugs pas/ /zhal gsum phyag drug 'bar ba dang / /ind+ra 'ubyā la'i 'od mnyam pa'i/ /rdo rje sems dpa' rnam par bsgom/ /rdo rje 'khor lo padma ni/ /g.yas pa'i phyag tu rnam par bsam /dril bu rin chen ral gri ni/ /g.yon pa'i phyag tu bsam par bya/ /de nas phung po la sogs pa'i/ /dbye ba shes pas snang mdzad sogs/ /gnod mdzes bar du sa bon gyis/ /dgod pas yang dag nyid du dgod/ /rnam snang mdzad kyi tsus bon ni/ /kha dog dkar po yi ge oṃ/ /gzugs phung ngo bo nyid kyis ni//sngags shes pas ni spyi bor dgod/ /sdzatsani mgon po 'od dpag med/ /'du shes phung po'i ngo bo nyid/ /mdog dmar kha la bsams nas ni/ /ngag gi 18—8

dbang phyug nyid thob 'gyur/ /mi bskyod ①pa yi yi ge hūṃ/ /rab tu bzang po'i mthing shun phyemadog /rnam shes phung po'i ngo bo nyid/ /sngags pas snying gar rnam par dgod/ /rin chen mgon po'i yi ge swā/ /tshor ba'i phung po'i ngo bo nyid—/ /tshor ba dag gi rgyu can ni/ /kha dog ser po lte bar dgod/ /rkang pa gnyis la yi ge hā/ /'du byed phung po'i ngo bo nyid/ /las kyi mgon po de nyid ni/ /sngags pas kha dog ljang gur dgod/ /gti mug dga' sogs sngags kyis ni/ /sa la sogs la rab tu gzhug /sra dang gsher dang dro ba dang / /rlung sogs der ni rim pa bzhin/ /shlau mig tu bkod nas ni/ /sa yi snying po rnam par bsgom/ /oṃ ni rna ba dag la dgod/ /phyag na rdo rje bsgom par bya/ /oṃ ni sna la rab bkod de/ /nam mkha'i snying po rab tu bsgom/ /u pya ni lce la bkod nas ni/ /'jig rten dbang po brtag par bya/ /yid la hūṃ ni bsams ④nas su/ /'jam pa'i dbyangs ni rab tu bsgom/ /yi ge oṃ ni lus kun la/ /bsgoms nas sgrib sel dran par bya/ /yi ge mi ⑤ni rtsar bzhag ste—/ /byams pa nyid du yongs su brtag /tshigs hūṃ kun la ni saṃ bkod de/ /kun du bzang po bsam par bya/ /lag pa g.yas par gshin rje gshed/ /g.yon par gzhan gyis mi thub pa/ /rta mgrin kha la bsam par bya/ /rdo rje la ni bdud rtsi 'khyil/ /dpung pa g.yas par mi g.yo mgon/ /g.yon par 'dod pa'i rgyal po'o/ /pus mo g.yas par bsam pa ni/ /dbyug pa sngon po cher 'bar ba/ /pus mo g.yon par stobs po che/ /spyi bor gtsug tor 'khor los ljusgyur/ /gnod mdzes rgyal po bsam pa ni/ /rkang pa gnyis la dgod par bya/ /dgod byas de nas sngags pa yis/ /phung po la sogs cho ga bzhin/ /18—9

sku yi dkyil 'khor rdzogs gyur nas/ /spyor ba chen po yang dag brtsam/ /zla ba'i dkyil 'khor yang dag rdzogs/ /spyi bo'i dbus su rnam par bsam/ /der kyeni yi ge oṃ dkar po/ /'od zer lnga ni rab 'phro ba'o/ /de las lha mo dbyung ba ni/ /bdag po dang ni rab sbyor ba'i3/ /srun ni du ma bsams bhu nas ni/ /nam mkha' thams cad rab tu dgang / /de nas sku yi rdo rje ni/ /nam mkha' gang bar legs gnas pa/ /de dbus bdag po bsgom pa ni/ /sum cu rtsa gnyis mtshan 'chang ngazhing / /dpe byad bzang po brgyad cus brgyan/ /bdag kyang de yi mdun gnas la/ /de nas sngags pas tshigs bcad 'di/ /gnyis brjod nas ni gsol ba gdab/ /dpal ldan sangs rgyas sku 'chang ba/ /rdo rje mi phyed gsum bsgoms 3pas/ /deng bdag byin gyis brlabs nas su/ /rdo rje sku ni mdzad du gsol/ /phyogs bcur bzhugs pa'i sangs rgyas rnams/ /rdo rje mi phyed gsum bsgoms pas/ /deng bdag byin gyis brlabs nas su/ /rdo rje sgu kyeni mdzad du gsol/ /spyan dang lhan cig ldan pa yi/ /rnam par snang mdzad bsams nas su/ /de bcug nas ni byen brlabs te/ /sku yi byin kyis brlab pa brtsam/ /sangs rgyas kun gyi 3sku gang yin/ /phung po lnga yis rab gang ba/ /sangs rgyas sku yi ngo bo yis/ /bdag kyang de dang 'dra bar shog /oṃ sarba ta thā ga ta kā ya badzra swa ghā wa ātma kophohaṃ/ āḥ sdeni kha dog dmar ldan pasatsu/ /lce yi padmar rnam bsams te/ /gos dkar zhes bya nam mkha' ru / /spros nas nam mkha'i khams rnams dgang / /gsung gi rdo rje'i kyesngags pa ni/ /nam mkha'i dbus na bzhugs pa la/ /de nas sngags pas tshigs bcad 'di/ /gnyis brjod nas ni gsol ba gdab/ /chos kyi gsung lam 18—10

dpal dang ldan/ /rdo rje mi phyed gsum bsgoms 1pas/ /deng bdag byin gyis brlabs nas su/ /rdo rje gsung du mdzad du gsol/ /phyogs bcur bzhugs pa'i sangs rgyas rnams/ /rdo rje mi phyed gsum bsgoms pas/ /deng bdag byin gyis brlabs nas su/ /rdo rje gsung du mdzad du gsol/ /gos dkar mo dang lhan cig nyid/ /rang gi gtso bor yang dag ldan/ /lce la zhugs par rab bsams te/ /gsung gi rngo byin gyis brlab pa brtsam/ /rdo rje chos kyi gsung gang yin/ /nges pa'i tshig ni phun sum tshogs/ /bdag gi tshig kyang de 'dra zhing / /chos 'dzin pa dang 'dra bar shog /oṃ sarba ta thā ga ta wā ka badzra swa bhā wa a ④kolhahaṃ/ sngags pas snying gar nyi ma yi/ /gzugs brnyan 'bar ba bsam bya ste/ /der ni mthing shun ngalta bu yi/ /'od zer lngar ldan hūṃ dgod do/ /de las lha mo mā ma shī/ /tshogs dang bcas pa dbyung bar bya—/ /de bzhin thugs kyi rdo rje bsgom/ /de la sngon bzhin gsol ba gdab/ /dpal ldan rdo rje thugs 'chang ba/ /rdo rje mi phyed gsum bsgoms snipas/ /deng bdag byin gyis brlabs nas su/ /rdo rje thugs su mdzad du gsol/ /phyogs bcur bzhugs pa'i sangs rgyas rnams/ /rdo rje mi phyed gsum bsgoms pas—/ /deng bdag byin gyis brlabs nas su/ /rdo rje thugs su mdzad du gsol—/ / mā ma ④ tī tshogs ma lus pa/ /rdo rje thugs dang yang dag ldan/ /snying gar yang ni bcug nas su/ /thugs kyi byin gyis brlab gepa brtsam /kun tu bzang po'i thugs gang yin/ /gsang ba'i bdag po blo ldan pa/ /bdag kyang de dang 'dra gyur cig /rdo rje 'dzin dang mtshungs par shog /oṃ sarba ta thā ga ta dziX badzra swa bhā wa a kophohaṃ/ de ltar rigs gsum dbye ba yis//18—11

so sor byin gyis brlabs nas ni/ /blo dang ldan pas gsang sngags 'dis/ /slar yang thams cad bdag nyid bya/ /oṃ sarba ta thā ga ta kā ya wāka tsitta badzra swa bhā wa ātpa kolhahaṃ/ de ltar bdag nyid byin gyis brlabs/ /zla ba'i dkyil 'khor dbus gnas pa'i/ /mtshan ma drug dang yang dag ldan/ /dam tshig sems dpa' bsgom par bya/ /snying ga'i dbus su phra mo yi/ /ye shes sems dpa' rnam par bsgom/ /ting 'dzin sems dpa' zhes bya ba'i/ /yi ge hūṃ ni de ru dgod/ /sems dpa' gsum gyi nyubadag nyid can/ /de ltar sbyor ba cher bskyed nas/ /cho ga'i sbyor ba 'di yis ni/ /sgrub pa chen po brtsam par bya / /gzugs bzang gzhon pas brgyan pa ni/ /sme sha can ni bdag nyid che//bu mo utpal mthing ga'i mdog /mig yangs dam pa rnyed nas ni/ /mnyam par bzhag cing legs par bslab/ /sgrub pa po la shin tu mos/ /oṃ ni spyi bor bsam par bya/ /sdzani ngag gi lam la dgod/ /hūṃ ni snying gar bsam bya zhing / /lte bar swā dang rkang gnyis hā/ /spyan dang mā ma tī dang ni/ /de bzhin du ni gos dkar mo/ /sgrol ma yang rnguni sngags pa yis/ /sa la sogs la rnam par dgod/ /lha mo rdo rje gzugs la sogs/ /de nyid la ni rnam bsams la/ /sa snying la sogs de rnams dang / /snyoms par 'jug pa bsgom par bya/ /lag g.yas rdo rje ro langs ma/ /g.yon la gzhan gyis mi thub ma/ /de yi khar ni khro gnyer ma/ /gsang bar ral pa gcig ma'o/ /gzhan yang dpung pa g.yas par ni/ /de bzhin gshegs yum rdo rje ma/ /g.yon du sna tshogs rin chen gyi/ /phyag rgya dag ni bsgom par bya/ /pus mo g.yas la gnas par yang / /sna tshogs padma de bzhin gshegs/ /g.yon pa la zuni sna 18—12

tshogs las/ /spyi bor nam mkha'i rdo rje ma/ /rkang pa gnyis la sa yi ni/ /sa 'dzin lha mo gzhag tūpar bya/ /de ltar 'dus byas rnal 'byor pas/ /rdo rje padma yang dag brtsam/ /hūṃ gi sngags skyes rdo rje ni/ /rtse mo mnga' 3ba bsam par bya/ /de tshe de yi rtse dbus su/ /oṃ ni rnam par bsam par bya de bzhin a las byung ba yi/ /padma 'dab ma brgyad pa ni/ /'od zer lnga yis khyab bsams rngul/ /de 'og ④sgrub pa brtsam par bya/ /oṃ sarba ta thā ga tā nu rā ga ṇa badzra swa bhā wa ā phyeko3haṃ/ rdo rje 'dzin pa'i nga rgyal legs 'chang ste/ /hūṃ gi glu yis kyang ni bskyod bya zhing / /rang gi byang chub sems nyid phyung ba'i tshe//des ni phaṭa kyi dugasang sngags brjod par bya/ /phyung nas slar yang sngags pas ni—/ /phyogs bcur bzhugs pa'i sangs rgyas rnams/ /byang chub sems kyis mchod nas ni/ /gsang sngags 'di ni brjod par bya/ /oṃ sarba ta thā ga ta pū dza badzra swa bhā wa ā kophohaṃ/ rang sngags yi ge las dbyung ba/ /rdo rje gsum gyis byen brlabs bdag /padma'i dbus su bskyed nas ni/ /slar yang zhe sdang rdo rjer gyur/ /badzra j-ika sngags kyis dbyung ba/ /mi bskyod rdo rje ④bsam pa yang / /mgon po ral pa thor tshugs can/ /mi bskyod pas ni dbu rgyan zubyas—/ /mthing shun tūbazang po'i mdog ltar snang / /sngo nag dkar dang dmar ba'i zhal/ /rgyan rnams thams cad yongs su rdzogs/ /phyag drug par ni rnam par bsgom/ /rdo rje 'khor lo padma ni/ /g.yas pa'i phyag tu bsam bya zhing / /dril bu rin chen ral gri ni/ /de yi g.yon la bsam par bya/ /'di ni thugs ka las byung nas/ /phyogs bcu rnams su gzigs nas ni/ /chos kyi 'khor lo bskor ba dang / /sangs rgyas mdzad pa kun mdzad de/ /sems can 18—13

ma lus kun sbyangs nas/ /zhe sdang rdo rje gnas la 'jog /slar byon rdo rje mgon po yi༄1/ /spyan snga ru ni 'dug par 'gyur3/ /sngags pas de yi snying ga ru—/ /rjes zhugs bdag nyid rnam bsgoms bye pas/ /snga ma'i gzugs ni yongs gyur nas/ /zhe sdang rdo rje gnas su zhugs/ /ind+ra nī la'i 'od 'bar ba//nyi ma'i dkyil 'khor dbus su gebazhugs/ /dpa' bo rang gi phyag rgyas 'khyud/ /rgyan rnams kun gyis rnam par brgyan/ /drag po zhi dang 'dod chags che/ /zhal gsum gyis ni rnam par mdzes/ /zhe sdang rdo rje ting 'dzin gnas/ /dkyil 'khor thams cad spro bar mdzad/ /dzi na dzika sngags kyis dbyung ba/ /gtso bo rnam par snang mdzad dbyung / /mi bskyod pas ni dbu rgyan byas/ /ston ka'i zla zer ltar snang zhing / /thor tshugs cod pan dag gis brgyan/ /dkar dang nag phyedang dmar ba'i zhal/ /phyag drug zhi ba'i gzugs can te/ /'khor lo rdo rje padma dag /g.yas pa la ni rnam par bsam/ /dril bu rin chen ral gri ni/ /'di yi g.yon du rnam par bsgomabhu/ /de bzhin thugs ka las byung ste/ /gti mug spyod nas sems can rnams/ /yang dag sbyangs te slar byon nas/ /shar phyogs kyi ni zla bar bzhugs/ /ratna dhrika sngags kyis dbyung ba/ /rin chen tog ni sngags pas dbyung / /zhi ba'i thor tshugs cod pan 'chang / /mi bskyod pas ni dbu rgyan byas/ / ④ser dang gnag dang dkar ba'i zhal/ /phyag drug par ni rnam par bsgom/ /yid bzhin nor bu rdo rje dang / /'khor lo de yi g.yas su bsgom/ /dril bu padma ser po dang / /ral gri g.yon du bsgom par bya/ /de bzhin thugs ka nas byung ste/ /nga rgyal gnas la gnas pa rnams/ /yang dag sbyangs nas lho yi char/ /rin chen 18—14

dbus su bzhugs par gsungs/ / ā ro '-ika kyesngags kyis dbyung ba/ /mtha' yas rdo rje can dbyung ste/ /zhi ba padma rā ga'i 'odalce/ /mi bskyod pas ni dbu rgyan neebyas/ /mgon po ral pa ④thor tshugs can/ /dmar dang gnag dang dkar ba'i zhal/ /sgeg pa'i nyams dang yang dag ldan/ /phyag drug par ni rnam par bsgom/ /g.yon pa'i phyag gis ⑤dril bu dang / /padma sdong bu 'dzin par mdzad/ /padma thugs ka'i phyogs gnas pa/ /g.yas pa yis ni 'byed par mdzad/ /rdo rje 'khor lo g.yas gnyis du la/ /rin chen ral gri g.yon gnyis la/ /sngon bzhin 'dod chags can sbyangs nas/ /rgyab kyi padma la bzhugs 'gyur/ /pradzñā byeka sngags kyis dbyung ba④/ /sngags pas don yod rdo rje can/ /mgon po sku mdog ljang gur phyadabyung / /mi bskyod pas ni dbu rgyan byas/ /thor tshugs cod pan dag gis brgyan/ /ljang dang gnag dang dkar ba'i zhal/ /phyag drug 'od zer rnam par 'phro/ /ral gri sna tshogs rdo rje dang / /'khor lo g.yas su bsgom du/par bya/ /phyag g.yon na ni dril bu dang / /de bzhin pad ljang nor bu'o/ /log pa'i ngang can sems can rnams/ /rnam par sbyangs nas slar byon te/ /de bzhin byang gi phyogs su ni/ /sna tshogs rdo rje dag la bzhugs/ /zhe sdang gti mug de bzhin chags/ /yid bzhin nor bu dam tshig ste/ /rigs ni lnga po 'di dag nyid/ /'dod dang thar par rab sgrub du pa'o/ /mo ha ra ti sngags kyis dbyung / /lha mo spyan skyeni dbyung bar bya/ /dkar zhing zhi ba'i nyams dang ldan/ /rnam snang mdzad kyis spyi bor mtshan/ /dkar dang gnag dang dmar ba'i zhal/ /phyag drug par ni rnam par bsgom/ /'khor lo rdo rje de bzhin du/ /a la dkar po g.yas su 18—15

bsam—/ /dril bu de bzhin rin chen dang / /ral gri g.yon du bsgom par bya /de bzhin thugs ka nas byung ste/ /phyogs bcu dag tu gzigs nas ni/ /gdon dang nad gdungs 'jigs pa rnams/ /thugs rje chen pos zhi mdzad de/ /slar byon nas ni zla dkyil du/ /shar gyi mtshams su bzhugs par gyur①/ /dī ṣa ra ti'i tsasngags kyis dbyung / /lha mo mā ma tī dbyung ste/ /utpal sngon po'i 'dab ltar sngo/ /bzhin bzangs byeshin tu yid du 'ong / /gnag dang dkar dang dmar ba ste/ /mi bskyod pas ni dbu rgyan byas/ /'khor lo rdo rje de bzhin du/ /utpal sngo dmar g.yas pa la/ /dril bu rin chen ral gri ni/ /g.yon gyi phyag na bsnams par mdzad/ /bgegs chen 'jigs pas gzir ba rnams / /thugs rje chen pos srung ④bar mdzad/ /byung nas slar ni byon nas su / /lho nub tu ni bzhugs par gyur/ /rā ga ra ti'i ④sngags kyis dbyung / /gos dkar mo ni dbyung bya ste/ /zhal ni dmar dang gnag dang dkar/ /padma rā ga'i 'od dang ldan/ /'od dpag med bcas ral pa'i tshogs/ /phyag drug pa ni rnam bsgoms te/ /g.yon pa dril bur bcas pa yis/ /utpal sdong bu 'dzin mdzad la/ /thugs kar gnas pa'i utpa la/ /dmar po g.yas kyis 'byed par mdzad/ /rdo rje 'khor lo g.yas dag la/ /nor bu rin chen ral gri g.yon/ /bsnams par mdzad pa phyung nas ni/ /gdon kyis nyen pa zhi mdzad de/ /slar byon padma'i dbus nyid du/ /nub byang mtshams su bzhugs par 'gyur/ /badzra ra ti'i sngags kyis dbyung / /yid 'ong sgrol ma dbyung bya ste//ljang dang gnag dang dkar ba'i zhal/ /drur bye ba'i lo ma'i mdangs dang ldan/ /don yod pas ni gtsug tor byas/ /phyag drug par ni rnam par bsgom/ /sna 18—16

tshogs rdo rje 'khor lo dang / /utpal dkar po g.yas pa na/ /dril bu rin chen ral gri ni/ /brtul zhugs can gyis g.yon du bsam/ /sems can thams cad dbang mdzad de/ /sna tshogs rdo rje'i gdan la yang / /byung nas slar ni byon nas su/ /byang shar mtshams su bzhugs par 'gyur/ /rnal 'byor pas ni rim gnyis par/ /gzugs rdo rje la sogs pa dbyung tsho/ /me yi mtshams su dgod bya ba/ /rdo rje gzugs ni yid 'ong ba/ /zhal gsum phyag drug dkar ba ste/ /dbu rgyan rnam par snang mdzad dpal/ /gnyis kyis me long 'dzin mdzad de/ /lhag ma gti mug dag phyadang mtshungs/ /bden bral phyogs dgod lha mo ni/ /rdo rje sgra ste bhuphyag drug ma④/ /zhal gsum sku mdog ser mo ste/ /dbu rgyan rin chen 'byung ldan yin/ /phyag gnyis kyis ni pi wang bsnams/ /lhag ma mā ma tī dang mtshungs/ /rlung gi phyogs dgod lha mo ni//rdo rje dri ste phyag drug ma④/ /zhal gsum sku mdog dmar mo ste/ /snang mtha' yas kyi thor tshugs can/ /phyag gnyis kyis ni dung bsnams te/ /lhag ma gos dkar can dang mtshungs/ /dbang ldan phyogs dgod lha mo ni/ /rdo rje ro ste phyag drug makye/ /zhal gsum sku mdog ljang gu ste/ /dbu rgyan la ni rnga sgra bzhugs—/ /phyag gnyis la ni ro yi snod/ /lhag ma sgrol ma lta bu yin/ /rdo rje sems dpa' legs 'khyud de/ /'khor lo'i tsudabus na rab bzhugs par/ /rdo rje reg bya bsam bya ste/ /zhal sogs bdag po lta bu'o/ /rim pa gsum pa shar gyi ni/ /snam bur brtul zhugs can gyis dbyung / / mo zlo 3sa bon las byung ba/ /byams pa sa yi snying po gnyis/ /oṃ gyi sa bon las byung ba/ /phyag na rdo rje mkha' snying po/ /lho yi phyogs kyi snam bu la/ /go rims ⑨bzhin du 18—17

dgod par bya/ /oṃ dang hūṃ las yang dag byung / /'jig rten dbang po nyu'ajam pa'i dbyangs/ /'di dag nub tu dbyung bar bya/ /byang gi phyogs su dbyung ba ni/ /oṃ dang saṃ ki sa bon skyes/ /sgrib sel kun du dbang zhupor bcas / /'di dag dbu rgyan rang gi mgon/ /sku mdog sogs pa de dang mtshungs / /phyag dang mtshon cha dag kyang ni/ /rang rang gi ni bdag por mtshungs / /byams pa 'ba' zhig g.yas pa na/ /klu shing me tog bsnams par mdzad/ /'di dag skye mched rnam sbyangs shing rngu / /lha yi mig sogs sprul ba po/ /sems can skye mched sbyangs nas su/ /slar byon nas ni stan la bzhugs / /ya mānta kṛta ④sngags kyis ni/ /sngags pas gshin rje gshed dbyung ba/ /rnam par snang mdzad dbu rgyan can/ /zhal ni gnag dang dkar dang dmar/ /'bar ba'i tshogs kyis rnam par 'khrigs/ /dbyug pa rdo rje 'khor lo rnams/ /phyag g.yas na ni bsnams snupar mdzad/ /thugs kar sdigs thumadzub zhags pa dang / /dril bu dgra sta g.yon pa na/ / g.yon brkyang pa yi gnas pa yis/ /3dbang po la sogs tshogs bcas dang / /mi bzad bgegs kyang skrag par mdzad/ /padma nyi ma mnan nas ni/ /shar gyi phyogs su bzhugs par gyur/ / pradzñānta kṛta sngags kyis ⑧/ni/ /rin chen 'byung ldan dbu rgyan can/ /sku mdog dkar zhing nor bus brgyan/ /gzhan kyis mi thub sngags kyis dbyung / /gsus khyem che zhing spyan gsum pa/ /dkar dang gnag dang dmar ba'i zhal/ /mche ba gcigs shing rnam par 'gyur/ /'bar ba'i tshogs kyis rnam par 'khrigs/ /rdo rje dbyug pa ral gri ni/ /g.yas kyi phyag na bsnams par mdzad/ /snying gar sdigs spumadzub zhags pa dang / /18—18

dril bu dgra sta g.yon pa na/ /g.yon brkyang pa yi nyu gnas pa yisadu mi bzad bgegs ni skrag par mdzad/ /padma nyi ma mnan nas ni/ /lho yi phyogs su bzhugs par gyur/ /padmānta kṛta zhusngags kyis ni/ /brtul zhugs can gyis thurta mgrin dbyung / /spyan gsum padma rā ga'i mdog /zhal ni dmar dang gnag dang dkar/ /zhal gdangs gsus khyem che ba dang / /'od dpag med pa'i cod pan can/ /dpa' bo g.yon brkyang pa yis gnas/ /'bar ba'i tshogs ni rnam par 'khrugs/ /padma ral gri gtun shing ni/ /g.yas kyi phyag na bsnams par mdzad/ /bsnyems dang bcas pas dril bu dang / /dgra sta zhags pa g.yon na bsnams/ /padma nyi ma la gnas te/ /phyogs bcu dag tu gzigs nas ni/ /klu rnams skrag par mdzad nas su/ /nub kyi phyogs su bzhugs par 'gyur/ /bispyonta kṛta sresngags kyis ni/ /rnga sgra'i cod pan yang dag ldan/ /atpal sngon po'i 'dab ltar ljang sne/ /bdud rtsi 'khyel pa dbyung bar bya/ /zhal ni sngo dang dmar dang dkar/ /zhal gdangs pa ni rnam par 'gyur—/ gsus khyim che zhing spyan gsum pa/ /'bar ba'i 'od kyis rnam par brgyan / /sna tshogs rdo rje 'khor lo dang / /gtun shing rnams ni g.yas pa na/ /sdigs mdzub zhags par bcas pa dang / /dril bu dgra sta g.yon na bsnams/ /g.yon brkyang pa yi ④gnas pa yis/ /padma nyi ma mnan nas ni/ /byang gi phyogs su bzhugs par gyur/ /rang gi sngags kyis bskyed pa yis/ /mi g.yo ba yang dbyung bar bya/ /spyan gsum ind+ra nī la'i mdog /dbu rgyan rnam par snang mdzad dpal/ /mche ba rnam par gcigs pa'i zhal/ /zhal ni gnag dang dmar dang dkar/ /mi bzad kyeha ha zhes bzhad sgra/ /gsus khyim che 18—19

zhing stobs po che/ /ral gri rdo rje 'khor lo rnams/ /g.yas pa'i phyag na bsnams par mdzad/ /sdigs mdzub dang ni dgra sta dang / /zhags pa g.yon pa'i phyag na bsnams/ /rims sogs 'jigs pa'i gdon 'joms te/ /g.yon brkyang pa yi tuganas pa yis/ /padma nyi ma la gnas nas/ /shar lho mtshams su bzhugs par gyur/ /rang gi sngags kyis bskyed pa yi du/ /brtul zhugs can gyis 'dod rgyal dbyung / /drag po ind+ra byā la'i mdog /rin chen 'byung ldan dbu rgyan can/ /zhal ni gnag dang dmar dang dkar/ /spyan gsum mche ba 'jigs su rung / /phyag gnyis rdo rje hūṃ mdzad kyizhu/ /phyag rgya dag ni 'ching bar mdzad/ /rdo rje ral gri g.yas dag na/ /g.yon na zhags pa lcags kyu'o/ /bden bral bgegs ni 'joms pa'o/ /g.yon brkyang gnas pas nyi mar bzhugs/ /rang gi sngags kyis bskyed pa yi④/ /brtul zhugs can gyis dbyug sngon bskyed/ /spyan gsum sprin sngon lta bu ste/ /'od dpag med pa'i dbu rgyan can/ /zhal ni sngo dang dkar dang dmar/ /gsus khyim che zhing 'jigs par mdzad/ /dbyug pa ral gri 'khor lo ni/ /g.yas kyi phyag na bsnams par mdzad/ /snying gar sdigs mdzub zhags pa dang / /dgra sta rnams ni g.yon na bsnams/ /yams kyi 'jigs pa bsal nas ni/ /gtum po g.yon brkyang gnas pa yis/ /padma nyi ma la gnas te/ /nub byang mtshams su bzhugs par gyurabra/ /rang gi sngags kyis bskyed pa yi bye / /rnga sgra yis ④ni dbu rgyan can/ /stobs po che ni sngags pas dbyung / /atpal sngon po'i mdog 'dra ba/ /zhal ni gnag dang dmar dang dkar/ /spyan gsum 'jigs pa'i sgra 3dang ldan/ /yan lag thams cad sbrul gyis brgyan/ /gsus khyim che zhing 18—20

'jigs par byed/ /dbyug pa ral gri 'khor lo ni/ /g.yas kyi phyag na bsnams par mdzad/ /snying gar sdigs mdzub zhags pa dang / /dgra sta rnams ni ①g.yon na bsnams/ /g.yon brkyang pa yi gnas pa yis/ /mkha' 'gro la sogs 'jigs pa 'joms/ /padma nyi ma la gnas te/ /byang shar mtshams su bzhugs par gyur/ /rang gi sngags kyis bskyed pa yi/ /gtsug tor 'khor los sgyur snyeb dbyung / /mkha' ltar sngo bsangs 'jigs pa po/ /mi bskyod pas ni dbu rgyan byas/ /zhal ni sngo dang dmar dang dkar/ /gtso bo spyan gsum gsus pa 'phyang / /g.yas g.yon gnyis kyi phyag gnyis kyis/ /spyi bor gtsug tor 'dzin par mdzad/ /rdo rje padma g.yas dag na/ /sdogs mdzub ral gri g.yon na bsnams/ /'tshe ba thams cad rnam 'jigs can / /gtum po g.yon brkyang gnas pa yis/ /padma nyi ma la gnas te/ /tshangs pa'i gnas su de bzhugs pa'o/ /rang gi sngags kyis bskyed pa yi/ /brtul zhugs can gyis gnod mdzes dbyung / /spyan gsum nam mkha' lta bu'i mdog /zhal ni gnag dang dmar dang dkar/ /gsus khyim che zhing 'jigs pa'i zhal/ /mi bskyod pas ni dbu rgyan byas/ /rdo rje 'khor lo rin chen ni/ /g.yas pa'i phyag na 'dzin par mdzad/ /snying gar sdigs mdzub zhags pa dang / /padma ral gri g.yon na bsnams/ /rgyu ba dang ni gnas pa'i dug /ka la ku ta sogs kun dang / /bgegs kyi bdag po kun bcom ste/ /thams cad zhi bar mdzad nas ni/ /ma lus bka' ④ni rdzogs byas la/ /g.yon brkyang pa yi gnas pa yis/ /padma nyi ma la gnas te/ /sa yi 'og tu de bzhugs so/ /lha ni sum cu gnyis rang bzhin/ /dkyil 'khor thams cad bskyed nas ni/ /18—21

'khor lo'i dbus su gnas gyur na/ /de nas phra mo'i rnal 'byor brtsam/ /sna yi rtse mor yungs kar bsam/ /'gro dang mi 'gro yungs kar la/ /gsang ba'i sngags kyis brtags pa yi/ /ye shes mchog gi gnas bsgom mo/ /rin chen kha dog sna lnga la/ /yungs kar gyi ni 'bru tshod tsam/ /sna yi rtse mor nan tan du/ /rnal 'byor rig pas rtag tu bsgom/ /rin chen brtan par gyur nas spro/ /brtan par ma gyur de mi spro/ /sangs rgyas 'bar ba'i 'od mnyam pa/ /rab mchog sprin ni spro bar bya/ /slong mo za zhing mi bzlas te/ /ma bslangs pa la'ang tu/chags mi bya/ /'dod pa kun las longs spyod cing / /sngags kyi du yan lag ma nyams bzlas / /brjod nas rdo rje spro ba ni/ /rdzogs nas rab tu bsdu bar bya/ /'di ni sangs rgyas thams cad kyi/ /don dam pa yi bzlas par bshad/ /phra mo'i rnal 'byor bzlas pa yang / /ci 'dod par ni rnam gnyis bya/ /slar yang sngags pas bdag nyid ni/ /de bzhin nyid la gzhug par bya/ /de nas dkyil 'khor gnas pa 'di/ /lha mos bdag po ma mthong bas / /tshigs su bcad pa 'di bzhi yis/ /bde ba chen po skul ④bar byed/ /sems can khams na gnas kyi dbang phyug khyod ni rdo rje'i thugs/ /dga' ba yid 'ong don chen 'dod pas bdag la bskyab tu gsol/ /mgon po gal te de ring bdag ni gson par mchis bzhed na/ /sems can yab chen gnyen mchog bdag la dgyes thu/par mdzad du gsol/ /rdo rje sku khyod bka' yi 'khor lo sems can kun la phan/ /sangs rgyas don du byang chub mchog bsgrub rab tu phan par gzigs/ /mgon po gal te de ring bdag ni gson par mchis bzhed na/ /'dod chags dam tshig chags pas bdag la dgyes par mdzad du 18—22

gsol—/ /khyod ni rdo rje gsung ste kun la phan zhing thugs brtse ba /'jig rten dag gi dgos nyupa'i don mdzad pa la rtag tu brtson/ /mgon po gal te de ring bdag ni gson par mchis bzhed na/ /spyod pa dri med kun du bzang pos bdag la dgyes par mdzod/ /khyod ni rdo rje'i thugs te dam tshig mchog gi phan don che/ /yang dag rdzogs sangs rgyas kyi gdung mchog mnyam pa nyid gzigs pa//mgon po gal te de ring bdag ni gson par mchis bzhed na/ /yon tan rin chen mang po'i gter gyur bdag la dgyes par mdzod/ /de ltar yang dag yon tan ni/ /brjod pas mgon po de bskul nas/ /mi bskyod la sogs ngo bo yis//de bzhin gshegs pa bstod par mdzad/ /mi bskyod pa ni rdo rje che/ /rdo rje dbyings ni mkha' chen po/ /rdo rje gsum mchog dkyil 'khor gsum/ /gsang ba'i dbyangs la phyag 'tshal lo/ /rnam par snang mdzad rab tu dag /rdo rje zhi ba dga' ba che/ /rang bzhin gyis ni 'od gsal mchog /ston pa rdo rje phyag 'tshal lo/ /rin chen rgyal po rab tu zab/ /rdo rje nam mkha' dri ma med / /dngos nyid dag pa gos med pa/ /gsang ba'i gsung la phyag 'tshal lo—/ /rdo rje mi 'chi tsa'adod chags che/ /mi rtog — —nam mkha'i rdo rje 'dzin/ /'dod chags pha rol phyin pa brnyes/ /rdo rje gsung la phyag 'tshal lo/ /rdo rje dga' ba gdon mi za/ /bsam pa thams cad yongs rdzogs pa/ /sangs rgyas ngo bo nyid las byung / /rdo rje sems dpa' phyag 'tshal lo/ /de nas 'khor lo sangs rgyas kyis bstod gsol/ /mchog tu gsang ba ji bzhin don spyad nas/ /rang gi 'khor lo la ni 'khor lo gzhug /mgon po bde ba chen po gcig po bzhugs / /de ltar rnal 'byor bzhi byed rnal 'byor pa/ /hūṃ gi snying pos 18—23

'jig rten rab tu bsgom/ /de byung 'gro kun rdo rje sems dpar bsam /langs nas 'gro la bltas te ji bzhin spyad par bya/ /sngags pas ting 'dzin dmigs pa'i tshe/ /gang tshe lus ni bskams gyur na/ /lus ngag yid ni tshim byed pa'i/ /sbyor ba 'di ni bsgom par bya/ /mtho gang tsam gyis dpags ①pa ru / /spyi bor dkyil 'khor bsgom par bya/ /bdud rtsi lnga ni nges 'bebs pa'i—/ /oṃ ni de ru bsam par bya/ /rdo rje sbyor ba 'di yis ni/ /skad cig gis ni gzi can 'gyur/ /lus ngag yid ni bde ba dag /thob 'gyur 'di la the tshom med/ /de ltar slob pa'i sngags pa yis/ /sbyangs dang de bzhin rtogs par khye bya/ /shog ma snying ga legs sbyangs shing / /de bzhin gshegs rnams tshim par bya/ /hūṃ gis legs par sbyangs byas la/ /yi ge yis ⑧yis rtogs byas te/ /oṃ gyis mnan nas sbar bar bya/ /'di ni kha zas sbyang bya ba'o/ /dang po mgrin pa'i mtshams bsam pa/ /der ni tweḥlas byung ba yi/ /padma 'dab ma brgyad pa bsgom/ /lte ba'i nang du yi ge hūṃ/ /hūṃ las skyes pa'i rdo rje che④ / /rtse mo thu lnga pa rnam hphupar bsam/ /rtse mo dbus mema'i steng du ni/ /oṃ bsam gog ma sbyang ba'o/ /sprin gyi sgra ni snying gar bsam/ /rtse gsum me ni de la spro/ /der ni bza' ba bsreg kyepa dag /'di ni nang gi sbyin sreb/ yin/ /rlung gis me ni sbar byed pa/ /der ni chu gang 'tshed par byed/ /dbang chen dkyil 'khor gnas su ni/ /gang du me ni rgyu ba dag /bza' ba dang ni btung ba rnams/ /gang ci rung ba chu'i kyedakyil 'khor/ /bza' ba kha yi padma las/ /snying ga'i padmar yang dag gzhugarte /lte ba'i dkyil 'khor phyin 'og tu/ /kha sbyar ba yi sbyor ba yis hūṃ/ /gsang ba'i padma las byung ba/ /18—24

thal pa'i mthar ni rnam par brtagahu /rims nad med cing nad kyang med/ /dug la sogs pas mi 'chi la/ /de ni dus min 'chi mi 'gyur/ /'tshe ba thams cad rnam 'joms pa'o/ /rdo rje phreng ba dpal mchog srub shing gis/ /gsang 'dus sbas chu'i rgya mtsho bsrubs ṭupa las/ /sgrub pa'i yan lag bdud rtsi gang thob des/ /'jig zurten ma lus 'chi med myur thob shog /sgrub pa'i thabs mdor byas pa slob dpon chen po ④klu sgrub kyis mdzad pa rdzogs so// //rgya gar gyi mkhan po ā tsārya shradhā phyeka ra warma dang / zhu ⑥chen gyi lo tsā ba bande rin chen bzang pos bsgyur cing zhus te gtan la phab pa// //bsdur mchan/3 ①mtshan byang 'di chos tshan 'di'i mtshan bod skad du smos pa ltar bkod/ ge〈〈pe 〉thaṇḍa dhi kri ta sā dha na/〈〈snar 〉8ṇḍa rnyi kri ta sā dha na/ zhu〈〈snar 〉rkogs/ ④〈〈pe 〉〉〈〈snar 〉ran/ phye〈〈pe 〉〉〈〈snar 〉〉skyed/4 ①〈〈pe 〉sko〈snar 〉glogon po/ ṭu〈〈pe 〉sko〈snar 〉rakyil/ ④〈〈pe 〉warya ra/ 〈〈snar 〉labyā ra/ ④〈〈pe 〉〉〈〈snar 〉〉duṭaṃ/5 hūṃ〈〈pe 〉sko〈snar 〉zod/ zhu〈〈pe 〉snga〈snar 〉phro1/ zhu〈〈pe 〉〉〈〈snar 〉7badzra/ /④〈〈pe 〉〉〈〈snar 〉7/ ⑤〈〈pe 〉〉〈〈snar 〉thacu/ rngo 〈〈snar 〉〉ging / ④〈〈pe 〉sko〈snar 〉〉hūṃ/6 1〈〈pe 〉〉〈〈snar 〉7phyi yi dkyil 'khor thig gdab bya/ / bhu〈〈pe 〉sko〈snar 〉ra ni/ 3〈〈pe 〉sko〈snar 〉ra /④ 〈〈pe 〉snga〈snar 〉7)/ phye〈〈pe 〉〉〈〈snar 〉glo/ 7 ①〈〈pe 〉〉〈〈snar 〉ra sam/ ṭu〈〈pe 〉snga〈snar 〉sngagatogs/8 gye〈〈pe 〉sko〈snar 〉zokha'/ ④〈〈pe 〉sko〈snar 〉〉gyur/ tsa 〈〈pe 〉sko〈snar 〉phrotma/ ④〈〈pe 〉〉〈snar 〉tha/ 7〈〈pe〉〉bskyod pas/ 〈〈snar 〉〉skyod pas/ byu〈〈snar 〉ye nd+ra/ ④〈〈pe 〉〉〈〈snar 〉thadi/ bla〈〈pe 〉sko〈snar 〉sras/9 nyu〈'ar 〉〉skyod/ bye 〈〈pe 〉sko〈snar 〉8nga / kye〈〈pe 〉sko〈snar 〉dzra/ bra/〈〈pe 〉sko〈snar 〉thasam/ 3〈〈pe 〉〉〈〈snar 〉tha/3 〈〈pe 〉〉〈〈snar 〉ra ga ④〈〈pe 〉〉〈〈snar 〉kho/78—25

cing / ④〈〈pe 〉〉〈'ar 〉ra22 gye 〈〈pe 〉〉〈〈snar 〉rnamangs pa la/ ༄ ༷〈〈pe 〉〉〈〈snar 〉dkyis/ bhu〈〈pe 〉〉〈〈snar 〉maradas/ ④〈〈pe 〉sko〈snar 〉rabaskul/3〈〈pe 〉〉〈〈snar 〉〉 gyes/18byed26

༄ / /rnal 'byor chen po'i rgyud dpal gsang ba 'dus pa'i bskyed pa'i rim pa bsgom pa'i thabs mdo dang bsras pa zhes bya ba/tu༄go/ /rgya gar skad du/ shrī gu hya sa mā dza ma hā yo ga tand+ra utpā da 3kra ma sā dha na sru tra me shra pha rngo ka nā ma/ bod skad du/ rnal 'byor chen po'i rgyud dpal gsang ba 'dus pa'i bskyed pa'i rim pa ④bsgom pa'i thabs mdo dang bsres pa zhes bya ba/ dpal rdo rje sems dpa' phyel phyag 'tshal lo/ /rnal 'byor chen po'i rgyud dpal gsang ba 'dus pa la rdo rje 'chang chen po la sogs pa'i sgrub pa la rab tu 'jug pa rnams kyis trebaskyed pa'i rim pa'i ting nge 'dzin nges par bya ba'i phyir mdo dang bsres pa zhes bya ba le'u bcu bdun pa las btus te bsdu bar bya'o/ /de la sgrub pa pos ji skad du le'u bcu gnyis pa las/dgon pa chen po'i sa phyogs ni/ /me tog 'bras bu sogs pas brgyan/ /ri bo dben pa'i sa phyogs su/ /dngos grub thams cad bsdus pa 'grub/ /ces bya ba la sogs pa rdo rje'i tshig gi tshul gyis rjes su mthun pa'i gnas su sems 78—28

dpa'i skyil mo krung du 'dug ste/ sems can thams cad la snying rje chen po'i sems bskyed de le'u gsum pa las/ nam mkha' hūṃdabyings kyi dbus gnas par—/ /sangs rgyas dkyil 'khor bsgom pa ni/ /'od zer sprin gyi tshogs chen po/ /sangs rgyas 'bar ba'i 'od dang ldan/ /'od zer sna lngas kun du khyab—/ /kun nas yongs su zlum po ste/ /'dod pa'i yon tan lnga yis brgyan//mchod pa rnam pa lngas brgyan pa/ /mdor na de ltar bsgoms nas su/ /gzugs ni dbus su bsgom spupar bya/ /zhes mdor bsnyus te gsungs pa de la dang po kho nar byang chub kyi sems rdo rje'i gzugs can zhes bya ba bskyed bhu par bya ba ste/ le'u bco lnga pa las/ rnam par snang mdzad 'od 'dra zhing / /rdo rje sems dpa' rgyal po che/ /sangs rgyas rdo rje gsum 'dzin 'gyur/ /zhes gsungs pa 'dis rdo rje 'chang chen po sku mdog dkar por bdag nyid ji lta ba bzhin mos par bya'o/ /de nas le'u dang po las/ ye shes sgron ma zhes bya ba'i ting nge 'dzin gsungs pa'i tshul gyis mi bskyod pa bskyed pas ④zhe sdang rdo rjer gyur nas le'u bcu gsum pa las/ khro bo zhe sdang gnas las skyes/ /gsod la rtag tu brtson pa dag /sgrub pa mchog gi chos can la/ /gsod pa'i don gyis 'grub par 'gyur/ /zhes gsungs pas yi ge hūṃ ring po las khro bo'i sge rgyal po bcu phyung la le'u bcu bzhi pa las/ oṃ sumbha zhes bya ba la sogs pa gsungs pa'i sngags kyis khro bo'i rgyal po gnod mdzes la bka' bsgo bas phyogs bcu'i bgegs kyi tshogs bkug nas le'u bcu gsum pa las/ yi dam bcas pa rdzogs nas kyang / /sngags kyi gnas ni bsrung bar bya/ /bsam gtan sbyor ba 'di la ni/ /gnas nas sangs rgyas byin gyis rlob/ /rdo rje bdud rtsi rgyal 18—29

chen po/ /rdo rje phur bu rnam par bsgom/ /me stag 'bar ba 'dra ba yis/ /phyogs bcu'i dkyil 'khor gdab par bya/ /zhes gsungs pa 'dis khro bo bdud rtsi thab nyusbyor gyi phur bu rnams kyis oṃ gha gha zhes bya ba la sogs pa'i sngags kyis gnod mdzes la bka' bsgo ste phur bu gdab bo/ /de nas 'dod pa'i rgyal po'i sngags kyis rdo rje ra ba bsam pa dang / hūṃ mdzad kyis rdo rje'i dra ba yi ge hūṃ gis sa'i cha rdo rje'i rang bzhin du bsam zhing yi ge gsum gyis go cha la sogs pa bya'o/ /de ltar phyogs dang mtshams bcing ba dang ra ba la sogs pa'i cho ga srung zu ba'i 'khor lo bsgoms la le'u gnyis pa las/ dngos po med pa sgom pa'i dngos/ /bsgom par bya ba bsgom pa min/ /de ltar dngos po dngos med pa/ /bsgom pa dmigs su med pa'o/ /zhes tshigs su bcad pa'i don gyis pya stong pa nyid kyi rang bzhin du bsgom 0mo/ /de nas le'u bcu gcig pa las/ dkyil 'khor rdo rje kun las skyes/ /nam mkha' rdo rje dbus su bsgom sgo/ /zhes bya ba la sogs pa gsungs pas/ rlung la sogs pa'i dkyil 'khor bzhi bskyed nas/bsdu ba dag kyang rab tu bya/ /zhes bya ba la sogs pas sa'i cha bskyed la le'u bcu gcig pa las/ yi ge rgyu gyis 3gnas bsgom ste/ /zhes bya bas gzhal yas khang bsams la/ der le'u dang po las/ gsal ba la sogs dkyil 'khor ldan/ /de bzhin gshegs pa kun gyi byeganas/ /zhes gsungs pa 'dis sna tshogs padma'i steng du zla ba la sogs pa'i gdan gyis brgyan la le'u brgyad pa las—/ dpag tshad bye ba'i khron tsam la/ /gru bzhi shin tu mdzes pa yi ghu / /mchod rten rin chen sna bzhi pa/ /gsal zhing rang bzhin dri ma med/ /ces bya ba la sogs pa gsungs pas/ de bzhin gshegs pa thams cad kyi ⑨bzhugs 18—30

gnas nyuji lta ba bzhin du bsgom mo/ /gnas ni bskyed pa sngon 'go bas/ /rdo rje gsum bskyed bsgom par bya/ /zhes gsungs pas lhag par mos pa can kyi sems kyis bdag nyid rdo rje 'chang nyid du gyur nas/ dbus kyi gdan la sems pa'i skyil mo krung gis gnas par bsams nas le'u dang po las/ gsal ba de yi ngo bo nyid/ /sna tshogs gzugs kyis kun du khyab/ /sangs rgyas tshogs kyis rab thutu rgyas/ /'od zer 'phro ba mang po 'khrug /ces gsungs pa 'dis dkyil 'khor gyi 'khor lo bkod pa'i ting nge 'dzin gyis dbang du byas te lhag par mos pa la dmigs par stan sgopa yin no/ /da ni rnal 'byor bzhi'i rim pa brtsam ④par bya ste de la le'u bdun pa las/ dam tshig khu phyung cho ga bzhin—/ /'bras bu 'dod pas btung bar bya/ /de bzhin gshegs pa'i tshogs bsad nas/ /dngos grub rab mchog thob par 'gyur/ /zhes gsungs pa 'dis lhag par mos pa'i ting nge 'dzin gyis dkyil 'khor gyi 'khor lo bkod pa'i de bzhin gshegs pa rnams phung po la sogs par bsdus te/ gzugs phung gtogs phyedang zhes bya ba la sogs pas don dam pa'i dkyil 'khor du zhugs la/le'u gsum pa las/ oṃ shu n+ya tā zhes bya ba la sogs pa gsungs pa'i sngags kyis byin gyis brlab pa'o/ /le'u brgyad pa las/ nam mkha' dbyings kyi bye dbus gnas par/ /ye shes rgya mtsho bsgom par bya/ /zhes gsungs pa 'dis ye shes rgya mtsho'i gzugs su ④yongs su gyur nas/ de nas ldang bar gyur pa ni ye shes rgya mtsho las nyi ma'i dkyil 'khor de'i steng du zla ba'i dkyil 'khor yang de'i steng du padma dmar po 'dab ma brgyad pa padma'i steng du yi ge gsum bkod de/ de thams cad bsdus te zla ba'i dkyil 'khor 'dra bar yongs su gyur par bltas ldu la/18—31

de las byung ba'i 'od zer gyi 'phro 'du bskyed nas ①sems can gyi khams rnams ye shes kyi bdag nyid zla ba'i dkyil 'khor de nyid du rjes su bcug la le'u gsum pa las/ oṃ dharma 5dhā tu zhes bya ba la sogs pa gsungs pa'i sngags kyis brtan par bya ba 'di ni rnal 'byor te/ de bas na/ ye shes tsam la snyoms 'jug pa//rnal 'byor yin par shes par bya/ /zhes gsungs pa yin no/ /de la le'u bcu gcig pa las/ rdo rje mchog gsum yi ge sngags/ /phyag rgya chen por rnam bsgom pa/ /byang chub thams cad thob bya'i phyir/ /ye shes rdo rje dag gis ③bya//zhes bya ba la sogs pa gsungs pas/ zla ba'i dkyil 'khor gyi steng du yi ge gsum bkod la rdo rje nga rgyal de las byung ba/ rdo rje 'chang chen por bdag nyid ji lta ba bzhin bsgom pa ni rjes su rnal 'byor ro/ /de nas le'u dang po las gsungs pa'i rig pa'i skyes bu gzugs can ye shes kyi rang bzhin kyi lus kyis ④sems can gyi don bya bar mi nus pas na le'u brgyad pa las/ nu ma'i bar nas klad pa'i rgya hyebar du/ /cho ga shes pas rkang mthil bar du dgod/ /lte ba rked pa gsang bar bye rgyal ba'i sras/ /rigs lnga rnams ni dgod par rab tu bya//zhes bya ba la sogs pa gsungs pa'i sngags kyis byen gyis brlabs pas phung po la sogs pa'i ngo bo nyid la de bzhin gshegs pa thams cad ye shes kyi rang bzhin lus la rjes su zhugs par bya'o/ /de bas na le'u bcu bdun pa las/ phung po lnga ni mdor bsdus na/ /sangs rgyas lngar ni rab tu bsgrags/ /rdo rje skye mched nyid dag kyang / /byang chub sems dpa'i dkyil 'khor mchog /ces gsungs pa yin no/ /da ni sku'i dkyil 'khor gyi lha rnams la rjes su zhugs pas zhal gsum lta bus gdul bya rnams kyi ④don du rdo rje 'chang gi bdag nyid du 18—32

bsgom par bya'o/ /don 'di nyid bstan pa ni le'u dang po las/ rig pa'i skyes bu chen po'i gzugs de bzhin gshegs pa thams cad kyi bdag po sngags kyis byen gyis brlabs so/ /byin gyis brlabs ma thag tu bcom ldan 'das byang chub kyi sems rdo rje de bzhin gshegs pa zhal gsum pa lta bur de bzhin gshegs pa thams cad kyis gzigs par gyur te nyuzhes gsungs pa ni shin tu rnal 'byor ro/ /de nas rnam par snang mdzad la sogs pa'i ye shes sems dpa' rjes su zhugs pas sku la sogs pa'i rim pa 'dis byin gyis brlab par bya'o/ /de la rim pa ni 'di yin te le'u bcu gcig phyepa las/ rdo rje dkyil 'khor dbus gnas par/ /hūṃ zhes bya ba rab tu bsgom/ /gsal ba'i dkyil 'khor dbus gnas par/ /yi ge oṃ ni rnam par bsam/ /chos kyi dkyil 'khor dbus gnas par/ /yi ge sdza bhuzhes rnam par bsam/ /zhes gsungs pa 'dis mgo bo dang lkog ma dang snying ga'i phyogs su yi ge gsum rnam par bkod la/de las byung ba'i spyan la sogs pa'i tshogs kyis sku rdo rje la sogs pa bkug la le'u bcu gnyis pa las/ sangs rgyas sku 'dzin dpal dang ldan/ /zhes bya ba la sogs pa'i tshigs su bcad pa rnams kyis gsol ba btab ④la rjes su zhugs nas le'u bdun pa las/ sangs rgyas kun gyi sku gang yin/ /zhes bya ba la sogs pa'i tshigs su bcad pa rnams kyis rigs gsum kyi bdag nyid can du nga rgyal bskyed la le'u drug pa las/ oṃ sarba ta thā ga ta kā ya/ zhes bya ba la sogs pa gsungs pa'i sngags kyis byin gyis brlab bo/ /le'u dang bo las/rdo rje dam tshig 'byung ba rdo rje zhes bya ba'i ting nge 'dzin gsungs pa'i tshul gyis bskyed pa ni dam tshig sems dpa' zhes bya'o/ /de nas le'u bcu gnyis pa las/18—33

rnam pa mchog rnams kun ldan pa'i/ /snying gar ye shes dam tshig dang / /dbu rgyan rdo rje 'dzin pa'i mchog /sangs rgyas thams cad mnyes 'gyur ba/ /'di ni dam tshig mchog yin te/ /dngos grub thams cad 'grub pa'i mchog /dam tshig mchog gis nyurab tu bya/ /zhes gsungs pa 'dis dam tshig sems dpa'i snying gar ye shes sems dpa' rdus bon gyis dgug pa dang / dbu rgyan la rang gi bdag po bsgom mo/ /de nas le'u bcu gcig pa las/ snying gar yi ge hūṃ bsams nas/ /sems ni thig ler gyur par gzhagarte /ces gsungs pa 'dis ye shes sems dpa'i thugs kar ④yang snying po yi ge hūṃ ting nge 'dzin sems dpa' bsgom thumo/ /'di ltar bcom ldan 'das kyis byang chub kyi go 'phang ni 'dod chags las skye bar 'gyur bar rab tu bstan pa'i phyir/ le'u dang po las/ 'dod chags chen po'i tshul rdo rje/ /zhes bya ba'i ting nge 'dzin la snyoms par zhugs par mdzad pa de bzhin du bskyed bzhin pa la gnas pas dang po'i spyor ba bya ste/ 'dod chags la spyod pa'i sems can rnams kyi 'dod pas thar pa rab tu bstan pa'i phyir/ le'u bcu bdun pa las/ 'dod pa thams cad longs spyod pa'i/ /zhes bya ba'i ting nge 'dzin la snyoms par zhugs nas zhes gsungs pa'i rim pa 'dis le'u bco lnga pa las gsungs pa'i mtshan dang ldan pa'i gdol pa'i bu mo legs par bslabs pa'am/ yang na rang gi snying ga nas phyungs te 4mdun du bzhag la le'u brgyad pa las/ nu ma'i bar nas klad pa'i rgyas kyi bar/ /zhes bya ba la sogs pa gsungs pas /3rigs lnga dang bsre ba byas la rdo rje dang padma mngon par 'dus byas pas dbang po gnyis kyis snyoms par 'jug pa bya ste/ le'u bdun pa las ji skad du/ bud med 18—34

gzugs ldan mdangs bzang ba/ /lo grangs bcu drug lon pa la/ /byin kyis brlabs kyi gnas gsum gyis/ /dbeen par mchod pa rab tu brtsam/ /de bzhin gshegs pa'i btsun mo'i mchog /spyan la sogs pa bsgom par bya/ /dbang po gnyis ni mnyam sbyor bas/ /sangs rgyas dngos grub thob par 'gyur/ /oṃ zhes pa dang sdzazhes pas/ /hūṃ dang phaṭa du rnam par brtag /'od zer sna lngas khyab pa yi/ /padma rdo rje bsgom par bya/ /zhes gsungs pa 'dis tha mal pa'i nga rgyal spangs la/ chags shing chags pa'i lta bas bltanyu/ /'di ni dam tshig dkyil 'khor ro/ /zhes bya ba 'dis thabs kyi rdo rjes mnyes rmepar bya zhing / rin chen 'byung ldan kyi nga rgyal dang ldan pas le'u drug pa las gsungs pa'i rjes su chags pa'i sngags brjod la 'khyud pa dang 'o bya ba dang / gzhib pa la sogs pa byas la yi ge hūṃ gi glu len cing las la gnas par bsgom mo/ /'byin pa'i skabs su phaṭa ces brjod la/ byang chub kyi sems kyi rdul phra rab de bzhin gshegs pa thams cad la sogs pa'i 'byung gnas su bsgoms snel sngar bshad pa'i gzhal yas khang na gnas par bya'o/ /de nas don yod pa'i nga rgyal dang ldan pas le'u drug pa las gsungs pa'i mchod pa'i sngags kyis byin gyis brlabs te gzhung 'di dag gis ni dkyil 'khor gsum sems dpa' gsum gyi bdag nyid can te/ bdag gi don phun sum tshogs pa dang po'i spyor ba zhes bya ba'i ting nge 'dzin to/ /de nas gzhan gyi don phun sum tshogs par bya ba'i phyir le'u dang po las gsungs pa'i ye shes sgon ma rdo rje zhes bya ba'i ting nge 'dzin gsungs pa'i tshul 18—35

gyis mi bskyod pa phyung la des zhe sdang la spyod pa'i sems can rnams yang dag par sbyangs la de bkug nas rang gi lus la bcug na zhe sdang rdo rjer 'gyur ro/ /de bzhin du rnam par snang mdzad la sogs pa'i dkyil 'khor kyi lha rnams phyung nas/de rnams kyis gti mug la sogs pa la rjes su dga' ba'i sems can rnams yang dag par sbyangs nas bsdus te/ ye shes kyi 'khor lor kyerjes su bcug la slar bkug ste gnas ji lta ba bzhin du bkod nas phyag rgya 3bzhis rgyas btab pa 'di ni dkyil 'khor gyi mchog ces bya ba'i ting nge 'dzin gnyis pa'o/ /de nas le'u gsum pa las/ rin chen kha dog sna lnga pa/ /yungs kar gyi ni 'bru tshod tsam/ /sna yi rtse mor nan tan du/ /rnal 'byor rig zhupas rtag tu bsgom/ /zhes bya ba la sogs pa phra mo'i sbyor ba'o/ /le'u bdun pa las / slong mo za zhing mi bzlas te/ /ma babeengs thupa la chags mi bya/ /'dod pa kun la rngulongs spyod cing / /sngags kyi yan lag ma nyams bzlas/ /zhes gsungs pa la sogs pas rdo rje'i khubazlas pa dran par bya ste/ le'u bcu gsum pa las/ brjod ④nas rdo rje neespro ba ni/ /rdzogs nas rab tu bsdu bar bya / /zhes bya ba dag gi bzlas brjod byas la nye bar bsdu bar bya ste/ le'u bcu bdun pa las/ de nas de bzhin gshegs pa thams cad kyi sku dang gsung dang thugs kyi btsun mo'i bha ga la bzhugs so/ /de nas de bzhin gshegs pa thams cad kyi 9btsun mos de bzhin gshegs pa thams cad kyi bdag po rdo rje 'dzin chen po la dga' bas bstod pa dzeezhes bya ba 'di thams cad bya ste/ bdag po rang nyid don dam pa'i bden pa la zhugs spel/ de nas spyan la sogs pa'i 18—36

lha mo rnams kyis rab tu bskul ba dang / de bzhin gshegs pa rnams kyis/mi bskyod pa ni ye shes che/ /zhes bya ba'i bstod pa rnams kyis ①mngon par bstod pas yang dag par sad tsa par bya ste/ cho ga bzhin legs par mchod nas rang gi sku la legs par gzhug par bya'o/ /de nas le'u bcu pa las/nam mkha' dbyings kyi dbus gnas par/ /bkod pa'i dkyil 'khor bsgom par bya/ /de yi dbus gnas yi ge hūṃ/ /rang gi gzugs su rab tu brtag /rdo rje 'od zer rab tu 'bar/ /rnam par 'phro bar bsam par bya sangs rgyas kyi ni sku gsung thugs/ /snying la de yis rnam bsgoms nami/ /de ma thag tu de 'gyur ba/ /sku gsung thugs kyi rdo rje 'dzin/ /zhes gsungs pa 'dis yi ge hūṃ gis nam mkha'i khams yongs su gang ba ni rdo rje sems dpa'i rang bzhin du rnam par bsams gel nye bar bsdu bar bya'o/ /de ltar las dang po pa rnams rab tu 'jug pa'i dam tshig dang sdom pa dang / dbang bsgur ba thob pas tha mal pa'i nga rgyal dang bral bas thun bzhir lha'i rnal 'byor la khyegoms pas bdag dang gzhan gyi don phun sum tshogs pa bsgrub pa'i phyir las kyi rab tu dbye ba rnams kyang bya'o/ /rim pa 'di nyid kyis le'u bcu bdun pa las/ lus kyi rdo rje kha zas dang / /phyi rol rdo rje 'dzin pa dang / /rdo rje chos la rtag par ni/ /sngags bton byecho ga spyad par bya/ /zhes gsungs pa'i ting nge 'dzin 'dis sgrub pa'i thabs las bshad pa'i rim pas kha zas sbyang ba dang / lkog ma sbyang ba dang / snying ga sbyang ba dag byas nas bdud rtsi lnga la sogs pa'i zas kyi bya ba dag kyang bya'o/ /de nas le'u bcu pa las/ sngags kyi skyes bu ji snyed pa/ /rdo rje gsum gyi ye shes rdzogs/ /dbang po gnyis ni sbyor ba yis/ /dngos po 18—37

thams cad brtag par bya/ /zhes gsungs pa 'dis rdo rje dang padma yang dag par sbyar bas zhi ba la sogs pa'i las thams cad rab tu bsgrub pa'i yi ge gsum gyi sngags dang / phreng ba'i sngags dang / gsang sngags dang / sman dang / nang gi sbyin sreg gis kyang las thams cad rab tu bsgrub par bya ste/'di ni las kyi mchog ces bya ba'i ting nge 'dzin gsum pa'o/ /de ltar mdo dang bsres pa rgyas par bstan nas/ da ni mdor bsdus nas bshad par bya ste/ de la thog mar gnas nges pa dang / snying rje chen po la dmigs pa dang / srung tsaba'i 'khor lo bsgom pa dang / stong pa nyid la dmigs pa dang / sa'i cha bskyed dupa dang / gzhal yas khang dang /dkyil 'khor dgod pa dang / don dam pa'i dkyil 'khor la 'jug pa dang /ldang ba dang / nyi ma'i dkyil 'khor la dmigs pa dang / mthar zla ba'i dkyil 'khor dang / rdo rje 'chang chen po bskyed pa dang / sngags kyi ③byin gyis brlabs pas phung po la sogs pa dgang ba dang / sku gsung thugs kyi ④byin gyis brlabs pa dang ldan pa'i 'dus byas pa dang / rdo rje dang padma 'dus byas pa dang / rjes su chags pa'i rdo rje byin gyis brlabs ⑤/ pa dang / dkyil 'khor phyung ba dang / phra mo'i sbyor ba dang / rdo rje'i bzlas pa dang / ngag gi bzlas pa dang / don dam pa la zhugs pa dang / rab tu bskul bas bslang ba dang / bstod pa byed pa dang / nye bar bsdu ba dang / las kyi rab tu dbye ba rnams su shes par bya'o/ /rnal 'byor chen po'i rgyud dpal gsang ba 'dus pa'i bskyed rim gyi 4sgrub pa'i thabs mdo dang bsres pa zhes bya 18—38

ba—/ slob dpon chen po klu sgrub kyi zhal snga nyunas mdzad pa rdzogs so// //rgya gar gyi mkhan po dharma ṭu shrī bha dra bhudang lo tsā ba dge slong rin chen bzang pos bsgyur cing zhus te gtan la phab pa④ // //bsdur mchan/28 tshimatshan byang 'di chos tshan 'di'i mtshan bod skad du smos pa ltar bkod cing / 〈〈pe 〉〉〈〈snar 〉mo la 'byor chen po'i rgyud dpal gsang ba 'dus pa'i bskyed dpa'i rim pa sgom pa'i thabs mdo dang bsres pa slob dpon klu sgrub kyis mdzad pa'o/ / 〈〈pe 〉sko〈snar 〉〉༅ te/ sne 〈〈pe 〉〉〈〈snar 〉〉 lya sru — me ba la/ ④〈〈pe 〉〉〈〈snar 〉ra 'i/ ⑤〈〈pe 〉〉〈〈snar 〉mi/ ④〈〈pe 〉sko' ra
