bsdur 'bras re'u migargyud/ (628)18wa 107

0702༄༅/ /byang chub sems kyi 'grel pa zhes bya ba/1 ༄go/ /rgya gar skad du/ bo bye tsitta bi ba ra ṇa nā ma/ bod skad du/byang chub sems kyi 'grel pa zhes bya ba/ dpal rdo rje sems dpa' la phyag 'tshal lo/ /dngos po thams cad dang bral ba/ /phung po khams dang skye mched kyi / /gzung dang 'dzin pa rnam spangs pa/ /chos bdag med pa 2mnyam nyid pas / /rang sems gdod nas ma skyes pa/ /stong pa nyid kyi rang bzhin no/ /zhes bya ba 'byung ngo / /sangs rgyas bcom ldan 'das rnams dang / byang chub sems dpa' chen po de rnams kyis ji ltar byang chub chen por thugs bskyed pa de bzhin du/ bdag gis kyang sems can ma bsgral ba rnams bsgral ba dang /ma grol ba rnams dgrol ba dang / dbugs ma phyung ba rnams dbugs dbyung ba dang / yongs su mya ngan las ma 'das pa rnams yongs su mya ngan las bzla ba'i phyir dus 'di nas bzung nas snying po byang chub la mchis kyi bar du byang chub chen 18—108

por sems bskyed par bgyi'o/ /byang chub sems dpa' gsang sngags kyi sgor spyad pa spyod pa rnams kyis de ltar kun rdzob kyi rnam pas byang chub kyi sems smon pa'i rang bzhin can bskyed nas/ don dam pa'i byang chub kyi sems bsgom pa'i stobs kyis bskyed par bya ba yin pas de'i phyir de'i rang bzhin bshad par bya'o/ /byang chub sems kyi bdag nyid dngos/ /dpal ldan rdo rje rnams btud de/ /byang chub sems kyi bsgom pa ni/ /srid pa 'jig rten 1bdag gis bshad/ /sangs rgyas rnams kyi byang chub sems/ /bdag dang phung sogs rnam rig gi/ /rtog pa rnams kyis ma bsgribs pa/ /rtag tu stong nyid mtshan nyid bzhed/ /snying rjes brlan pa'i sems kyis ni/ /'bad pas bsgom par bya ba yin/ /thugs rje'i bdag nyid sangs rgyas kyi rjo/ /byang chub sems 'di rtag tu bsgomazhu//mu stegs can gyis gang brtags pa/ /bdag de rigs pas rnam dpyad na/ /phung rnams kun gyi nang rnams niphye/ /gang zhig gnas kyang rnyed ma yin/ /phung rnams yod kyi de rtag min/ /de yang bdag gi ngo bo min/ /gang yang rtag dang mi rtag gnyis/ /rten dang brten pa'i dngos po med/ /bdag ces bya ste yod min na/ /byed po zhes bya ga la rtag /chos can yod na chos rnams la / /'jig rten na ni spyod pa 'jug /gang phyir rtag pa byudon byed pa/ /rim dang cig car gyis min pa/ /de phyir phyi rol nang du ni/ /rtag pa'i dngos de med pa nyid/ /gal te nus na ci ste ltos/ /de ni cig car dngos 'byin 'gyur/ /gang zhig dngos gzhan la ltos la/ /de ni rtag dang nus ldan min/ /gal te dngos na rtag min te/ /dngos rnams rtag tu skad cig phyir—/ /gang phyir mi rtag dngos po la/ /byed pa po nyid bkag pa rnged/ /18—109

bdag sogs bral ba'i 'jig rten 'di/ /phung po khams dang skye mched dang / /gzung 'dzin blo yis 'joms par 'gyur/ /phan par bzheng pa rnams kyis ni/ /gzugs dang tshor ba 'du shes dang / /'du byed rnam shes phung po lnga/ /de ltar nyan thos rnams la gsungs/ /rkang gnyis mchog gis rtag tu yang / /gzugs ni dbu ba rdos 'drar kyesnang / /tshor ba chu yi chu bur 'dra/ /'du shes smig rgyu dang mtshungs shing / /'du byed chu shing dang 'dra la/ /rnam shes sgyu ma lta bu zhes/ /phung po bstan pa 'di lta bu/ /byang chub sems dpa' rnams la gsungs/ /'byung chen bzhi yi rang bzhin can/ /gzugs kyi phung por rab tu bshad/ /lhag ma gzugs med nyid du ni/ /med na mi 'byung phyir na 'grub/ /de dag rnams kyi mig gzugs sogs/ /khams rnams bshad pa de dag nyid/ /skye mched dag ni gzung ba dang / /'dzin par yang ni shes par bya/ /gzugs rdul dbang shes skyed min te/ /de ni dbang po las 'das yin/ /'dus pas de rnams skyed byed na/ /tshogs pa de yang mi 'dod do/ /phyogs kyi dbye bas phye ba yis/ /rdul phran la yang dbye ba mthong /gang la cha shas kyis brtags pa/ /der ni rdul phran ji ltar 'thad/ /phyi rol don ni rnam gcig la/ /tha dad shes pa 'jug par 'gyur/ /yid 'ong gzugs ni gang yin pa/ /de nyid gzhan la gzhan du 'gyur/ /bud med gzugs ni gcig pu la/ /ro dang 'dod bya bza' ba la/ /kun rgyu chags can khyi rnams bzhin/ /rnam par rtog pa gsum yin no/ /don mtshungs pa yis don byed pa/ /rmi lam gnod pa bzhin min nam/ /rmi lam sad pa'i gnas skabs la/ /don byed pa la khyad par med/ /gzung dang 'dzin pa'i ngo 18—110

bo yis/ /rnam shes snang ba gang yin pa/ /rnam shes las ni tha dad par/ /phyi rol don ni 'ga' yang med/ /de phyir dngos po'i ngo bor ni/ /phyi don rnam pa kun du med/ /rnam shes so sor snang ba 'di/ /gzugs kyi rnam par snang bar 'gyur/ /ji ltar skye bo sems rmongs pas/ /sgyu ma smig rgyu dri za yi/ /grong khyer la sogs mthong ba ltar/ /de bzhin gzugs sogs snang ba yin/ /bdag tu 'dzin pa bzlog pa'i phyir/ /phung po khams sogs bstan pa yin/ /sems tsam po la gnas nas ni/ /skal chen rnams kyis de yang spangs/ /rnam par shes par smra ba la/ /sna tshogs 'di ni sems su grub/ /rnam shes rang bzhin gang zhe na/ /da ni de nyid bshad bya ste/ /'di dag thams cad sems tsam zhes/ /thub pas bstan pa gang mdzad de/ /byis pa rnams kyis / skrag pa ni—/ /spang ba'i phyir yin de nyid min/ /kun brtags dang ni gzhan dbang dang / /yongs su grub pa 'di nyid ni/ /stong nyid bdag nyid gcig pu yi/ /ngo bo sems la brtag zhu pa yin/ /theg chen dga' ba'i bdag nyid la/ /chos la bdag med mnyam pa nyid/ /sems ni gdod nas ma skyes te/ /sangs rgyas kyis ni mdor bsdus gsungs/ /rnal 'byor spyod pa pa rnams kyis/ /rang gi sems kyi dbang byas te/ /gnas yongs gyur nas dag pa'i sems so so rang rig snespyod yul brjod/ /'das pa gang yin de ni med/ /ma 'ongs pa ni thob pa min/ /gnas phyir gnas ni yongs gyur pa/ /da lta ba la ga la yod/ /de ji ltar de ltar snang min/ /ji ltar snang de de ltar minacho/ /rnam shes bdag med ngo bo ste/ /rten gzhan rnam par shes pa med/ /ji ltar khab len dang nye bas/ /lcags ni myur du yongs su 'khor/ /de la sems ni yod min 18—111

te / /sems dang ldan zhing snang bar 'gyur/ /de bzhin kun gzhi'i dzeernam shes ni/ /bden min bden pa bzhin du ni/ /gang tshe 'gro ge'ong g.yo bar 'gyur—/ /de tshe srid pa 'dzin par byed/ /ji ltar rgya mtsho dang ni shing / /sems ni med kyang g.yo bar 'gyur/ /de bzhin kun gzhi'i rternam shes ni/ /lus brten nas ni g.yo ba yin/ /lus med na ni rnam par shes/ /yod pa min zhes yongs rtog na/ /de yi so so rang rig nyid/ /ci 'dra zhes kyang brjod par gyis/ /so so rang rig nyid brjod pas/ /de ni dngos po nyid du brjod—/ /'di de yin zhes brjod pa ni/ /nus min zhes kyang brjod pa yin//rang la nges ④bzhin gzhan dag la/ /nges pa bskyed par bya ba'i phyir/ /rtag tu 'khrul pa med par ni/ /mkhas rnams rab tu 'jug pa yin/ /shes pas shes bya rtogs pa ste/ /shes bya med par shes pa med/ /de ltar na ni rig bya dang / /rig byed med ces cis mi 'dod/ /sems ni ming tsam yin pa ste/ /ming las gzhan du 'ga' phye yang med/ /ming tsam du ni rnam rig blta/ /ming yang rang bzhin med pa yin/ /nang ngam de bzhin phyi rol lam/ /yang na gnyis ka'i bar dag tu/ /rgyal ba rnams kyis du sems ma rnyed/ /de phyir sgyu ma'i rang bzhin sems/ /kha dog dbyibs kyi ④dbye ba'am/ /gzung ba dang ni 'dzin pa'am/ /skyes pa bud med ma ning sogs/ /ngo bo sems ni gnas pa min/ /mdor na sangs rgyas rnams kyis ni/ /gzigs par ma gyur gzigs mi 'gyur/ /rang bzhin med pa'i rang bzhin can/ /ji lta bur na gzigs par 'gyur/ /dngos po zhes bya rnam rtog yin/ /rnam rtog med pa stong pa yin/ /gang du rnam rtog snang gyur pa/ /der ni stong nyid ga la yod/ /18—112

rtog bya rtog khyebyed rnam pa'i sems/ /de bzhin gshegs rnams kyis ma gzigs//gang na rtog bya rtog tsabyed yod/ /der ni byang chub yod ma yin/ /mtshan nyid med cing skye ba med/ /yod gyur ma yin ngag lam bral/ /mkha' dang byang chub sems dang ni/ /byang chub gnyis med mtshan nyid can/ /byang chub snying po la bzhugs pa'i/ /bdag nyid chen po'i sangs rgyas dang / /brtse ldan kun gyis dus kun du/ /stong pa mkha' dang mtshungs par mkhyen/ /de phyir chos rnams kun gyi gzhi/ /zhi zhing sgyu ma dang mtshungs par/ /gzhi med srid pa 'jig byed pa'i/ /stong pa nyid 'di rtag tu bsgom/ /skye med dang ni stong nyid dang / /bdag med ces byar stong pa nyid/ /bdag nyid dman pa gang sgom pa/ /de de sgom par byed pa min/ /dge dang mi dge'i rnam rtog gi/ /rgyun chad pa yi mtshan nyid can/ /stong nyid sangs rgyas kyis gsungs gzhan/ /de dag stong pa nyid mi bzhed/ /sems la dmigs pa med pa yi/ /gnas pa nam mkha'i mtshan nyid yin/ /de dag stong nyid bsgom 1pa ni/ /nam mkha' bsgom ④/par bzhed pa yin/ /stong nyid seng ge'i sgra yis ni/ /smra ba thams cad skrag par mdzad/ /gang dang gang du de dag bzhugs/ /de dang der ni stong nyid 'gyur/ /gang gi phyernam shes skad cig ma/ /de yi de ni rtag ma yin/ /sems ni mi rtag nyid yin na/ /stong pa nyid du ji ltar 'gal/ /mdor na sangs rgyas rnams kyis ni/ /sems ni mi rtag nyid bzhed na/ /de dag sems ni stong nyid du/ /ci yi phyir na bzhed mi 'gyur/ /thog ma nyid nas sems kyi ni—/ /rang bzhin rtag tu med par 'gyur/ /dngos po rang bzhin kyis grub pa / /rang bzhin med nyid brjod pa min/ /de skad brjod na sems kyi ni/ /18—113

bdag gi gnas pa spangs pa yin/ /rang gi rang bzhin las 'das pa/ /de ni chos rnams chos ma yin/ /ji ltar bu ram mngar ba dang / /me yi rang bzhin tsha ba bzhin/ /de bzhin chos rnams thams cad kyi/ /rang bzhin stong pa nyid du 'dod/ /stong nyid rang bzhin du brjod pas/ /gang zhig chad par smra ba min/ /des ni rtag pa nyid du yang / /'ga' zhig smras pa ma yin no/ /ma rig nas brtsams rga ba yinyu// /mthar thug yan lag bcu gnyis kyi/ /brten nas byung ba'i bya ba ni/ /kho bo rmi lam sgyu 'drar 'dod/ /yan lag bcu gnyis 'khor lo 'di/ /srid pa'i lam du 'khor ba ste/ /de las gzhan du sems can gang / /las 'bras spyod par 'dod pa med/ /ji ltar me long la brten nas/ /bzhin kyi dkyil 'khor snang gyur pa/ /de ni der 'pho ma yin zhing / /de med par yang de yod min/ /de bzhin phung po nying mtshams sbyor—/ /srid pa gzhan du skye ba dang / /'pho ba med par mkhas rnams kyis/ /rtag tu nges par bya ba yin/ /mdor na stong pa'i chos rnams la/ /chos rnams stong pa skye bar 'gyur/ /byed po las 'bras longs spyod pa/ /kun rdzob tu ni rgyal bas bstan/ /ji ltar rnga yi sgra dang rgo/ /de bzhin myu gu tshogs pas bskyed—/ /phyi yi rten cing 'brel 'byung ba/ /rmi lam sgyu ma dang mtshungs 'dodaske/ /chos rnams rgyu las skyes pa ni/ /nam yang 'gal bar mi 'gyur te//rgyu ni rgyu nyid kyis stong pas/ /de ni skye ba med par rtogs/ /chos rnams kyi ni skye ba med/ /stong nyid yin par rab tu bshad/ /mdor na phung po lnga rnams ni / /chos kun zhes ni bshad pa yin/ /de nyid ji bzhin bshad pas na/ /kun rdzob rgyun ni 'chad mi 'gyur/ /kun rdzob las ni tha dad par/ /de nyid 18—114

dmigs pa ma yin te/ /kun rdzob stong pa nyid du bshad/ /stong pa kho na kun rdzob yin/ /med na mi 'byung nges pa'i phyir/ /byas dang mi rtag ji bzhin no/ /kun rdzob nyon mongs las las byung / /las ni sems las byung ba yin/ /sems ni bag chags rnams kyis bsags/ /bag chags bral na bde ba ste/ /bde ba'i sems ni zhi ba nyid/ /sems zhi ba ni rmongs mi 'gyur/ /rmongs med de nyid rtogs pa ste/ /de nyid rtogs pas ༄1grol thob 'gyur/ /de bzhin nyid dang yang dag mtha'/ /mtshan ma med dang don dam nyid/ /byang chub sems mchog de nyid dang / /stong nyid du yang bshad pa yin/ /gang dag stong nyid mi shes pa/ /de dag thar pa'i rten ma yin/ /'gro drug srid pa'i btson rar ni/ /rmongs pa de dag 'khor bar 'gyur/ /de ltar stong pa nyid 'di ni/ /rnal 'byor pa yis bsgom byas na/ /gzhan gyi don la chags pa'i blo//'byung bar 'gyur bar zhuthe tshom med/ /gang dag pha dang ma dang ni/ /gnyen bshes gyur pas bdag la sngon/ /phan pa byas par gyur pa yi bye/ /sems can de dag rnams la ni/ /byas pa gzo bar gyur par bya/ /srid pa'i btson rar sems can ni/ /nyon mongs me yis gdungs rnams la/ /bdag gis sbug bsngal byin pa ltar/ /de bzhin bde ba sbyin par rigs/ /'jig rten bde 'go ngan 'gro yis/ /'dod dang mi 'dod 'bras bu de/ /sems can rnams la phan pa dang / /gnod pa las ni 'byung bar 'gyur/ /sems can bsten pas sangs rgyas kyi④/ /go 'phang bla med nyid 'gyur na/ /lha dang mi yi longs spyod gang / /tshangs dang dbang po drag po dang / /'jig rten skyong bas bsten ④de dag /sems can phan pa tsam zhig gis/ /ma drangs pa ni 'gro 18—115

gsum 'dir/ /'ga' yang med la mtshar ci yod/ /sems dmyal dud 'gro yi dwags su/ /sdug bsngal rnam pa du ma'i dngos/ /sems can rnams kyis myong ba gang / /de ni sems can gnod las byung / /bkres skom phan tshun rdeg hūṃpa dang / /gzir ba yi ni sdug bsngal nyid/ /bzlog par dka' zhing zad med de/ /sems can gnod pa'i 'bras bu yin/ /sangs rgyas byang chub sems nyid dang / /bde 'gro dang ni ngan 'gro gang / /sems can dag 3gi rnam smin kyang / /ngo bo gnyis su shes par bya/ /dngos po kun gyis bsten dubya zhing / /rang gi lus bzhin bsrung bar bya/ /sems can rnams la chags bral ba/ /dug bzhin 'bad pas spang bar bya/ /nyan thos rnams ni chags bral bas/ /byang chub dman pa thob min nam/ /sems can yongs su ma dor bas / /rdzogs sangs rgyas kyis byang chub thob/ /de ltar phan dang mi phan pa'i / /'bras bu 'byung bar dpyad pa na/ /de dag skad cig gcig kyang ni//rang don chags ④shing ji ltar gnas/ /snying rjes brtan pa'i rtsa ba can/ /byang sems myu gu las byung ba/ /gzhan don gcig 'bras byang chub ni/ /rgyal ba'i sras rnams sgom par byed/ /gang zhig bsgoms 3pas brtan pa ni/ /gzhan gyi sdug bsngal gyis bred nas/ /bsam gtan bde ba dor nas kyang / /mnar med par ༄ ༷yang 'jug par byed/ /'di ni ngo mtshar 'di bsngags 'os/ /'di ni dam pa'i tshul lugs mchog /de dag rnams kyi rang lus dang / /nor rnams byin pa ngo mtshar min/ /chos rnams stong pa 'di shes nas/ /las dang 'bras bu sten pa gang / /de ni ngo mtshar bas ngo mtshar/ /rmad du byung bas rmad du byung / /sems can bskyab pa'i bsam pa can/ /de dag srid pa'i 18—116

'dam skyes kyang / /de byung nyes pas ma gos pa/ /chu yi padma'i 'dab ma bzhin / /kun bzang la sogs rgyal ba'i sras/ /nyon mongs bud shing bsregs mod kyi/ /de ltar snesnying rjes brlan gyur sbung / /snying rje'i dbang du gyur pa rnams/ /gshegs dang bltams lcedang rol ba dang / /khab nas 'byung dang dka' ba spyod/ /byang chub che dang bdud sde 'joms/ /chos kyi 'khor lo bskor gyeb dang / /lha rnams kun la ④zhugs pa dang / /de bzhin du ni mya ngan las/ /'das pa ston par mdzad pa yin/ /tshangs dang dbang po khyab 'jug dang / /drag sogs gzugs su sprul mdzad nas/ /'gro ba 'dul ba'i sbyor ba yis/ /thugs rje'i rang bzhin can gar mdzad/ /srid pa'i lam la skyo rnams la/ /ngal so'i don du theg pa che/ /'byung ba'i ye shes gnyis po yang / /gsungs pa yin te don dam min/ /ji srid sangs rgyas kyis ma bskul//de srid ye shes lus dngos can/ /ting 'dzin myos pas rgyal 'gyur ba/ /nyan thos de dag gnas par 'gyur/ /bskul na sna tshogs gzugs kyis ni/ /sems can don la chags gyur cing / /bsod nams ye shes tshogs bsags nahye//sangs rgyas byang chub thob par 'gyur/ /gnyis kyi lcebag chags yod pa'i phyir/ /bag chags sa bon brjod pa yin/ /sa bon de dngos tshogs pa ni/ /srid pa'i myu gu skyed par byed/ /'jig rten mgon rnams kyis bstan pa/ /sems can bsam dbang rjes 'gro ba/ /'jig rten du ni thabs mang po/ /rnam pa mang po tha dad 'gyur/ /zab cing rgya che'i dbye ba dang / /la lar gnyis ka'i mtshan nyid can/ /tha dad bstan pa yin yang ni/ /stong dang gnyis med tha dad min/ /gzungs rnams dang ni sa rnams dang / /sangs rgyas pha rol phyin 18—117

gang dag /de dag byang chub sem sa kyi char/ /kun mkhyen rnams kyis gsungs pa yin/ /lus ngag yid kyis rtag blapar ni/ /de ltar sems can don byed nga// /stong nyid rtsod par smra rnams la/ /chad pa'i rtsod pa nyid yod min / /'khor ba mya ngan 'das pa la/ /bdag nyid che de byemi gnas pa/ /de phyir sangs rgyas rnams kyis ni/ /mi gnas mya ngan 'das 'dir bshad/ /snying rje ro gcig bsod nams gyur/ /stong nyid ro ni mchog gyur pa/ /bdag dang gzhan don bsgrub zhudon du/ /gang 'thung de dag rgyal sras yin/ /dngos po kun gyis de la 'dud/ /srid pa gsum na rtag mchod 'os/ /sangs rgyas gdung ni 'tshob don du/ /'jig rten 'dren pa de dag bzhugs/ /byang chub sems 'di theg chen po/ /mchog ni yin par bshad pa ste/ /mnyam par gzhag pa'i 'bad pa yis/ /byang chub sems ni bskyed par gyis/ /rang dang gzhan don bsgrub don du/ /srid na thabs gzhan yod ma yin/ /byang chub sems ni ma gtogs par ④/ /sangs rgyas kyis sngar thabs ma gzigs/ /byang chub sems bskyed tsam gyis ni/ /bsod nams phung po gang thob pa/ /gal te gzugs can yin na ni/ /nam mkha' gang ba las ni lhag /skyes bu gang zhig skad cig tsam/ /byang chub sems ni sgom byed pa/ /de yi bsod nams phung po ni/ /rgyal ba yis kyang bgrang mi spyod/ /nyon mongs med pa'i rin chen sems/ /'di ni nor mchog gcig pu ste/ /nyon mongs bdud sogs chom rkun gyis/ /gnod min 'phrog ④par bya ba min/ /ji ltar 'khor bar sangs rgyas dang / /byang chub sems dpa'i smon lam ni/ /mi g.yo de ltar blo nyid ni/ /byang chub sems gzhol rnams kyis bya/ /ngo mtshar gyis kyang khyed 18—118

cag gis/ /ji ltar bshad pa la 'bad kyitso/ /de rjes kun bzang spyod pa ni/ /rang nyid kyis ni rtogs par 'gyur/ /rgyal mchog rnams kyis bstod pa'i byang chub sems ni bstod byas pa'i/ /bsod nams mtshungs med deng du bdag gis thob pa gang yin pa/ /de yis srid pa'i rgya mtsho dba' klong nang du nub pa yi/ /sems can rkang gnyis dbang pos bsten pa'i lam du 'gro bar shog /byang chub sems kyi 'grel pa slob dpon bdag nyid chen po 'phags pa klu sgrub kyis mdzad pa rdzogs so// //rgya gar gyi mkhan po gu ṇa ā ṭuka ra dang / lo tsā ba rab zhi bshes gnyen gyis bsgyur cing zhus/ slad kyi rgya gar gyi mkhan po ka na ka warma dang / bod kyi lo tsā ba pa tshab nyi ma grags kyis bcos pa'o du/// //bsdur mchan/1༷8 ①mtshan byang 'di chos tshan 'di'i mtshan bod skad du smos pa ltar bkod cing / 〈〈pe 〉〉〈〈snar 〉7nga chub sems kyi 'grel pa zhes bya ba slob dpon klu sgrub kyi zhal snga nas mdzad pa'o// ༄ 〈〈pe 〉〉〈〈snar 〉ra sa/ bye 〈〈pe 〉〉sgral/1༷9 sne〈〈pe 〉〉〈〈snar 〉8/ zhu〈〈pe 〉sko〈snar 〉dkus/ zhu〈〈pe 〉〉〈〈snar 〉thasgoms/ ④/〈〈pe 〉〉〈〈snar 〉'ag spru〈〈pe 〉sko〈snar 〉ra/ bhu〈〈pe 〉sko〈snar 〉7sa/11༷ nyu〈〈pe 〉〉〈〈snar 〉thadra/111 rkya〈〈pe 〉〉〈〈snar 〉dku/ bhu〈〈pe 〉〉〈〈snar 〉༄rtags/ —〈〈pe 〉〉〈〈snar 〉༄ra rang gi/ ④〈〈pe 〉〉〈〈snar 〉than/112 hu〈〈pe 〉sko〈snar 〉sngazhi/ bye〈〈pe 〉〉〈〈snar 〉〉sgra/ ge〈〈pe 〉〉〈〈snar 〉shazhi/ thu〈〈pe 〉〉〈〈snar 〉8/ thu〈〈pe 〉〉〈〈snar 〉raga'/ hūṃ〈〈pe 〉〉〈〈snar 〉dku/ ④〈〈pe 〉〉〈〈snar 〉sum̐s/113 nyurmye 〈〈pe 〉〉〈〈snar 〉lkegs bya rtogs/ rngo ④〈〈pe〉〉〈〈snar 〉spom/ phye〈〈co 〉lkes/114 ①〈〈pe 〉sko〈snar 〉raga' ba yin/18byed119

115 hu〈〈pe 〉〉〈〈snar 〉〉pa/ thu〈〈pe 〉྾〈snar 〉〉ba/ du〈〈pe 〉sko〈snar 〉stanas/ ④〈〈pe 〉sko〈snar 〉nya)sa/ phye〈〈pe〉〉〈〈snar 〉stabarten/116 nyu〈〈pe 〉〉〈〈snar 〉〉bdeg ②〈〈pe 〉〉〈〈snar 〉stanang / du 〈〈pe 〉྾〈snar 〉〉rton/ ④〈〈pe 〉〉〈〈snar 〉〉gnas/phye〈〈pe〉྾〈snar 〉〉bsgom/ ⑥〈〈pe 〉྾〈snar 〉〉pa/117 ༅〈〈pe 〉྾〈snar 〉〉lta'ang / ④〈〈pe 〉〉〈〈snar 〉〉bltam/ ⑧〈〈pe 〉〉〈〈snar 〉〉skor/ ④〈〈pe 〉྾〈snar 〉nya)sa/ rgya〈〈pe 〉྾〈snar 〉stanas/ yi〈〈pe 〉྾〈snar 〉〉kyis/118 nyu〈〈pe 〉〉〈〈snar 〉〉brtags/ 00〈〈pe 〉྾〈snar 〉〉ste/ ③〈〈pe 〉྾〈snar 〉〉sgrub/ ④〈〈pe 〉྾〈snar 〉〉pas/rgya〈〈pe 〉〉〈〈snar 〉〉phrogs/119 nyu〈〈pe 〉〉〈〈snar 〉〉kyis/ ④〈〈pe 〉྾〈snar 〉snam/ ②〈〈pe 〉྾〈snar 〉〉pa/bsdur 'bras re'u migabyud/ (629)18wa 120

༄go/ /rgya gar skad du/ bo dhi tsitta kyebi ba ra ṇa/ bod skad du/byang chub sems kyi 'grel pa/ 'phags pa 'jam dpal la phyag 'tshal lo/ /de nas byang chub kyi sems sgom pa'i 'grel pa bshad par bya'o/ /bcom ldan 'das kyis chos thams cad sems kyis rnam par brtags pa'o zhes gsungs pas re zhig sems ni de nyid kyi rang bzhin ci zhig ces nges par rtog pa na/ dngos po thams cad dang bral ba/ /phung po khams dang skye mched dang / /gzung dang 'dzin pa rnam par spangs/ /chos bdag med par mnyam nyid pas/ /rang sems gdod nas ma skyes pa/ /stong pa nyid kyi rang bzhin no/ /zhes gsungs so/ /smras pa 'di yi don ci yin zhe na/ brjod pa/ dngos po thams cad zhudang bral ba ④/ /zhes te dngos po'i sgras bdag la sogs pa mngon par brjod do/ /'di skad du sems de ni bdag dang / sems can dang /18—121

srog dang / gso ba dang / skyes bu dang / gang zag dang / shed las skyes dang / shed bu dang / byed pa ༄rtepo la sogs pa'i rang bzhin ma yin no/ /ci'i phyir zhe na/ de dag la bya ba'i mtshan nyid can yod pa ma yin pa'i phyir ro/ /de nyid kyi phyir bdag la sogs pa'i dngos po yod pa ma yin na/ sems de'i rang bzhin du gyur pa lta ga la yod ces smras par 'gyur ro/ /de'i phyir dngos po thams cad dang bral zhing bdag tu ṭu'adzin pa tsam gyis yang dag par bskyed pa'o / /nyon mongs pa thams cad bdag tu 'dzin pas yang dag par bskyed pa'i phyir sems ni de'i rang bzhin du 'gyur ro zhe na/ sems de ni phung po dang khams dang skye mched kyi rang bzhin ma yin pa'i phyir/ phung po khams dang skye mched dang / /gzung dang 'dzin pa rnam par spangs/ /zhes gsungs so/ /'di ltar re zhig phung po la sogs pa nyid kyi dngos po don dam par ma dmigs na/sems de'i rang bzhin du 'gyur ba lta ga la yod/ ji ltar zhe na/ re zhig gzugs la sogs pa'i phung po rnams pya dngos po med pa nyid de/ gzugs kyi phung po ni 'byung ba dang 'byung ba las gyur pa'i tshogs so/ /'byung ba ni bzhi ste/sa dang / chu dang / me dang / rlung ngo / /'byung ba las gyur pa lnga ste/gzugs dang / sgra dang / dri dang / ro dang / reg bya'o/ /sa la sogs pa 'byung ba rnams dang / gzugs la sogs pa 'byung ba las gyur pa de dag re re zhing tha dad pa'i dngos po nyid du ma dmigs te/ gang du gcig tu yod pa der gzhan yang yod pa'i phyir ro/ /de'i phyir gzugs ni ming tsam du kun du brtags pa'o/ /gzugs kyi phung po ni gzugs kyi phung pos stong zhes gsungs pa las ni gzugs kyi phung po yang yongs su ma grub pa'o/ /de bzhin du 18—122

tshor ba'i phung po yongs su ma grub ste/ ji lta zhe na/ tshor ba rnam pa blagasum mo/ /bde ba dang / sdug bsngal ba dang / sdug bsngal ma yin zhing bde ba yang ma yin pa de dag phan tshun ltos pa'i phyir te/ snyug bsngal la ltos shunas bde ba dang / bde ba la ltos nas sdug bsngal du 'dogs par byed do/ /chos gang zhig gcig pur gnas pa dmigs pa med pa de ni rdzas nyid du yod pa yin te/ring po dang thung ngu bzhin no/ /gzhan du tshor ba ni rnam pa gnyis te/ lus las byung ba dang / sems las byung ba'o zhes par yang re zhig lus ni gzugs kyi phung pos bsdus pa'i phyir ma dmigs so/ /de'i phyir lus med pa'i phyir lus las byung ba'i tshor ba ma grub bo/ /sems kyang yul na mi gnas pa/ phyogs na mi gnas pa/ gzugs med pa/ bstan du med pa/ rab tu mi gnas pa/snang ba med pa/ rnam par mi rig par gsungs na/ tshor ba de ni ci 'dra zhig de'i phyir sems las byung ba yang ma grub bo/ /de'i phyir tshor ba'i phung po 5 ni tshor ba'i phung pos stong ngo ④ zhes gsungs pa las na/ tshor ba'i phung po yang yongs su ma grub bo/ /'du shes kyi phung po yang ming tsam kyis dngos po nyid de/'du shes ni mtshan mar 'dzin pa'i bdag nyid can yin la/ de ltar re zhig gang dag la mtshan mar gzung bar bya ba'i dngos po yod pa ma yin pa de'i phyir mtshan ma med pas mtshan ma can yang yod pa ma yin no/ /'du shes kyi phung po ni 'du shes kyi phung pos stong ngo zhes gsungs pa las na 'du shes kyi phung po yang yongs su ma grub bo/ /'du byed kyi phung po yang yongs su ma grub ste tshogs pa tsam gyi phyir ro/ /'du byed kyi phung po ni tshor ba dang / sems pa byedang 'du shes dang 'dun pa dang reg pa dang blo dang / dran pa dang yid la byed pa dang 18—123

mos pa la sogs pa mtshungs par ldan pa rnams dang / sa dang chu dang me dang rlung la sogs pa'i skye ba la sogs pa mtshungs par mi ldan pa dag la brjod na/sems las byung ba'i chos rnams dang skye ba la sogs pa dag kyang re re zhing la skye ba yod pa ma yin no/ /'du byed kyi phung po ni las kyi mtshan nyid can yin pa'i phyir yang med pa nyid do/ /byed pa po med pa'i phyir bya ba yang dngos po med do//'du byed kyi phung po ni 'du byed kyi phung po'i dngos pos stong ngo zhes gsungs pa las na 'du byed kyi phung po yongs su grub pa med do/ /rnam par shes pa'i phung po yang yongs su ma grub ste/ 'di ltar rnam par shes pa'i phung po nyid ni mig dang / rna ba dang / sna dang / lce dang / lus dang / yid kyi rnam par shes pa rnams yin la/ mig gi rnam par shes pa la sogs pa de dag kyang re re zhing rang gi ngo bo ma dmigs so/ /ci'i phyir zhe na/ mig dang gzugs la brten nas mig gi rnam par shes pa 'byung zhing med na mi 'byung ste/ mig dang gzugs med na mig gi rnam par shes pa ji ltar 'byung bar 'gyur/ de ltar na re zhig mig gi rnam par shes pa yongs su ma grub bo/ /tshig de nyid kyis rna ba dang / sna dang / lce dang lus kyi rnam par shes pa yang 1yid 'das pa dang ma 'ongs pa'i chos thams cad kyi rten can yin na/ ci ltar 'das pa dang ma 'ongs pa'i chos rnams yid kyi rnam par shes pa skyed pa'i rkyen du 'gyur/bcom ldan 'das kyis re zhig 'das pa ni de nyid dang / lhan sbug 'gags shing ma 'ongs pa ni ma thob pa yin la/ da ltar byung ba rnam par shes pa dang lhan cig pa yang gnas pa yod pa ma yin zhes gsungs so/ /rnam par shes pa'i phung po yang rnam par shes pa'i phung pos stong ngo zhes pa las rnam par shes pa'i 18—124

phung po yang yongs su ma grub bo/ /de ltar phung po de nyid khams dang skye mched du bstan pa'i phyir logs su dgag 51par mi bya ste/ sa bon med pas myu gu med pa bzhin du phung po rang bzhin med pa nyid kyis de rnams kyang rang bzhin med par grub bo/ /de'i phyir sems ni phung po dang / khams dang / skye mched dang bral ba zhes bya'o/ /gzung dang 'dzin pa rnam par spangs/ /zhes bya ba ni yang dag par rdzogs pa'i sangs rgyas kyis de bzhin gshegs pa'i gsang ba'i mdo las/ sems ni sngon po dang / ser po dang / dmar po dang /btsod kha dang / shel dang / dngul gyi kha dog dang / ring po dang /thung ngu dang / zlum po dang / gru gsum dang / gru bzhi la sogs pa'i rnam pa dang / skyes pa dang bud med dang / ma ning gi rnam pa ma mthong ngo zhes pa dang / gsang ba'i bdag po sems ni 'dod pa'i khams kyi rang bzhin ma yin/gzugs kyi khams kyi rang bzhin ma yin/ gzugs med pa'i khams kyi rang bzhin ma yin/ lha dang / klu dang / gnod sbyin dang / dri za dang /lha ma yin dang / nam mkha' lding dang / mi 'am ci dang / lto 'phye chen po dang / mi dang mi ma yin pa'i 'gro ba'i rang bzhin ma yin no zhes pa nas—/ rnam pa thams cad du yongs su btsal na ma dmigs so zhes bya ba'i bar du gsungs so/ /de ltar na re zhig sems de ni gzung ba ma yin no/ /ji ltar 'dzin pa yang ma yin pa de ltar brjod par bya ste/ 'di ltar bcom ldan 'das kyis gsang ba'i bdag po sems de ni nang na yang ma yin phyi rol na yang ma yin/ gnyis ka'i bar du tsoyang ma yin no/ /de ci'i phyir zhe na/ gsang ba'i bdag po sems de ni rang bzhin gyis yongs su dag pa'i phyir ro/ /de'i 18—125

phyir gang rnam pa thams cad kyis yongs su btsal na ma dmigs pa de ji ltar gzung ba dang 'dzin pa yin par 'gyur/ de ltar na sems de ni gzung ba dang 'dzin pa dang bral ba zhes bya'o/ /chos bdag med par mnyam rmyenyid pas/ /zhes bya ba ni phung po la sogs pa thams cad bdag med pa de bzhin du sems de yang ngo / /de skad du bcom ldan 'das kyis chos thams cad stong pa de bzhin du sems kyang stong pa'i mtshan nyid do/ /chos thams cad bdag med pa de bzhin du sems de yang bdag med pa'i mtshan nyid do/ /chos thams cad rnam par dbeen pa ste/ de bzhin du sems de yang rnam par dbeen pa'i mtshan nyid do / /de'i phyir chos bdag med par mnyam pa nyid kyis sems de mnyam pa yin pa'i phyir rang gi sems gdod ma nas ma skyes pa'o/ /de'i phyir stong pa nyid kyi rang bzhin no/ /stong pa nyid kyi rang bzhin ci zhe na/ stong pa nyid ni nam mkha'i rang bzhin no/ /de skad du'ang nam mkha' stong pa'o/ /chos thams cad nam mkha'i rang bzhin no/ /byang chub kyang de'i rang bzhin no/ / sems kyang de'i rang bzhin no 5zhes gsungs so/ /de bzhin du nam mkha' rang bzhin med pa 8ming tsam mo/ /de bzhin du sems kyang rang bzhin med pa ③ ming tsam yin/ gang yang sems ma skyes ma 'gags kyepar khong du chud pa de ni byang chub bo/ /de skad du yang bcom ldan 'das kyis byang chub gang zhe na/gang sems kyi yang dag pa ji lta ba bzhin yongs su shes pa ste/ de nyid bla na med pa yang dag par rdzogs pa'i byang chub bo/ /gsang ba'i bdag po chos bye phra ba yang yod pa ma yin zhing dmigs pa med pa des ni bla na med pa yang dag par rdzogs pa'i byang chub ces brjod do/ /ci'i phyir zhe na/ byang chub ni nam 18—126

mkha'i mtshan nyid de/ rtogs pa po dang rtogs par bya ba 'ga' yang med do/ /de ci'i phyir zhe na/ byang chub ni nam mkha'i 1mtshan nyid kyi phyir ro zhes gsungs so/ /de'i phyir gang zhig rang gi sems yang dag pa ji lta ba bzhin 2rig pa de la brtse ba'i thabs kyis/ kye ma kyi hud sems can 'di dag ni sdug bsngal ba/ 'di dag ni rang gi sems kyi chos nyid kyi rang bzhin ma gtogs pa yang dag pa ma yin pa'i rnam par rtog pa phyin ci log gi gdon gyis bzung ba/'khor ba na sdug bsngal sna tshogs nyams su myong ba yin zhing / ji ltar de dag rang gi sems kyi chos nyid kyi rang bzhin rtogs par 'gyur ba de bzhin du bdag gis 'bad par bya'o zhes sems can la dmigs pa'i sems skye bar 'gyur ro/ /gang snying rje chen pos yongs su bzung ba'i sems bskyed pa de ni byang chub kyi sems dang / sems can thams cad la phan pa'i sems dang / sems can thams cad la bde ba'i sems dang / bla na med pa'i sems dang / chos kyi dbyengs la 'jug pa'i sems dang / sems can thams cad la brten nas skyes pa'i byang chub kyi sems zhes bya'o/ /byang chub sems kyi 'grel pa slob dpon klu sgrub kyis mdzad pa rdzogs so// //kha che'i paṇḍi ta dza tre ya a nanta dang / bod kyi lo tsā ba khu mdo sde 'bar gyis bsgyur ba'o// //18—127

༄go/ /rgya gar skad du/ pañtsa kra ma/ bod skad du/ rim pa lnga pa/'jam dpal gzhon nur gyur pa la phyag 'tshal lo/ /mgon po sangs rgyas kun bdag nyid/ /dpal ldan bde chen la btud de/ /rnal 'byor rgyud kyi rjes 'brangs nas/ /rdo rje bzlas pa'i rim bshad bya/ /bskyed pa'i rim la legs gnas shing / /rdzogs pa'i rim pa 'dod rnams la/ /thabs 'di rdzogs pa'i sangs rgyas kyis/ /skas kyi rim pa lta bur gsungs/ /sems can rnams kyi srog gyur pa/ /rlung zhes bya ba las kun byed/ /'di ni rnam shes bzhon 5pa ste/ /lnga yi bdag nyid bcu ming can/ /rlung gi de nyid rim kyis ni/ /sngags kyi de nyid yang dag 'jug /sngags kyi dmigs pa rtogs nas ni/ /rdo rje bzlas pa rnams la slob③/ /rdo rje bzlas nas rnal 'byor pa/ /sems la dmigs pa thob par 'gyur/ /sgyu ma lta bu'i ting 'dzin gnas/ /yang dag mthas ④ni 18—129

rnam par sbyang / /yang dag mtha' las langs nas ni/ /gnyis med ye shes 'thob par 'gyur/ /zung nyu'ajug ting 'dzin la gnas nas/ /beer zhing gang la'ang mi slob bo/ /'di ni rdzogs pa'i rnal 'byor pa/ /rdo rje 'dzin pa chen po'ang de/ /rnam pa kun gyi mchog ldan pa'i/ /thams cad mkhyen par de nas 'gyur / /'das pa dang ni ma 'ongs dang / /de phyeltar byung ba'i srid gsum ni / /'od gsal bas ni rnam dag pas/ /skad cig de la ma lus mthong / /dpal ldan 'dus pa'i rgyud du ni/ /de nyid 'di dag rgyas btab nas1/ /bshad pa'i rgyud kyi rjes 'brangs nas/ /bla ma'i kha las rtogs par bya/ /de la dang po kho nar rlung gi de kho na nyid bstan pa'i tshig rtsa ba'i rgyud la 'jug par bya ste/ sna yi rtse mor yungs kar bsam/ /'gro dang mi 'gro yungs kar la/ /gsang ba'i sngags kyis brtags pa yis/ /ye shes mchog gi gnas bsgom mo/ /rin chen kha dog sna lnga pa/ /yungs kar gyi ni 'bru tshod tsam/ /sna yi rtse mor nan tan du/ /rnal 'byor rig pas rtag tu bsgom/ /zhes bya ba ste/ 'di ni dgongs pas bshad pa'o/ /rdo rje'i tshig 'di'i bshad pa lha mo bzhis zhus pa zhes bya ba'i bshad pa'i rgyud las/ snying po las ni snying po mchog /sangs rgyas kun gyi gsang ba ni/ /gang de thams cad bdag nyid gnas/ /de ni lha mo bshad par bya/ /ye shes lnga yi ④dngos de nyid/ /yungs kar gyi ni 'bru tshod tsam/ /de yi dbus na gnas pa'i lha/ /mi gsal gsal ba'i bdag nyid can—/ /zhes gsungs pa dang / gsang ba 'dus pa'i rgyud phyi ma las kyang don 'di nyid gsal bar gsungs te/ ye shes lnga yi rang bzhin dbugs/ /'byung ba lnga yi ngo bo nyid/ /gong bu'i gzugs kyis phyephyung nas ni/ /sna yi rtse 18—130

mor rab tu brtag /rin chen kha dog sna lnga pa/ /srog dang rtsol ba zhes byar bshad—/ /rang sngags snying gar bsams nas ni/ /srog ni thig ler gnas par gzhag① /ces gsungs pa dang / 'di nyid yang slar bshad pa rdo rje phreng ba zhes bya ba ⑤bshad pa'i rgyud las/ sna rtser yungs kar zhes bya ba/ /srog dang rtsal ④/ba'i brtag pa ste/ /srog dang rtsol ba la gnas pa/ /'od lnga sangs rgyas rnams su bsgom/ /steng gi sna las nges 'byung ④ba/ /g.yon dang g.yas dang gnyis ka dang / /dal bar rgyu dang rnam bzhir 'gyur/ /nang gi dus ni yin par bshad/ /sgog ma snying ga lte ba dang / /gsang ba'i padmar 'gro 'ong ston/ /thun phyed kyi ni dus rtag ⑤tu/ /go rims ji bzhin gnas par bstan/ /g.yas pa nas ni 'byung ba'i khams/ /me yi dkyil 'khor nyid yin te/ /kha dog dmar zhing gsal ba 'di/ /padma mgon po'i rgyu ba'o/ /g.yon pa las ni 'byung ba'i khams/ /rlung gi dkyil 'khor zhes bya ba/ /ljang ser dag tu snang ba ste/ /las kyi mgon po'i rgyu ba'o/ / gnyi ga 'ulas ni byung ba'i khams/ /mdangs chen kha dog ser po ste/ /dbang chen gyi ni dkyil 'khor nyid/ /rin chen mgon po'i rgyu ba'o/ /dal zhing rgyu ba med pa'i khams/ /dag cing shel ltar snang ba ni/ /chu yi dkyil 'khor nyid yin te/ /rdo rje mgon po'i rgyu ba'o/ /lus kun la ni gnas pa'i rlung / /bya ba kun la 'jug pa po/ /'di ni rnam snang ngo bo ste/ /'chi ba'i lus las 'byung bar 'gyur/ /rlung gi de nyid gsal ba 'di/ /ye shes lnga yi ngo bo nyid/ /rnal 'byor byis pa'i yul min zhing / /rtog ge pa yis mi shes so/ /de ltar rlung gi de kho na nyid bstan nas/ da ni sngags kyi de kho na nyid ston pa'i tshig rtsa ba'i rgyud nyid 18—131

la 'jug par bya ste/ de bzhin gshegs pa thams cad kyi sku dang gsung dang thugs kyi gsang sngags thams cad kyi snying po kun du skul bar byed pa zhes bya ba mchog tu gsang ba nyid kyi sku dang gsung dang thugs rdo rje las tshig gi lam nges par brjod pas sngags bsdus pa 'di lta bu gsungs so/ /oṃ sdza①hūṃ/ don rtogs pa yi 3bzlas pa ni/ /ngo bo nyid med bzang po las/ /dus gsum sangs rgyas kyis brtags pa/ /rdo rje bzlas par de bshad do/ /slong mo za zhing mi bzlas te/ /ma bslangs pa la'ang chags mi bya/ /'dod pa kun la longs spyod cing / /sngags kyi yan lag ma nyams bzlas/ /bshad pa 'di nyid slar bshad pa/ /dgongs pa lung bstan pa'i rgyud las gsungs pas de la 'jug par bya ste/ de nas dpal ldan snang mdzad che/ /khyab bdag la ni beer gsol pa/ /sems can thams cad skyed pa po/ /sna tshogs gzugs can sems 'di ni/ /de bas dngos po med gyur kyang / /srid pa dag tu rab tu grags / /byang chub sems ni mkha' mnyam pa/ /legs par rjes su myong mdzad pa/ /'gro ba'i don ni mdzad pa po/ /skye bo mchog la de bstan gsol/ /sgrub pa yi ni thabs tsam zhig /shes nas rgyud rnams 'chad par byed/ /'di ltar bdag ni slob dpon zhes/ /ma 'ongs pa na smra bar 'gyur/ /bdag gi tshig ni 'di nyid dag /yin zhes smra zhing byis pa 'jig /de ni dgongs pa'i byang chub sems/ /ji bzhin don du mi shes so/ /de nas bdag po bcom ldan 'das/ /rnam par snang mdzad thub chen gyis/ /legs zhes lan gsum gsungs mdzad nas/ /lag na rdo rje la 'di gsungs/ / mi rtog 1don gyi de nyid ni/ /rab tu phye nas bshad par bya/ /brjod dang dmigs par bcas pa 18—132

dang / /brdar gyur dang ni don dam mo/ /tshig gi brjod pa thun mong ste/ /dmigs par bcas pa sangs rgyas nyid/ /sngags kyi de nyid brda ru bshad/ /don dam de bzhin nyid yin no/ /dang po gcig ni dgu dbus na/ /gang zhig bcu yis ma bcings nyupa/ /de nyid bcing 3/med ces bya ste/ /de shes pa ni mchog gi gnas/ /dbyangs dang gsal byed yi ge ste/ /grangs dgu yi ni rjes 'jug pa/ /as bcings phan tshun yang dag sbyor/ /gang gis shes de 'gro ba'i bla/ /'byung ba'i mtha' dang yang dag ldan/ /cha la sogs pa bcu drug gnas/ /lnga pa lnga dang yang dag ldan/ /bzhi ni gsum du snyenges par sbyar//yi ge sde bcas ring por bcas/ /yon tan sbyor sogs phyogs ④dang mtshungs/ /thung ngu ma las ñdzudag tu 'gyur/ /gcig min du ma'ang lcem yin na/ /yi ge gang zhig sngar bshad pa/ /gang yang mngon par phyogs pa rnams/ /bud med skyes pa ma ning ste/ /khams la sogs par rab tu brtag /'og dang steng du bcas par 3ni/ /shes nas blos ni nges par sbyar/ /brjod pa yi ni sngags 'di dag /dngos med ngo bo las byung ba'o/ /de ni yongs su gyur pa'i gzugs—/ /lha ru nye bar mtshon pa gang / /de ni nye bar dmigs pa'o/ /brda ni de nyid gsum gnas pa/ /rang bzhin bzlas pa'i mtshan nyid do/ /a yig bshad pa'i ye shes ni/ /sangs rgyas kun gyi snying por gyur/ /oṃ gyis sems can yang dag sdud/ /sangs rgyas skur ni rab tu brtag /hūṃ gis sems can yang dag spyo/ /sangs rgyas thugs su rab tu brtag /sdzani gnas par gyur pa'o/ /sangs rgyas gsung du rab tu brtag /'jug pa nyid dang gnas pa dang / /ldang ba yi ni rim gyis kyang / /shes rab thabs kyi gzhir 18—133

gnas te/ /sngags kyi yan lag ma nyams bzlas/ /gos dkar la sogs bzlas bshad pa/ /brgya phrag gnyis dang nyi shu lnga/ /bzhi po legs par bsdus pa ni/ /spyor bzhi bsdus pa brgya phrag dgu/ /dgu brgya dag tu gang bstan pa/ /nyi shu rtsa bzhi'i rim gyis ni/ /de ni so sor 'byung ba las/ /nyi khri chig stong drug brgya'o/ /nang gi dus 'di nyid gsal bar bya ba'i phyir gsang ba 'dus pa'i rgyud phyi ma las/ rig pa'i cho ga 'di yis ni/ /thun mtshams bzhi ni rab sbyor bas/ /grangs 'bum gyi ni mtshan nyid can/ /sngags kyi yan lag ma nyams bzlas/ /zhes gsungs pa dang / bsgom pa yi ni bar chad can/ /rnal 'byor phyi rol bzlas pa spang ①/ /sngags don bcom ldan rdo rje can/ /rdo rje bdag nyid ji ltar bzlas/ /glang po sngon du rnyed gyur nas/ /glang po'i rjes ni tshol byed ltar/ /sngags lus rang nyid mngon gyur nas/ /gzhan dag ji ga tshol byed dam/ /gzhan yang rdo rje 'dzin gang zhig /spyor ba gsum dang ldan pa yisasnye/ /spyan drangs gshegs su gsol gyur dang / /de bzhin bzhugs su gsol ba dang 1/ /bzhugs pa yis ni spyan drangs te/ /myur ba yis ni gshegs su gsol/ /gnyis ka min pas bzhugs su gsol/ /sna tshogs gnas grub bla med pa'o/ /myur ba dang ni rnam bsdus dang / /dal ba can dang sngags sbyor ba/ /bla mas slob ma'i rna drung du/ /rab tu 'bad de bshad par bya/ /de nas rnal 'byor dbang phyug gi5/ /thabs kyi dam pa bstan pa'i phyir/ /rnal 'byor 'bras bu rab ster ba'i/ /gsang ba'i yi ge bshad par bya/ /gang zhig bsams pa tsam gyis ni/ /rnal 'byor can la mchog ster gyur/ /dang po'i yi ge'i spyor ba yis⑤/ /rtag tu dbugs ni rngub 18—134

par bya/ /brgyad pa'i mtha' dang ldan pa yi/ /yi ge u ni thig ler bcas/ /rnal 'byor pa ni dbugs gtong ①byed/ /'di ni ci dga'i bzlas par bshad/ /khri phrag gnyis dang chig stong dang / /de bzhin du ni brgya phrag drug /rnal 'byor dbang po nyin mtshan gyi/ /bzlas brjod kyi ni grangs byed do/ /de 'dir gsang zhing dgongs pa yis/ /phra mo'i sbyor ba ②bshad pa yin/ /kkog dang kha ton med mod kyi/ /'on kyang bzlas par bshad pa yin ③/ /rdo rje bzlas pa 'di yis ni/ /cho ga ji bzhin bsten ④bya zhing / /snga ma lta bu'i ting 'dzin gyis/ /las rnams thams cad bsgrub par bya/ /de bas na gnyis su med pa mnyam pa nyid rnam par rgyal ba zhes bya ba rnal 'byor chen po'i rgyud las kyang / mnyam med sngags ni bzlas nas su/ /sgrub pa'i bdag nyid can gyis bsgrub⑤—/ /de yis zla ba gcig gis ni/ /khams gsum 'grub par gdon mi zaske/ /rnam shes las ni 'byung ba'i sngags/ /mtshan nyid drug ldan bzas pya /nas kyang / /rdo rje sems dpa' phyag byas na/ /zla ba nya la de 'grub 'gyur/ /de las ⑦brtul zhugs bshad pa med/ /phreng ba mi dgos sngags mi spudagos/ /gzung dang sbyin sreg las rnams dag /gcig nas gcig tu ldog spu par 'gyur//ya yi don gyis gang ci'ang rung / /dngos grub 'dod pas bya ba ni/ /ra la sogs pa gsum nyid kyis/ /'gro ba'i don la 'jug par bya/ /me dang rlung dang dbang chen dang / /chu ste ⑫so so'i dkyil 'khor du/ /thun ni phyed phyed dus su ni/ /las ni gnyis gnyis gnas par 'gyur/ /mchod la brtson pas mchod par 'gyur/ /bzlas la brtson pas rnam par dag /me la sbyin sreg brtson pas 'byor/ /bsam gtan brtson pas thar pa 'thob/ /sngags pas 18—135

de ltar shes nas ni/ /'gro na byis pa bzhin du spyod/ /des ni mi rtog chos can gyis/ /gsang sngags rnams ni 'grub par 'gyur/ /gsung gi rdo rje sgrub ①pa ste/ /'di ni sngags kyi de nyid gsal/ /ye shes gsum gyi dbye ba yis/ /sems tsam snyel ni nges par sbyar/ /bla ma la brnyas ①sgyu can dad pa med/ /sngags kyis thurlon zhing glegs bam mthong bas khengs/ /dad pa med cing dbang bskur ⑤dman pa la/ /gtam gyi rim pa'ang de la brjod mi bya/ /gang zhig bla ma la gus dad dang ldan/ /mos pas bsnyen bkur la ni rtag tu brtson/ /thos pa 'dzin gang slob ma'i dam pa yis/ /de la bla ma'i drin sbyin brtag mi dgos / /ri dbang rtse nas 'ga' zhig lhung gyur na/ /rtsang bar mi bya snyam yang ltung bar 'gyur/ /bla ma'i drin gyis phan pa'i lung thob na/ /grol bar mi 'gyur snyam yang grol bar 'gyur/ /rdo rje bzlas pa'i rim pa ste slob dpon klu sgrub kyi zhal snga nas kyis mdzad pa'i rim pa dang po'o// //phyag 'tshal 'dud cing phyag 'tshal 'dud/ /phyag 'tshal phyag 'tshal phyag 'tshal 'dud/ /ji ltar bstod cing phyag 'tshal ba/ /gang la bstod cing gang gis bstod/ /ji ltar chu la chu bzhag dang / /ji ltar mar la mar bzhin du/ /rang gis rang gi thoye shes ni/ /legs mthong gang yin 'dir phyag yin/ /'on kyang kun mkhyen ma thob par/ /de ni nye bar dmigs mi 'gyur/ /mun nag rab rib kyis khebs pa/ /drin gyis snang ba thob par 'gyur/ /stong nyid shin tu stong pa dang / /gsum pa chen po stong pa dang / /bzhi pa thams cad stong pa ni/ /rgyu dang 'bras bu'i bye brag go/ /shes rab thabs su sbyor ba las//18—136

rdzogs pa ①nye bar thob par 'gyur/ /rdzogs pa ④nye bar thob gyur nas/ /thams cad stong pa 'od gsal ba/ /rgyu yi rim pa rnam dag pa/ /rnam shes gsum po spyor ba 1dang / /stong pa gsum ni mnyam spyor bas/ /bla med go 'phang thob par 'gyur/ /snang ba stong pa shes rab dang / /sems dang gzhan gyi dbang dag ste/ /de yi rang bzhin 'phro gsal ba/ /da ni rab tu bshad par bya/ /chags bral dang ni bar ma nyid/ /de bzhin du ni chen po dag /yid la 'gro zhing 'ong ba dang / /mya ngan la sogs gsum de bzhin/ /zhi dang rnam rtog 'jigs pa dang / /'jigs pa bar dang shin tu 'jigs/ /sred dang sred pa bar ma dang / /shin tu sred dang nyer len pa/ /mi dge bkres dang skom nyid dang / /tshor dang tshor ba bar ma dang / /shin tu tshor ba'i skad cig dang / /rig pa po dang rig 'dzin bzhi/ /so sor rtog ④dang ngo tsha shes/ /snying rje dang ni brtse ba gsum/ /dogs dang bsam pa nyid dang ni/ /phrag dog ces ni bya bar grags/ /rang bzhin sum cu rtsa gsum gang / /lus can rnams kyi rang rig ste/ /kun rdzob gsal ba'i gzugs kyis ni/ /mtshan mo'i ming du nges par bshad/ /de bzhin bud med ming du brjod/ /'jam po lta bu'ang de bzhin no/ /g.yon pa'i ming yang de nyid de/ /zla ba'i dkyil 'khor padma can/ /brtan par bya ba'i rgyur gyur pa/ /dang po'i yi ge thig ler bcas//zla ba'i 'od zer ltar snang zhing / /snang ba'i ye shes yang dag 'byung / /shin tu stong pa thabs ldan pa/ /snang ba mched pa zhes brjod de/ /de bzhin du ni kun brtags ⑤dang / /de bzhin sems las byung bar bshad/ /chags dang zhen dang de bzhin dga'/ /dga' ba bar ma shin tu dga'/ /rangs dang 18—137

rab tu mgu ba dang / /ngo mtshar de bzhin dgod ①pa dang / /tshim dang de bzhin 'khyud pa dang / /'o byed de bzhin 'jib pa dang / /brtan dang brtson dang nga rgyal dang / /bya dang 'phrog dang stobs dang ni/ /spro dang lhan cig skyes nyid dang / /de bzhin lhan skyes bar ma dang / /shin tu lhan cig skyes dang grag ṭu /rnam par sgeg dang zhe ④'gras nyid/ /dge dang tshig gsal bden pa dang / /mi bden pa dang de bzhin nges/ /nye bar mi len sbyin pa'o//skul dang de bzhin dpa' bo dang / /ngo tsha med dang sgyu dang gdug /mi srun pa dang gya gyu nyid/ /mtshan nyid bzhi bcu gang yin pa/ /shin tu stong pa'i skad cig ste/ /nyin mo skyes pa'i ming dang ni/ /rtsub mo g.yas par bstan pa yin / /nyi ma'i dkyil 'khor ming dang ni/ /de bzhin du ni rdo rje'i ming / /thig le gnyis kyis ④brgyan pa yi/ /cha ru de nyid shes par bya/ /nyi ma'i 'od zer 'dra ba yang / /snang ba mched pa'i sbyor las byung / /snang ba thob pa dag dang ni/ /nye bar thob pa de bzhin te/ /yongs su grub pa nyid dang ni/ /ma rig pa ni nyid ces bya/ /stong pa chen po'i tshig gis ayoni/ /rnam grangs 'di dag rgyal bas gsungs/ /chags pa bar ma'i skad cig dang / / brjed ngas rjopa dang 'khrul pa dang / /mi smra gyur dang skyo ba dang / /le lo de bzhin the tshom ste—/ /ma rig skad cig bdun po ni/ /phra mo'i rnal 'byor pas shes bya/ /sa bon thig le ldan min la/ /rlung gi sgo nas 'byung ba min/ /gang zhig snang ba thob pa ni/ /yongs su rdzogs pa'i mtshan nyid do/ /rang bzhin phra ba brgya dang ni/ /drug cu tham pa 'di dag nyid/ /rlung gi bzhon pa'i rgyu yis ni/ /nyin dang mtshan du byung ba yin/ /skad cig thang cig yud tsam dang / /mig 18—138

btsums de bzhin thal mo ste/ /skad cig se gol gtogs par bshad/ /thang cig yungs kar bskor ba dang / /yud tsam dbugs rngub 'byung ba tsam /mig btsums ①mig ni btsums pa'i bar/ /thal mo lag gnyis brdabs pa ste/ /skad cig la sogs mtshan nyid do/ /rang rig tsam gyi steye shes ni/ /nam mkha' lta bur mtshan nyid med/ /'on kyang de yi dbye yod de/ /mtshan mo nyin mo mtshams bdag nyid/ /snang dang snang ba mched pa dang / /de bzhin snang ba nyer thob dang / /sems ni rnam pa gsum bshad nas/ /de yi sgrub pa brjod par bya/ /rlung rnams phra ba'i gzugs kyis ni/ /shes dang yang dag 'dres gyur nas/ /dbang po'i lam nas byung ②nas ni/ /yul rnams la ni dmigs par byed/ /gang tshe snang ba ldan gyur cing / /rlung ni bzhon pa nyid gyur pa/ /de tshe rang bzhin de dag kun/ /ma lus lus pa med par 'byung / /rlung ni gang dang gar gnas pa/ /rang bzhin de dang de 'byung 'gyur/ /ji srid rlung ni mi rgyu dang / /snang ba mi g.yo bar gyur pa/ /snang ba gnyis kyi rgyur gyur pas/ /bdag gi dngos po rnam par brtag /ji ltar snang ba thob pa ltar—/ /gnyis ka'i yan lag nyid du 'gyur/ /sgyu ma dag ni thams cad las//bud med sgyu ma khyad par 'phags/ /ye shes gsum gyi dbye ba ni/ /gsal bar 'di las mtshon par 'gyur/ /'dod chags nyid dang chags bral dang / /de yi bar de gsum po ni/ /dbang po gnyis ni mnyam spyor ba'i/ /rdo rje padma 'dus las so/ /ye shes gnyis ni mnyam sbyor las/ /snyoms par 'jug par bshad pa yin/ /ye shes gnyis kyi mnyam sbyor dang / /ji skad bshad pa'i bya ba yis/ /'bad pas ye shes gang thob pa/ /de ni snang ba thob pa'o/ /gang 18—139

zhig chu skyes rdo rje sbyor/ /kun rdzob tu yang med gyur na/ /lan cig tsam zhig myong nas kyang / /rnal 'byor stobs kyis 'grub par 'gyur/ /ye shes 'jug pa'i ngo bo yi nyu/ /dbye ba ji bzhin shes byas la/ /rang bzhin de nyid slar yang ni/ /rtag tu rnal 'byor pas mtshon bya/ /ji ltar sprin ni sna tshogs shing //mdog dang dbyibs ni tha dad pa/ /nam mkha'i dbyings su byung nas ni/ /de nyid du ni thim par 'gyur/ /de bzhin rang bzhin thams cad ni/ /snang ba gsum ni ṭurgyu can te/ /ma lus yul la zhugs nas ni/ /'od gsal par ni zhugs par 'gyur/ /de 'dra'i rang bzhin ma shes pas/ /mi shes mun pas khebs pa ni/ /dge dang mi dge'i las byas nas/ /'gro ba lngar ni 'khor bar 'gyur/ /mtshams med la sogs byas nas ni/ /dmyal la sogs par 'tshed par byed/ /sbyin sogs dge ba byas nas ni/ /mtho ris la sogs dag tu mchod/ /skye ba dpag med stong phrag ni/ /'dir ni yang dang yang 'thob pa /'di bye ni sngon las rnam smin zhes/ /rmongs pa rnams ni mya ngan byed/ /rang bzhin snang ba'i tshul gyis ni/ /gang gis skye bo nyon mongs pa/ /de nyid shes nas ye shes can/ /srid pa'i gzeb las rnam grol 'gyur/ /shes rab ngo bo nyid 'di ni/ /zla ba'i dkyil 'khor dag tu brtag /sems nyid rang gis mthong 'gyur te/ /rang nyid zla ba'i gzugs bzhin no/ /de nas zla ba la dmigs pa/ /rdo rje'i mtshan mar rab tu brtag /'di ni rdo rje las byung ba'i/ /rnal 'byor pa yi thabs su bshad/ /zla ba rdo rje sogs mnyam sbyor/ /sems dang sems byung 'dus pa ste/ /shes rab thabs su 'dus pa las/ /lha yi gzugs ni 'byung bar 'gyur/ /phyag rgya bzhis ni rgyas btab cing / /lha yi 18byed140

nga rgyal 'chang byed de/ /bskyed pa'i rim dang ldan par ni/ /sngags pa rtag tu spyod par 'gyur/ /ji skad dpal ldan 'dus sogs par/ /de dang der ni rgyas gsungs pa'i/ /ji srid sgom la sprur gyur pa/ /de srid dang po'i las can yin/ /da ni yongs rdzogs rnal 'byor gyi/ /gsal ba ru ni bshad bya ste/ /stong pa gsum gyi rnam dag gang / /'od gsal bar ni 'dir bshad do/ /thams cad stong par de brjod de/ /ye shes gsum ni rnam dag pa/ /ye shes dag nas de nyid rtogs/ /thams cad mkhyen pa bla na med/ /'gyur ba med cing snang ba med/ /gnyis med mchog tu zhi ba nyid/ /yod dang de bzhin med pa dang / /de ni tshig gi spyod yul min/ /de nas 'od gsal dag pa la/ /ye shes gsum ni 'byung 'gyur te/ /sum cu rtsa gnyis mtshan 'chang zhing / /dpe byad bzang po brgyad cur gyur/ /rnam pa kun du mchog ldan pa'i/ /thams cad mkhyen par de nas 'gyur/ /de skad du rgya cher 1rol pa'i mdo las/shākya thub pa de bzhin gshegs/ /mngon par byang chub 'di bzhed nas/ /stong pa chen po sangs rgyas nyid/ /thob par bya zhes mngon par dgongs/ /nai raspya na'i chu 'gram du/ /mi g.yo'i ting 'dzin la bzhugs la/ /de'i tshe rgyal ba mkha' rdo rje/ /til gyi gang bu gang bzhin bzhugs/ /rgyal ba'i sras la se gol gtogs/ /de la dbyangs gasbug gis gsungs pa/ /bsam gtan 'di ni rnam dag min/ /'dis ②/ni mthar thug mi 'thob ste/ /nam mkha'i ngos ltar mchog gyur pa/ /'od gsal ba ni de dmigs shing / /'od gsal ba yi gnas thob nas/ /rab dga'i gzugs su skye bar 'gyur/ /de tshe rab dga'i rdo rje'i sku/ /kun gyi mchog ni thob par 'gyur/ /'di ltar sgra de gsan pa 18—141

dang / /de nas ting 'dzin mi g.yo btang / /'di ltar nam phyed dus su ni/ /rgyal ba'i sras kyis de nyid dmigs/ /sku ni drang po ma yin zhing / /mi drang ba yang ma yin la/ /dbugs gtong ba dang rngub pa yis⑨/ /gsung ba ma yin mi gsung min/ /spyan bzang btsums pa ma yin zhing / /spyan phye ba yang ma yin pas / /thams cad stong pa rmad chen po/ /dang zhing gsal ba'i ye shes che/ /bla ma nyid kyi drin gyis ni/ /de nas de ni gsal mthong gyur/ /'das pa dang ni ma 'ongs dang / /da ltar byung ba'i srid pa gsum/ /skad cig de la ma lus mthong / /'od gsal ba ni rnam dag 'chang / /rdo rje lta bu'i ting 'dzin gyis//skya rengs 'char ba'i dus su ni/ /chu zla dang ni smig rgyu sogs/ /sgyu ma'i yon tan rnams kyis brgyan/ /byang chub snying por bzhugs nas ni/ /de ni bdud rnams bcom par mdzad/ /shākya mgon pos yang dag pa'i/ /ye shes bla med legs thob nas/ /'gro ba gsum la phan pa'i phyir/ /de nyid 'dir ni ston par mdzad/ /mngon par byang chub ston pa ni/ /de nyid ye shes zhes byar bshad / /mtshams med lnga yi las can dang / /mi gang bsod nams dman pas kyang / /yid bzhin nor dang 'dra ba gzhanadzu/ /bla ma'i drin gyis thob par 'gyur/ /spyod pa ci dgar ke spyod byed de/ /'di ni ma 'ongs rdzogs sangs rgyas/ /chags min chags dang bral ba min/ /dbu mar yang ni mi dmigs so/ /stong pa ma yin mi stong min/ /dbu mar yang ni mi dmigs so/ /sangs rgyas kun gyi mnyam spyor ba/ /'di nyid ltar 5ni rab ston te/ /ye shes gsum bral de nyid gang / /dgongs pa yis ni gsungs pa yin/ /de bzhin dpal ldan gsang 'dus kyi/ /byang chub sems kyi le'u las/ /dngos med la 18—142

sogs tshigs bcad kyi nyu/ /mngon par byang chub mtshan nyid gsungs/ /'dod chags la sogs rnam dag gang / /dpal mchog las kyang gsungs pa yin//de nyid de bzhin gshegs pas kyang / /thams cad stong par gsungs pa yin/ /sna tshogs mdo dang rgyud las ni/ /de nyid gang zhig nyer bstan pa/ /thams cad stong gnas 'di nyid las/ /der ni gzhan dag ma gsungs so/ /chos phung brgyad khri bzhi stong ni/ /thub pa chen pos gsungs pa las/ /mngon par byang chub mtshan nyid ni/ /snying po las ni snying por gsungs/ /ral pa gcer bu mgo reg gam/ /cod pan 'dus pa spong 'jug ste/ /sna tshogs rtags can de dag ni/ /mngon par byang chub 'dod pa rnams/ /de nyid dman pa de rnams kyis/ /brtul zhugs spyod pa la sogs rim/ /de nyid ye shes dman pas na/ /des ni grol ba rnyed mi 'gyur/ /dang po las kyi sbyor ba yis/ /sa brgyad pa ni thob par 'gyur/ /snang ba gsum pos mthong ba dgakye /sa bcu la ni rab tu gnas/ /mngon par byang chub legs thob nas/ /gtsang ma'i gnas su nye bar 'gro/ /sangs rgyas zhing nas mi ldog pas/ /tshe 'di nyid kyi zu thams cad mkhyen/ /chos 'byung mngon par byang chub pa'i/ /chags sogs rol mo rgya chen po/ /chos dbyings mngon par byang chub pa/ /ji ltar rnyed pa'i spyod pas so/ /mngon par rtogs pa gang 'byung ba/ /bla med mngon par byang chub pa/ /spros bcas la sogs spyod pa yis/ /rnal 'byor pa ni 'dir slob po/ /gzod ④nas dag pa'i rang bzhin can/ /ngo bo nyid kyis de grub na//bslab pa'i sbyor bas ⑤ci zhig bya/ /rtog las de bzhin nyid mi skye/ /gang zhig de ltar 'dir rtog na/ /ye shes rim pa spangs pa nyid/ /de yi dbye ba mi shes 18—143

pas / /slar yang slob par 'gyur ba yin/ /rang bzhin snang ba'i dbye shes shing / /de nyid bzhi pa la brten kyang / /gang zhig rnam gsum mi slob na/ /des ni 'bras bu thob mi 'gyur/ /ji ltar shing la me gnas pa/ /ma gtsubs ①par ni 'byung mi 'gyur/ /de bzhin byang chub babeeb bral bas/ /tshe 'di nyid la 'byung mi 'gyur/ /gang zhig g.yo sgyu'i blo can le lo can dag dang / /bla ma la smod dbang bskur thob ces zlas sems 'gyur/ /blo dman sems ldan kun mkhyen yang dag thob mi 'gyur/ /nyon mongs bla ma'i skyon rnams mthong gi yon tan min/ /bsnyen bkur med par myur du de nyid thob par 'dod/ /yang dag tshig ma yin zhes khro bcas g.yo bar 'gyur/ /tshogs nang bla ma mthong na rgyab kyis phyogs par byed/ /de nas de ni dben par song nas phyag byed 'gyur//de ltar rang bzhin ngan gyur dman pa'i slob ma ni/ /rang gi slob bu yin yang gzhan bzhin yongs su spang rju/ /rgyal rigs rje'u rigs mchog las skyes par 3gyur pa yang / /brtan par pya nam yang de nas drung du gzhag ⑤mi bya/ /yon tan mchog ldan ye shes brtson par bcas pa dang/ /yang na bla ma la gus sangs rgyas dang mnyam lta/ /rgyal ba'i chos rnams rtogs shing bstan la shin tu dad/ /de 'dir snod gyur yin phyir de la drin sbyin bya/ /rgyud mang rab tu thos shing lung la legs sbyangs kyang / /bla ma'i bsnyen bkur dman phyir lung thob ma gyur pa—/ /de ni bdag phan tsam la'ang dbang med bstan pa'i mchu/ /de yi bstan bcos skyo ba'i rgyu tsam 'ba' zhig yin/ /skal ldan gyur cing de nyid man ngag thob gyur kyang / /gang zhig blo gros blun min don ni sbyor nus pa/ /gzhan don bya ba'i blo yis ston la rab tu 'jug /tshig gi yon tan med na de 18—144

yang brnyas bcas 'gyur/ /rgyud mang thos shing shes ldan gnas drug shes pa dang / /dran dang blo gros brtan blo brtson pa phun tshogs ldan/ /bla ma'i zhabs bkur bcas shing de nyid lung thob pa/ /rgyud rgyal man ngag de la bstan par 'os pa yin/ /'phags pa rdo rje'i drin gyis rgyud rnams mang po thos/ /gsal ba rnam spras tshig gis byang chub lam ni rnam phye bas/ /shākya bshes gnyen kyis ni dge ba gang bsags des/ /mkhas shing gsal ba'i rnam smin byang chub snod gyur shog /ming gi khyad par gzhan yang bla na med pa'i dgongs pa zhes bya ba thams cad dag cing rnam par dag pa'i rim pa slob dbon shākya bshes gnyen gyis mdzad pa ste rim pa gnyis pa'o// //rdo rje can rnams kun gyi gtso/ /rdo rje che la phyag 'tshal te/ /bdag la byin gyis brlab pa'i rim ①/ /brtse bas bdag gis bshad par bya/ /de la dang por bskyed pa'i rim pa'i ②rjes su 'brang bas dbang bskur ba thob cing /rgyud rnam pa bzhi'i dgongs pa shes pa/ shes rab dang ldan zhing lus dang /ngag dang / yid rnam par dben pa'i thos pa 'dzin pa/ bden pa rnam pa gnyis la lhag par mos pas rdo rje slob dpon yang dag par mnyes par byas te de'i 'og tu bla ma mnyes par gyur nas tshogs kyi mchod pa chen bo byas la lo bcu drug ma rdo rje slob dpon chen po la phul te/ de'i 'og tu bla ma'i zhal snga nas bdag la byin gyis brlab pa'i rim pa'i man ngag thob nas/ de'i 'og tu phreng ba dang chu dang rdzogs pa'i sangs rgyas dang rdo rje dang dril bu sbyin pa rdume long dang ming dang slob dpon dang rjes su gnang ba ste/ de dag dang bcas par gsang 18—145

ba'i dbang bskur ba thob nas bstod pa 'dis bla ma la bstod par bya'o/ /khong stong khyod kyi sku la med/ /sha dang rus pa khrag med kyang / /nam mkha' la ni 'ja' tshon ltar/ /khyod kyi sku ni ston par mdzad/ /sku la bsnyun med mi gtsang med/ /bkres dang skom pa 'byung med kyang / /khyod ni 'jig rten rjes 'jug phyir/ /'jig rten bya ba ston par mdzad/ /chu zla bzhin du gzung du med / /chos rnams kun la gnas pa med/ /nga rgyal med cing rmongs mi mnga'—/ /dmigs med khyod la phyag 'tshal lo/ /gshegs dang bzhugs dang de bzhin gzims/ /spyod lam dag ni thams cad du/ /khyed ni rtag tu mnyam 'jog pa/ /mi dmigs khrod la phyag 'tshal lo/ /sgyu ma lta bu'i ting 'dzin gyis//rdzu 'phrul che la rnam 'phrul zhing / /sna tshogs min la snyems 'jug pa/ /dmigs med khyod la phyag 'tshal lo/ /de ltar rdo rje slob dpon la yang dag pa'i bstod pas bstod nas tshigs su bcad pa 'dis mnyan par bya ba'i phyir gsol ba gdab par bya'o/ /kun mkhyen ye shes phung po can/ /srid pa'i 'khor lo rnam sbyong ba/ /de ring bshad pa'i rin chen gyis/ /gtso bo 1/bdag la bka' drin stsol/ /khyod zhabs padma spangs nas ni/ /gtso bo gzhan la skyabs ma mchis / /'gro ba'i dpa' bo thub chen gyis/ /de bas blo mchog mnyes par mdzod—/ /de ltar 'jigs med gsol 'debs pa'i/ /tshig dag thos par gyur nas ni/ /snying rje slob ma la bskyed de/ /de nas bdag la byin brlab snebartsam / /bdag byin brlab gepa'i rim zhes pa/ /kun rdzob bden pa bstan pa ste/ /de ni bla ma'i drin dag gis/ /'thob par 'gyur gyi gzhan du min/ /bdag la byin kyis brlab pa'i rim/ /gang gis rnyed par ma gyur pas/ /mdo 18byed146

sde rgyud dang rtog pa la/ /de yi ngal ba don med 'gyur/ /bdag la byin brlab rim thob pa'i/ /gtso bo sangs rgyas kun bdag nyid/ /tshe 'di nyid du sangs rgyas ni/ /the tshom med par thob par 'gyur/ /bdag byin brlab pa'i ting 'dzin dang / /de bzhin 'od gsal ba yi gnas/ /rgyu dang 'bras bu'i khyad par gyis/ /bden pa gnyis su bstan pa yin/ /bdag byin brlab pa'i rim gyis ni/ /'od gsal ba ni thob par 'gyur/ /de bas rdo rje slob dpon gyis—/ /dang por bdag la byin brlab bstan/ /'gro kun rang dbang med pa ste/ /rang dbang du ni 'byung ma yin/ /de yi rgyu ni 'od gsal ba/ /'od gsal thams cad stong pa'o/ /sems gang gis ni byis pa rnams/ /'khor bar 'ching bas bcings ①gyur pa/ /sems de nyid kyis rnal 'byor pa/ /bde gshegs gnas su 'gro bar 'gyur/ /'dir ni gang yang skye ba med/ /gang yang 'chi ba yod ma yin/ /sems kyi rang bzhin rnam gnas par/ /'khor ba nyid ni shes par bya/ /rlung gi sbyor ba med par ni/ /sems kyi rang bzhin gzung du med/ /sems kyi rang bzhin rgyur gyur pa/ /las dang skye ba kun du 'byung / /de nyid rlung dang yang dag ldan/ /rnam shes gsum po slar yang ni/ /rnal 'byor pa yi lus su 'byung / /sgyu ma'i lus zhes de la bshad/ /de bas 'di ltar 'gro ba kun/ /sgyu ma lta bur 'dir bshad de/ /sgyu ma lta bu'i ting 'dzin gnas/ /thams cad de dang 'dra bar mthong / /gzugs dang tshor ba nyid dang ni/ /'du shes dang ni 'du byed rnams/ /lnga pa rnam par shes pa dang / /de bzhin khams ni bzhi po dang / /mig la sogs dang yul rnams nyid/ /shes pa lnga po nyid dag ste/ /phyi dang nang du rnam phye ba/ /18—147

thams cad sgyu ma las gzhan min/ /me long nang gi gzugs brnyan gyis/ /sgyu ma'i lus ni shes par bya/ /kha dog rnams ni 'ja' lta bu/ /khyab pa chu yi zla bas so/ /dngos dang dngos min las grol ba/ /rdo rje sems dpa' legs bris pa/ /me long dri ma med pa la/ /gzugs brnyan gsal bar snang dang mtshungs—/ /rnam pa kun gyi lhamachog ldan pa'i/ /sku ni blta bas mi ngoms pa/ /slob ma bzang po de la bstan/ /bdag byin brlab ces de bshad do/ /sgyu mar bstan pa'i mtshan nyid kyis/ /'di nyid nye bar mtshon pa ste/ /kun rdzob bden pa'i sgyu ma nyid/ /longs spyod rdzogs pa'i sku yang de/ /de nyid dri za'i sems can gyur/ /rdo rje'i sku yang de nyid yin/ /rdo rje sems dpa' bdag nyid de/ /de bas bdag nyid mchod la 'jug /bdag nyid sangs rgyas thams cad dang / /byang chub sems dpa' thams cad nyid/ /de bas kun nas 'bad pa yis/ /bdag nyid rtag tu mchod par bya/ /sngags dang phyag rgya'i spyor ba dang / /dkyil 'khor la sogs rnam rtog dang / /sbyin sreg gtor ma la sogs kun/ /rtag tu sgyu ma bzhin du bya/ /zhi ba dang ni rgyas pa dang / /de bzhin dbang dang mngon spyod dang / /dgug sogs gang ci'ang rung ba kun/ /dbang po'i gzhu dang mtshungs par bya/ /sgeg dang nye bar longs spyod dang / /glu dang rol mo sogs bsten dang / /sgyu rtsal rnams la rab 'jug pa/ /chu zla dag dang mtshungs par bya/ /gzugs dang sgra dang de bzhin dri/ /ro dang reg bya nyid dag la/ /mig la sogs pa 'jug 'gyur ba/ /sgyu ma lta bur nye bar brtag /rdo rje theg pa de nyid du/ /'dir ni mang du bshad ci dgos/ /rnal 'byor pas ni gang gang dmigs/ /de de sgyu ma bzhin 18—148

du brtag /me long gi ni gzugs brnyan dang / /rmi lam sgyu ma chu bur dang / /mig 'phrul mtshungs par gang gis mthong / /de ni gtso bo yin par bshad/ /mthong ba dang ni reg dhipa nyid/ /'gro ba sgyu ma ji bzhin te/ /dmigs med kun rdzob dag tu ni/ /sgyu ma lta bur rab tu bshad/ /dbang po gang dang gang lam gyur/ /de dang de yi ngo bor bya/ /mnyam par ma gzhag sbyor ba yis/ /sangs rgyas kun dang mnyam par sbyor/ /kun du kun nas thams cad dang / /bdag nyid rtag tu rnam pa kun/ /sangs rgyas kun bdag dngos grub ni/ /rang nyid kyis ni de mthong 'gyur/ /gtso bo bde ba kun rang bzhin/ /sems dpa' chen po 'gro dang bzhugs/ /gnas dang zas dang gos la sogs/ /mkha' la skad cig dag gis rnyed/ /srid pa gcod par 'gyur ba dang / /'gro la rab mchog ston par 'gyur/ /lha dang bcas pa kun gyis mchod/ /yang dang yang du phyag byed 'gyur/ /ji ltar ston pa rdzogs sangs rgyas/ /'jig rten phan par bzhed pas gshegs/ /de bzhin rnal 'byor chen po ni/ /sna tshogs ye shes rjes su sdud/ /rdo rje sems dpa' mtshon pas na/ /bsgrub par mi bya ci yang med/ /bde chen phyag rgya chen po ni/ /rang nyid rjes su 'grub 1 par 'gyur/ /las dang nyon mongs las can lus/ /byed pa po dang 'bras bu nyid/ /smig rgyu rmi lam lta bu dang / /dri za'i grong khyer dag dang mtshungs—/ /'di 'dra'i ting 'dzin mi shes pas/ /dngos po la ni nyer dmigs te/ /'dod chags sna tshogs skyes pa rnams/ /de dag sgyu ma'i sman gyis ④gso/ /bdag byin brlab pa'i man ngag dag /gang gis bla ma las ma bsgrubs④—/ /rtag dang chad pa la dmigs pas/ /mi de phyir ldog 'gyur ba 18—149

yin / /mchod pa thams cad spangs nas ni/ /bla ma la mchod yang dag brtsam1—/ /de mnyes pas ni kun mkhyen pa'i/ /ye shes mchog ni thob par 'gyur / /bla med byed pa slob dpon gyi/ /rdo rje sems dpa' mchod byas nas / /de yi bsod nams ma byas ci/ /dka' thub ma bsten ②gang zhig yod/ /de nyid mi zad 'dod pa yis/ /shin tu dga' ba gang dang gang / /shin tu khyad par can nyid de/ /de dang de ni bla mar ④sbyin/ /slob dpon gyis ni sdig pa 'phrog /slob dpon gyis ni 'jigs pa sel/ /slob dpon gyis ni sdug bsngal gyi/ /rgya mtsho'i 'jigs las pha rol bsgral④/ /gang zhig nga rgyal gyis sbags shing / /yang dag rim pa sun 'byin dang / /de nyid chos la brnyas bcas phyopa/ /de las de nyid bstan mi bya/ /bla ma la gus bden par smra/ /rnam par mkhas shing rgyud gcig la/ /dam tshig spyod pa bsrung ba dag /rim pa de la bstan par bya/ /bdag la byin byus brlab pa'i rim pa slob dpon klu sgrub kyi zhal snga nas mdzad pa ste rim pa gsum pa'o// //thams cad stong pa nyid ston pas/ /rdo rje sems dpa' phyag byas te/ /bzhi pa mngon par byang chub pa'i/ /rim 'di bdag gis bshad par bya/ /'di ni rang byung bcom ldan 'das/ /gcig pu bdag nyid che ba'i lha/ /man ngag rnams ni rab ster bas/ /rdo rje slob dpon de bas lhag /de ni yang dag mnyes byas te/ /lo'am yang na zla ba la/ /bla ma de ni mnyes byas la/ /ci nus pas ni mchod par bya/ /ci 'byor pa yi phyag rgya ni/ /legs par bslabs la dbul bya zhing / /tshogs kyi dkyil 'khor dbus su ni/ /cho ga ji 18—150

bzhin mchod par bya/ /de nas 'dod yon lnga spyod pas/ /rnal 'byor chen po mnyes gyur te/ /snyoms par 'jug pa'i cho ga yis/ /snang ba dag ni bskyed par bya/ /byang chub sems ni rab 'bad pas/ /ka la sha sogs dag tu gzhagakye /slob ma bzang la bla ma yis/ /brtse bas nam phyed dus dbang bskur/ /dbang bskur yang dag thob nas ni/ /tho rangs kyi ni dus su yang / /slob mas thal sbyar bla ma la/ /mchod cing bstod pas mnyes par bya/ /khams gsum las ni rnam grol zhing / /nam mkha' dang ni mnyam gyur la/ /'dod pa rnams kyis ma gos pa/ /dmigs med khyod la phyag 'tshal lo/ /phung po rnams dang khams rnams dang / /skye mched rnams la mi brten cing / /phyin ci log las rnam grol ba/ /dmigs med khyod la phyag 'tshal lo/ /rnam rtog med cing kun rtog med—/ /thugs ni rab tu mi gnas pa/ /bsam gyis mi khyab pa yi thugs/ /dmigs med khrod la phyag 'tshal lo/ /ji ltar nam mkha' gnas med cing / /spros med gos pa med pa ltar/ /mkha' dang mnyam pa'i thugs mnga' ba/ /dmigs med khyod la phyag 'tshal lo/ /thams cad stong pa'i rang bzhin can/ /mngon par byang chub lta bar 'tshal/ /slob mas thal sbyar bla ma la/ /bstod nas slar yang bskul bar bya/ /las dang skye las rnam grol zhing / /snang ba gsum po spangs pa yi/ /mngon par byang chub mthong bar da/ni/ /mgon po chen po bdag 'tshal lo zhu/ /sangs rgyas kun gyi ye shes che/ /de bzhin gshegs pa kun gyi gnas/ /rdo rje ye shes bla na med/ /slob dpon chen po bdag ④'tshal lo/ /thog mtha' med cing zhi ba dang / /nyon mongs thams cad rnam sbyong zhing / /lus dang ngag dang sems sbyong ba/ /rdo rje chen po 18—151

bdag tsho'atshal lo/ /de ltar yon tan yang dag pa/ /brjod pas rnal 'byor pas mnyes bya/ /snyeng rje slob ma la bskyed de/ /de nas rim pa 'di nyid brtsam / /mtshan mo snang ba'i cha ste gsal ba rtenyi ma'i zer 'gyed snang ba mched pa yin/ /mtshams ni snang ba thob par rang gi rang bzhin rnams kyis lan cig min par 'gro/ /mtshan min nyin par ma yin mtshams min gang zhig rang bzhin rnams dang rnam bral ba/ /de ni byang chub skad cig yin par bla ma mchog bshad rnal 'byor pa nyid yul/ /mtshams kyi mtha' ni 'jig min mun nag tshogs ni ma lus gang du 'das pa dang / /ji srid nyi ma ma tsashar skad cig 'dir ni dri med yang dag mtha' ru bshad/ /slob dpon mchog ni rab rib bral bas slob ma la ni phyi rol byang chub bstan/ /nang gi bde ba rnyog bral sangs rgyas byang chub skad cig dag gis thob par 'gyur/ /tha mar 'byung dang thog mar 'byung ba'am/ /dbus min 'byung ba'am dbus su 'byung ba'am/ /mtha' min 'byung ba'am mthar ni 'byung ba rnams/ /de dag thams cad stong par dam pas gsungs/ /gang du 'gro ba dang ni 'ong med cing / /zad dang 'phel med dngos dang dngos med min/ /ngo mtshar gzugs can yin zhing ngo mdzar min/ /gnas par 'gyur min myur du 'gro ba min/ /gang zhig yod dang med pa'i tha snyad rnams dang bral/ /bsod nams gzugs min sdig pa'i gzugs ma yin/ /bsod nams sdig gi bdag min mchog gyur pa/ /de ni thams cad stong par sangs rgyas rnams kyis gsungs/ /rnal 'byor pas ni phyede lta'i de nyid thob/ /rgyu dang mi rgyu'i bdag nyid 'gro gnyen ṭugacig /ye shes rang bzhin mi yi seng ge gang / /mi zad lus thob ma lus 'gro ba'i rgyu/ /de 18—152

ni yon po'i lus kyang drang po yin/ /stan nyul gnas med gyur kyang gnas pa yin—/ /de ni mig btsums gyur kyang rnam rgyas yin/ /de ni mnyam ma bzhag du kyang mnyam gzhag yin/ /de ni tshig dang ldan yang brjod bral yin/ /de ni longs spyod ldan yang gzung bral yin/ /de ni 'jig rten mgon yang gzhan bral 'gyur/ /gang zhig de nyid rtogs shing nyes kun zad/ /man ngag thob pa'i slob ma yis/ /de nas rnal 'byor rnam gnyis bslab/ /ril por 'dzin pa'i rim pa dang / /de bzhin rjes su gzhig pa'o/ /mgo bo nas ni rkang pa'i bar—/ /ji srid snying gar phyin pa'i bar/ /rnal 'byor yang dag mtha' la 'jug /ril por 'dzin pa zhes bshad do zu/ /rgyu ba dang ni mi rgyu nyid/ /dang po 'od gsal bar bya ste/ /phyi nas de bzhin bdag nyid byed/ /rjes su gzhag ④pa'i rim pa yin/ /dbugs snye kyi rlung ni me long la/ /ji ltar kun du thim gyur pa/ /de bzhin rnal 'byor yang dag mtharatre/ /yang dang yang du 'jug par byed/ /'go dang 'dug dang nyal dang za/ /mig btsums 'byed dang dgod pa na/ /bsam gtan sbyor ba 'di yis ni/ /de nyid rig pa rtag tu gnas/ /gzugs bcas 'od zer de dang de/ /rnam shes rlung dang ldan pa yi—/ /bdag byin brlab pa'i rim gyis kyang / /sems can don du'ang lan 'ga' ④'gyur/ /ji ltar dang ba'i chu klung las/ /nya dag myur du ldang ba ltar/ /de bzhin thams cad stong gsal las/ /sgyu 'phrul dra ba 'byung bar 'gyur/ /rigs lnga'i sangs rgyas la ltos ༄shepa'i/ /phyag rgya chen por brtag pa ni/ /'od zer lnga yi tū'abyung ba dag /nam mkha'i 'ja' tshon dag dang mtshungs/ /phyag rgya 'ching bar byed pa'am/ /gal te gsang sngags zlos pa'am/ /gang 18—153

gzhan thams cad byed pa na/ /thams cad stong pa'i gzhi la gnas/ /thams cad za zhing kun la lta1/ /kun la phyag byed kun du 'gro/ /thams cad byed pa'i mtshan ma can/ /thams cad stong pas 'grub par 'gyur/ /byang chub sems ni don dam zhes bya ba/ /skal bzang slob ma bzang pos man ngag thob/ /thal mo sbyar nas me tog 'dzin pa yi/ /bla ma las ni slar yang blang bar bya/ /dngos po kun dang rnam bral zhing / /phung po khams dang skye mched dang / /gzung dang 'dzin pa rnam spangs pa/ /chos bdag med dang mnyam med pa/ /rang sems gzod pya nas ma skyes pa/ /stong pa nyid kyi ngo bo nyid/ /de nas rjes su mthun pa'i yon/ /bla ma la ni dbul bya ste/ /rin chen khyim dang glang po rta/ /yul dang mal stan dag dang ni/ /bran pho bran ④chung ma sdug /bu mo shin tu yid 'ong dang / /gang gis bdag kyang dbul bya na/ /lhag ma rnams lta smos ci dgos/ /slob dpon la ni drin thob dri med brtan pa'i blo ldan dngos kun bdag /gsal dag shin tu phra ba mchog zhi'i rang bzhin sangs rgyas mya ngan 'das pa'i khams/ /gnyis med rtog bral rtag tu bde ba'i rang bzhin de nyid rnal 'byor pas bsgom bya/ /bsod nams bsod nams min grol rang nyid 'dir ni bcom ldan rdo rje sems dpar 'gyur/ /mchog tu gsang ba'i bde ba mngon par byang chub pa'i rim pa ste slob dpon klu sgrub kyi zhal snga nas mdzad pa ste ṣyorim pa bzhi pa'o// //mgon po sangs rgyas kun bdag nyid/ /gnyis pa thams cad rnam spangs la—/ /phyag 'tshal nas ni zung 'jug pa'i/ /rim pa tha ma bri bar bya/ /18—154

'khor ba dang ni mya ngan 'das/ /rtog pa gnyis po spangs pas na/ /gang du dngos po gcig gyur pa/ /zung du 'jug ces de la bshad/ /kun ⑫nyon mongs dang ⑤rnam par byang / /don dam nyid du shes nas ni/ /gang gis gcig tu shes gyur ④pa/ /de yis zung du 'jug par shes/ /dngos po rnam bcas kun rtog dang / /dngos po med par rtog pa dag /rnal 'byor pas ni cig car spyod/ /de ni zung 'jug shes pa'o/ /gzung ba dang ni 'dzin pa zhes//rnam gnyis blo ni yod min gyi/ /gang du mi phyed blo yod pa/ /de ni zung 'jug ces byar bshad/ /rtag dang chad pa'i blo dag ni/ /gang gis spangs nas gnas pa yi/ /zung du 'jug pa'i rim 'di yi/ /de nyid shes te mkhas pa yin—/ /shes rab snying rje gcig par ni/ /shes nas gang du 'jug gyur pa/ /zung 'jug ces byar bshad pa ste/ /rim 'di sangs rgyas spyod yul lo/ /thabs dang shes rab snyoms 'jug par/ /thams cad bsnyus las shes gyur pa/ /rnal 'byor chen po gang du gnas/ /de ni zung du 'jug par 'gyur/ /gang du lhag mar bcas pa dang / /de bzhin lhag ma med pa zhes/ /'di lta'i rtog pa med gyur pa/ /de ni zung du 'jug pa'o/ /gang du gang zag bdag med dang //chos la bdag med pa dag gi/ /rtog pa gnyis las rnam grol ba/ /zung du 'jug pa'i mtshan nyid do/ /de nyid shes pa'i rim shes nas/ /bdag byin brlab pa'i 'od gsal la/ /de nyid la ni 'dus pa gang / /zung du 'jug pa'i rim 'di yin/ /ril ④por 'dzin dang rjes zhig phye dang / /'jug dang de bzhin gnas pa dang / /de nas gang du ldang gyur pa/ /mnyam gyur zung du 'jug pa'o/ /kun rdzob dang ni don dam dag /so so'i char ni shes gyur pa/ /18—155

gang du yang dag 'dres gyur pa/ /zung du 'jug par de bshad do/ /de bzhin nyid la dmigs nyid dang / /gang du ldang bar gyur pa ni/ /zung du 'jug pa de yin te/ /mi zad rnal 'byor pa yi gnas/ /gnyid log dang ni sad pa ste/ /gnas skabs de gnyis spangs pa ni/ /gnyid log sad dang rnam bral ba/ /zung 'jug yin par ston pas gsungs/ /mnyam par bzhag dang ma bzhag pa/ /gang la 'di dag thams cad med/ /dngos dang dngos med rnam spangs pa/ /rnal 'byor pa ni zung 'jug gnas/ /dran dang mi dran las grol zhing / /rtag tu 'byung ba'i mtshan nyid can/ /rnal 'byor pa ni 'dod bzhin spyod/ /zung 'jug rim pa la gnas pa'o/ /chags dang chags min las grol zhing / /mchog tu dga' ba'i lus dang ldan/ /'khor ba srid du gnas byed pa/ /zung 'jug rnam par bsgom pa'o/ /bya ba dang ni byed pa dang / /mi phyed pa yi ngo bo nyid/ /gnas gang ①rnal 'byor pas shes pa/ /zung du 'jug par de bshad do/ /bskyed pa'i rim pa 'di gcig yin/ /gzhan yang rdzogs pa'i rim pa dag /gnyis po gang du gcig gyur pa/ /de ni zung du 'jug par bshad/ /yongs su dag pa'i lha dang ni/ /'dir ni ma dag par gyur duzhes/ /gang zhig mi phyed par rtog 3 pa/ /gang yin de ni zung 'jug pa'o/ /gzugs can dang ni gzugs med ces/ /rtog pa gnyis po spangs pas na④/ /gang zhig zhi rtogs rnal 'byor dbang / /de ni zung 'jug thob pa'o/ /da spultar gang gnas rnal 'byor pa'o/ /zung 'jug rim la gnas pa ste/ /de ni kun mkhyen de nyid mthong / /sna tshogs 'dzin ces brjod pa yin/ /sgyu 'phrul dra bas mngon sangs rgyas/ /'khor ba'i rgya mtsho'i 18—156

pha rol son/ /bya ba byas pa'i rnal 'byor che/ /bden pa gnyis kyi tshul la gnas—/ /de nyid gnyis med ye shes te/ /mi gnas mya ngan 'das pa yin/ /sangs rgyas rdo rje sems dpa' nyid/ /de bzhin kun gyi dbang phyug yin/ /rdo rje lta bu'i ting 'dzin yang / /rdzogs pa'i rim gnas de nyid de/ /sgyu ma lta bu'i ting 'dzin dang / /gnyis su med par de bshad do/ /tshosgra gang skye med la sogs pa/ /gnyis med ye shes ston pa rnams/ /thams cad 'di yi tshig yin te/ /der ni gzhan dag med par bshad/ /gaṅgā klung gi bye snyed kyi/ /sangs rgyas rnams kyis 'di dag nyid/ /thugs chud yod med phyogs spangs pa/ /phyag rgya chen po'i bdag nyid sgruba.e/ /zung 'jug go 'phang la gnas pa'i/ /slob bzhin pa yi rnal 'byor che/ /zung du 'jug pa bsgoms gyur pas/ /spyod pa'ang de dang gnyis su med/ /ji ltar bdag nyid de bzhin dgra/ /chung ma de bzhin mna' ma dang / /ji ltar smad 'tshong de bzhin ma/ /ji ltar bram ze de bzhin gdol/ /ji ltar pags pa de bzhin gos/ /ji ltar rin chen phub ma dang / /ji ltar chang dang 5de bzhin gci/ /ji ltar bza' ba de bzhin bshang—/ /ji ltar dri bzang ga bur dag /de bzhin bshang las byung ba'i dri/ /ji ltar bstod pa byed pa'i tshig /de bzhin du ni smod pa'i tshig /drag po rdo rje can de bzhin/ /ji ltar nyin mo de bzhin mtshan/ /ji ④ltar rmi lam de bzhin mthong / /ji ltar 'jig pa de bzhin gnas/ /ji ltar bde ba de bzhin sdug /ji ltar sdang ba de bzhin bu3/ /mnar med mtho ris de bzhin te—/ /de bzhin sdig dang bsod nams so/ /de ltar shes nas ye shes can/ /rtog trepa med par thams cad byed/ /sbas pa'i brtul zhugs kun bsgrubs na/ /18—157

phun sum tshogs pa thams cad 'grub/ /mchog gyur rim pa lnga pa 'di/ /bshad nas bsod nams gang thob pas/ /zung du 'jug pa'i ting nge 'dzin/ /'di yis 'jig rten rol par shog /zung du 'jug pa'i rim pa slob dpon klu sgrub kyi zhal snga nas mdzad pa ste rim pa lnga pa rdzogs so// //'phags pas mdzad pa'i rdzogs tshul rim pa lnga/ /lam lnga sbyang phyir bla ma'i bka' bsgyur 1bas/ /sgrib pa lnga bral ye shes lnga thob ste/ /sku lnga mngon shes lngar ldan sangs rgyas shog /rgya gar gyi mkhan po ā tsārya shraddhā 'uka ra warma dang /zhu chen gyi lo tsā ba bande rin chen bzang pos bsgyur cing zhus te/ beed kyi rgya gar gyi mkhan po ka ma zhul gupta dang / lo tsā ba rin chen bzang pos ④yul dbus kyi dpe dang yang gtugs te gtan la phab pa'o// //bsdur mchan/129 nyumatshan byang 'di chos tshan 'di'i mtshan bod skad du smos pa ltar bkod cing / 〈〈pe 〉sko〈snar 〉'am pa lnga pa slob dpon chen po klu sgrub kyi zhal snga nas mdzad pa bzhugs so// khye〈〈pe 〉sngagazhon/ snye〈〈pe 〉sko〈snar 〉snga bas/4〈〈pe 〉〉〈〈snar 〉thamatha'/13༷ nyu〈〈pe 〉〉〈〈snar 〉thazung / 3〈〈pe 〉sko〈snar 〉ra/ zhe〈〈pe 〉〉〈〈snar 〉ranas/ ④/〈〈pe 〉sko〈snar 〉thas/1〈〈pe 〉〉〈〈snar 〉〉〉nga /131 —nye〈〈snar 〉thazhag 3〈〈pe 〉〉〈〈snar 〉7ba/ ༄ bye〈〈pe 〉〉〈〈snar 〉zal/ ④〈〈pe 〉〉〈〈snar 〉thong / tre〈〈pe 〉〉〈〈snar 〉rag tre7〈〈pe 〉〉〈〈snar 〉ranyis ka132 lam̐〈〈co 〉phroḥ/ kye〈〈pe 〉snga〈snar 〉thas/ zhu〈〈pe 〉sko〈snar 〉'a tog133 kye〈〈pe 〉〉〈〈snar 〉khicings/ 3〈〈pe 〉〉〈〈snar 〉thacings/ hūṃ〈〈pe 〉〉〈〈snar 〉ra/ ④〈〈pe 〉〉〈〈snar 〉〉phyis/pe〈〈pe 〉〉〈〈snar 〉7sa/ ṭu〈〈pe 〉〉〈〈snar 〉zo/ 3 〈〈pe 〉〉〈〈snar 〉7/18—158

zhu 〈〈pe 〉sko〈snar 〉tham/ (pya〈〈pe 〉sko〈snar 〉〉sgol/⑤〈〈pe 〉sko〈snar 〉thacad/1 51 ①〈〈pe 〉sko〈snar 〉〉bzhag ②〈〈pe 〉〉〈〈snar 〉rab/ ③〈〈pe 〉sko〈snar 〉〉phyag 'tshal/ ④〈〈snar 〉〉 phyag1 52 thochi〈〈snar 〉7phyag 3 〈〈pe 〉〉〈〈snar 〉tha'i/ zhu 〈〈snar 〉7ma/ ④ 〈〈pe 〉sko〈snar 〉'ad/ phyo 〈〈pe 〉thar ni/〈〈snar 〉snga ra na/ ⑪ 〈〈pe 〉sko〈snar 〉sngaganyer/18— 1 59

0705༄ / /spyod pa bsdus pa'i sgon ma/spre /༄spro/ /rgya gar skad du/ tsārya rmyeme lā pa bye na pra dī paṃ/ bod skad du/spyod pa bsdus pa'i sgon ma/ byang chub sems dpa' sems dpa' chen po 'jam dpal ye shes sems dpa' la phyag 'tshal lo/ /dngos med rnam dag nam mkha' mnyam la phyag 'tshal lo/ /ma lus tshig med yi ge bral la phyag 'tshal lo/ /'das dang ma byon kun du son la phyag 'tshal lo/ /kun du ma lus thams cad stong la phyag 'tshal lo/ /rdo rje theg pa 'di la sngags kyi sgor spyod pa ni rnam pa gnyis te/ slob dpon gsang sngags la mchog tu gzhol ba dang / nang la mchog tu gzhol ba ste/ thos pa'i pha rol tu son pa rnams kyis sems can thams cad rjes su gzung bar bya ba'i don du/ mdo sde dang rgyud dang rtogs thu pa dag las yang dag par gsungs pa'i lung gi tshig rnam par gsal bar bya ba'i phyir tshig snyan byung rgya che ba du ma dag bltas nas tshigs su bcad pa dang rkyang pa 18—161

la sogs pa sgra sbas pa rnams dang spel zhing rab tu spel ba rnams kyi rgyud yang dag pa rnams las btus te/ byis pa'i skye bo rnams kyis khong du chud par bya ba'i phyir sgrub pa'i thabs kyi yan lag mar me lta bu byed pa dag sngon byung bar gyur pa ni mi rigs so/ /de ci'i phyir zhe na/ rdzogs ldan dang gsum ldan dang gnyis ldan gyi dus na ni 'jig rten pa rnams tshe dang nad med pa phun sum tshogs shing / sbyin pa dang / tshul khrims la spyod pa la sogs pa kṇiyon tan phun sum tshogs pa dang ldan pa rnams ni bstan bcos la gnas shing yongs su tshol bas de kho na nyid shes pa la mngon par zhugs shing tshig rgya che ba la sogs pa rnams dang / sbas pa'i sgra'i sgo nas de kho na nyid ston la/ de rnams kyis kyang khong du chud pa yin no/ /da ltar ni rtsod pa'i dus te 'jig rten pa rnams tshe dang nad med pa dang / phun sum tshogs pa dman zhing g.yo dang sgyu dang dregs pa dang / phrag dog dang ldan la/ shes rab zhan cing log par lta bas rngo /las ngan pa la sogs pa la dga' bas ji srid du tshig rgya che ba la sogs pa sbas pa'i sgra'i don rnams la nges par mi dga' bas de kho na nyid tshol bar mi byed do/ /de'i phyir na dang po'i bstan bcos yongs su tshol ba spangs pas de kho na nyid mi rtogs shing dge ba dang mi dge ba'i las la mngon par gzhol bas dus byed par 'gyur ro/ /de bas na thar pa thob par 'dod pa rnams la dgos pa med par ④'gyur te/ tshig snyan pa dang rgya che ba la sogs pa'i sdetshig gi sgo la gnas pa'i sgra rnams ni gzings dang 'dra ba yin pa'i phyir ro/ /bcom ldan 'das kyis kyang ji skad du don gyi rjes su 'brang bar bya'i sgra ji bzhin par ma yin no zhes gsungs so/ /phyadon kyi dbang 'di mthong nas bdag gi bye slob dpon klu sgrub kyi 18—162

zhal snga nas kyi man ngag las bskyed pa'i go rims kyis rdzogs pa'i go rims kyi ting nge 'dzin thob nas 'dus byas pa dang 'dus ma byas pa'i slob ma rnams kyi thun mong du bshad pa'i sgra'i sgo nas/ sngags kyi de kho na nyid dang / phyag rgya'i de kho na nyid dang / bdag gi de kho na nyid dang / chos kyi de kho na nyid dang / lha'i de kho na nyid de/ go rims rnam pa lnga rnam par gsal bar bya ba'i phyir mdo sde dang / rgyud dang / rtog pa rnams bsres nas bshad par bya'o / /bcom ldan 'das kyis mdo sde la sogs pa bshad pa'i gsung rab kun las—/ bskal pa bye ba rnams su yang / /de nyid bral na kye'agrub mi 'gyur/ /zhes gsungs te/ ji skad du/ bcom ldan 'das la lha mo bzhis zhus pa zhes bya ba'i rnal 'byor chen po'i rgyud lasarmye/ thub pa chen po'i chos rnams kyi/ /phung po brgyad khri bzhi stong la/ /gang gis de nyid mi shes pa/ /de yi thams cad 'bras bu med/ /ces gsungs pas so/ /rdo rje slob mas gsol pa/ de kho na nyid mi shes par 'tshang rgya bar mi 'gyur ro zhes bcom ldan 'das kyis gsungs na/ yang de kho na nyid ces bya ba'i rang gi mtshan nyid gsung rab kyi sgo nas nyan par 'tshal lo/ /gang gi phyir theg pa chen po pa dang / rtog ge pa la sogs pa rnams ni don 'di nyid la gnas nas rnam pa sna tshogs pas de kho na nyid rtogs par bkyid na/ de rnams bsdu bar bya ba'i phyir de kho na nyid ces bya bsgyu 'di gang yin pa bcom ldan 'das kyis bshad du gsol/ rdo rje slob dpon gyis smras pa/ yang dag pa gang yin pa de ni de bye kho na nyid do/ /gsol pa/bcom ldan 'das yang dag pa zhes bgyi ba de ji lta bu lags/ smras pa/ gang mi slu ba zhes bya ba de ni yang dag pa zhes bya'o/ /gsol pa/ mi slu ba zhes bya 18—163

ba de ji lta bu lags/ smras pa/ shin tu yang dag pa'i tshul gyi nyubadag nyid can gyi ting nge 'dzin de ni mi slu ba zhes bya'o/ /gsol pa/ yang dag pa'i tshul gyi bdag nyid can gyi ting nge 'dzin ces pa de gang lags/ smras pa/gang bden pa gnyis gnyis su med pa'i rnam pa'i mtshan nyid can de ni yang dag pa'i tshul gyi bdag nyid can gyi ting nge 'dzin to/ /gsol pa/ bcom ldan 'das bden pa gnyis zhes bgyi ba de gang lags/ smras pa/ dang po ni kun rdzob kyi bden pa dang / gnyis pa ni don dam pa'i bden pa'o/ /gsol pa/bcom ldan 'das bden pa gnyis kyi mtshan nyid ji lta bu lags/ rdo rje slob dpon gyis smras pa/ bcom ldan 'das kyis rdo rje gtsug tor gyi rgyud las bka' stsal te/ phyag na rdo rjes gsol pa/ bcom ldan 'das chos thams cad kyi gnas don dam pa'i bden pa ji lta bu lags/ bcom ldan 'das kyis bka' stsal pa/ gsang ba'i bdag po chos thams cad ni miphung po dang khams dang skye mched rnams dang / 'gro ba rgyu ba dang mi rgyu ba rnams te/ de yang don dam pa'i bden pa la gnas pas gnas gamed pa'i tshul gyis don dam pa'i bden pa ni bdag med pa zil kyis mi non pa thams cad stong pa ste/ 'phel ba med pa/ 'grib pa med pa/ rnam par dag pa/ nam mkha' dang mnyam pa dang dri ma med pa'i ngo bo nyid/ yi ge med pa/ tshig med pa/ lus chedang ringag dang yid dang bral ba/ yod pa ma yin/ med pa ma yin/ rgyu ba ma yin/mi rgyu ba ma yin/ thag ring ba ma yin/ thag nye ba ma yin/ stong pa ma yin/mi stong pa ma yin/ dbu ma yang ma yin pa 'di ni don dam pa'i bden pa'o/ /de bas na de ni mchog tu zab pa dang / 'jug par dka' ba dang / skye ba 18—164
