pa'o—/ /zhes so/ /ra rā ga ste ye shes de nyid khyad par 'gyur ba'i chags ①pa chen por rang bzhin gzung 'dzin gnyis med pa'i ye shes byang chub kyi sems kun du bzang po gnyis pa'o/ /de yang / ston ka'i sprin med nam mkha' la—/ /nyi ma'i 'od zer shar ba ltar/ /thabs kyi ye shes gnyis pa ni/ /don dang sems can bcas snang byed/ /ces so/ /la la ti ste gzung ba dang 'dzin pa gnyis spangs pa'i ye shes len cing gzung 'dzin gyi rnam par rtog pa'i sgo 'gags shing nam mkha' ltar ram mun pa pyaltar mi rtog dngos po'i snang ba rnams nub pa'o/ /de yang ji skad du/ sprin med mkha' dang mun lta bu'i/ /snang med ye shes goms byas pas/ /rang rig tsam las grub pa yis sgyu ma'i lus ni len par byed/ /ces so/ /ha a na ha ta ste mi shigs pa'i ye shes de nyid kyis yid kyi lus kyi rang bzhin 'byung ba'o/ / de yang /rngu rang rig tsam du 'od gsal ba/ /rlung dang ldan pa'i rnam shes kyis/ /chu zla 'dra bar gzugs med pa'i/ /chags med lus ni 'grub par 'gyur/ /zhes so/ /ka ka pā la ste de lta bu'i yid kyi lus rang snang ba'i bde bas gang zhig rdzogs pa ni bde skyong zhes bya'o④/ /de yang / yid kyi lus dang ldan pa yi/ /rnal 'byor pas ni khams gsum du/ /bdag dang gzhan gyi don byas nas/ /mthar ni rang gnas bde bar 'go/ /zhes so/ /kha kha ga na ste sgyu ma'i lus las ⑤/brten nas ril por 'dzin pa'am rjes su gzhig pa'i sgo nas don dam pa'i bden pa mngon du byed pa'o/ /de yang / sgyu ma'i lus la brten byas nas/ /ril por 'dzin dang rjes gzhig gis/ /dngos po thams cad bshigs snenas ni/ /de nas snang ba med par 'gro/ /zhes so/ /gha a pra ti ga ste thogs pa med 18—331

pa'i ye shes kyi nam mkha' lta bu'i chos don hūṃdam pa'i bden pa'i tsa bden pa rtogs par 'gyur ro/ /de yang / thogs pa med pa'i ye shes kyis/ /snang ba thams cad nub byas nas/ /rang tsam la yang chags med pa'i/ /snang ba med pa'i dbyings su 'gro/ /zhes so/ /na ni she ta ste bdag dang gzhan la sogs pa'i mtha' 'gog pa ste/ de yang / bdag dang gzhan du rtog pa yi/ /rnam rtog dra ba bsal nas ni/ /mtha' med dmigs pa med pa ru/ /snang ba med pa'i tshul du 'gro/ /zhes so/ /dza dza na ma ste sgyu ma lta bu'i lus de nyid las snang ba med par gong nas gong du 'gro ba'o/ /de yang / snang ba med pa'i ting 'dzin gyis/ /snang ba tsam yang 'dzin spangs te/ /yang dang yang du don dam pa'i/ /bden pa mngon du byas nas 'go/ /zhes so/ /da da da ste sgyu ma lta bu'i lus kyis bye'abad pa med par 'dod pa thams cad nam mkha' mdzod kyis ster ba'o/ /de yang / sgyu ma'i lus kyis 'bad med par/ /'dod pa thams cad nam mkha' la/ /'bad pa med par rnyed 'gyur te/ /bdag dang gzhan rnams bde bar 'tsho/ /zhes so/ /dha dha ra ste yid kyi lus sgyu ma'i dpe bcu gnyis kyis bsgrub ④pa 'dzin pa'o/ /de yang / yid kyis phyelus tsam bzung nas ni/ /bdag dang gzhan gyi don sgrub cing / /dmigs pa thams cad zad byed pas/ /'gro med gnas su nam zhig 'gro/ /zhes so/ /ma ma no ha ra ste yid kyi lung snang ba gsum gyi bdag nyid rlung dang ldan pa las grub pa'i gyesgyu ma'i dpe bcu gnyis kyis nye bar mtshon pa'o/ /de yang / rang snang rlung dang ldan pa yi/ /'ja' tshon bzhin du mtha' med pa'i/ /stong pa gsum du goms byed pas/ / thogs pa hūṃmed par 'byung bar 'gyur/ /zhes 18—332

so / /yang mthar thug pa'i don du bshad par bya ste/ sgyu ma lta bu'i lus la brten te don dam pa'i bden pa mngon du byed do/ /de yang chos bdun dang ldan pa yin te sgyu ma lta bu'i lus dang / thabs ril 'dzin dang / rjes gzhig dang / tha mal pa'i chos 'gog pa dang / rtags mngon du skye ba dang /de 'dra bar rtogs pa dang / dbang gi rim pa la sbyar ba dang / nyams su blang zhing bslab pa'i go rims dang bdun no/ /de la la ste sa chu la thim pa las smig rgyu 'dra bar skye ba dang / ba ste chu me la thim pa las du ba lta bu dang /ra ste me rlung la thim pa las mkha' snang lta bu dang / ya ste rlung rnam par shes pa la thim pa las mar me lta bu'o/ /ha ste rnam par shes pa 'od gsal ba la thim pa las nam mkha' lta bur snang ba'o/ /de yang / dang po ri1sa ni chu la thim/ /chu yang me la thim par 'gyur/ /me ni rlung la thim par 'gyur/ /rlung yang rnam par shes la 'jug /rnam shes 'dzin pa de nyid ni/ /'od gsal bar ni 'jug par 'gyur/ /zhes so/ /gzhan yang phung po la sogs pa ni khams phra ba la gzhug go/ /khams phra ba ni rnam par shes pa la'o/ /rnam par shes pa ni sems pa dula'o/ /sems pa zhu ni ma rig pa la'o/ /ma rig pa ni 'od gsal ba la'o zhes pa'i rim pas kyang dang po ni sgyu ma lta bu la 'od zer lnga dang ldan par mthong ngo / /gnyis par zla ba lta bu dang / gsum par nyi ma lta bu dang /bzhi par mun pa lta bu dang / lnga par ni snang ba med pa nam mkha' lta bu mthong ngo zhes kyang gsungs pa'i phyir ro/ /ka su ka ste snang ba med pa'i bde ba chen po dmigs pa med pa'i mya ngan las 'das pa thob par 'gyur ro/ /de yang /stobs dang mi 'jigs la sogs pa'i/ /che ba'i yon tan rnam brgyan pa/ /18—333

bden gnyis sbyor ba'i zung 'jug sku/ /bde ba chen po des thob 'gyur/ /zhes so/ /kha kha ga ste nam mkha' lta bu'i chos kyi sku nyusnang ba'i tshogs thams cad nub pa'i rang bzhin las rnam par rtog pa med bzhin du bsod nams dang ye shes kyi tshogs bsags pa'i dbang gis chu klung dang ba las dngha —nya 'phar ba dang gnyid log pa las myur du sad pa bzhin du zung du 'jug pa'i skur ldang bar 'gyur ro/ /de yang / mkha' dang 'dra chos stong pa las/ /rtog med ye shes 'ja' 'dra ba/ /tshogs dang smon lam stobs dag gis/ /'bad pa med par ༄ — lhun gyis grub/ /ces so/ /na ni she ta ste zung du 'jug pa'i ting nge 'dzin gyis nyon mongs pa'i sgrib pa dang shes bya'i sgrib pa la sogs pa'i sgrib pa rnam pa drug gtan spangs pa'o/ /de yang / zung du 'jug pa'i ting 'dzin gyis / /nyon mongs sgrib sogs rnam spangs shing / /phun sum tshogs pa 'thob 'gyur te/ /'dod pa tsam gyis 'gro 'ong ston/ /zhes so/ /de yang /'ja' tshon 'dra ba'i longs sku las/ /'bad pa med pa sprul pa'i sku/ /mtha' yas rdul phran ji bzhin du/ /sems can don kun grub par mdzad/ /ces so/ /dza dza na ma te zung du 'jug pa'i sku rdo rje 'chang chen po las sprul pa'i sku du ma skye zhing 'byung ba'o/ /da da da ste sems can rnams la gang dang gang gis 'dul ba la de dang de ltar skal ba dang mthun par snang zhing 'dod pa'i dngos grub ster bar 'gyur ro/ /de yang / gang dang gang gis ge'adul 'gyur ba/ /de de bzhin du so sor snang / /mos pa'i dbang gis tha dad par/ /sems can rnams ni 'dul bar 'gyur/ /zhes so/ /dha dha ra ste lhun gyis grub pa'i sku rgyun gyis rtag par stug po bkod pa'i 'jig rten gyi khams na rang bzhin gyis 18—334

btsun mo la 'khyud pa'i bdag nyid dus rtag tu 'dzin pa'o/ /de yang /lhun grub bde ba chen po'i sku/ /rang snang rig mas nyer brgyan pa/ /'og min gnas su dus rtag tu/ /mtshan dang dpe byad brgyan pas bzhugs/ /zhes so/ /ma byurnya —rmem ṇi ste yid bzhin kyi nor bu ltar 'bad pa med par bdag dang gzhan gyi don sgrub par mdzad pa'o/ /de yang / yid bzhin nor ltar bsams tsam gyis/ /'bad med bdag dang gzhan gyi don/ /che ba'i yon tan rnam brgyan ṭusku/ /bde ba che las 'byung bar 'gyur/ /zhes so/ /de ltar tshul bzhi'i bshad pa'o/ /dpal gsang ba 'dus pa'i rdzogs rim mthar phyin pa slob dpon ārya de bas mdzad pa rdzogs so// //bsdur mchan/328 /༷mtshan byang 'di 〈〈sde 〉〉〈〈co 〉〉ltar bkod cing / 〈〈pe 〉thacom ldan 'das gsung gi dbang phyug 'jam dpal ye shes sems dpa' bzhugs// // ge〈〈pe 〉〉〈〈snar 〉〉gipar/ —〈〈pe 〉〉〈〈snar 〉〉 dhi byu/329 nyu〈〈pe 〉sko〈snar 〉〉〉/ ༄ ༷〈〈pe 〉〉〈〈snar 〉staXd/ zhu〈〈pe 〉〉〈〈snar 〉7/ zi〈〈pe 〉sko〈snar 〉zo'i/ snye〈〈pe 〉〉〈〈snar 〉〉〈myaka tsu 〈〈pe 〉〉〈〈snar 〉rol/ )〈〈pe 〉〉〈〈snar 〉〉// // sdo〈〈pe 〉〉〈〈snar 〉ma ga33༷ sne〈〈pe 〉〉〈〈snar 〉〉byung / /sems gzung / 3〈〈pe 〉〉〈〈snar 〉thamathun/331 1〈〈pe 〉sko〈snar 〉7ga dzee〈〈pe 〉〉〈〈snar 〉7ltar ram mun pa/ ༄ —〈〈pe 〉〉〈〈snar 〉lke'i/ ④〈〈pe 〉〉〈〈snar 〉〉bya ba'o/ 3〈〈pe 〉〉〈〈snar 〉rol/ ⑥〈〈pe 〉〉〈〈snar 〉thashig332 rkya〈〈pe 〉〉〈〈snar 〉7don/ 3〈〈pe 〉〉〈〈snar 〉〉〈〈co 〉7bden pa'i/ 〈〈pe 〉〉〈〈snar 〉7/ 〈〈pe 〉〉〈〈snar 〉thasgrubs/ 3〈〈pe 〉sko〈snar 〉dkyi/ — —〈〈pe〉〉〈〈snar 〉zo/ 3〈〈pe 〉〉〈〈snar 〉〉thog ma/333 kye 〈〈pe 〉sko〈snar 〉yas/ kye〈〈pe 〉〉〈〈snar 〉rapa'/334 hūṃ〈〈pe 〉〉〈〈snar 〉7sku/ 3〈〈pe 〉〉〈〈snar 〉phro/ ༄ —〈〈pe 〉〉〈〈snar 〉zo/ ④〈〈pe 〉〉〈〈snar 〉lke/ sa〈〈pe〉〉〈〈snar 〉stan/ ༄da〈〈pe 〉〉〈〈snar 〉snga /18—335

༄/ /'dus pa'i sgrub pa'i thabs rnam par gzhag pa'i rim pa zhes bya ba/ 1༄7/ /rgya gar skad du/ sa ma dza sā dha rgo bya bsgo le 2nā ma/ bod skad du/ 'dus pa'i sgrub pa'i thabs rnam par gzhag pa'i rim pa zhes bya ba/dpal rdo rje sems dpa' la phyag 'tshal lo/ /rdo rje gsum po mi phyed sku/ /rdo rje sems dpa' phyag byas te/ /'dus pa'i sgrub thabs yan lag gi/ /rnam gzhag rim pa bshad par bya/ /de la dang por re zhig dngos po med la zhes bya ba la sogs pa tshigs su bcad pa brjod nas snod la sogs pa'i dngos po rnams stong pa nyid du gzhug par bya'o/ /de nas/ nam mkha'i dbyings kyi dbus gnas par/ /rlung gi dkyil 'khor bsgom par bya/ /zhes bya ba la sogs pas dkyil 'khor bzhi'i rim kyis sa'i cha bsgrubs te/ de'i steng du rgyu las gzhal yas khang bskyed la/ der mi bskyod pa la sogs pa'i lha'i 'khor lo thams cad lhag par mos pas dgod par bya'o/ /de'i 'og tu rnal 'byor dang / rjes su 18—337

rnal 'byor dang / shin tu rnal 'byor dang / rnal 'byor chen po'i rim pas rdo rje 'chang chen po'i bdag nyid du bskyed 1de/ dbang po gnyis mnyam par sbyar ba las dkyil 'khor kyi 2lha rnams phyung ste/ bsgom pa dang bzlas pa byas nas gshegs su gsol ba 'di bsgom pa basbus te bstan pa'o/ /rnam par gzhag 4pa dang po nye bar bstan pa brjod par bya ste/ gang gi tshe 'dir 'jig rten du 'jig pa thob par gyur cing / khams gsum pa'i sems can gcig kyang ma lus par gyur nas sgod kyi 'jig rten 'ba' zhig lus pa de'i tshe rim gyis rim gyis nyi ma bdun gyi 'od zer rnams rab tu bklags pas khams gsum pa bsregs te nam mkha'i rang bzhin du byed do/ /don 'di ltar bskyed pa'i rim pa sgom pa pos/ dngos po med la zhes bya ba la sogs pa'i tshigs su bcad pa brjod cing bsam par bya'o/ /de nas yang rten cing 'byel bar 'byung ba'i rgyun gyi stobs las khad kyis 5khad kyis rlung rnams g.yos te/ rlung de rnams 'phel bar gyur pa ni/ rngams su ni dpag tshad 'bum phrag bcu drug go/ /rgyar grangs med pa'i rlung gi dkyil 'khor de nam mkha'i steng du chags par gyur nas rlung gi dkyil 'khor de las byung ba shing rta'i 'phang 6lo tsam gyi char gyi rgyun bab par gyur te/ de las chu'i dkyil 'khor du gyur te3/ de'i tshad ni rngams su 'bum phrag bcu gcig dang stong phrag nyi shu'o/ /de yang slar chu la rlung gis bsrubs pas gser kyi rang bzhin gyi sa gzhi chu'i steng du chags te/de'i tshad ni 'bum phrag gsum dang stong phrag nyi shu'o/ /me'i dkyil 'khor yang de dag gi nang nyid du gnas so/ /de ltar yang dag par bsgrub cing bskyed tso pa'i rnal 'byor pas—/ nam mkha' dbyings kyi dbus gnas par/ /rlung gi 78—338

dkyil 'khor bsgom kyepar bya/ /zhes bya ba la sogs pas dkyil 'khor bzhi'i rim pas sa'i cha bskyed par bya'o/ /de ltar sems can rnams kyi las kyi dbang gis yang dag par byung ba'i rlung rnams kyis yang dag par bsrubs pas gser la sogs pa'i tshogs kyis byas pa'i ri rab la sogs pa'i ri dang / lha'i gzhal med khang dang / gling lcags ris bskor ba tshun chad du shing dang ljon pa dang lcug rtsam la sogs pa 'byung bar 'gyur ro/ /sred pa'i rim pa de ltar sgom par byed pa rnams kyis der ni zhes bya ba la sogs pa'i gzhung gis stong pa nyid dmigs pa sngon du/du song bas dkyil 'khor bzhi'i rim pas sa'i cha bskyed la/dzee de'i steng du gzhal yas khang bskyed par bya'o zhes bstan par 'gyur ro/ /de nas rnam par shes pa'i bdag po rdo rje 'chang chen po sems can skyed par mdzad pa pos snod kyi 'jig rten bskyed kyi 'og tu sems can gyi khams nges par sprul par mdzad de/ gnas ni bsgom pa sngon phya'agre bas/ /rdo rje gsum bskyed bsgom par bya/ /zhes gsungs pa'i phyir ro/ /der skye gnas bzhi po 'di lta ste/sgo nga las skyes pa dang / mngal las skyes pa dang / drod gsher las skyes pa dang / rdzus ༄ date skyes pa'o/ /skye gnas ni skye ba'o/ /sgo nga las skyes pa gang zhe na / sems can gang dag sgo nga las skye bar 'gyur ba'o/ /de dag kyang gang zhe na/ ngang pa dang / khrung khrung dang / rma bya dang / nee tso dang / sha ri ka la sogs pa'o/ /mngal nas skye ba gang zhe na/ sems can gang dag mngal nas skye ba ste/ de dag kyang gang zhe na/ glang po dang / rta dang / ba lang dang / ma te dang / bong bu dang / phag dang / mi la sogs pa'o/ /drod gsher las skyes pa gang zhe na/ sems can gang dag 'byung ba'i drod las 18—339

skyes pa ste/ de dag kyang gang zhe na/ srin bu dang / phye ma leb dang /mchu sbrang la sogs pa'o/ /rdzus kyete skyes pa gang zhe na/ sems can gang dag dbang po ma tshang ba med cing ma rdzogs pa med pa yan lag dang nying lag thams cad dang ldan par cig car skyes pa ste/ de dag kyang gang zhe na/ lha dang /dmyal ba dang / srid pa bar ma dang / bskal pa dang po pa'i mi la sogs pa'o / /'dir gsol pa/ gling gsum pa'i mi rnams kyang so sor gnas pa ma ṭulags sam/ ci'i slad du 3skye ba gcig gis thogs pa'i byang chub sems dpa' sems dpa' chen po dga' ldan gyi gnas mchog nas der 'jug par mi mdzad par 'dir nges pa kho nar 'dzam bu'i gling du 'jug cing mi rnams la chos ston pa'i rgyu nyid bcom ldan 'das rdo rje slob dpon ston pas bshad du gsol/rdo rje slob dpon gyis smras pa/ shar gyi lus 'phags dang / nub kyi ba lang spyod dang / byang gi sgra mi snyan gyi mi rnams longs spyod chen po dang ldan te/de lta mod kyi blun zhing rmongs pas mi spyod thu cing mi 'byed do/ /'dzam bu'i gling pa 'di ni las kyis pa yin te/ de na legs par srud pa dang / nyes par spyad pas mchog dang 'bring dang tha ma'i sems can rnams su las kyi 'bras bu rnam par smin pas 'dir snang bar 'gyur ro/ /'di lta ste 'dzam bu'i gling pa'i mi rnams g.yo 3 dang / sgyu dang / dregs pa dang / phrag dog dang gdug pa'i bsam pas rims nad la sogs pas yongs su gzir bar 'gyur ro/ /'on kyang mgo smos pas go ba dang / dbang po rno zhing sgrin pa ste/ des na byang chub sems dpa' rnams 'dzam bu'i gling gi skye bo'i gnas kyis khyedabus su sku 'khrungs shing gye chos ston par 'gyur ro/ /de'i phyir gsungs pa/ mi ru 18—340

'khrungs pa nges tshul dang po ste/ /rab tu byung ba tshul ni gnyis pa'o/ /'dul ba srung ba tshul chen gsum pa ste/ /ting 'dzin brnyes pa tshul mchog bzhi pa yin/ /zhes bya ba thun mong ma yin pa'i gsang ba zhes bya ba'i rnal 'byor chen po'i rgyud las gsungs pas 'das pa dang ma 'ongs pa dang da ltar byung ba'i sangs rgyas thams cad mi'i bdag nyid kyi srid par zhugs te thams cad mkhyen pa'i dngos grub kyi go 'phang brnyes pa dang ldan par 'gyur ro/ /rgyu des na 'dir mi'i srid pa'i skye ba'i rim pa bstan to/ /de la bskal pa dang po pa'i ① mi rnams sangs rgyas kyi yon tan thams cad kyis brgyan cing yid kyi rang bzhin gyi lus can yan lag dang nying lag thams cad kyis mtshan pa/ dbang po ma tshang ba med cing ma rdzogs pa med pa/ kha dog gsal ba'i lus can/ rang gi mthus nam mkhar 'gro ba/ tshe ring zhing dga' ba la spyod pa/ ye shes kyi lus can yin yang de rnams kyis sgyu ma lta bu'i ting nge 'dzin mi shes shing ma shes pas na thog ma med pa'i dus nas mi shes pa'i bag chags kyi rgyun kyi stobs las rim gyis rang gi sems las byung ba'i las dang nyon mongs pa rnams kyis mngon par zil gyis mnan par 'gyur ro/ /de nas de dag gis ༄ —yid kyi rang bzhin gyi lus spangs te/ nyon mongs pa'i rgyun kyi rim gyis tha mal pa'i mi'i bdag nyid kyi dngos por yongs su 'dzin to/ /de lta bu'i thugs rdo rje dge ba'i bshes gnyen dang bral bas rang gi rang bzhin yongs su ma shes pas sems can gyi ris nas 'pho zhing / ji srid du skye ba'i zutshogs pa ma rnyed pa de srid du nyin zhag bdun du srid pa bar ma dor ④gnas so zhes nges par bshad do/ /srid pa bar ma'i rang bzhin ji lta bu lags/ smras pa/ 'chi ba'i srid pa dang skye ba'i srid 18—341

pa'i bar na bdag gi ngo bo mngon par grub cing yul gzhan du skye ba grub pa de la srid pa bar ma zhes bya'o/ /de yang dbang po rno bar 'gyur te/ ji 1ltar skye ba gcig gis thogs pa'i byang chub sems dpa' mtshan thams cad dang dpe byad dang lang tsho yongs su rdzogs pa de bzhin du srid pa bar ma na gnas pa yang ma'i rum du rab tu 'jug pa'o/ /bye ba brgya yang 'di'i 'od kyi snang bas gsal bar byed do/ /ji skad 1du bzang skyong gis zhus pa'i mdo las gsungs te/ de yang 'byung ba chen po rnams rab tu spangs te lha'i dran pa rab tu thob cing 'dod pa drug la spyod pa'i lha mthong ba dang dmyal ba bcu drug mthong ngo / /de yang rkang pa dang lag pa ma tshang ba med cing rang gi ngo bor snang bar 'gyur ro/ /'di ltar yang bdag gi lus de dang de ni 'di yin no zhes rab tu shes so/ /de yang ji skad du mdzod kyi tshig tsa)le'ur byas pa las/ sngon dus srid pa'i sha tshugs can/ /dbang po kun tshang thogs med ldan/ /las kyi rdzu 'phrul shugs dang ldan/ /ris mthun lha mig dag pas mthong / /zhes gsungs pa'o/ /'dis bskyed pa'i rim pa sgom par byed pa rnams kyis kyang rnal 'byor dang rjes su rnal 'byor gyi rim pas lha'i sku bskyed pa bstan te/ ji ltar skye ba gcig gis thogs pa'i byang chub sems dpa' sems dpa' chen pos longs spyod rdzogs pa'i sgus mi rnams kyi don mdzad par mi spyod pas phung po dang khams dang skye mched kyi rjes su zhugs pas sprul pa'i sku 'dzin pa'i don du mngal du 'jug pa nye bar bstan pa de bzhin du srid pa bar ma na gnas pa yang nyin zhag bdun pa dor te/thog ma med pa'i rang gi rnam par rtog pa'i bag chags las byung ba'i las kyis yang dag par bskul te rim pa 'dis skye ba len to/ /de la rim pa ni 'di yin 18—342

te—/ dang po'i bskal pa'i mi rnams bdud rtsi za ba nas ji srid du 'bras chan za ba yan chad kyis lus sra ba dang phyi ba nyid kyis non te/ 'od mi snang bar 'gyur ro/ /de'i 'og tu mun pa skyes pas nyi ma dang zla ba dag 'jig rten du rab tu byung ba'o/ /de nas thabs dang shes rab kyi rnam par dbye ba bstan pa'i ched du de dag gi pho dang mo'i dbang po rab tu dod cing dbyibs tha dad cing /de dag sngon goms pa'i dbang gis gcig la gcig lta zhing phan tshun du chags pa'i sems skye'o/ /gang gi phyir log par zhugs pa de nas brtsams te pho dang mo zhes bya ba'i ming du 'jig rten du grags so/ /de nas dri za nye bar 'khor ba'i sems can gnas skabs gsum nye bar gyur pas ma'i rum du mngal du 'jug par 'gyur te/ mo nad med pa dang / khrag dang ldan pa dang / ma dang pha rjes su chags par 'gyur ba'o/ /de nas de dag phan tshun rjes su chags pas rdo rje byin gyis brlabs nas 'khyud pa dang 'o bya ba la sogs pa'i bya bas dbang po gnyis mnyam par sbyor ba mthong bas 'dod pa nye bar len pa'i phyir srid pa bar ma spangs te rta zhon pa bzhin rnam par shes pa'i bdag po thugs rdo rje rlung gi bzhon pa la yang dag par zhon nas shin tu myur bar 'ong zhing skad cig thang cig gam yud tsam kyis ye shes sems dpa' ltar rnam par snang mdzad kyi sgo nas zhugs te/ ye shes kyi sa thob nas thabs kyi ye shes dang lhan cig gnyis su med par gyur nas shin tu dga' bar chud pa'i snying po yin te/ rgyud las de bzhin gshegs pa thams cad zil gyis gnon pa'i ting nge 'dzin gsungs pa'i rigs pa dang / shes rab kyi mdo las gnyis ka mchog tu dga' ba'i bde bas tshim par byas pas rtsa stong phrag bdun cu rtsa gnyis yang dag par bskul te/ gnyi ga'ang 18—343

mchog tu dga' ba'i bde bas tshim par bya'o/ /nyu.ā li dang kā li rnams gcig tu gyur nas khams phra ba la zhugs pas shes rab dang zhu/ ye shes kyi 'od zer shar bas gnyi ga geyang zhu bar gyur te khu ba dang khrag yang dag par 'dres nas skye gnas kyi dbus su thig le'i gzugs su babs so zhes gsungs so/ /'di'i don gsal bar gsungs pa/ rtsa ba'i rgyud las/ de bzhin gshegs pa thams cad kyi sku dang gsung dang ④thugs rdo rje'i btsun mo'i bha ga la zhugs spu so zhes gsungs so/ /de'i 'og tu rim gyis 'phel te/ dang por mer mer po'i rnam pa'o—/ /mer mer po las ltar ltar por 'gyur/ ltar ltar po las gor gor po'o / /gor gor po las mkhrang gyur/ mkhrang gyur la pya yang rlung gis bskul te / des rkang lag 'gyus te 2gnas skabs lnga gsal bar 'gyur ro/ /de'i 'og tu skra dang / kha spu dang / sen mo la sogs pa dang / dbang po rnams dang / gzugs dang mtshan ma rnams rim kyis skye'o/ /de yang de bzhin gshegs pa lngas byin gyis brlabs pa las ⑧sa bon gyi gnas skabs nas brtsams te gnas skabs lnga nges par skye'o/ /de la mer mer po ni mi bskyod pa'o/ /ltar ltar po ni rin chen 'byung ldan gyi'o/ /gor gor ⑨/ni 'od dpag med kyi'o//mkhrang gyur ni don yod grub pa'i'o/ /rkang lag 'gyus pa bu ni rnam par snang mdzad kyis byin kyis brlabs pa'o/ /khrag gi yang gnas skabs lngar bstan par bya ste/ de la zhu ba ni mi bskyod pa'o/ /dmar po ni 'od dpag med kyi'o/ /gor gor po ni rin chen 'byung ldan kyi'o/ /mkhrang ⑪gyur ni don yod par grub pa'otsa/ /yang dag par 'dres pa ni rnam par snang mdzad kyis byin kyis brlabs pa'orto / /de yang / skye ④gnas dbus kyi rtsa gnyis rgo/ /g.yas 18—344

dang g.yon na de bzhin gnas/ /g.yon na khu ba shes par bya/ /g.yas pa na ni khrag nyid de/ /de dag gcig tu 'dres pa nyid/ /chos kyi dbyings su bsdus pa yin/ /zhes gsungs so/ /de ltar na mer mer po la sogs pas sa bon dang myu gu bzhin yongs su smin pa thob ste/ mngal gyi snod kyi nang du las kyi rnam par smin pa las skyes pa'i rlung rgyu ba gang dag gis mngal gyi snod yongs su bsgyur nas ma'i rum nas chos kyi 'byung gnas kyi sgor mngon par phyogs shing gnas par 'gyur ro/ /de yang pho zhig yin na ma'i rum gyi g.yas su brten cing rgyab tu mngon par bltas nyute tsog tsog zupor gnas so/ /gal te mo zhig na de'i phyir mngal gyi g.yon du brten te lte bar mngon par bltas te gnas so/ /de'i 'og tu zla ba bcu'i tha mar rtsa ba'i rgyud las gsungs pa'i dam tshig 'byung ba'i rdo rje'i ting nge 'dzin la yang dag par bstan pa'i rim pas ma'i mngal nas 'thon par gyur te/ de'i phyir dri za nye bar 'khor gyi sems can sha'i mig gi yul du gyur to/ /de ltar rtsa ba'i rgyud las gsungs te/ bcom ldan 'das de bzhin gshegs pa byang chub kyi sems rdo rje zhal gsum pa lta bur de bzhin gshegs pa thams cad kyis yang dag par gzigs par gyur to zhes gsungs so/ /'dir gsungs pa/ chu yi khams ni pha yin te/ /me yi khams ni ma zhes bya/ /pags pa sha dang khrag rnams ni/ /ma zhes su ni bstan pa yin/ /rus spre pa rkang dang khu ba rnams/ /pha zhes su yang bstan pa yin/ /de tsam zhig tu bstan pa yin ④/ /lus kyi gong bu bsdus pa'o/ /gzugs dang tshor ba 'du shes dang / /'du byed rnam par shes pa nyid/ /phung po la sogs sangs rgyas lnga'i—/ /rang bzhin dngos zhes bstan pa yin/ /zhes bcom ldan 'das kyis 78—345

lha mo bzhis zhus pa'i rnal 'byor chen po'i rgyud las gsungs so/ /gzhung 'dis rnal 'byor bzhi las bsgrubs pa ni bdag yin no zhes sngags pas nga rgyal bskyed par bya'o zhes bstan to/ /rnam par dgod pa bstan pa'i rim par phye ba ste dang po'o// //da ni rnam par gzhag kyepa'i rim pa gnyis pa nye bar bstan pa'i phyir dang po kho nar sku'i dkyil 'khor rnam par bshad par bya ste/ tshangs pa'i thig nas yang dag brtsam2// /gru bzhi pa ru rnam par dbye/ /gzhal yas khang ltar snang ba yis/ /rnal 'byor pa yi sku dkyil 'khor/ /de skad du/ bha ga'i dkyil 'khor zhes bya dang / /byang chub sems kyi dkyil 'khor dang / /dkyil 'khor lus su gsungs pa ste/ /dkyil 'khor rnam pa gsum du brtags/ /zhes 'dus pa'i rgyud phyi ma las gsungs so/ /de ltar gyur pa'i rang gi lus kyi dkyil 'khor la phung po dang khams dang skye mched kyi rang bzhin gyis lha rnams dgod pa'i rgyu dang 'bras bu gsungs pa/ de la gzugs kyi phung po ni rnam par snang mdzad / tshor ba'i phung po ni rin chen 'byung ldan/ 'du shes kyi phung po ni 'od dpag med/ 'du byed kyi phung po ni don yod grub pa/ rnam par shes pa rgo mi bskyod pa'o/ /de'i phyir rtsa ba'i rgyud las/ mdor na phung po lnga rnams ni//sangs rgyas lnga ru rab tu bsgrags/ /zhes gsungs so/ /des na phung po la sogs pa'i mtshan nyid shes par bya ste/ de bzhin gshegs pa lnga 3dgod pa las—/ phung po lnga byang chub kyi rgyur 'gyur te/ ji skad du rtsa ba'i rgyud las/gti mug zhe sdang chags pa dang / /yid bzhin nor bu dam tshig rnams/ /de 18—346

ltar rigs ni lnga nyid de/ /'dod dang thar pa rab sgrub byed/ /ces gsungs so—/ /lha mo rnams rnam par gzhag nyupa gsungs pa/ gti mug dga' ma spyan ma ni sa'i khams so/ /zhe sdang dga' ma mā ma shī ni chu'i khams so/ /'dod chags dga' ma gos dkar mo ni me'i khams so/ /rdo rje dga' ma sgrol ma ni rlung gi khams so/ /don de nyid gsal bar bya ba'i phyir rtsa ba'i rgyud las/sa yi khams ni spyan mar bshad/ /chu yi khams ni mā ma khri/ / me ni zugos dkar mor bshad de/ /rlung ni sgrol mar byerab tu grags/ /zhes gsungs so/ /de ltar khams rnams kyi ④yang rang gi mtshan nyid shes par bya ste/ lha mo rnams bkod pas khams rnams kyis sangs rgyas nyid stsol bar 'gyur ro/ /mig la sogs pa'i skye mched rnams la byang chub sems dpa' rnams dgod pa'i rgyu dang 'bras bu gsungs pa/ bcom ldan 'das thugs rdo rje de nyid kyis sa'i snying po'i ting nge 'dzin mig gi dbang po la bkod pas gzugs gsum la 'od gsal bas ④thogs pa med pa'i rdo rje'i mig gi dbang po stsol bar 'gyur ro/ /de bzhin du phyag na rdo rje rna ba la bkod pas sgra gsum la de bzhin du thogs pa med pa'i rdo rje'i rna ba'i dbang po rab tu stsol lo/ /nam mkha'i snying po sna la bkod pas dri gsum la thogs pa med pa'i rdo rje sna'i dbang po rab tu stsol lo/ /'jig rten dbang phyug lce la bkod pas ro gsum la thogs pa med pa'i rdo rje lce'i dbang po rab tu ster ro/ /bcom ldan 'das 'jam dpal 'jug pa'i rnam par shes pa mtha' drug la bkod pas ye shes gsum la thogs pa med pa'i gzhan gyi sems shes pa'i mngon par shes pa rab tu stsol lo/ /bcom ldan 'das sgrib pa rnam par sel ba lus kyi dbang po la bkod pas sgrib pa med par nang gi 18—347

khams rnams gcig la gcig bsnyus te skye ba la rab tu zhugs nyunas rdo rje'i sku rab tu bsgrub par 'gyur ro/ /bcom ldan 'das kun du bzang po tshigs thams cad la bkod pas 'od gsal du tshigs thams cad gzigs par 'gyur ro//bcom ldan 'das byams pa rgyus pa'i rang bzhin la bkod pas rgyus pa'i rang bzhin 'od gsal bar rab tu 'jug go/ /bcom ldan 'das de nyid gzugs gsum gyi rnam pas phyi rol lta bur snang bas mig gi dbang po la bde ba ṭustsol ba'i gzugs rdo rje'o/ /de ltar sgra rdo rje la sogs pa rnams kyang khong du chud par bya'o//ji skad du/ rnal 'byor thams cad bcom ldan 'das/ /rdo rje sems dpa' de bzhin gshegs/ /khams gsum pa ni ma lus kun/ /de yi nye bar longs spyod nyid/ /ces bde mchog las gsungs te 'dis lha mo rnams dgod pa'i rang bzhin yongs su shes pas yul rnam par dag pa bsgrub par 'gyur ro/ /don 'di nyid gsal bar rtsa ba'i rgyud las/ rdo rje skye mched nyid dag kyang / /byang chub sems dpa'i dkyil 'khor mchog /ces pa dang / gzugs sgra dri ro sngags pa yis/ /lha rnams su ni rtag par bsgom/ /zhes gsungs pas so/ /yan lag thams cad la khro bo rnams bkod pa'i rgyu dang 'bras bu gsungs pa/lag pa g.yas la zugashin rje gshed/ /g.yon la gzhan kyis mi thub pa/ /kha yi padmar rta mgrin bsam/ /rdo rjer bdud rtsi 'khyil pa ste/ /dpung pa g.yas par mi g.yo ba/ /g.yon par 'dod pa'i rgyal po'o/ /pus mo g.yas par bsam bya ba/ /dbyug pa sngon po 'bar chen po/ /pus mo g.yon la stobs po che—/ /spyi bor gtsug tor 'khor los sgyur/ /rkang mthil ④ gnyis su bsam bya ba/ /gnod mdzes rgyal po rnam par bsam/ /khro bo'i rgyal po 'di dag ni 18—348

sgrub pa po'i yan lag la bkod pas 'bad pa khyemed par zhal gsum phyag drug pa'i rnam pa lta bu nyid kyi sku'i dkyil 'khor las byung nas phyogs bcu'i bgegs kyi tshogs la bsdigs par mdzad do/ /'dir rtsa ba'i rgyud las/ khro bo zhe sdang gnas las skyes/ /rtag tu gsod la brtson pa ste/ /gsod pa'i don gyis 'grub par 'gyur/ /sgrub pa'i mchog la chos can yin/ /zhes gsungs so/ /sku'i dkyil 'khor rnam par gzhag ② pa'i rim par phye ba ste gnyis pa'o// //sku'i dkyil 'khor la lha rnams dgod pa'i rgyu dang 'bras bu rtogs pa'i sngags pas gzhan gyi don bsgrub pa'i phyir sku'i dkyil 'khor las phyung ba'i dkyil 'khor rim pa 'dis sprul par ④bya ste/ de'i rim pa ni 'di yin te/ sems las rjorang gi rigs kyi bu mo spro ba'amaphye/ yang na phyi rol gyi bu mo blangs la sgrub thabs las gsungs pa'i rim pas dbang po gnyis mnyam par sbyor ba byas te/sngon du gsungs pa'i rim pas gzhal yas khang bsgrubs la byang chub kyi sems las sgrub ducing badzra j-ika ces bya ba la sogs pa'i sngags brjod ⑦de lha thams cad kyi 'khor lo spro bar bya'o/ /phyung ba'i dkyil 'khor ba'i sngags bstan par bya ste/ mngon par byang chub pa rnam pa lnga ston pa'i rdo rje bsnams pas na rdo rje 'chang ngo / /'dis nyon mongs pa zhe sdang rnam par sbyangs nas slar byon te rdo rje 'chang chen po dang gnyis su med par gyur gyete/ kha sbyar gyi ⑨sbyor bas mi bskyod pa'i gzugs kyis bzhugs so/ /de bzhin du rtsibs bcu gnyis pa'i chos kyi 'khor los bdud bzhi las rgyal bas na rgyal ba'i rgyal ba'o ⑫ bsam pa thams cad yongs su rdzogs par byed pa'i rin po che 'dzin pas na rin chen 18—349

'chang ngo / /ā ni ma lus pa'o/ /ro ni 'khor ba ste 'khor ba las 'das shing 'gro bas na 'khor 'das so/ /rnam par 'byed pa'i mtshan nyid ni shes rab ste/de ①'dzin pas na dushes rab 'chang ngo / /gti mug ni rnam par snang mdzad de/de la dga' bas na gti mug dga' ma'o/ /zhe sdang ni mi bskyod pa ste/ de la dga' bas na zhe sdang dga' ma'o/ /'dod chags ni 'od dpag med do bhu/ /de la dga' bas na 'dod chags dga' ma'o/ /rdo rje ni don yod par grub pa ste/de la dga' bas na rdo rje dga' ma'o/ /sa ltar mi g.yo ba'i ting nge 'dzin de nyid snying po ste/ nang gi bdag nyid gang la yod pa de ni sa'i snying po'o/ /ye shes lnga'i rang bzhin gyi rdo rje 'chang bar mdzad pas na phyag na rdo rje'o/ /nam mkha' ni sgrib pa dang bral ba'i ye shes te de nyid snying po ste nam mkha'i snying po'o/ /ting nge 'dzin gyi stobs kyis 'jig rten rnams dbang du byed pas na 'jig rten dbang phyug go/ /'od gsal zhing yid du 'ong ba'i ting nge 'dzin gyis bskul ba'i dpal yod pas na 'jam dpal lo/ /sgrib pa thams cad ni nyon mongs pa rnams sgyu ma lta bu'i ting nge 'dzin gyi stobs kyis mnan pas na sgrib pa thams cad sel ba'o/ /kun nas mdzes pas ④na kun du bzang po'o/ /byams pa'i yon tan gang la yod pa ni byams pa'o/ /blta bar bya bas na gzugs so/ /mnyan par bya bas na sgra'o/ /bsnam ④par bya bas na dri'o/ /myang bar bya bas na ro'o/ /reg par bya bas na reg bya'o/ /rdo rje'i sgras ni de dag gi ting nge 'dzin gyis gzugs la sogs pa rnam par dag pa bstan to/ /gshin rje ni ⑥dmyal ba ste de 'joms pa dang ldan pa'i phyir te/ khro bo chen po'i ting nge 'dzin gyis mthar byed pas na gshin rje mthar byed do/ /shes rab kyis ṣyo'aching 18—350

ba rnams mthar byed pas na shes rab mthar byed do/ /padma ༄1ltar 'dod chags la sogs pa rnam par dag pas kyen padma mthar byed do/ /bgegs ni bdud bzhi ste de 'joms pa dang ldan pas na khro bo chen bo'i ting nge 'dzin gyis de rnams mthar byed pas na bgegs mthar byed do/ /'jig rten gyi chos brgyad kyis rtag tu sems rab tu bskyod pa rnams rdo rje lta bu'i ting nge 'dzin gyis mnan cing bcom pas na mi g.yo ba'o/ /ṭakki ni 'dod pa'i 'dod chags te/de bsal bar byed cing rnam par dag par byed pas na 'dod pa'i rgyal po'o/ /sngon po ni sems can rnams kyi sdig pa'i las so/ /dbyig zu pa ni de chad pas tshar gcod pa ste/ de byed pas na dbyug sngon no/ /don dam pa'i stobs kyis sems can rnams kyi nye ba'i nyon mongs pa 'joms par byed pas na stobs po che'o—/ /sems can rnams la khams gsum las rnam par sgrol ba'i ye shes sprul ④ bas na gtsug tor 'khor los sgyur ba'o/ /phyogs bcu'i bgegs kyi tshogs nges par bkug nas phur bus 'debs pas na gnod mdzes rgyal po'o/ /lha sum cu rtsa gnyis po 'di dag gi sprul pa'i sku zhal gsum phyag drug pa mtshan ma'i phyag mtshan sna tshogs phyag na bsnams pa rnams byang chub kyi 3sems las sngags kyi gzugs kyis ④sprul pa yang 'bad pa med pa nyid kyis sgrub pa po'i lus kyi dkyil 'khor las phyung ste/ bsod nams kyi tshogs 'phel bar bya ba'i don du 'dod chags dang zhe sdang dang gti mug la spyod pa'i sems can rnams kyi nyon mongs pa'i sgrib pa rnams ting nge 'dzin de dang des sbyangs nas slar byon te rang rang gi stan la bzhugs par gyur to/ /rdo rje dang / 'khor lo dang / rin po che dang / padma dang / ral gri dang / dril bu rnam grangs bzhin du de bzhin 18—351

gshegs pa drug gi mtshan mar gsungs te/ de nyid ni ①mtshon cha lta bur bsnams so/ /zhi ba dang rgyas pa la sogs pa'i las kyi dbye bas kha dog so sor bya'o—/ /rin po che thams cad dang ldan pa'i phyir mdog ind+ra nī la lta bu'o/ /phyung ba'i dkyil 'khor 'di nyid bshad pa'i phyir rtsa ba'i rgyud las/ de nas de bzhin gshegs pa mi bskyod pa de bzhin gshegs pa thams cad btsun mo'i bha ga la rdul dang bral ba'i dam tshig chen po'i dkyil 'khor byin gyis brlabs pa ni/gsal ba de yi ngo bo nyid/ /sna tshogs gzugs kyis kun du mtshan/ /sangs rgyas sprin gyis kun du khyab/ /'od zer 'phro ba mang po 'khrug /gsal ba la sogs dkyil 'khor ldan/ /de bzhin gshegs pa kun gyi snegazhi/ /zhes gsungs so/ /gsol pa/ gal te rgyud 'di la lag pa'i phyag rgya med na 'di ltar phyag rgya bzhis rgyas btab pa'i lha'i sku bskyed par 'gyur/ bka' stsal pa/sangs rgyas kyi yon tan ma lus pas brgyan pa'i gzhir gyur pa'i lha'i sku ni phyag rgya chen po'o/ /btsun mo ni dam tshig gi phyag rgya'o/ /sngags kyi yi ge ni chos kyi phyag rgya'o/ /gzugs sna tshogs kyis sems can thams cad kyi don byed cing sgrub pa ni las kyi phyag rgya'o/ /gsol pa/ de kho na nyid bsdus pa la sogs pa dang / gnyi ga'i ①rgyud las ni zhal gcig par rab tu grags na/ ci'i phyir 'dir zhal gsum pa lta bur snang bar 'gyur/ bka' 6) pa/ bcom ldan 'das nyid kyis 'di'i don bshad pa'i rgyud dgongs pa lung ston pa'i rgyud las/gang zhig phyi nang bdag gyur dang / /de nyid gnyis ka'i rtog pa rnams/ /gnyis su med par bshad pa ste/ /'di yi de nyid chen po yin/ /lag pa g.yon par rab grags pa'i/ /mthe'u chung tha ltag ④gung mo dang / /de bzhin 18—352

mdzub mo mthe bong ni/ /rim bzhin gzugs la sogs par gzung / /de rnams dngos po med pa yi/ /shes rab rnam par 'byed mtshan nyid/ /chos kyi sku ru rnam par bshad/ /de bzhin nyid dang ①gnyis med ming / /mi bskyod rin chen dpag med dang / /don yod rnam snang de bzhin gshegs/ /'di dag lag pa g.yas pa yi/ /mthe'u chung la sogs rim bzhin gnas/ /gnyis ka gcig tu sbyar ba yi/ /'di yi de nyid skyabs gsum pa/ /sangs rgyas chos dang dge 'dun te/ /gcig kyang gsum du brtags pa yin/ /phan tshun sbyor bas rdo rje sems/ /shes rab thabs kyi go 'phang mchog /thal mo spyor ba tsam gyis ni/ /sangs rgyas thams cad yang dag 'gugs/ /skyabs gsum de nyid gsum yin te/ /sku gsum rnam par thar gsum gyi tsa/ /zhal gsum yin te mdog gsum yang / /sbyor gsum dam tshig gsum sbyor bas/ /khams gsum du ni lha gsum gyi/ /dkyil 'khor gsum gyis dus gsum du/ /lam gsum gyis ni mchog gsum gyi/ /ji snyed du ni rtogs dupas bskul/ /gsol ba 'debs pa yid la byed/ /'jig rten rnams kyi don rnams byed/ /yang dag sangs rgyas de mnyes 'gyur/ /de nyid 'dir ni thal mor gnas/ /sems can gang de sangs rgyas yin/ /de bzhin nyid dang gnyis med chos/ /gnas med gnas pa'i sbyor ba yis/ /sangs rgyas thams cad rnam par bzhugs/ /zhes gsungs so/ /gsol pa/ 'dir gsang ba 'dus pa'i dkyil 'khor la lha rnams dgod pa slob dpon sna tshogs pa'i gzhung 'jig rten du rab tu 'jug par 'gyur te/ de ji ltar sgrub pa po rnams som nyi ma mchis par 'gyur/sems dpa' chen po legs so legs so/ /lung dang rigs pas so sor bshad 18—353

—par bya'o/ /ji ltar sku'i dkyil 'khor la phung po la sogs pa'i rang bzhin gyi lha rnams ming gis dgod pa de bzhin du phyung ba'i dkyil 'khor la yang lha rnams dgod par 'gyur ro/ /de lta mod kyi rtsa ba'i rgyud las lha dgod pa rdzogs par ma bstan pa ni 'di ltar slob dpon med par 'jug par ma gyur cig snyam du dgongs so/ /dkyil 'khor dgod pa yang gcig tu yongs su rdzogs par bcom ldan 'das kyis dpal rdo rje phreng ba zhes bya ba'i bshad pa'i rgyud las yang dag par gsungs te de la 'jug par bya'o/ /sems kyis gzhan ni mi bsam par/ /sems dpa' chen po mnyan par gyis/ /rdo rje slob dpon lus 'di la/ /rgyal ba'i sku ni rim bzhin gnas/ /dang po sku yi rdo rje ni/ /gzugs phung la ni rab tu bzhugs/ /rjes su chags pa'i rdo rje ni/ /tshor ba'i phung por rab tu bzhugs1—/ /bcom ldan gsung gi rdo rje ni/ /'du shes kyi ni phung por bzhugs / /mchod pa kun gyi rdo rje ni/ /'du byed kyi ni phung por bzhugs/ /bcom ldan thugs kyi rdo rje ni/ /rnam shes phung por yang dag bzhugs/ /'di yi sha sogs sa khams la/ /bcom ldan 'das yum spyan ma bzhugs/ /khrag sogs chu yi khams la ni/ /bcom ldan 'das yum zhumā ma bzhugs/ /dro ba la sogs me khams la/ /bcom ldan 'das yum gos dkar bzhugs/ /bskyod pa la sogs rlung khams la/ /bcom ldan 'das yum sgrol ma bzhugs/ /de yi mig gi dbang gnyis la/ /de bzhin gshegs pa sa snying bo/ /de yi rna ba'i dbang gnyis la/ /bde gshegs phyag na rdo rje'o/ /de yi sna yi dbang gnyis la//de bzhin gshegs pa mkha' snying bzhugs/ /de lce dbang la bzhugs pa ni/ /de bzhin gshegs pa 'jig rten dbang / /khams bzhi'i rang bzhin gong bu ni/ /18—354

rang gi lus zhes bya ming la/ /sgrib pa thams cad rnams sel ba/ /de bzhin gshegs pa 'dir bzhugs so/ /de yi yid kyi dbang po la/ /de bzhin gshegs pa 'jam dbyangs bzhugs/ /lus kyi tshigs ni thams cad la/ /nyude bzhin gshegs pa byams pa'o/ /lag pa g.yas pa'i rtsa bar ni/ /de bzhin gshegs pa gshin rje gshed/ /lag pa g.yon pa'i rtsa bar ni/ /bder gshegs gzhan gyis mi thub pa/ /kha yi padmar bzhugs pa ni/ /de bzhin gshegs pa rta mgrin no/ /gsang ba'i gnas su bzhugs pa ni/ /de bzhin gshegs pa bdud rtsi 'khyil/ /dpung pa g.yas par bzhugs pa ni/ /de bzhin gshegs pa mi g.yo ba/ /dpung pa g.yon par bzhugs pa ni/ /de bzhin gshegs pa 'dod pa'i rgyal/ /pus mo g.yas na bzhugs pa ni/ /de bzhin gshegs pa dbyug pa sngon/ /pus mo g.yon la bzhugs pa ni/ /de bzhin gshegs pa stobs po che/ /rang gi spyi bor bzhugs pa ni/ /de bzhin gshegs pa 'khor los sgyur ④/ /rkang pa'i mthil du bzhugs pa ni/ /de bzhin gshegs pa gnod mdzes te/ /lus ni 'di nyid kun la 'dir/ /sku yi dkyil 'khor zhes brjod pa/ /rdo rje slob dpon nyid kyi lus/ /sangs rgyas rnams kyi sku rdzogs pa/ /'di dag ma lus rdzogs sangs rgyas/ /rdo rje legs byas bstan pa ni/ /mya ngan 'das la 'jug par 'gyur/ /bcom ldan mya ngan 'das 'gyur thob/ /khyod kyi dge ba yongs su smin/ /de ni rdo rje slob dpon gyi—/ /lus la rgyal ba thams cad bzhugs/ /nyon cig mthong ba don yod kye//phyi ma'i dus na sems dpa' che/ /dang po'i las kyi sems can kyi/ /rab tu 'bad de bla ma bstenal// /de tshe mthong ba don yod bcas/ /byang chub sems 18—355

dpa' grags pa che/ /dga' zhing mgu la rab dang ldan/ /phyag 'tshal nas ni mchi ma blags/ /zhes gsungs so/ /gsol pa/ nyon mongs pa thams cad spangs pa'i sangs rgyas dang byang chub sems dpa' stobs bcu dang mi 'jigs pa la sogs pa ①sangs rgyas kyi yon tan brnyes pa rnams 'dir tha mal pa'i lus la dgod pa mi 'gal lags sam/ bka' stsal pa/ ji srid du bkru bshal gyi snod yin pa'i gnas skabs su ni mchil ma 'dor ②la gzhong pa'i gnas skabs su 'jig rten pa rnams zas za'o/ /gzugs brnyan gyi gnas skabs su mchod par byed do/ /de bzhin du tha mal pa'i lus la 'dod chags dang zhe sdang dang 5gti mug la sogs pas brlan pa'i sngon gyi gnas skabs su 'khor ba'i rgyu yin la phyis rang bzhin yongs su shes shing yongs su dag pas thams cad mkhyen pa grub pa'i rgyur 'gyur ba la skyon med do/ /de yang gsungs pa/ shin tu mi gtsang gzugs 'di gzung byas la④ / /rgyal ba'i rin chen gzugs byas rin thang med/ /rtsi yis sbyangs pa lta bur bskyed pa 'di/ /byang chub sems ni rab tu brtan par gzung / /zhes bya ba dang / de bzhin du yang dkon mchog brtsegs pa'i mdo las/ 'od srungs ⑤'di lta ste lud kyis g.yogs pa'i sa gzhi la gyes bon thams cad skye bar 'gyur ro/ /'od srungs de bzhin du nyon mongs pa'i lud kyis khyab pa'i 'jig rten pa rnams la byang chub sems dpa'i sangs rgyas kyi chos rnams skye bar 'gyur ro zhes gsungs pa dang / dgongs pa lung ston pa zhes bya ba'i rgyud las kyang / phra mo'i sbyor don de nyid shes/ /phyag na rdo rje grags chen la/ /'gro ba gnyis med sbyor ba yi⑦/ /phra mo'i de nyid dgongs pas gsungs/ /mngon par byang chub rnam lnga 'di/ /ma 'ongs 18—356

skye bo'i rgyu ①can yin/ /chos rnams yang dag brjod pa'i sku/ /ji lta ji ltar yin gsungs pa/ /phung po 'di dag sangs rgyas yin/ /rdzogs pa'i byang chub rkyen du 'gyur/ /gnyis med de bzhin nyid 'jug pas/ /de yang de bzhin gshegs par gsungs/ /zhes so/ /phyung ba'i dkyil 'khor gyi rim par phye ba ste gsum pa'o// //da ni don dam pa'i dkyil 'khor gyi rnam par gzhag ②pa bstan pa'i phyir/mdor bstan pa'i tshig rtsa ba'i rgyud la 1'jug par bya ste/ dam tshig khu phyung cho ga bzhin/ /'bras bu 'dod pas btung bar bya/ /de bzhin gshegs pa'i tshogs bsad nas/ /dngos grub rab mchog thob par 'gyur/ /zhes le'u bdun pa las mdor bstan te/ 'di'i bshad pa dgongs pa lung ston pa zhes bya ba'i bshad pa'i rgyud las gsungs te/ gzugs sogs nang gi chos rnams ni//mthong ba lhag mthong zhes bshad de/ /mi bskyod pa ④sogs grangs bzhin du/ /brtags pa dag ni zhig gnas bya/ /'di dag dngos po med 'gyur ba'i/ /de bzhin nyid ni zhi ming can/ /de bzhin nyid kyi dkyil 'khor du/ /rnal 'byor pas ni sangs rgyas gzhug /'di yang slar bshad pa rdo rje phreng ba zhes bya ba rnal 'byor chen po'i rgyud las gsungs te/ de la 'jug par bya'o/ /gzugs phung rtogs la me long dang / /sa khams mig gi dbang po dang / /gzugs dang rnam lngar gyur pa ste/ /khro bo byams par yang dag ldan/ /tshor ba'i phung po mnyam nyid dang / /chu khams rna ba'i dbang po dang / /sgra dang rnam lngar gyur pa ste/ /khro bo gnyis dang yang dag ldan/ /'du shes so sor rtog pa dang / /18—357

byin za sna yi dbang po dang / /dri dang nyurnam lngar gyur pa ste/ /khro bo gnyis dang yang dag ldan/ /'du byed bya ba grub pa dang / /rlung khams lce yi dbang po dang / /ro dang rnam lngar gyur pa ste/ /khro bo gnyis dang yang dag ldan/ /steng 'og khro bo shin tu bcas/ /rang bzhin gyis ni snang ba nyid/ /rnam shes phung por bzhugs pa ste/ /rnam shes kyang ni 'od gsal ba'o/ /mya ngan 'das bcas kun stong dang / /chos kyi sgur yang bshad pa yin/ /brtan par bya ba'i don du ni/ /gsang sngags 'di ni brjod par bya/ /oṃ shu n+ya tā dzñā na badzra swa bhā wa a dhikophohaṃ zhes brjod par bya'o/ /rnam par gzhag gepa bzhi pa 'di nyid kyis rdzogs pa la gnas pa nye bar bshad par bya ste/ de las ④gzugs kyi phung po 'od gsal du zhugs rgya pa'i mtshan ma mkhas pas shes par bya ste/ yan lag thams cad phra ba dang / lus kyi nyam pya chung zhing lhod par 'gyur ro/ /me long lta bu'i ye shes thim pa na rab rib tu 'gyur ro/ /sa'i khams 'gags pa na lus thams cad skams par 'gyur ro/ /mig gi dbang po 'gags ⑦pa na mig 'gyur zhing zum par 'gyur ro/ /gzugs kyi yul 'gags ⑧pa na rang gi lus kyi mdangs med cing nyams zad pa nyid du 'gyur ro/ /de ltar 'khor ba thog ma med pa nas rkang med dang / rkang gnyis dang / rkang bzhi dang /rkang mangs la sogs pa'i sems can rnam par snang mdzad kyi rigs can rnams sku'i dkyil 'khor la gnas te/ don dam pa'i dkyil 'khor du skad cig pa'i rim gyis 'jug go/ /gang dag cha shas la gnas pa de dag gi ni 'dir rnam par gzhag ⑨ pa med mod kyi/ 'on kyang rim gyis don dam pa'i bden par rab tu 'jug go/ /de bzhin du gnyis pa rin po che'i rigs kyi lha rnams 18—358

don dam pa'i bden par 'jug pa de'i tshe mtshan ma mkhas pas shes par bya ste/tshor ba'i phung po thim pa na rlung dang mkhris pa dang bad kan dang 'dus pa la sogs pa lus tshor ba nyams su myong bar mi 'gyur ro/ /mnyam pa nyid kyi ye shes thim pa na yid kyi tshor ba rnam pa gsum dran par mi 'gyur ro/ /chu'i khams skams pa na rang gi lus la kha chu dang khrag dang khu ba la sogs pa skams par 'gyur ro/ /rna ba'i dbang po thim pa na phyi dang nang du bcas pa'i sgra thos par mi 'gyur ro/ /sgra'i yul thim pa na rang gi lus kyi sgra thos par mi 'gyur ro//gnyis pa rin po che'i rigs kyi lha rjes su gzhug pa'o/ /gsum pa padma'i rigs kyi lha rnams 'jug pa'i dus su mtshan ma mkhas pas shes par bya ste/ 'du shes kyi phung po thim pa na rkang gnyis pa la sogs pa'i sems can rnams dran par mi 'gyur ro/ /so sor rtog pa'i ye shes thim pa na pha dang ma dang bu dang gnyen la sogs pa rnams khyadang 'gro ba thams cad kyi ming mi dran no/ /me'i khams thim pa na bza' ba thams cad mi 'ju'o/ /sna'i dbang po thim pa na steng gi rlung rtseg cing rtseg cing sar 'gro bar 'gyur ro/ /dri'i yul thim pa na rang gi lus la bhudri'i yul bro bar mi 'gyur ro/ /gsum pa padma'i rigs kyi lha rjes su gzhug pa'o—/ /bzhi pa las kyi rigs kyi lha rnams kyi yang dag pa'i mthar 'jug pa'i mtshan ma mkhas pas shes par bya ste/ de la 'du byed kyi phung po thim pa na lus kyi bya ba thams cad la 'jug par mi 'gyur ro/ /bya ba grub pa'i ye shes thim pa na 'jig rten pa'i bya ba dang dgos pa dran par mi 'gyur ro/ /rlung gi khams thim pa na srog la sogs pa'i rlung bcu rang gi gnas nas 'pho'o/ /lce'i dbang po thim pa na lce sbom pa dang thung ba dang rtsa ba sngon por 'gyur ro/ /ro'i lus 18—359

thim pa na ro drug nyams su mi myong ngo / /bzhi pa las kyi rigs kyi lha rnams rjes su gzhug pa'o/ /lhag ma rang bzhin gyi snang ba 'jam dpal gyi ye shes rim pa gnyis par bya ste/ de yang srog dang rtsol ba dang bcas par rdo rje bzlas pa'i rim pas gnas te/ ril por 1'dzin pa dang / rjes su gzhig pa'i rim pas mi shigs pa mngon sum du bya ste/ 'dzin pa nye bar bsdus nas de'i tshe/oṃ shu n+ya tā dzñā na badzra swa bhā wa ātma dukophohaṃ zhes bya ba'i sngags kyis pedon mngon sum byed par 'gyur ro/ /gsol pa/ sngags 'di'i don bcom ldan 'das rdo rje slob dpon ston pas bshad du gsol/ rdo rje slob dpon kyis gsungs pa/bcom ldan 'das kyis bshad pa'i rgyud las gsungs te/ de bshad par bya'o/ /de nas de bzhin gshegs pa kun/ /phra mo'i sbyor ba rnam par gzhug④ /oṃ zhes pas ni gcig dang ldan/ /shu n+ya tā ni gnyis pa yin/ /dzñā na zhes pa gsum pa yin/ /bzhi pa badzra ming can te/ /swa bhā wa yis tsako lnga pa/ /drug pa a haṃ zhes su brjod/ /de ltar de bzhin gshegs pa drug /skye bo mchog la bstan pa yin/ /oṃ shu n+ya tā zung dang po'o/ /dzñā na badzra gnyis pa yin/ /swa bhā wa ātma kolhahaṃ ༷ gsum pa yin/ /de nyid gsum du 'di ru bstan/ /de nyid gsum ni gcig tu 'gyur/ /gsal dang mi gsal ming can te/ /gzhan yang rdo rje 'dzin gang zhig /gsum gyi brda dang ldan pa'i mi/ /spyan drangs gshegs su gsol ba dang / /de bzhin du ni bzhugs pa'o/ /'jug pa yis ni spyan drangs te/ /myur ba yis ni gshegs su gsol/ /dal ba yis ni de bzhugs 'gyur/ /dag pa las ni dngos grub mchog /skyes bu de de'i sbyor ba yis—/ /phyag rgya chen po gcig tu 'gyur/ /myur ba la sogs gsum ldan pa/ /18—360

phyag rgya sgrub par ①bshad pa yin/ /myur dang rnam bsdus dal ba can/ /sngags su nges par sbyor ba yi/ /slob dpon gyis ni 'bad pa yisaphya/ /slob ma'i rna ba'i drung du brjod/ /dpal gsang ba 'dus pa zhes bya ba'i rnal 'byor chen po'i rgyud las don dam pa'i dkyil 'khor gyi rnam par gzhag pa'i rim par phye ba ste bzhi pa'o// //grub pa'i slob dpon klu'i blo'i zhal snga nas ④mdzad pa rnam par gzhag snipa'i rim pa bzhi pa rdzogs so// //bsdur mchan/337 ①mtshan byang 'di chos tshan 'di'i mtshan bod skad du smos pa ltar bkod cing / 〈〈pe 〉〉〈〈snar 〉maradus pa'i sgrub thabs rnam par bzhag pa'i rim pa zhes bya ba grub pa'i slob dpon klu'i blo'i zhal snga nas mdzad pa'o//zu〈〈snar 〉〉la—/ zhu〈〈pe 〉sko〈snar 〉thazhag ④〈〈pe 〉sko〈snar 〉med/338 ①〈〈pe 〉sko〈snar 〉〉skyed/ rju (〈pe 〉sko〈snar 〉〉gyis/ zhu〈〈snar 〉〉gib/ ④〈〈pe 〉thazhag thu〈〈pe 〉sko〈snar 〉〉kyi—/ pya〈〈pe 〉sko〈snar 〉〉pang / ⑦〈〈pe 〉〉〈〈snar 〉〉to/ / tsa 〈〈pe 〉〉〈〈snar 〉〉gi/ tū〈〈pe 〉〉sgrub cing skyed/〈〈snar 〉〉sgrub cing skyes/ ⑪〈〈pe 〉sko〈snar 〉ra /329 / ①〈〈pe 〉sko〈snar 〉rkam/ tsa/〈〈pe 〉snga〈snar 〉ra gas/ ④〈〈pe 〉sko〈snar 〉7ngon/ ④ 〈〈pe 〉sko〈snar 〉〉skyed/⑤〈〈pe 〉sko〈snar 〉rimangon/ bye 〈〈pe 〉thardzus/34 nyu〈〈pe 〉sko〈snar 〉thardzus/ bhu〈〈pe 〉snga〈snar 〉7ma/ rju〈〈pe 〉〉〈〈snar 〉7du/ ④/〈〈pe 〉snga〈snar〉rapyod/⑤〈〈pe〉sko〈snar 〉ṅkab/ pya 〈〈pe 〉sko〈snar 〉7)/ ④〈〈pe 〉〉〈〈snar 〉skorakhrung zhing /341 ①〈〈pe 〉sko〈snar 〉༅'i/ ṭu〈〈pe 〉〉〈〈snar 〉lke/ zhu〈〈snar 〉jo'i/ ④〈〈pe 〉sko〈snar 〉ra na/342 ①〈〈co 〉re/ zhu〈〈co 〉tsād/ 3〈〈pe 〉〉〈〈snar 〉7tshig344 ①〈〈pe 〉snga〈snar 〉7gnyi ga'ang mchog tu dga' ba'i bde bas tshim par bya'o// bu〈〈pe 〉sko〈snar 〉ṅkadang /18—361
bsdur 'bras re'u mig da/ (638)18wa 363

༄ga /dpal gsang ba 'dus pa'i dkyil 'khor gyi cho ga nyi shu pa zhes bya ba/༄1༄4/ /rgya gar skad du/ shrī gu hya sa mā tsadza maṇḍa la u pā yi ka bye bo sha ta 4bi dhi nā ma/ bod skad du/ dpal gsang ba 'dus pa'i dkyil 'khor gyi cho ga nyi shu pa zhes bya ba/ dpal rdo rje sems dpa' la phyag 'tshal lo/ /gnyis med ye shes sgu mnga' ba/ /dang po'i mgon la phyag 'tshal nas/ /rdo rje slob mar phan 'byung ba/ /dkyil 'khor yan lag bdag gis bshad/ /bya rgyud cho ga ma gtogs par/ /spyod dang gnyi ga'i rnal 'byor gyis/ /grub pa'i dkyil 'khor sangs rgyas ni/ /kun lugs las 'ongs yang dag bsngags/ /dang por sa ni sbyang ba dang / /de nas sa yongs 'dzin pa dang / /phyi nas bgegs ni nyer zhi dang / /thod le kor gyis thig gdab dang / /de nas sa lha sogs lhag par/ /gnas dang de nas gsol gdab dang / /phyi nas slob ma lhag gnas dang / /nam mkhar thig ni gdab pa dang / /tshon sna lnga yi cho ga 18byed364

dang / /tshon rtsi rnams ni dgye ba dang / /lha rnams spyan drang 1nyid dang ni/ /de nas slob ma gzhug pa dang / /khrus kyi dkyil 'khor cho ga dang / /de nas sangs rgyas dbang bskur dang / /de nas phyag mtshan dbang bsgur dang / /bla ma lha dang yon gnyis dang / /rjes su gnang ba sbyin pa dang / /de nas gshegs gsol cho ga dang / /dkyil 'khor las ched (phur pa dang / /skud pa bsdu ba nyid kyang ste/ /rab bshad cho ga nyi shu yis/ /ji lta ji ltar rgyas shes pa'i / /rdo rje slob dpon mkhas pa yis/ /rdul tshon dkyil 'khor bri bar bya//kha cig grub pa brgyad 'dod pas/ /dkyil 'khor 'di la 'jug par 'gyur/ /de bzhin bden mthong de bzhin du/ /dpa' bo sngags pa brtag — pa ste/ /de dag sbyor ba bla ma yis/ /rig ④nas bla ma mkhas pa yis/ /slob ma'i don du sabasgrub bya'i phyir/ /'khor lo rnam brgyad bri bar bya/ /rin chen sa bon de bzhin dang / /me tog tshon dang de bzhin du/ /bye ma g.yo dang phye ma ste/ /de bzhin yid kyi dkyil 'khor bden/ /sa bon dgod dang phyag mtshan dang / /yang na lha yi sku nyid ni/ /'bur du btod dang lugs ma ni/ /stobs bzhin dkyil 'khor la dgod bya/ /phreng ba chu dang rdzogs sangs rgyas/ /rdo rje dril bu me long dang / /ming dang slob dpon rjes gnang zhes/ /bya ba 'di ni dbang bskur rim/ /de bzhin gshegs pas rdo rje yi/ /theg par slob dpon rnam gnyis gsungs/ /gcig ni gsang sngags gtsor byed 'gyur/ /gcig ni bsam gtan la gzhol ba/ /gsang sngags smrar gnas rnal 'byor pa/ /lha la dmigs pa lhur len pas/ /de las mtshan ma rnyed gyur te/ /rdul tshon dkyil 'khor bri bar bya/ /gsang sngags tshul gnas rnal 'byor pa/ /gnyis med ye 18—365

shes spyor ldan pas/ /sgyu ma lta bu'i lus kyis ni/ /'khor lo sgyu ma lta bu bri/ /grong khyer grong dang grong rdal dang / /kun dga' tshong 'dus gtsug lag ni/ /khang du pus nub tsam brkos nas/ /rim gyis sa ni sbyang bar bya/ /shing dang gyo mo gseg ma dang / /de bzhin rus pa sol ba dang / /skra la sogs pa bsal byas nas/ /de nas sa ni sbyang bya ste/ /kun nas steng ni yang dag par / /bsnyams te ba lang phyi bas byug /dri yi chu yis bsangs nas ni/ /phyi nas drag po'i sbyin sreg bya/ /sngags pa rdo rje sems zlos shing / /rdo rje'i lta bas blta bar bya/ /dkyil 'khor gyi ni sa yi cha/ /skyon dang ldan yang spyod par 'gyur/ /gsang dbang rtog pa la gnas shing / /byang chub sems ni rnam spangs pa'i/ /sngags pa gang zhig sa sbyang ①bar/ /byed pa de yis 'grub mi 'gyur—/ /sa sbyang ba'i cho ga'o// //de nas bla re sogs brgyan cing / /mchod pa lnga dang bcas pa yi/ /'khor lo'i khyim du phyin nas su/ /sa ni yongs su gzung bar bya/ /dkar la ma nyams gos 'chang zhing / /gtsug tor dag pa yis brgyan la/ /rgyan rnams thams cad kyis spud cing / /dri bzangs byug 9pa'i chal 'thor bas /nyi ma gsum du thun gsum du/ /cho ga ji bzhin gtor ma dbul/ /de nas bgegs rnams zhi bar ni/ /bya phyir phyogs skyong bcu la'o/ /brtul zhugs brtan pas zhi ba yi/ /sbyin sreg tshul bzhin sngar byas nas/ /phyi nas dbang bskur rab grub phyir/ /slob mas kyang ni byed du gzhug /sa yongs su gzung ba'i cho ga'o// //18—366

zhe sdang rdo rje'i ting 'dzin la/ /gnas shing khro bos yongs bskor ba'i/ /rnal 'byor pa yis thabs byung tshe/ /bgegs ni nges par bsal bar bya/ /rkang mthil rdo rje bsam byas nas/ /rdo rje gsor ba lhur len zhing / /rdo rje'i rnam nyu༄sgeg gar byed bzhin/ /hūṃ yig drag po che bar bcas/ /yi ge ṭa yis mig g.yon zla bar byas/ /yi ge ma yis mig g.yas nyi ma bkod/ /rdo rje 'dzin kyi bsnyems la 'chang ba yis/ /dkyil 'khor sa yi cha la 'gro byed cing / /mnga' bdag brtse spuba'i bdag nyid kyis/ /brgya byin la sogs gdug pa yi/ /tshogs bcas sa dang bar snang dang / /phyogs nas bsal bye bya 'di skad brjod/ /a pa sa rantu bha brnyo yi ge tsi ta de ba a su ra yakṣa rākṣa ༄sa pre tapi shā tsa a pasmra ra bhū ta ḍā ki n+ya oṃ phyesta ra kamā hakhri sneka ma halli ka 3a nu —ra sa pa ri kha ta ga ru ḍa ki pu ru ṣa mant+ra sidhi/ bdag gis sa 3phyogs 'dir slob ma che ge mo'i rdzogs pa'i byang chub rdzogs par bya ba'i phyir dang / sems can thams cad bla na med pa'i ye shes thob par bya ba'i phyir dpal rdo rje sems dpa'i dkyil 'khor bri bar bya'o/ /rdo rje 'dzin pa chen po'i bye/bka' stsal pa 'di thos nas myur du dengs shig /gang zhig mi dengs pa de'i nyu— mgo bo ye shes kyi rdo rje chen po 'bar ba dag tt+waṃ gi rdo rje 'bar zhing rab tu 'bar ba 'dis tshal pa brgyar 'gas par tsu2bya'o/ /de skad lan gsum brjod nas de nas ni/ /sngags pa khro bar gyur cing shar phyogs na/ /gnas pas hūṃ yig phyag rgya dang bcas par/ /g.yas brkyang sngon 'gro'i sbyor ba tshul bzhin bya/ /g.yas brkyang dang / g.yon brkyang dang / sa ga dang / zlum po dang / mnyam pa'i stang stabs dang /rus sbal kyi stang stabs dang / rdo rje phul byung dang / rdo rje sgeg pa dang /18—367

rkang gcig gis 'phur stangs dang / bung ba'i 'phur stangs dang / seng ge'i stang stabs dang / seng ge'i gal thupa dang / rdo rje lcags sgrog dang /rdo rje skor 2'dzin dang / rdo rje 'phen pa dang / rdo rje'i gar stabs dang /rdo rje 'jigs ༄/byed dang / rdo rje ro langs dang / rdo rje tho ba dang / gdong bzhi byin gyis brlab pa dang / rdo rje 'khyil ba dang / bud med ltar sgyu 'phrul byed pa dang / rdo rje lcags sgrog dang / stobs po che phul byung dang /rdo rje mche ba dang / rdo rje bzhad pa dang / rdo rje sgrogs pa dang / ral gri'i tshul dang / rdo rje'i tshul dang / 'khor lo'i tshul dang / gtun shing gi tshul dang / ba dan kyi tshul dang / zhags pa'i tshul dang / padma'i tshul dang /gtum po'i tshul dang / mi 'jigs pa'i tshul dang / lcags kyu'i tshul dang /thong gshol gyi tshul dang / 'phang mdung gi tshul dang / mda' 'gengs pa'i tshul dang / mda' 'dren cepa'i tshul dang / mda' 'phen pa'i tshul dang / thag mdung 'phen pa'i tshul dang / mchog sbyin pa'i tshul dang /mdung thung gi tshul dang / chu'i tshul dang / phyag 'tshal ba'i tshul dang / rdo rje'i 'dug tshul dang / bsam gtan pa'i tshul dang / rdo rje'i skyil krung dang /padma'i 'dug tshul dang / sems dpa'i skyil krung dang / dpa' bo'i 'dug tretshul dang / bzang po'i 'dug tshul dang / tsog tsog por 'dug tshul dang / rol pa'i 'dug tshul dang / mngon du phyogs pa'i tshul dang / rgyab kyis 7phyogs pa'i tshul zhes bya ba'o/ /sngags pa rang bzhin shes pa yis /stang stabs de ltar dbang po sogs/ /tshogs bzang bsdigs nas phyogs skyong rnams / /ji bzhin phur bus yang dag gdab/ /seng ldeng phur ba sor 18—368

brgyad pa'i/ /tshad dang ldan pa blangs nas ni/ /tshon sna lnga pa'i skud pa yis/ /de ni go rims bzhin du dkri/ /dri dang me tog sogs rnams kyis/ /mchod nas snod ni sar par gzhagasne /lag par reg cing phur bu la/ /yi ge gsum gyis mngon par bsngags/ /de ltar 'dus byas phur pa ni/ /kun rdzob rang bzhin mthon kyepo las/ /blo dang ldan pas rim pa 'dis/ /slar yang bsam gtan rang bzhin bya/ /oṃ sumbha ni sumbha hūṃ/ kṛṇḍa kṛhā tt+waṃ/ grettha pa ya kṛza pa ya hūṃ/ ā na ya ho bha ga wān bibyā ge rā dza hūṃ phaṭa/ khro bo'i gzugs can 'di yis ni/ /de ltar log 'dren kun bkug ste/ /blo dang ldan pas spyor ba yis / /cho ga bzhin du phur bus gdab/ /rdo rje bdud rtsi rgyal po che/ /utpal sngon po'i 'dab ltar sngo/ /'bar ba'i phreng bas 'khrigs 'od ④can/ /rdo rje phur bu rnam par bsgomashe/ /lte ba'i phyogs nas smad kyi cha/ /rtse mo'i rnam par rab tu bsgom/ /stong ni khro bo'i rnam pa dang / /zhal gsum rnam pa phyag drug tu'o/ /gnod mdzes gzugs 'dzin rdo rje can/ /gcig gis rdo rje tho ba ste/ /g.yon pas phur pa 'dzin byed cing / /gsang sngags 'di yis phur bus gdab/ /oṃ gha gha ghā ta ya ghā ta ya/ sarba duṣṭhan phaṭa phaṭa/ shī la tī la ya sarba pā paṃ phaṭa phaṭa/ hūṃ hūṃ hūṃ badzra tī la ya/ badzra dha ro thu.ādzñā pa ya ti/sarba bispyon/ kā ya wāka tsitta badzra tsoshī la ya tt+waṃ hūṃ hūṃ phaṭa phaṭasnye / de ltar rtogs spupa'i rnal 'byor gyis/ /bgegs rnams bsal nas sngags rig pas/ /bde mchog dpal gsungs cho ga yis/ /slar yang bgegs rnams sbyang bar bya/ /rgyal ba rnams kyis rnam par sbyong mdzad pa/ /sems can phyir yin las sbyang bya phyir min/ /'di na bgegs yod ma yin bdud rnams sam ge/ /rtog pas 78—369

'phel med byen rlabs 'grub med nyid/ /bdag bdud nyid dam brtan pa nyid mi 'go/ /brtan pa nyid phyir rjes su bstan mi bya/ /rang bdes kyebasgrub kyi sdug bsngal gyis min — gang / /byang chub mchog rab myur phyir brtan par bya/ /bgegs nye bar zhi ba'i cho ga'o// //de nas legs par mnyam gzhag kyepa'i/ /slob dpon bla ma thabs cig pa//blo dang ldan pas rim pa 'dis/ /thod le kor gyis thig gdab bya/ /slob dpon chu lha'i phyogs gnas dang / /slob ma mngon du phyogs gyur pa/ /dbang po'i phyogs na gnas pa yis/ /tshangs pa'i thig ni gdab par bya/ /sngags rig gshin rje'i phyogs gnas pa/ /slob ma lus ngan phyogs gnas dang / /lhan cig tshangs pa'i thig gnyis pa/ /yang dag par ni gdab par bya/ /slob dpon me lhar gnas pa dang / /slob ma mngon du phyogs gyur pa/ /dbang ldan du ni gnas nyid kyis/ /rtsa ba'i thig ni gdab par bya/ /de nyid du gnas rdo rje can/ /thig shes pa la mkhas pa dang / /bden bral la gnas bu yis 4ni/ /lho phyogs kyi ni thig gdab bya/ /de nyid du gnas slob ma dang / /rlung lhar sgoganas pa'i slob ma yis/ /bden bral rlung lha la gnas pa'i/ /thig ni gsum pa gdab par bya/ /de nyid du gnas rnam khu'abyor pa/ /las shes pa dang zhi phyogs su/ /gnas pa'i bu yis phyi nas ni/ /rtsa thig bzhi pa gdab par bya/ /me lhar gnas pa'i slob dpon ni/ /rang gi lha yi sbyor ldan dang / /rlung lhar gnas pa'i sngags pa yis/ /mtshams kyi thig kyang gdab par bya/ /bla ma dbang ldan phyogs su ni/ /gnas nas slob ma bden bral du/ /18—370

gnas pa yis ni mtshams kyi thig /gnyis pa yang dag gdab par bya /sgyu ma'i lus ni dran bzhin du/ /de nas sgo ni rnam par dbye/ /sgo ni 'khor lo'i brgyad cha ste/ /lha yi snam bu de bzhin no/ /sgo khyud sgo yi tshad du ste/ /de bzhin 'gram dang ngos kyang ngo / /de yi phyed du kha khyer ro/ /kha khyer phyed du tshon gyi sa/ /rtsa ba'i thig gi phyed kyis ni/ nang gi dkyil 'khor tshad yin te/ /'od zer lnga yis rnam brgyan cing / /rdo rje phreng bas 'bar bar bya/ /nang gi dkyil 'khor phyi rol du/ /thig bzhi yang dag bri bar bya/ /nang du ka ba brgyad po ni/ /'khor los mtshan cing legs mdzes bri/ /rdo rje ka ba'i bar dang bar/ /de nyid du ni re'u mig dgu/ /dra ba kha khyer tshad du 'gyur/ /rin chen pha gu de phyed du/ /'bab ༄rteli dang ni mda' yab dang / /phyi rol ka ba'i sa de bzhin/ /bum pa ka ba'i steng gnas pa/ /rta babs sgo yi sum 'gyur te/ /mda' yab dang ni bya 'dab dang / /ldan zhing dril bu nges par 'khrol—/ /ba dan dag dang rnga yab dang / /me tog chun 'phyang sogs mdzes pa'othu / /dkyil 'khor gyi ni zur bzhi po/ /zla phyed nor bu rdo rje 'dzin/ /sgo khyud kyi ni mtshams rnams su/ /rdo rje rin chen rnams kyis spras/ /rta babs rdo rje'i rtse mo can/ /de yi phyi rol khor yug ste/ /rdo rje'i phreng ba 'od zer rgyas/ /thig btab pa las grub 'gyur ba'obye / /gzhan rnams 'khor lo'i rjes mthun par/ /ji ltar mdzes par rab tu brtag /sngags pas slob ma'i nus pa dang / /rjes su bstun nas dkyil 'khor de/ /khru gang pa nas brtsams byas nas/ /khru stong bar du bri bar bya/ /thod le kor gyis thig gdab pa'i cho ga'o// //18—371

bgegs rnams phur pas btab byas te/ /de nas ra ba dra ba sogs/ /bsams nas rdo rje'i rang bzhin sa1/ /thig btab lhag par gnas par bya/ /skyob pa sangs rgyas thams cad kyisatso/ /skyod pa'i tshul kyi khyad par dang / /sa dang pha rol phyin rnams la/ /lha mo khyod ni dpang du 'gyur༄ / /skyob pa shākya seng ge yis/ /ji ltar bdud kyi dpung bcom ltar/ /de bzhin bdag gis ④bdud kyi dpung / /pham par byas te dkyil 'khor bri/ /dri zhim sogs kyis sa byugs te/ /me tog sna tshogs kyis bkram nas/ /tsandan sogs kyis lha gnas su/ /mkhas pas maṇḍal rab tu bya/ /gser gyi'am geyang na dngul gyi'am / /zangs sam sa yi rang bzhin nyid/ /ji ltar rnyed pa bzung nas ni//brtul zhugs can gyis bum pa gzhagatre /byi ru dngul dang gser dang ni/ /padma rā ga mu tig ste/ /rin chen shis pa lnga po rnams/ /bum pa'i chu yi nang du gzhug /nas dang gro dang mo sran gre'u/ /til dang de bzhin mon sran sde'u3—/ /'bru ni shis pa lnga po rnams/ /bum pa'i nang du gzhug par bya/ /chen po tsher ma'i dgra dang ni/ /lhar bcas gzhan gyis mi thub dang / / daṇḍi ta 8utpal rtsa ba ste/ /sman lnga po ni gzhug par bya/ /a mra u dusmra ༄9ra dang / /mya ngan 'tshang dang a shwa dzeeka /de bzhin klu shing skyes yal ga /bum pa'i kha mdzes lnga gzugs so/ /gos ni dkar po chen po yis/ /bum pa'i mgrin pa basbung bar bya/ /gos kyi steng du srad bu dag /dkar po cho ga mkhas pas dgod—/ /mkhas pas gur kum la sogs pa/ /mngon 'dus byas pas dkyil 'khor pa/ /kun kyi sa bon nam mtshan ma/ /bum pa'i ngos la nges par bri/ /rin po che la sogs ldan zhing / /rang gi sngags kyis mngon bsngags ༄ rtepa/ /chu 18—372

bcas 'di rnabyus blo ldan gyis/ /lha yi grangs kyis gzhag tshupar bya/ /dkyil 'khor gyi ni tshwa ṭu bzhi dang / /'khor ༄ ༄yug gi ni nang dag tu4/ /blo dang ldan pas bum pa kazhag5 /gcig ni sgo la gzhag snepar bya/ /sa'i lha mo dang 3bum pa lhasapar gnas pa'i cho ga'o// //phyo nas gos dmar 'dzin cing rgyan/ /thams cad kyis ni brgyan gyur cing / /dril bu dang bcas bla ma yis/ /bsnyems bcas rdo rje gsor byas te/ /bar snang la gnas sangs rgyas dang / /dkyil 'khor pa rnams go rims bzhin/ /bltas nas mig rgyas 'gyur ba yis/ /tshig 'di dag ni 3gsal bar brjod/ /deng du bdag tshe 'bras bur bcas/ / bdag gi gson pa 'bras bur bcas/ /she bdag ni dam tshig lha rnams dang / /mnyam par gyur pa the tshom med/ /byang chub sems dpa' sems gcig pa/ /bdag ni phyir mi ldog par 'gyur/ /bdag deng de bzhin gshegs pa yi/ /ris su skye bar gdon mi za/ /sangs rgyas thams cad spyan drangs pas/ /deng du bdag gi nyi ma mchog /deng bdag mchod sbyin bla na med/ /deng du bdag gi 'dus pa mchog /de nas sangs rgyas de dag la/ /btud de mchod yon phul nas ni/ /blo dang ldan pas phyi nang gi/ /mchod pas mchod de 'di skad brjod/ /ma lus phyogs na bzhugs pa yi/ /sangs rgyas rnams ni bdag la dgongs/ /rdo rje can bdag che ge mo/ /zhes ni bgyi ba'i dkyil 'khor 'dri/ /sangs rgyas kun deng gshegs su gsol/ /dngos grub 'di ni stsal du gsol/ /dkyil 'khor chen po'i las la ni/ /ci nus bzhin du rab tu bkyi/ /de nas bsnyems bcas 18—373

langs nas ni/ /rdzogs rims rnal 'byor dang ldan pa'i/ /brtul zhugs can gyis 'gro byed cing / /dril bu dgrol bzhin 'di skad brjod/ /bdag ni bhurang nyid rdo rje can/ /rdo rje sems dpa' bdag rang nyid/ /bdag ni sangs rgyas rgyal po che/ /bdag ni rnal 'byor dbang phyug rgyal/ /bdab ni phyag na — rdo rje brtan/ /bdag ni bdag po rdo rje che/ /deng bdag rdo rje sems dpar 3grub / /de nas sangs rgyas sangs rgyas lnga'i/ /rigs 'byung rnams la gsol ba gdab/ /de dag bar snang gnas bsams nas/ /'di skad brjoྈ cing bskul bar bya/ /thugs rje yi ni bdag can bdag /slob ma rnams la rjes brtse dang / /khyed cag la yang mchod beed du/ /sang byeni dkyil 'khor ṣpebar 'tshal / /bcom ldan gus pas bdag la ni/ /de'i phyir bka' drin mdzad par 'os/ /rdo rje can bdag che ge mo/ /zhes bgyi'i dkyil 'khor mdzes pa ri //che ge ci nus yo byad kyis/ /sang ni yang dag 'dri bar 'gyur/ /de phyir slob mar bcas bdag la/ /rjes su brtse bas ④nyer bzung nas/ /'khor bcas kun gyis dkyil 'khor la/ /byin gyis brlab par mdzad par 'os sre'agro ba 'don pa'i bsam ldan pas/ /'khor los sgyur ba'i sgeg pa yis/ /bsgrubs trenas gdul bar bya ba rnams/ /shar sgor lhag par gnas par bya/ /de nas 'khor lo can mchod nas/ /bla ma byang chub gsol ba la/ /slob mas me tog thal mo ni/ /snying gar sbyar byas gsol ba gdab/ /slob dpon khyod ni dgongs su gsol/ /dga' chen khyod bdag ston pa ste/ /byang chub chen po'i tshul brtan pa/ /mgon po chen po bdag 'tshal lo/ /dam tshig de nyid 18—374

bdag la gsol/ /byang chub sems kyang bdag la gsol/ /sangs rgyas chos dang dge 'dun te/ /skyabs gsum bdag la sprul du gsol/ /thar pa chen po'i grong mchog tu/ /mgon pos bdag ni 'jug nyutu gsol/ /sangs rgyas dang byang chub sems dpa' thams cad bdag la dgongs su gsol/ bdag che ge mo zhes bgyi ba dus 'di nas bzung ste/ ji srid byang chub kyi snying po la mchis kyi bar du/ byang chub sems ni bla na med/ /dam pa bdag gis bskyed par bgyi/ /deng nas bzung ste sdom pa ni/ /sangs rgyas rnal 'byor 'byung ba gzung / /rdo rje rigs mchog chen po la/ /rdo rje dril bu phyag rgya yang / /yang dag nyid du gzung bar bgyi/ /slob dpon dag kyang gzung bar bkyi/ /rin chen rigs byemachog chen po yi/ /dam tshig yid du 'ong ba la/ /nyi ma re re lan drug tu/ /sbyin pa rnam bzhi snerab tu sbyin/ /padma'i rigs chen dag pa ni—/ /byang chub chen po 'byung ba la/ /phyi dang gsang ba theg gsum pa/ /dam pa'i chos ni gzung bar bgyi/ /las kyi rigs mchog chen po la/ /sdom pa thams cad ldan par ni/ /yang dag nyid du gzung bar bgyi/ /mchod pa'i las kyang ci nus bgyi/ /byang chub sems ni bla med pa/ /dam pa bskyed par bgyis nas ni/ /sems can kun gyi rtsedon gyi phyir/ /sdom pa ma lus gzung bar bgyi/ /ma rgal rub rnams bsgral bar bgyi/ /ma grol ba rnams bdag gis dgrol/ /dbugs ma phyin rnams dbugs dbyung trezhing / /mya ngan 'das la dgod par bgyi/ /slob ma dang ni bla ma yis/ /dang por lan gsum brjod nas ni/ /de nas gsang sngags rig pa yin/ /so shing la sogs sbyin par bya/ /srid du sor ni bcu gnyis pa/ /'o ma'i shing las byung zhing sar3/ /18—375

ma gas rtse mor me tog bcas/ /gsang sngags 'di yis 'cha' ru gzhug /oṃ badzra hā sa haḥ/ shar dang byang gi nyuphyogs gnas nas/ /bcas te de ni 'dor du gzhug /de nas bla mas phyogs kyi ni/ /rnam dbyes zhi sogs bstan par bya/ /de nas ku sha rtsar bcas shing / /skyon spangs pa rnams blangs nas ni / /stan dang sngas phyir slob ma la/ /sngags 'di yis ni steng du gzhug /oṃ badzra ṣṭṛkyā gebaṃ/ bu mos skud pa sum bsgril pa/ /mdud gsum mngon par legs bsngags ༄ pa'i/ /gsang sngags 'di yis rang nyid kyis/ /dpung pa g.yas la bcing bar bya/ /oṃ budhe 5mo tri rakṣa rakṣa sarban phyeswā hā/ de nas bla mas de'i snying ga /lkog ma spyi bo rim bzhin du/ /rdo rje de bzhin pad 'khor lo/ /yi ge gsum gyis sprul pa bsam/ /slar yang dri chu yig gsum gyis//bzlas shing legs par 'dus byas pa/ /de nyid rig pas gsang sngags 'dis/ /sdig pa sbyang phyir 'thung du gzhug /oṃ shuddhā dharmā ṭusarba pā paṃ tsun a su bi sho dha ya sarpā bi kalbān a pa na ya hūṃ/ de nas slob ma de nyid ni/ /de nyid rtogs la de nyid don/ /dran bya'i phyir dang rnam g.yengs pa⑨/ /zhi bar bya phyir dam chos bstan/ /sangs rgyas rnams kyis chos bstan pa/ /bden pa gnyis la yang dag brten/ /'jig rten kun rdzob bden pa dang / /da ma pa'i don gyi ju bden pa'o/ /zab mo nyid ni rnam mi rtog /rgya che sangs rgyas rnams kyi sku/ /zab dang rgya che zhes grags pa/ /bden pa gnyis zhes bya bar bshad—/ /kun rdzob dang ni dam pa'i don/ /rnam dbye so sor shes nas ni/ /phyi nas slar yang bsreg bya ste/ /go 'phang zad pa med par bsgom༄ 3/ /de yis kun du kun las kun/ /rnam kun kun tshe rang nyid ni/ /sangs rgyas 18—376

thams cad rang bzhin du/ /grub par rang nyid kyis mthong 'gyur/ /byang chub sus kyang byin ma yin/ /su yis kyang ni bzung ma yin/ /rang chos yongs su shes pa las/ /de la sangs rgyas sangs rgyas brjod/ /sems can bag la nyal byed pahu/ /yang dag mgon pos de nyid ni/ /'bad pas sbas nas phung po ni/ /rin chen za ma tog tu bzhag /de phyir bla ma'i zhabs kyi ni—/ /drin gyis 'bad pas rtogs byas te/ /de nyid kyis yid gsal gyur pas—/ /de nas spyod pa 3rab tu bya/ /'di na gtsang sbra nges sdom med/ /dka' thub med cing dka' spyad med/ /dka' spyad med cing nges med la/ /bde ba bsten pas 'grub par 'gyur/ /dkyil 'khor dam pa mthong nas ni/ /bskal pa bye ba mtha' yas su/ /sngan chad sdig pa gang byas pa/ /de dag thams cad zad par 'gyur/ /de skad yang dag bstan byas nas/ /ku sha bting bar nyal du gzhug /mtshan mo mthong ba gang de kun/ /bdag la smros shig ces bstan bya/ /nang par dge mi dge thos nas/ /dge ba slar yang spel bar bya/ /mi dge dge ni rmi lam bdag /med pa'i gtam gyis rnam par sbyang / /slob ma lhag par gnas pa'i cho ga'o// //lus dang ngag sems goms pa yisnye/ /shes rab can gyis thig skud ni/ /sar pa legs par bsgril gyur pa/ /tshad legs mdzes pas thig gdab bya/ /zhes bya ba ni bstan pa'i tshig go/ /mdo 'di'i bshad pa rgyas par brjod par bya ste—/ thig skud dkyil 'khor gnyis 'gyur te/ /sbom min de bzhin phra ba min//ji lta ji ltar sangs rgyas ‘snga'i/ /bdag can mdog lngas kha bsgyur ba/ /sa 18—377

bon de des bzlas gyur pa/ /snod ni gtsang mar gzhag kyepar bya/ /sngags pa mi bskyod spyor ldan pas/ /rtag pa'i rnal 'byor pa la sbyin/ /sa bon lnga yis bzlas pa de/ /slob mas blangs nas 'gro bar bya/ /hūṃ oṃ swā a hā sa bon lnga yis bkug nas ni/ /thig shes bla mas thig rnams ni/ /zer lnga'i bdag nyid can bsgoms nas/ /sngags dang ldan pas bsgril bar bya/ /oṃ dīpta dṛṣṭi rjo saṃ ku sha dzaḥ/ oṃ a byo tyā lcanu ga taḥ sarba dhasthāḥpa raspa ra a nu pra biṣṭaḥ sarba dharmā ④ oṃ āḥhūṃ/ bsgril ba zin nas thig skud ni/ /gtsang ma'i snod du bzhag pa la//dri dang me tog sogs mchod nas/ /yi ge gsum gyis mngon par bsngags3 / /de nas langs te rnal 'byor pa/ /'khor los hphusgyur sgeg ldan slob mar/ /bcas pas 'khor lo mchod pa'i mthar/ /slar yang mkha' la thig gdab bya/ /slob dpon rang rnal 'byor can dzaḥ/ /yig las nyi zla'i mig can gyur/ /dzaḥyig las 3gsum brjod nas ni/ /lte gnas thig skud drangs byas te/ /khu tshur g.yon pas gzung byas nas/ /sngags 'dis slar ldubazhin tshangs sgud sogs / /de ni rim bzhin mkha' la gdab/ /oṃ badzra sa ma ya sru tram̐ mā ti kra ma tt+waṃ/ hūṃ oṃ swā āḥhā/ drangs nas sngags pa cho ga shes pas ༄spuni/ /slob bcas rdo rje'i 'gos kyis 'gros dal ba/ /byas pas mkhar gnas thig ni ji lta ba / /de bzhin sa la gnas pa gdab par bya/ /zur bzhi pa 'a/ sgo bzhi pa/ /rta babs bzhis ni brgyan gyur pa/ /thig bzhi dang ni yang dag ldan/ /ka ba brgyad kyis nyer mdzes shing / /dra ba dra ba phyed pas spras/ /rdo rje nor bu zla phyed can/ /sgo khyud bye kyi ni mtshams rnams su/ /rdo rje rin chen rnams kyis spras / /ka bum rdo rje chen po can/ /mda' yab la gnas bya dang ldan/ /18—378

dril bu ba dan gyis mdzes la/ /rnga yab sogs kyis rnam brgyan pa'o/ /nam mkha' la thig gdab pa'i cho ga'o// //de nas tshon rtsi kha dog lnga/ /legs par 'dus byas blangs nas ni/ /dzaḥyig las ni rdo rje yi/ /lta bas de rjes sbar lcebar bya/ /rtag pa la sogs so sor ni/ /rim bzhin dkar la sogs mdog can/ /phyag rgya bzhi dang ldan pa rnams/ /bltas nas rang yig gis bsngags te/ /cho ga shes pas gsang sngags ni/ /'di yis slar yang mngon bsngags rkyenas/ /dri dang me tog sogs mchod do༄ —/ /snod ni sar par gzhag ④par bya/ /oṃ badzra tsi tra sa ma ya hūṃ / tshon sna lnga'i cho ga'o// //de nas nang par dus su ni/ /rang gi lha yi sbyor ldan dang / /rdo rje can kyis dbang ldan phyogs/ /brtsams nas khu tshur g.yon pa yis/ /ri mo sgo yi nyi shu'i cha/ /dkar dang de bzhin ser dang dmar/ /ljang dang de bzhin sngon po ni/ /snyoms par yang dag dgye bar bya/ /shar phyogs re'u mig dkar po ste/ /lho ni ser po 3ru 'gyur ro/ /nub ni dmar por rig par bya/ /byang ni ljang gur 'gyur ba ste/ /dbus kyi re'u mig gang yin te/ /anda rnyil mtshungs 'od can 'gyur/ /rnam dag blo yis byang chub tu/ /sems bskyed nas ni thams cad bya/ /sgo dang mda' yab la sogs pa'i/ /thod le kor gyi thig bshad pa/ /kun ni tshon 'gyed rim pa yis/ /sna tshogs tshon gyis dgye bar bya/ /phras snepa yis ni mu ge byed/ /de bzhin chad pas tshe zad pa'o/ /18—379

yon pos yul nas 'byung ba ste/ /shin tu sbom pas de bzhin no/ /de nyid bsam min sbyor ldan la/ /tshon rtsi 'gyed pa'i sbyor ༄rkegang dag /de nyid bzang bsam spyor ldan la/ /na ma yang bgegs byed nus ma yin/ /dkyil 'khor yang dag ji bzhin du/ /rab tu brtag par su yis nus/ /rang lhag lha yi rnal 'byor gyis/ /dkyil 'khor brtags pas 2'grub par 'gyur/ /tshon 'gyed ༄ —pa'i cho ga'o// //rang lhag lha yi spyor ba yis/ /rdul tshon bya ba rdzogs nas ni/ /de nas cho ga mthong ba yis/ /las kyi phyag rgya dgod par bya/ /de yi dbus su rdo rje ni//anda rnyil mtshungs 'od can bri/ /shar du 'khor lo chen po ni/ /rdo rje 'bar bas brgyan pa'o/ /lho ru rin chen chen po ni/ /me stag 'thibs pa 'khrugs rge pa'o / /nub tu padma chen po ni/ /padma rā ga mtshungs 'od can/ /byang du ral gri chen po ni/ /'od zer 'bar mtshungs gsal ba'o/ /shar gyi grwa ru mig sprin gyi/ /dbus dang mtshungs pa'i 'od can bri/ /lho yi grwa ru rdo rje ni/ /mā ma tī'i rigs byung ba'o/ /nub kyi grwa ru padma ni/ /kha bye 3sdong bur bcas pa bri/ /byang gi grwa ru utpa la/ /sprin sngon lta bur mdzes pa bri/ /phyi rol gyi ni mtshams bzhi ru/ /blo dang ldan pas rim gyis ni/ /me long de bzhin pi wang dang / /dri yi dung phor ro snod dgod/ /shar kyi snam bur klu shing gi/ /me tog dang ni 'khor lo dgod/ /brtul zhugs can gyis lhor rin chen/ /de bzhin rin chen ser po dgod/ /phyi nas nub tu padma dang / /de bzhin padma dmar po dgod/ /byang du mkhas pas ral gri dang / /ral gri sngo bsangs 18—380

dgod par bya/ /shar gyi sgo ru tho ba ni/ /'bar ba 'od bzang bri bar bya/ /lho ru dbyug pa rdo rje ni/ /'bar ba 'od bzang bri skyobar bya/ /nub tu padma ral gri ni/ /'bar ba'i 'od kyi 'byung gnas bri/ /byang du rdo rje 'khyel pa ni//rdo rje can gyi rdo rje bri/ /me yi mtshams su ral gri bri/ /bden bral du ni zhags pa bri/ /rlung du ral gri bri bar bya/ /dbang ldan du ni ral gri bri/ /steng du gtsug tor mtshan ma ni༄ / /bris nas 'og tu zhags pa bri/ /thugs kyi dkyil 'khor dam pa ni/ /yongs su gsal bar shes par bya/ /lus dang ngag dang sems dag gighu/ /mchod pas 'bad de mchod par bya/ /bu mo mdangs 'od legs chags pa④ / /lo ni bcu drug lon rnyed nas/ /dri dang me tog dkris byas te/ /de dbus su ni 'dod pa bya/ /shes rab can gyis mā ma kri/ /yon tan ska rags can de byin/ /brlabs nas sangs rgyas gnas zhi mkha'i/ /dbyings ni rgyan pa dbyung bar bya/ /mi bskyod la sogs de bzhin gshegs/ /byang chub sems las bsgrubs pa ni/ /thugs rje'i bdag gis sdang rmongs sogs//spyod pa'i sems can gzigs nas ni/ /sangs rgyas rdzu 'phrul ska rags can/ /mdzad de chos 'khor rab bskor nas/ /ting nge 'dzin des de dag gi/ /zhe sdang la sogs yongs sbyangs te/ /mchog tu dga' ba'i sku mnga' rnams/ /rang rang bzhin du gshegs nas ni/ /slar yang byon par bzhed pa rnams/ /ji ltar bzhed pa bzhin du bzhugs/ /de nas rang bzhin shes rnal 'byor/ /pa yis slob ma dbang bskur phyir/ /gus pas rgyal ba de dag kun/ /slar byon ched du bskul bar bya/ /lha yi thugs kar ye shes kyi/ /rdo rje phra mo bsgoms byas nas/ /slar yang de yi thugs kar ni/ /ting 'dzin zhes bya rnam 18—381

par bsgom—1/ /bdag nyid sems dpa' gsum las byung / /'od zer lcags kyu'i rnam pa yis/ /sems dpa' gsum po bkug nas ni/ /rim pa bzhin du lha rnams la'o/ /de ltar thugs ni bskul byas nas/ /de bzhin gshegs rnams drang byas te/ /thams cad mkha' la gnas byas nas/ /tshigs bcad 'dis ni gsol ba gdab/ /khams kyi snying po gcig pu ma rungs bdud/ /rab tu bcom zhing 'gro ba ma lus pa'i/ /rang bzhin mngon sum mdzad pa rang bzhin ni/ /'gro ba mtha' yas rang bzhin kun gshegs shig /de nas se gol rdo rje yis/ /phyag rgya chen po'i rang bzhin rnams/ /gsang sngags 'di yis bkug nas ni/ /oṃ badzra sa ma ya dzaḥdzaḥdzaḥdzaḥ dam tshig lcags kyus bsgul gyur pa'i/ /sangs rgyas thams cad byon nas ni/ /sems can dbang rnams bskur slad du/ /dkyil 'khor 'di la bzhugs par gyur/ /de nas rnal 'byor dbang dga' bas/ /dngos su sangs rgyas rnams mthong nas/ /rgyas btab mchod yon kyis mchod de/ /dril bur bcas pas bstod par bya/ /mi bskyod rdo rje ye shes che/ /rdo rje dbyings te mkha' du chen po/ /rdo rje gsum mchog dkyil 'khor gsum/ /gsang ba sgrogs khyod la phyag 'tshal/ /rnam par snang mdzad dag pa che/ /rdo rje zhi ba dgyes chen po/ /rdo rje rang bzhin gyis 'od gsal/ /chos ston khyod la phyag 'tshal lo/ /rin chen rgyal po rab tu zab/ /nam mkha' rdo rje mkha' dri med/ /rang bzhin gyis dag gos pa med// gsang ba gsum la phyag 'tshal lohūṃ / /rdo rje mi 'chi rgyal po che/ /mi rtog nam mkha' rdo rje 'dzin/ /'dod chags pha rol phyin pa brnyes/ /gsang ba gsum rjod la phyag 'tshal/ /don yod rdo rje rdzogs sangs rgyas/ /re ba thams cad 18—382

yongs skong mdzad/ /rang bzhin dag pa las byung ba/ /rdo rje sems dpa' khyod phyag 'tshal/ /gang zhig bstod pa'i rgyal po 'dis/ /de bzhin gshegs rnams la bstod pa/ /de la sangs rgyas rdo rje sems/ /rang nyid grogs por nye bar gnas/ /de nas rnal 'byor pa yis ni/ /'dod yon lnga yis mnyes par bya/ /nang gi sbyin sreg byas nas ni/ /'di skad brjod cing gtor ma gtang ༄1/ /oṃ da sha dika bya battha te ༄(bhyaḥtsa de ba nāg yakṣa gandharba a su ra ga ru ḍa kinda ④ra ma ho rā geg bhū ta pra treta pi shā tsa u nda a pa sthā ra ostu rā ka 3a ti bhyo ba lo risheta pa yā mi kṛ tī to su kha sau ma na tya la spubi no bha ban tsosthā rgo tsa ni rū pa tra baṃ kurbantu bye sarba budhe a dhijo nee na/ oṃ āḥhūṃ i rda a mṛ ta piṇḍaṃ bhu kta ༄ snem ma sa pa ri bā bur su shīdhe kurbantu swa ste swā hā/ spyan drang ba'i mcho ga'o// //de nas mig phye gsal ba yi/ /rnal 'byor dbang gis langs nas ni/ /bskor ba byas nas 'khor lo yi/ /sgo ni dbye ba brtsam par bya/ /nub phyogs kyi ni sgor gnas te/ /g.yon brkyang stabs kyis rol bzhin du/ /zlos shing rdo rje hūṃ mdzad kyi/ /phyag rgyas shar sgo dbye bar bya/ /oṃ badzra udmā ṭā 7ya sa ma ya pra be sha ya hūṃ/ de bzhin byang gi phyogs gnas shing / /khro bo'i lta bas de bzhin du/ /zlos shing lho sgo phye nas ni/ /sngar gyi phyag rgya dgrol bar bya /shar gyi phyogs gnas rnal 'byor pa/ /de bzhin nub tu mngon phyogs pas/ /chu lha'i sgo ni phye byas nas/ /khro bo'i skyephyag rgya dgrol bar bya/ /de bzhin lho phyogs su gnas shing / /byang phyogs la ni sngar bzhin pas/ /nor byin gyis byin brlabs pa'i sgo/ /phye nas de bzhin gzung ba dang / /de nas slob ma 18—383

gzung bya'i phyir/ /rang nyid thal mo sbyar ba yis/ /bden pa'i byin rlabs snesngon 'gro bas/ /'khor lo che la gsol ba gdab/ /rang bzhin 'od gsal las 3byung ba'i/ /rdo rje sems dpa' bde ba che/ /gzugs brnyan dang yang 'dra ba nyid/ /dkyil 'khor yang ni de dang 'dra/ /de ltar bden pas slob ma ni/ /sems kyi dkyil 'khor la zhugs shing / /sdig dang bral rnams 'khor lo las/ /rdzu 'phrul ma lus mthong bar 'gyur/ /'di de rdo rje snying po ste/ /rdo rje ye shes sgrub byed pa/ /de bzhin gshegs kun pho brang du/ /bdag gis slob ma gzhug par bgyi/ /zhugs la de bzhin gshegs rnams kyis/ /chos kyi dbyengs kyi byin rlabs dang / /dam tshig kyang ni spros pa las/ /phun sum tshogs kun pal du gsol/ /shar gyi sgo ru bkug nas ni/ /bum pa'i chu yis yang dag par/ /byas te gdong g.yogs blangs nas kyeni/ /gsang sngags 'di yis de bcing bya/ /oṃ tsakṣu bhandha ba ra ma san ya hūṃ // //rjo oṃ pra bee 3sha bha ga wān ma hā su kha mokṣa su re sarba sirnyi su khaṃ pra ri sgodaspa ra ma su kha utta ma sisgye dzaḥhūṃ baṃ hoḥpra sisgru swā hā/ de nas slob ma la dri bya/ /kye rab tu shedaga' la dga' khyod su/ /de nas slob mas kyang brjod bya/ /bde ba chen po bdag skal bzang / /rkang pa mnyam pas 'dug gyur cing / /thal mo spyor ba'i slob ma la/ /tshigs su bcad pa 'di brjod cing / /slar yang sems bskyed kye sbyin par bya/ /dkon mchog gsum la bdag skyabs mchi/ /ldig pa thams cad so sor bshags/ /'gro ba'i dge la rjes yi rang / /sangs rgyas byang chub yid la gzung / /de nas slob ma de nyid lari — / /phyag bzhi byed du gzhug par bya//dang po mi bskyod dbang byas nas/ /rdo rje thal mo mdzes sbyar te/ /gsang 18—384

sngags 'di ni brjod bzhin du/ /lhag ༄rmepa brgyad nas phyag bya'oshe/ /oṃ sattha ta thā ga ta pū dza u pastha nā ༄ —ya ātma māṃ nityā ④ta yā mi sarba ta thā ga sabadzra satwa a dhi tiṣṭha 6 oṃ/ rin chen 'byung ldan dbang bya stedzee/ /thal mo snying gar slar phab nas/ /sngags pas gsang sngags 'di yis bu/ /rab tu phyag ni 'tshal du gzhug /oṃ sattha ta thā ga ta pū dza a bhi ṣe ka ya ātma māṃ nirya sheta yā mi sarba ta thā ga ta badzra ratna a bhi ṣiñtsa mo/ de nas 'od dpag med pa yi/ /dbang du byas nas bla ma yis/ /slob ma dpral bar thal sbyar ba/ /gsum pa'i sngags zlos 'dud spudu gzhug /oṃ sarba ta thā ga ta pū dza pra brta nā ya ātma dzā nityā ༄ —ta yā mi sarba ta thā ga ta badzra dharmā pra brta yā mo— te/ de nas don yod ces bya ba'i/ /dbang byas thal mo snying ga ru/ /phab nas blo ldan kyis sngags 'dis/ /phyag 'tshal bzhi pa byed du gzhug /oṃ sarba ta thā ga ta pū dza karma bee ātma māṃ nityā bye ta yā mi sarba ta thā ga ta badzra karma ku ru me/ deng khyod de bzhin gshegs pa thams cad kyi rigs su zhugs kyis/ de'i phyir ngas khyod la rdo rje'i ye shes bskyed par bya — — yis ye shes gang gis de bzhin gshegs pa thams cad kyi dngos grub kyang thob par 'gyur na/ dngos grub gzhan lta smos kyang ci dgos/ khyod kyis dkyil 'khor ma mthong ba'i mdun du brjod par mi bya'o/ /khyod dam tshig nyams par gyur ta re zhes pa dang / sa ma ya st+waṃ zhes brjod nas/ sems ma rdo rje 'dzin byed cing / /me tog phreng rtser 'dzin de la/ /mna' ni dang por bsgag par bya/ /de nas phyag rgya de nyid ni/ /slob ma'i spyi bor bzhag byas te//slar yang rdo rje mna' yis ni/ /'di skad brjod cing bstan par bya/ /'di ni khyod kyi dam tshig gi rdo rje ste/ gal te khyod kyis 'ga' zhig la smras na spyi bo 18—385
