༄/ /dpal gsang ba 'dus pa'i dkyil 'khor gyi cho garme ༄go/ /rgya gar skad du/ shrī gu hya sa mā dza maṇḍa la no pi ka /bod skad du/ dpal gsang ba 'dus pa'i dkyil 'khor gyi cho ga /oṃ dpal rdo rje sems dpa' la phyag 'tshal lo/ /rdo rje 'dzin 'di yon tan gyi/ /rin chen 'byung gnas la btud nas/ /man ngag ji ltar rnyed pa bzhin/ /dkyil 'khor cho ga bri bar bya/ /dang po re zhig slob dpon sngags kyi tshul rig cing sems can gyi don la gcig tu gzhol ba/ sngags zlos pa dang ldan pa la slob mas dkyil 'khor bri ba'i phyir lan gsum du gsol ba gdab par bya'o/ /de nas rang gi snying ga'i sa bon kyi 'od zer gyis slob ma'i sems las byung ba'i bgegs bsal la bdud rtsi 'khyil pa'i phreng ba'i sngags sam mtshan gyi sngags lan bdun bzlas pas bsrung bar bya'o/ /de nas bdag nyid lha'i rnal 'byor dang ldan pas dkyil 'khor gyi gtso bo'i sngags 'bum phrag bzlas par byas la/18—678

dkyil 'khor pa rnams kyi ni khri phrag re re bzlas pas sngon du bsnyen pa bya'o/ /de ltar mi nus na tshes dang skar ma bzang po la khrus byas la gos sar pa bsgos hūṃte/bcom ldan 'das 'jig rten dbang phyug gi spyan sngar maṇḍal byas nas mchod pa phul te/ oṃ mu tsi le ②swā hā/ oṃ mo tī 1ni swā hā/ oṃ darnyi li swā hā/ zhes bya ba'i sngags khri phrag gcig bzlas la bcom ldan 'das kyi spyan sngar nyal lo/ /de nas rmi lam dge ba dang sdig pa bltas te/ gal te dge ba mthong na ni ④dkyil 'khor bri'o/ /de yang ri la sogs pa nyams dga' zhing slob ma dang rjes su mthun pa'i gnas su song ste byang dang shar du gzhol ba'i sa'i cha brtags la lci ba'i maṇḍal byas te/ dri zhim po'i chus bsang gtor byas la bdud rtsi 'khyil pa'i sngags zlos shing mtho gang tsam du sa'i dong brkos la lci bas byugs te sngags de nyid bzlas pa'i chus dgang ngo / /de nas yi ge gsum gyi sngags zlos shing shar phyogs su gom pa brgyar ⑤phyin nas slar log nas blta'o 4/ /gal te chu skams par gyur na der mi bya ste gzhan du spo'o/ /ci ste gang bar gnas na ni dge ba'i mtshan ma yin no/ /de las bri bar gyur na ni der gnas te khro bo'i dkyil 'khor bsgoms la gnod mdzes la bka' bsgo bas phyogs skyong rnams bkug ste gtor ma byin nas mngon par rtogs pa ji lta ba bzhin du bdud rtsi 'khyil pa'i phur pas gdab po/ /de nas phur pa las byung ba'i 'od kyis 3rdo rje'i sa gzhi dang / steng du rdo rje'i dra ba dang / phyogs mtshams su rdo rje'i ra ba dang /phyi rol du me lce'i phreng bas bskor bar ldubyas la sa'i lha mo sku mdog ser mo phyag 18—679

gnyis na gser gyi bum pa bsnams pa blos bkug la me tog la sogs pas mchod de / slob dpon gyis gsol ba gdab par bya ste/ skyob pa sangs rgyas thams cad la/ /lha mo khyod ni dbang du gyur/ /rin chen sna tshogs 'dzin pa yisanyu//sa 'dir dkyil 'khor bri bar bya/ /zhes brjod de/ nam mkha' la yid kyis ༄ bteg ste gzhag rdugo/ /de nas las byed pa bdud rtsi 'khyil par bsgoms la de'i sngags bzlas pa'i chus bsang gtor byas te/ dkyil 'khor gyis pus nub tsam bajo/sa nas kyo mo dang sol ba la sogs pa'i sa'i nad rnams bsal te/ dri zhim po dang bcas pa'i sa de nyid kyis dgang ngo / /de skad du yang gsungs pa/pus mo nub tsam brkos nas su/ /sa de nyid kyis dgang bar byas/ /gal te lhag par gyur na ni/ / der ni ④ dngos grub yod par bshad/ /ces pa'o/ /de nas mtshan nyid dang ldan par bcags te/ der dkyil 'khor gyi khang pa bya'o5 / /slob dpon gyis ni rig sngags bzla bar bya'o/ /khang pa zin nas der slob dpon rang gi lha'i rnal 'byor dang ldan pas/ oṃ byu khaṃ zhes bya bas sa gzhi nam mkha'i rang bzhin du byas la/ oṃ hūṃ hūṃ hūṃ zhes bya bas sa gzhi rdo rje'i rang bzhin du bsgoms la/ oṃ me di nī badzrī bye bha ba badzra banta hūṃ zhes bya bas byen gyis brlabs te/ 'di ni sa sbyang ba'i cho ga'o/ /de nas rdo rje dril bu thogs pa'i slob ma bzhi dkyil 'khor gyi sa'i phyogs bzhir bzhag la slob dpon rdo rje dang dril bu thogs pa dbus su 'dug ste/dkyil 'khor gyi 'khor lo'i ting nge 'dzin sdogs par byas la gos sar pa bgos shing me tog gi phreng ba dang cod pan la sogs pa dang ldan pa'i slob ma bzhis 78—680

shar phyogs nas brtsams te/ rim bzhin du gsol ba gdab bo/ /de la shar phyogs nas gsol ba gdab pa'i tshig ni/ de bzhin gshegs pa kun zhi ba/ /de bzhin gshegs pa kun gyi gnas/ /chos kun bdag med pa yi mchog /dkyil 'khor dam pa bshad du gsol/ /gnyis pa'i ni/ mtshan nyid thams cad yang dag rdzogs/ /mtshan min thams cad rnam par spangs/ /kun du bzang po sku yi mchog /dkyil 'khor dam pa bshad du gsol/ /gsum pa'i ni—/ zhi ba'i chos ni mchog las byung nyu/ /ye shes spyod pas rnam sbyang 3ba/ /kun du bzang po gsung gi mchog /dkyil 'khor snying po bshad du gsol/ /bzhi pa'i ni/ sems can kun gyi sems chen po/ /rang bzhin dag pa dri ma med/ /kun du bzang po thugs kyi mchog /dkyil 'khor snying po bshad du gsol/ /de ltar gsol ba btab pa'i mthar langs te bsgoms pa'i dkyil 'khor gyi 'khor lo nam mkha' la bteg la bdag nyid bdud rtsi 'khyil bar bsgoms nas/ mig g.yas pa dang g.yon par ma dang ṭa las nyi ma dang zla ba'i dkyil 'khor bsams te/ rkang mthil du hūṃ las sna tshogs rdo rje gdengs pa bltas la dbang ldan nas brtsams te hūṃ zhes brjod cing rdo rje 'gros kyis dkyil 'khor gyi sa gzhi kun du bskor la sa de na gnas pa'i bgegs rnams la 'di skad ces bsgo'o/ /lus ngag sems la gnas pa yi— / /bgegs kyi tshogs kun nga la nyon/ /nga ni dpal ldan rdo rje 'dzin/ /bka' yi 'khor lo sbyor ba yi/ /rdo rje rab tu 'bar ba 'dis/ /sku gsum las byung dgas par bya//gal te dam tshig las 'das na/ /tshal par 'gas par gdon mi za/ /zhes bya ba 'dis bgegs rnams bskrad la slar yang sgrub thabs las 'byung ba bzhin 18—681

du gnod mdzes la bka' bsgo bas bgegs rnams la phur bus gdab pa dang /sa gzhi dang ra ba la sogs pa bsgoms la/ slar yang sa'i lha mo bkug ste mchod pa byas nas dkyil 'khor bri bar bya ba'i phyir gsol ba gdab par bya'o/ /skyob pa sangs rgyas thams cad kyi/ /spyod pa'i tshul gyi khyad par ni/ /sa dang pha rol phyin pa la/ /lha mo khyod ni dbang du gyur/ /shākya seng ge skyob pa yisanyu/ /ji ltar bdud kyi stobs bcom pa/ /de bzhin bdag gis bdud las ni/ /rgyal bar byas nas dkyil 'khor bri/ /zhes bya'o/ /de nas dkyil 'khor gyi sa'i char dri zhim pos 2byugs te/ me tog dri zhim pos gtor ba 'di ni sa gzung ba'i cho ga'o/ /de nas dkyil 'khor gyi sa'i cha so so'i 3gnas su bdud rtsi lngas maṇḍal tshom bu sum cu rtsa gnyis byas la nam mkha' la gnas pa'i lha'i 'khor lo spyan drangs te/ so so'i gnas su bzhugs su gsol ba la me tog la sogs pa'i mchod pa'i ④yo byad rnams kyis mchod de bdug spos kyis bdug sbung dril bu dkrol nas bstod pa 'dis bstod par bya'o/ /mi bskyod pa ni ye shes che/ /chos kyi dbyings ni mkha' chen po/ /rdo rje gsum mchog dkyil 'khor gsum/ /rdo rje'i dbyings 3la phyag 'tshal bstod/ /rnam par snang mdzad rab tu dag /rdo rje zhi ba dga' ba che/ /rang bzhin 'od gsal mchog gi mchog /ston pa rdo rje phyag 'tshal bstod/ /rin chen rgyal po rab tu zab/ /rdo rje nam mkha' dri ma med/ /rang bzhin dag pas gos pa med/ /rdo rje sku rngo la phyag 'tshal bstod / /rdo rje dpag med rgyal po che/ /mi rtog nam mkha' rdo rje 'dzin/ /'dod chags pha rol byin pa brnyes/ /rdo rje gsung la phyag 'tshal bstod/ /18—682

don yod rdo rje rdzogs sangs rgyas/ /bsam pa thams cad rdzogs mdzad pa/ /rang bzhin dag pa nyid las byung / /rdo rje sems dpa' phyag 'tshal bstod/ /ces bya bas bstod la phyag byas te/ pus mo g.yas pa'i lha nga sa la btsugs skyenas thal mo sbyar ba btud de 'og nas 'byung ba 'dis du lha rnams la snyan gsan dbab par bya'o/ /bcom ldan rdo rje che ge mo/ /rig pa'i rgyal po phyag 'tshal bstod—/ /khyed rnams la ni mchod pa dang / /slob ma rnams la brtse ba'i phyir/ /mgon po thugs rje'i bdag nyid kyisarngu/ /dkyil 'khor 'dir ni bri bar 'tshal/ /bcom ldan bdag ni gus pa la/ /de bas bka' drin mdzad par 'os/ /'gro ba'i 'khor lo don mdzad pa'i/ /sangs rgyas bdag la dgongs su gsol/ /byang chub sems dpa'i ④dgra bcom dang / /gang gzhan gsang sngags lha rnams dang / /'jig rten skyong ba'i lha gang yin/ /'byung po gang dag mthu chen dang / /bstan la dga' ba'i sems can ni/ /gang su rdo rje'i mig ldan rnams//rdo rje can bdag che ge mos/ /che ge 'byung ba'i dkyil 'khor ni/ /yo byad ji ltar 'byor pa yis/ /'gro ba dag phyir bdag 'dri na/ /thugs rjes nye bar dgongs nas ni/ /bdag dang slob mar bcas pa yi/ /tshogs pa kun la dkyil 'khor du/ /khyod kyis byin brlab skyemadzad par 'os/ /zhes bya ba 'di lan gsum brjod de/ /'di ni lha sta gon la gnas pa'i cho ga'o/ /de nas dkyil 'khor gyi gtso bo dang dkyil 'khor pa'i sngags kyang ci nus par bzlas la gshegs su gsol ba'i phyir slar yang mchod pa dang gtor ma phul la—/ dri'i maṇḍal la bzhugs yepa rnams yid kyis ④nam mkha' la bteg ste/18—683

bkod nas rim pa 'dis dkyil 'khor thig gdab bo/ /tshangs pa'i thig gnyis btab nas su/ /mtshams kyi thig gnyis bri bar bya/ /gru bzhi dang ni skud nyupa bzhi—/ /dkyil 'khor tshad bzhin gzhal te gdab/ /sgo ni 'khor lo'i brgyad cha ④ru/ /tshangs skud gnyis kyi ngos su bya/ /sgo yi ngos su tshon rtsi'i sa/ /de phyed skud pa gnyis kyis bri/ /sgo yi bzhi char yang btab nas/ /sgo phyed gsum yang de nas gdab/ /mtshams su sgo yi thad du ni/ /lha yi snam bu'i thig gdab bya/ /ri mo lnga yi blas yi cha/ /sgo yi bzhi char gdab par bya/ /kha khyer sgo yi phyed du ste/ /de yi phyed ni ④rin chen sa/ /dra ba dang ni dra phyed gnas—/ /kha khyer dang ni mnyam par bya/ /de phyed ba gam sa yin te/ /'di ni thig skud bri ba yin/ /so so'i gnas su thig bri ba/ /skye bo rang gis shes sla zhing / /gzhan du lta bar sla bas ④na/ /'dir ni spros te ma bshad do//dbang ldan mtshams nas brtsams nas ni/ /mtshams su so sor bor ba la/ /padma rdo rje phreng ba dag /rlum por kun du bskor bar bya/ /snying po'i dkyil 'khor bskor ba'o/ /rdo rje phreng ba de bzhin bya/ /sgo yi sum 'gyur twa ra ṇa/ /shes rab can gyis /⑥bri bya ste/ /snam bu bcu gcig phye ba la/ /ci ltar mdzes par brtag par bya/ /de nas ye shes kyi sgud pa tshon rtsi lngas kha bsgyur zhing dkyil 'khor gyi nyis 'gyur dang ldan pa snod dri zhim par gzhag ④ste 'bar ba'i lta bas de bzhin gshegs pa thams cad kyi thugs ka nas ye shes kyi thig skud drangs te der bstems nas bdud rtsi rnam pa lngas byugs te/ yi ge gsum mngon par bzlas pas byin kyis brlab po/ /de nas oṃ e bye hi bha ga wān ⑧pra yatstsha sha sha ta sru tram̐ sa tsakra sru tra nā ⑨ya swā hā hūṃ zhes bya bas nam mkha' la 18—684

bzhugs pa'i dkyil 'khor la thig skud bslang bar bya'o/ /de nas oṃ a byo tyā nu ga ta sarba dharma hūṃ/ nyu.oṃ a byo rsā nu pra bee sha lcesarba dharma hūṃ/ zhes bya bas slob ma bdud rtsi 'khyil par bsgoms pa dang / lan cig tu skud pa bsgril byenas bdag dang slob ma gnyis ka yi ge dzdza rngugasum bzlas pas bskul la g.yon pa rdo rje khu tshur lte bar bzhag la skud pa bzung ste/ slob dpon nub sgor gnas la/ slob ma shar sgor gnas pa dang / oṃ badzra sru tra sa ma ya mā ti kra ma tt+waṃ zhes brjod de gnam thig dang sa thig gdab bo/ /de yang sems can gyi phyo dus su ni/nam mkha' khyab pa'i de bzhin gshegs/ /thig skud sgra yis bskul nas su/ /de dag 'dir ni gshegs par mdzadagye/ /de nas skor phyogs kyis gshin rje'i phyogs su song ste byang phyogs na gnas pa'i slob ma de bzhin du thig gdab bo/ /de nas me'i mtshams su song ste dbang ldan gyi mtshams na gnas pa dang / shar phyogs kyi thig gdab bo/ /yang rlung mtshams su song ste bden bral gyi mtshams na gnas pa dang / nub logs kyi thig gdab bo/ /de nas de nyid du bsgyur te dbang ldan gyi mtshams na gnas pa dang byang logs kyi thig gdab bo/ /yang me'i mtshams su song ste bden bral gyi mtshams na gnas pa dang lho ngos kyi thig gdab bo/ /de nyid du gnas nas rlung mtshams su gnas pa dang mtshams kyi thig gdab bo/ /bden bral gyi mtshams su song ste dbang ldan gyi mtshams na gnas pa dang / mtshams kyi thig gnyis pa gdab bo/ /de nas thig skud nyis 'gyur du byas te slob dpon dbus su 'dug nas slob mas dbang ldan gyi mtshams nas phyi nang gi 'khor lo bskor bar bya'o/ /de ltar ye shes kyi thig btab nas bdag nyid khro zhing bsgyings pa dang bcas pas smin ma bcum pa'i khro bo'i lta 18—685

bas bltas te sgo phye la phyi rol du phyung ste/ oṃ yisamuḥzhes bya bas ye shes kyi skud pa gshegs su gsol lo/ /'di ni ye shes kyi thig gdab pa'i cho ga'o/ /de nas de bzhin gshegs pa lnga'i kha dog tu btsos pa'i tshon rtsi snga ma ltar snod bzang por bzhag la 'bar ba'i lta bas de bzhin gshegs pa rnams las tshon rtsi bkug ste/ so so'i kha dog ji lta ba bzhin du bstems la oṃ badzra tsi tra sa ma ya hūṃ/ zhes bya bas mngon par bsngags pas byen gyis 3brlab bo/ /de nas oṃ badzra bee ga zhes bya bas ye shes kyi skud pa yid kyis bteg ste/ tshon rtsi rnams bzung la 'di skad ces brjod par bya'o/ /chos dbyings 'di ni rnam par dag /sems can khams ni rab sgrol ba/ /rdo rje sems dpa' rgyal po che/ /dkyil 'khor rang gis bri bar bya/ /de nas tshon rtsi khu tshur g.yon pas bzung ste/dbang ldan gyi mtshams nas brtsams te ri mo rnams ma 'byar zhing drang la mtho ba g.yas skor 3snadu bri'o/ /rim pa ni sngon po dang / dkar po dang / ser po dang / dmar po dang / ljang gu rnams te slob dpon rang gis —/de ltar bris la kham phor la sogs pas bkab ste/ rdo rje shugs kyis 'jug pa dang 'byung ba bya'o / /de'i 'og tu gzhan gyis thuci dga' bar bri'o/ /'di ni tshon bri ba'i dam tshig go/ /de la mi bskyod pa gtso bor gyur pa'i dkyil 'khor la ni rdo rje phreng ba'i nang gi sa gzhi sngon por byas la/ shar gyi char ni dkar po'o/ /lhor ni ser po'o/ /nub ni dmar po'o/ /byang ni ljang gu'o/ /snying po'i dkyil 'khor gyi dbus su ni sna tshogs padma dang rdo rje'i gdan la rdo rje rtse lnga pa sngon po phyag rgya dang bcas pas bri'o/ /shar du ni 'khor lo dang bcas pa'i padma 18—686

la 'khor lo dkar po'o/ /de bzhin du lhor ni rin po che la gnas pa'i rin po che ser po'ohūṃ/ /nub tu ni padma la gnas pa'i padma dmar po'o/ /byang du ni sna tshogs rdo rje la gnas pa'i rdo rje ljang gu'o/ /mtshams rnams su ni gdan de dag nyid la 'khor lo dang rdo rje dang padma dang sna tshogs rdo rje rnams so/ /rim pa gnyis par gdan de dag nyid la me mtshams la sogs par me long dang /bee wang dang dri'i dung chos dang ro snod rnams so/ /kha dog rnams kyang sngar bshad pa bzhin no/ /de'i snam bu'i shar phyogs kyi ngos gnyis su ni gdan de nyid la nā ga putpa dkar po dang / 'khor lo dkar po'o/ /lhor ni rin bo che ser po gnyis so/ /nub tu ni padma dmar po gnyis so/ /byang du ni ral gri ljang gu gnyis so/ /shar la sogs pa'i sgo bzhir ni padma dang nyi ma'i gdan la rdo rje tho ba sngon po dang / rdo rje dbyig pa dkar po dang / sdong bu dang bcas pa'i padma dmar po dang / sna tshogs rdo rje ljang gu'o/ /dbang ldan la sogs pa'i mtshams su ni padma dang nyi ma la ral gri sngon po dang / rdo rje dang / rdo rje sngon pos mtshan pa'i dbyig pa dang / yang dbyeg pa'o/ /steng 'og tu padma dang nyi ma la rdo rje nag po dang sngon po'o/ /de nas bum pa mgrin pa ring zhing mchu 'phyang pa lto ba yangs pa rnams nas dang gro dang grumon sran gre'u dang / 'bras kyi so ba dang / til te 'bru lnga dang / z-i /zuha ti dang / kaṇḍa ka ri dang / a pa rā 4dzi ta dkar po dang/ha sa dang / ha sa de ba ste sman lnga dang / gser dang / dngul dang / byi ru dang / mu tig dang mu men te rin po che lnga rnams de'i nang du blugs 5la dri 18—687

zhim po'i chus bkang ste/ snam bu sar pas mgrin pa bcings la shing los kha brgyan pa'i bum pa rim pa 'dis sta gon la gnas par tūbya'o/ /bdag nyid dkyil 'khor gyi rnal 'byor la gnas nas rnam par rgyal ba'i bum pa'i nang du dkyil 'khor gyi bdag po sa bon las babyed la/ bum pa gzhan rnams su yang dkyil 'khor pa'i lha rnams so so'i sa bon las bskyed de ye shes kyi 'khor lo spyan drangs nas gnyis su med par byas la/ mchod yon dang zhabs bkru dang zhal bsil la sogs pa phul la so so'i sngags yi ge gsum dang spel ba ci nus su bzlas so/ /gzhan yang skye bo thams cad la bsang gtor bya ba'i phyir bgegs mthar byed kyi sngags yi ge gsum dang spel ba 2snalan mang du bzlas pa'i bum pa rtsa ba'i sgo drung du gzhag go/ /rnam par rgyal ba'i bum pa ni mdun logs su bzhag la/lhag ma ni ci rigs par gzhag ༄ —ste bum pa sta gon la gnas pa'i cho ga'o/ /de'i 'og tu slob ma me tog 'dzin cing phan pa don du gnyer ba bde bar gshegs pa'i bstan pa la dga' bas dkyil 'khor gyi khang pa'i sgor maṇḍal byas la—/ slob dpon gyis 'di skad brjod par bya'o / /bye /sngags kyi dngos grub don gnyer gang / /dkyil 'khor 'dir ni gzhug par bya/ /bsod nams 'dod pas 6de las gzhanadzee/ /gzhan dag 'jig rten pha rol gnyer/ /dad pa chen po ldan pa dag /'jig rten pha rol la dmigs nas/ /blo ldan dkyil 'khor gzhug bya ste/ /'di yi 'bras bu gnyer mi bya/ /gal te 'bras bu bye don gnyer na/ /'jig rten pha rol mi 'grub 'gyur/ /'jig rten pha rol la dmigs na/ /'bad pa med par 'di 'bras 'grub/ /de nas slob ma 18—688

rnams kyis rmyetshigs su bcad pa 'dis gsol ba gdab par bya ste/ dga' chen khyod bdag ston pa bas tsa/ /slob dpon khyod ni dgongs su gsol/ /byang chub sems dpa'i tshul bstan pa/ /mgon po chen po bdag 'tshal lo/ /dam tshig de nyid stsal du gsol/ /byang chub sems kyang bdag la stsol5/ /sangs rgyas chos dang dge 'dun te/ /skyabs gsum dag kyang tsubadag la stsol/ /thar pa chen po'i grong mchog tu/ /mgon po bdag ni 'jug par 'tshal de nas slob dpon gyis slob ma'i gtso bo la dmigs te/ 'di skad ces brjod par bya'o/ /khyod ni tshul chen snod yin pas/ /khyod la yang dag bstan par bya//sku gsung thugs kyi rdo rje can/ /dus gsum sangs rgyas 'byung ba rnams/ /gsang sngags rdo rje'i phyemathu yis ni/ /ye shes mnyam med yang dag brnyes/ /gsang sngags sbyor ba mnyam med pa/ /shākya seng sogs mchog gis ni/ /drag po chen po bdud kyi sde/ /stobs chen dag kyang des bcom mo/ /'jig rten mthun par gshegs nas su/ /'khor lo bskor nas mya ngan 'das/ /de bas kun mkhyen thob bya'i phyir/ /bu yis blo gros 'di gyis shig /de nas slob ma rnams snying ga'i sa bon gyi 'od zer gyis bkug la rang gi 'od kyis 6shes rab kyi padmar zhugs te/ de bzhin gshegs pa thams cad kyis dbang bskur bar bsgoms la phyung nas slob dpon rang nyid kyis/ dkon mchog gsum la skyabs su mchi/ /sdig pa thams cad so sor bshags/ /'gro ba'i dge la yi rang ste/ /sangs rgyas byang chub yid kyis gzung / /zhes lan gsum brjod la/ de nas khrob ma rnams kyi mgo bor lag pa bzhag ste/ bdud rtsi 'khyil ba'i sngags lan bdun bzlas pas bsrungs te/ de rnams kyi snying ga dang mgrin pa dang mgo bo 18—689

rnams su rdo rje dang padma dang 'khor lo bsams te/ de dag gi lte ba la hūṃ sdza.oṃ zhes bya bar gebasgoms te/ spyi bor me tog /mdun du spos dang mar me dang snying gar dri byin la so shing sor bcu gnyis pa rtse mor me tog gi phreng ba btags la dri zhim pos byugs te bgegs mthar byed kyi sngags brjod la byin no/ /de rnams kyis kyang kha shar ram byang du bltas te zos la lci bas mandal ba'i ko ba tsam byugs te der bor ro/ /de la shar dang lho dang nub dang byang du rtse mo phya bltas pa'i bye brag gis zhi ba dang rgyas pa dang dbang dang mngon spyod kyi snod yin par rim pa bzhin du bstan par bya'o/ /de nas sngags 'di bzlas pa'i chus kha bkru ba sbyin par bya ste/ oṃ spyoḥ④bi shudhe dharma thu sarba pā paṃ nishtsa 5sho dha ya/sarba bi kalpa na a pa na ya hūṃ zhes bya ba ni sngags so/ /de nas skud pa mdud pa gsum dang ldan pa la bgegs mthar byed kyi sngags bzlas pas dpung pa g.yas par bcings nas de nyid bzlas pa'i ku kyesha stan dang sngas kyi phyir lag pa g.yon par byin la chos nyan du gzhug par bya ste/ 'jig rten du ni kun mkhyen pa/ /u dusmra ra'i me tog bzhin/ /brgya lam na ni res 'ga' zhig /'byung 'gyur yang na mi 'byung ngo / /gsang sngags spyod pa'i tshul 'byung ba/ /de bas kyang ni dkon pa ste/ /gang gis krusems can mnyam med don/ /bla med byed par nus pa yin/ /bskal pa bye ba du ma ru/ /sngon du sdig pa byas pa gang / /dkyil 'khor 'di 'dra mthong ma thag /de dag zad par 'gyur yin na/ /grags pa mtha' yas sngags spyod pa'i/ /tshul la gnas na smos ci dgos/ /skyob pa'i gsang sngags bzlas nas ni/ /go 'phang bla na med par 'gyur/ /gang gi spyod pa mchog 'di la/ /blo gros shin du dri med na/ /sdug bsngal 18—690

thams cad 'byung ba yi/ /ngan 'gro de yis gcod par 'gyur/ /bdag nyid chen po khyed rnams kyis/ /rnyed pa mnyam med de ring rnyed/ /gang phyir rgyal ba ①sras bcas pa'i/ /bdag nyid chen po thams cad kyis/ /bstan pa 'di la spyod rnams kun/ /yongs su bzung ste skye bzhin pa/ /de phyir khyed rnams theg chen du/ /legs pa nyid du 'gro bar 'gyur/ /theg pa chen po cher 'byung ba'i/ /lam mchog 'di ni dpal dang ldan/ /khyed rnams 'dir ni 'dod pas na e/ / rang byung skal ba chen po pa/ /'jig rten thams cad mkhyen pa yi/ /④ de bzhin gshegs pa nyid du 'gyur/ /zhes brjod de/ bzhin bzangs ④ dag song la rmi lam ci byung ba nang par nga la smros shig ces bsgo nas khyad par gyi sdom pa 'dzin du gzhug ste/ phyir mi ldog pa'i dkyil 'khor du/ /byin nas mgon po bdag la gsungs/ /dkyil 'khor lha yi de nyid dang / /slob dpon yongs su phrin las rnams/ /sangs rgyas kun gyi dam tshig dang / /gsang ba'i sdom pa bla na med/ /sems can kun gyi don gyi phyir/ /rtag tu bdag nyid slob dpon gyur—/ /zhes bya ste/ 'di ni slob ma sta gon la gnas pa'i cho ga'o/ /de nas dkyil 'khor gyi khang par zhugs te slob ma la sogs pa bsrung ba'i ge phyir bdud rtsi 'khyil pa'i sngags bzlas so khye/ /nang par slob ma rnams bos la/dge ba dang sdig pa'i mtshan ma rnams bltas te/ gal te sdig pa mthong na sngags bzlas pa la sogs pa byas la rdul tshon bri bar tsuzin nas dkyil 'khor gyi phyi rol dri zhim po'i chus byugs la me tog la sogs pa bkram ste/ rdul tshon lhag ma rnams yi ge gsum gyi mthar muḥbazlas pas gshegs su gsol la gnas gtsang 18—691

mar gzhag 2go/ /de nas mchod pa'i yo byad rnams bshams te mngon par 'du byas te bum pa rnams bshams khrupa'i gnas rnams su gzhag ③ste slob dpon bdag nyid sgo skyong gi sngags kyis lus khrus byas la gos sar pa bgos te/ ba dan la sogs pas brgyan pa dang /④ tsandan la sogs pas lus byugs nas me tog gi phreng ba dang dbu rgyan bcings te stan bde ba la 'dug ste/ dkyil 'khor kyi she'akhor lo'i rnal 'byor dang ldan pas dga' ba'i sgras sgede bzhin gshegs pa thams cad spyan drangs te kha'i lam nas zhugs te zhu nas shes rab kyi padmar phab la dkyil 'khor gyi 'khor lo'i tshul du spros nas rdul tshon gyi dkyil 'khor la bsnyims te/ argha dang zhabs bkru dang / zhal bsel dang /bdug spos phul te/ dril bu gsil zhing / mi bskyod pa zhes bya ba klul sogs pas bstod par bya'o/ /de nas bdud rtsi lnga'i phyadakyil 'khor du gtor te bdag nyid kyang myang ngo / /sgrub pa'i gogs dkyil 'khor du gzhag ⑨ste bdag nyid phyir byung nas phyogs skyong rnams la gtor ma rgya chen po spyin par bya ste/ 'di ni dkyil 'khor bsgrub 6pa'i thabs so/ /de nas slar yang dkyil 'khor du zhugs te/ dril bu gsel zhing dkyil 'khor la bskor skyeb byas la bdag nyid dkyil 'khor du 'jug pa'i phyir/ byang chub rdo rje zhes bya ba la sogs pa 'og nas 'byung ba'i tshigs bcad kyis dkyil 'khor gyi bdag po la gsol ba btab ste yol ba'i phyi rol du byung la dkyil 'khor gyi bdag bos dkyil 'khor du zhugs pa nas rjes su gnang ba'i dbang bskur ba ⑩byin par bsgoms te/ chags chen las byung de nyid ni/ /'khor lo gzugs brnyan 1/ lta bu ste/ /zhes bya bas dkyil 'khor gzugs brnyan dang 'dra bar bltas laskye/ slob ma rnams gzhug 18—692

par bya ba'i phyir tshigs su bcad pa 'dis gsol ba gdab par bya ste/ nam mkha' las byung mtshan ma'i phyir/ /thog ma tha ma med pa'i mchog /sems dpa' ①rdo rje che rang bzhin/ /rdo rje sems dpa' bdag sgrubs shig /dngos grub chen po kun gyi mchog /dbang phyug chen po lhag pa'i lha/ /rdo rje 'dzin pa kun gyi rgyal/ /mi 'gyur mchog tu bdag sgrubs zhushig /nyes pa mi 'da' zurtag pa ste/ /'dod chags kun gyi rjes su chags/ /'dod chags byachen po dga' ba che/ /bcom ldan de nyid kyis sgrubs bhushig /shin tu dag pa kun gyi mchog /gdod nas grol ba de bzhin gshegs/ /kun du bzang po kun bdag nyid/ /byang chub sems dpa' bdag sgrubs spyoshig /dngos grub chen po kun gyi mchog / dbang phyug chen po phyag rgya'i mchog /3grub pa'i rdo rje cher bstod pa/ /rdo rje snyems bdag kyebadag po'i bdag /sems can kun gyi yid khyab pa/ /sems can kun gyi snying la gnas/ /sems can kun gyi yab nyid de/ /'dod chags mnyam pa'i dam tshig mchog /ces bya ba'i dam tshig gi glu blangs nas bden pa'i tshig 'di bsgrags spu par bya ste/ shes rab thabs bdag dkyil 'khor gyi/ /bden pa'i byin rlabs ⑫gang yin pa/ /bden pa de yis mgon khyod kyis/ /bdag gi 'dod pa skong byed shog /chos rnams gzugs brnyan lta bu ste/ /gsal zhing dag la rnyog pa med/ /gzung du med cing brjod du med—/ /rgyu dang las las byung ba dang / /de bzhin de spyokho na las byung 8/ /bden pa de yis dkyil 'khor ni/ /gzugs brnyan gsal bar sems can rnams—/ /dri med thams cad mthong bar shog /ces brjod la phyag byas te/dril bu gsil lo/ /'di ni slob dpon 'jug pa'i cho ga'o/ /18—693

de nas slob ma khrus byas shing gos sar pa bgos la bkug la/ tshig 'dis gsol ba 'debs su gzhug ste/ byang chub rdo rje sangs rgyas la/ /mchod chen ji ltar bgyis pa bzhin/ /bdag kyang bsgral ba'i don du ni/ /nam mkha'i rdo rje bdag la stsol/ /zhes brjod nas maṇḍal byed du bcug ste/yon dbul bar bya'o/ /de nas bgegs mthar byed kyi ①sngags bzlas pa'i chus bsang gtor byas la/ yi ge gsum bzlas pa'i snam bus gdong g.yogs du/dkyil 'khor du gzhug pa'i phyir/ 'dod par dga' ba gang yin smros/ /zhes dri'o/ /des kyang / skal ba zhubazang po la ④dga'o/ /zhes smra'o/ /de'i rjes la ā khaṃ ⑤bī ra hūṃ zhes bya bas me tog gi phreng ba byin la rdo rje snying gar bzhag ste/ oṃ badzra yo ga dzistotpā da pya yā mi/ zhes bya bas byang chub tu sems bskyed la/ oṃ su ra te sa ma ya st+waṃ kluho/ badzra sirnyi ya thā su khaṃ/ zhes brjod la / de ring khyod de bzhin gshegs pa thams cad kyis byin kyis brlabs par gyur gyis gsang chen dam pa 'di de bzhin gshegs pa thams cad kyi dkyil 'khor du ma zhugs pa rnams la smra bar mi bya zhing ma dad pa rnams la yang ma yin no zhes bsgo nas/ ā shekhaṃ bī ra hūṃ zhes bya bas yol ba'i nang du bcug la 'di skad ces brjod par bya ste/ de ring khyod de bzhin gshegs pa thams cad kyi rigs su zhugs te/ gzhan yang khyod la ye shes gang gis de bzhin gshegs pa thams cad kyi dngos grub kyang thob par 'gyur na dngos grub gzhan 'grub pa lta smos kyang ci dgos te/ de lta bu'i ye shes bskyed par bya'i⑨/ khyod kyis dkyil 'khor ma mthong ba rnams kyi mdun du smra bar mi bya ste/ khyod dam tshig 18—694

nyams par gyur ta re/ de nas spyi bor rdo rje bzhag la 'di ni khyod kyi dam tshig gi rdo rje ste/ gal te tshul 'di su yang rung ba la smras na 'dis khyod kyi mgo 'gems par byed do zhes brjod la slar yang snying gar rdo rje bzhag ste/ oṃ rdo rje sems dpa' deng khyod kyi/ /snying la de ring yang dag zhugs/ /gal te tshul 'di smras na ni/ /de ma thag tu dral te gshegs/ /zhes brjod nas mna' bsgag par bya ste/ rnam par rgyal ba'i bum pa'i steng na gnas pa'i padma'i nang du song ba'i bdud rtsi lnga la/ oṃ badzra a mṛ to da khyeka ṭha/ zhes bya ba mngon par bzlas la/ 'di ni khyod kyi dmyal ba'i chu/ /dam tshig 'das na sreg 2 par byed/ /dam tshig bsrungs na dngos grub 'thob1/ /rdo rje bdud rtsi'i 4chu 'thung shig /ces brjod de blud la de ring phyin chad khyod kyi rdo rje sems dpa' nga yin gyis/ ngas de ring phan chad 3'di kyis shig ces bsgo ba rnams bu khyod kyis hūṃbya dgos so/ /nga la brnyas pa ma byed cig /byas na yang ba ma spangs par 'chi ba'i dus byas nas sems can dmyal ba chen por lhung bar gyur ta re zhes brjod do/ /de nas bden pa'i byin gyi rlabs 3brjod par bya ste/ snying po'i dkyil 'khor 'di ru ni/ /bdag gis byeslob ma gzhug par bya/ /lha yi rigs kyi rim du/pa dag /bsod nams ji bzhin de bzhin shog /'dis ni dngos grub gang 'grub dang / /rigs ni gang gi snod du gyur/ /'di ni bsod nams ci yod las/ /dkyil 'khor 'dir ni de bzhin shog /ces pas bden pa'i byen gyi rlabs byas bye la/ de nas phyag byas la mig tu ci zhig snang zhes dris la/ des skyedakar po dang / ser po dang / dmar po dang /nya sngon po'i kha dog rnams bstan pa las/ zhi ba dang / rgyas pa dang / dbang 18—695

dang / mngon spyod kyi las rnams so sor bstan par bya'obye// /de nas oṃ pra tt+waṃtstsha badzra ho/ zhes bya ba'i sngags kyis slob mas dkyil 'khor du me tog phul te/gang la bab pa de'i rigs so/ /ci ste lha gnyis kyi bar du lhung na gang la nye ba de'i rigs so/ /gal 2te ri mo la 1/bab na beer bskyar te dor ro/ /lan gsum du bskyar te dor yang ri mo la cephog na ni de la dngos grub med do/ /rdo rje ra ba'i phyi rol du lhung na yang de bzhin no/ /gal te gtso bo la phog na/phyag rgya chen po'i dngos grub thob ste/ me tog dor ba'i cho ga'o/ /de nas dbang nod pa'i phyir slob dpon la yon phul la byang chub rdo rje zhes bya ba'i tshigs bcad kyis gsol ba btab ste phyag bya'o/ /slob dpon gyis kyang slob ma de dbang bskur ba'i phyir rtsa ba'i dkyil 'khor gyi phyi rol du snying po'i dkyil 'khor gyi tshad tsam pa'i gru bzhi sgo bzhi pa'i dkyil 'khor bris la/ de'i dbus su padma 'dab brgyad bris te/ sgo dang mtshams rnams su de bzhin gshegs pa rnams dang / lha mo'i mtshan mas mtshan par bya'o/ /slob ma la khrus byas shing gos sar pa bgos ༄5pa bzhag la shis pa'i cho ga byas te/ nyungs kar 'ubadud rtsi 'khyel pa'i sngags bzlas pa/ lag pa g.yas g.yon gyis lan gnyis gnyis bskor te/ khom 7phor gyi me'i nang du blugs so/ /de ltar lan gsum du byas la/ de nas chu'i shis pa yang de ltar bya'o/ /de nas sngags de nyid bzlas pas bsrungs te sna/ nye reg byas la/ yang dri zhim po sngags bzlas pas byugs la/sngags bzlas pa'i me tog gi phreng ba mgo la bcings te/ mar me mdun du bkor 9 zhing bdug spos kyis kyang bdugs te/ shis pa'i cho ga'o/ /18—696

nas mig la sogs pa byen gyis brlabs te/ steng du bla re byes la tt+waṃ las byung ba'i gser gyi yu ba can gyi gdugs dkar po steng du bzung nas g.yon phyogs su ba dan dang rgyal mtshan byes te dung dang / zangs dung dang hūṃrnga bo che la sogs pa'i sgras nam mkha' gang bar bsams grel dril bu gsil zhing khrus bya ste/ ji ltar bltams pa tsam gyis kyang / /de bzhin gshegs kun khrus gsol ba/ /lha yi chu ni dag pa yis/ /de bzhin bdag gis khrus bya'o/ /oṃ sarba ta thā ga ta a bhi ṣe ka te 1༄sa ma ya shri ye ④hūṃ/ dang po rnam par rgyal ba'i bum pas bkrus la de'i 'og tu gzhan gyis bkru'o/ /de ltar phyi rol du dbang bskur nas rang gi snying ga'i sa bon gyi 'od zer gyis mtha' yas pa'i phyogs nas 'khor los 7sgyur ba'i de bzhin gshegs pa rnams sbyan drangs te/ de rnams kyi 'od zer las byung ba'i dbang bskur ba'i yo byad thams cad kyis dbang bskur bar bsgoms la/bdag nyid kyis kyang / oṃ sangs rgyas rnams ni thams cad kyi/ /rdo rje gsang ba gsum las byung / /khams gsum kun gyes phyag byas pa/ /rdo rje dbang bskur chen po sbyin/ /zhes brjod do/ /mi bskyod pa'i rang bzhin gyi chu'i dbang ngo / /de nas gser la sogs pa las brdungs pa'am de med na ras la sogs pa las byas pa'ang rung ste/ sngar bstan pa'i tshigs bcad kyis slob ma'i spyi bor bcings la nam mkha'i dbus na bzhugs pa'i de bzhin gshegs pa thams cad rin chen 'byung ldan gyi 6gzugs kyis der thim ste byin kyis brlab bo/ /rin chen 'byung ldan gyi pyarang bzhin gyi cod pan gyi dbang ngam 5rdzogs pa'i 18—697

sangs rgyas kyi dbang ngo / /de'i 'og tu hūṃ las bskyed pa'i rdo rje rtse lnga pa bzung ste / slob ma'i snying ga la sogs par gtugs la/ sangs rgyas kyi ni rdo rje'i dbang / /de ring khyod la bskur bar bya/ /'di de sangs rgyas thams cad nyid/ /rab tu grub phyir rdo rje zung nyu/ /zhes pas slob ma'i lag pa g.yas par rdo rje sbyin te/ snang ba mtha' yas kyi rang bzhin rdo rje'i dbang ngo / /de nas a las bskyed pa'i dril bu lag pa g.yon par byin la/ lag pa g.yas g.yon gnyis ka bsnol te/ oṃ badzra a bye pa bye st+waṃ a bhi ṣi.āoṃ mimi badzra sa ma ya st+waṃ zhes brjod de/ dam tshig rdo rje'i rang bzhin bdag po'i dbang ngo / /de nas me long la/ oṃ a badzra satwa zhes bzlas la tshigs su bcad pa 'dis bstan par bya ste/ rdo rje sems dpa' me long ltar/ /gsal zhing dag la rnyog pa med/ /bu khyod kyi ni snying la gnas/ /sangs rgyas kun bdag rang nyid yin/ /de bzhin gshegs pa kun bdag gang / /byang chub sems 'di shes par kyis/ /rdo rje sems dpa'i rang bzhin gyi me long gi dbang ngo / /de'i rjes la rdo rje dril bu slob ma'i spyi bor bzhag la/ oṃ ④badzra satwa st+waṃ a bhi ṣi.āoṃ cho mi badzra nā mā rnyi ṣe ka ta kye dpal che ge mo rdo rje nyezhes rigs mthun pa'i ming btags la/ gang gang snang ba de dang de/ /rdo rje 'dzin pa rang nyid gtso/ /gang phyir chos rnams rnam dag pas/ /sangs rgyas ye shes rang bzhin yin/ /zhes bsgrags te / rnam par snang mdzad kyi rang bzhin gyi ming gi dbang ngo / /de nas slar yang slob mas/ bdag dang gzhan gyi don gyi phyir/ /rdo rje slob dpon dbang bsgur ba/ /thugs rje can khrod bka' drin gyis/ /bdag la de ring stsal du gsol / /zhes gsol ba btab pa dang nam mkha' khyab pa'i de bzhin gshegs 18byed698

pa nyu lha mo rnams kyis dbang bskur bar bsgoms la/ rdo rje che dang dril bu che/ /zung shig rdo rjer byin gyis brlabs/ /de ring rdo rje slob dpon gyur/ /slob ma rnams ni bsdu bar gyis/ /zhes pas slob ma bskul la/ dam tshig gsum po 'dzin du gzhug ste hūṃ gis rdo rje bsgoms la/ 'di ni sangs rgyas thams cad nyid / /rdo rje sems dpa'i phyag na gnas/ /rtag tu khyod kyis 7 kyang gzung ste/ /phyag na rdo rje brtul zhugs brtan/ /oṃ sarba ta thā ga ta sedhi badzra sa ma ya tiṣṭha e sha st+waṃ dha ra ya mi hi hi hi hi te zhes pa ste 'dis 5slob ma rdo rje bzung la de kho na nyid 'di brjod de/ thog mtha' med pa'i sems dpa' ni/ /rdo rje sems dpa' dga' ba che/ /kun du bzang po thams cad bdag /rdo rje snying po bdag po'i gtso/ /bcom ldan 'das dpal mchog byedang bo'i skyes bu'o/ /oṃ ma hā badzra hūṃ/ de nas a las bskyed pa'i dril bu bzung la⑤/ 'di de sangs rgyas thams cad kyi/ /shes rab dbyangs kyi rjes 'gror brjod/ /khyod kyis kyang ni rtag tu bcang / /byang chub mchog tu rgyal ba bzhed/ /ces pa 'dir dril bu byin la/ srid pa'i rang bzhin dag pa'i phyir/ /rang bzhin gyis ni dngos med byas/ /byurang bzhin dag pa'i sems ldan pas/ /srid pa dam pa mchog tu byed/ /ces bya ba'i chos kyis dkrol bar bya ste/ oṃ badzra gharnye ④a/ zhes brjod do/ /de yang yid kyi lus ni brtan pa'i phyir/ /dam tshig phyag rgya shes rab brjod/ /gang gi lus kun rten byebyed pa/ /de nas phyag rgya rab tu grags/ /zhes bya ba'i mngon par rtogs pas bskyed la/ rdo rje sems dpa'i rnam rngu par bltas te/ me tog la sogs pas mchod cing kun du bstod par byas te/ stems pa dang bcas pas me tog cig slob ma la bsnun la/18—699

deng nas brtsams te rdzogs sangs rgyas/ /sras dang bcas pas rnam rol cing /rdo rje snyems pas rab sbyor gyis/ /dga' ston bde ba mchod pa tūgyis/ /a/sgeg rngudang bcas pas phreng ba 'phang / /sangs rgyas thams cad mchod par bya//de ni bcom ldan 'bral mi 'gyur/ /phreng ba de ni rgyan yin no/ /oṃ/ lus can kun la dam chos kyi ④/ /khyod kyis glu ni blang bar bya/ /de yi thubader gshegs dngos grub ni/ /myur du bde ba myong bar 'gyur/ /gi/ de nyid thal mo'i gar gyis ni/ /sangs rgyas thams cad chags par byos/ /sangs rgyas 'dul ba'i phrin las kyis/ /gar mkhan tshul du bsgyur bar gyis/ /hoḥrdzogs sangs rgyas la spos phul bas/ /brtul zhugs bzang pos bye legs tshim ④gyis/ /lus can bde du gshegs cha lugs su/ /ye shes kyis ni tshim par gyis/ /aḥsangs rgyas rnams la me tog gtor/ /byang chub yan lag tshogs 'gyur bas/ /mtshan dang dpe byad ldan pa yi/ /bde kyegashegs sku ni thob par gyis/ /rgyu hūṃ chos kyi me ni legs sbar bas/ /rdo rje chos dang 'dra bar 'gyur/ /sems can ma rig mdongs pa skyol/ /ye shes sgron ma sbar bar gyis/ /pra/ rgyal ba rnams la dri phul la/ /tshul khrims de bzhin shes rab dang / /rnam grol ye shes mthong ba yi/ /byang chub lus can rnams la bsgokyi/ /ghaḥde'i 'og tu gser gyi thur ma la bcom ldan 'das kyi rtsa ba'i sngags bzlasaskye/ ji ltar mig mkhan rgyal po yis/ /'jig rten ling tog bsal ba ltar/ /bu khyod kyi thuni mi shes pa'i/ /ling tog rgyal ba rnams kyis bsal/ /oṃ badzra nee tra a pa ha ra pa ṭa lo tweḥkyizhes pas mig la byugs te dag par bya'o/ /de nas me long bstan te/chos rnams gzugs brnyan lta bu ste/ /gsal zhing dag la rnyog pa med/ /18—700

gzung du med cing brjod du med/ /rgyu dang las las kun du byung / /rang bzhin dag cing bdag med pa/ /de ltar chos 'di shes byas nas/ /sems can don ni mnyam med byos/ /'on kyang skyob pa'i sras su skye/ /de nas a las bskyed pa'i dril bu byin te/ thams cad nam mkha'i mtshan nyid de/ /nam mkha' la kyeyang mtshan nyid med/ /nam mkha' dang ni mnyam sbyor bas/ /kun mchog mnyam pa nyid du gsal/ /zhes pas dkrol bar bya'o/ /yang hoḥzhes bya bas mda' gzhu byin la/ de bzhin gshegs pa thams cad rjes su chags par byos shig ces bsgo la/ phyogs bzhir mda' bzhi 'phang ba dang /steng dang 'og tu yang re re 'phen du gzhug go/ /oṃ bhu.a badzra satwa zhes bya ba 'dis me long bstan la/ rdo rje sems dpa' me long ltar/ /gsal zhing dag la rnyog pa med/ /bu khyod kyi ni snying la zhugs/ /rdo rje sems dpa' rang nyid gtso—/ /zhes bya ba dang / gang yang sangs rgyas thams cad kyi bdag po byebyang chub kyi sems 'di nyid yin par shes par gyis shig ces brjod do/ /oṃ badzra te tu zhes bya bas 'khor lo rkang pa'i bar du bcug la/ oṃ badzra bha thuṣa re zhes bya bas lag pa g.yas su dung byin la/ g.yon par yi ge a las gsang ba 'dus pa'i po ti byin la/ dril bu yang dkrol zhing / deng nas brtsams te sems bskyed pa/ /tsam gyis chos kyi 'khor lo bskor/ /khyod kyis the tshom dogs med par/ /yid gnyis med pa'i sems kyis su/ /chos kyi dung ni bla med pa/ /dri med kun du gang bar gyis/ /sngags kyi tshul gyi cho ga rnams/ /skye bo rnams la rtag tu shod/ /de ltar byas na phyesangs rgyas la/ /phan 'dogs drin du gzo zhes bya/ /rdo rje 'dzin pa de kun yang / /khyod la rtag tu srung 18—701

bar mdzad/ /de nas so so'i 'khor los kyesgyur ba'i rnal 'byor byas la/sems can kun la phan pa'i phyir/ /sems can ma lus thams cad la/ /ji ltar 'dul ba sna tshogs pa'i/ /chos kyi 'khor lo rab tu bskor/ /zhes bya ba dang / chos kyi gnas su rdo rje dang / rin po che dang / padma dang /las kyi tshig bcug la tshigs su bcad pa lngas rjes su gnang ba byin la bdag nyid langs te sangs rgyas kyi gzugs su dmigs la g.yon pa snying gar chos gos 'dzin pa'i tshul du byas te/ g.yas pa mi 'jigs pa sbyin pa'i phyag rgyar byas la/rdo rje ming gi dbang bskur bas lung bstan to/ /'di ni khyod la ngas lung bstan//rdo rje slob dpon de bzhin gshegs/ /srid pa shin tu dag pas 3na/ /srid pa'i ngan 'gro rnams las bton/ /kye che ge mo zhes bya ba'i de bzhin gshegs pa bhur bhu ba swaḥ/ gang la 'di ltar lung bstan pa de la sangs rgyas dang byang chub sems dpa' dkyil 'khor gyi 'khor lo dang bcas pa rnams kyis mgrin gcig tu byang chub chen por lung ston par mdzad de/ phyag rgya chen po dang sngags 'di'i mthu yin no zhes dad pa bskyed par bya'o/ /de nas gsang ba bsgrags te/'dod chags bral ba lta bu yi/ /khams gsum na ni sdig med de/ /de bas 'dod la chags bral ba/ /khyod kyis ④nam yang mi bya'o/ /ma hā sa ma ya ha na ha na hūṃ phaṭa/ de nas slob ma'i spyi bor gdugs bzung la bskor ba byas nas thal mo sbyar te/ gdugs dang bcas pas dkyil 'khor gyi sgo drung du sa la 'dug la/ sngags rnams 'dzin par gyur pa yi5/ /slob ma 'di ni phul ba lags / /de nas gdugs gzhan du bzhag trel/ slob ma'i snying la gdab pa'i tshig 'di dag brjod do/ /de ring dkyil 'khor slob dpon gyur/ /18—702

gsang sngags rgyud rnams 'dzin gyur pasahūṃ/ /sangs rgyas byang chub sems dpa' dang / /lha rnams kun kyis mthun par gsungs/ /sems can kun la sems brtse bas/ /dkyil 'khor cho ga bzhin du bri/ /khyod kyis nan tan bskyed nas su/ /sgrub pa po rnams sngags la spyor/ /de nas slar yang bstod par bya ste/ mchog tu gsang ba'i dkyil 'khor 'dir/ /bcug pa dang ni mthong ba yis/ /de ring sdig las rnam grol nas/ /de ring khyed rnams dge bar gnas/ /bde chen theg pa 'di la ni/ /phyin chad 'chi ba yod min zhing //thub pa tshugs pa yod min pas/ /cis kyang mi 'jigs dga' bar gyis/ /sdig pa shin tu dag pas na/ /srid pa'i sdig pa las 'das pa'o/ /byang chub sems ni yongs mi spong ༄ sgo/ /rdo rje zhes bya'i phyag rgya de/ /gang zhig bskyed pa tsam gyis ni/ /sangs rgyas nyid 'gyur the tshom med/ /dam pa'i chos ni smad mi bya/ /nam yang bor bar yang mi rung / /mi shes pa'am rmongs pa la/ de ni bstan par mi bya'o/ /rdo rje dril bu mi spang stesnye/ /slob dpon nam yang smad mi bya—/ /sangs rgyas kun dang mtshungs pa yin/ /rang bdag ziyongs su spangs nas su / /dka' thub kyis ni gdung mi bya/ /ji ltar bde ba bde bzung nas/ /'di ni ma 'ongs rdzogs sangs rgyas/ /zhes bya bas dbugs dbyung ngo / /slob mas kyang phyag byas te/ gtso bos ci ltar bka' stsal pa/ /de dag thams cad bdag gis bgyi—/ /zhes khas blang ngo / /slob dpon gyi dbang bskur ba'i cho ga'o// //de'i rjes la slob ma yid du 'ong ba'i gnas dbeen par yol ba la sogs pas byes la/ gzugs la sogs pa yon tan dang ldan pa dam tshig can gyi bu mo 18—703

rdo rje slob dpon la phul te/ bza' dang bca' ba dang btung ba zhim po rnams kyis bla ma mnyes par byas la maṇḍal byas te/ tshigs su bcad pa 'dis gsang ba ༄1nod pa'i don du gsol ba gdab bo/ /khyod kyi bka' drin grugang gis bdag/bdag dang gzhan don byed nus pa/ /yang dag gsang ba'i dbang bskur ni/ /snying rje'i kyegater gyis shebadag la stsol/ /zhes bya'o/ /de ltar gsol ba thubatab pa'i mthar bla mas slob ma la snying rje chen po bskyed de sgrub thabs las 'byung ba'i rim pa bzhin bdag nyid dang shes rab gsung rdo rje'i gzugs su mngon par 'dus byas la snyoms par 'jug par bya'o/ /de las byung ba'i bdud rtsi dang bdud rtsi lnga bsres la 3tshigs su bcad pa 'dis slob ma'i khar sbyin no/ /ji ltar 'phags pa sangs rgyas kyis/ /byang chub sras la dbang bskur ba/ /de bzhin gshegs pa'i dbang bskur ni/ /sems kyi rgyun gyis dbang bskur ro/ /des kyang a ho su kha zhes brjod de longs spyod rdzogs pa'i rgyun du gzhug go/ /de nas de snang ba mtha' yas su dmigs la de bzhin gshegs pa thams cad kyi 3gsang ba'i dbang bskur bar bsgom mo/ /gsang ba'i dbang bskur ba'i cho ga'o// //de'i 'og tu khyed kyi bka' drin gang gis bdag /bdag dang gzhan gyi don byed pas/ /shes rab ye shes dbang bskur ni/ /snying rje'i regater gyis bdag la stsol/ /zhes slob mas gsol ba btab pa dang / slob ma'i lag par shes rab kyi lag pa byin la/ rdo rje sems dpa'i gzugs su bsgoms te/gzungs tsum 'di ni yid 'ong ma/ /sangs rgyas rnams kyis ⑫bsten par gnang //18—704

'khor lo rim gyi sbyor ba yis/ /bde ba dam pa myang bar gyis/ /thabs gzhan gyis ni 'tshang mi rgya/ /'gro ba gsum po 'di yis bdag /de bas 'di dang bral bar ni/ /khyod kyis 1nam yang mi bya'o/ /'di ni sangs rgyas thams cad kyi / /rig pa'i brtul zhugs bla na med/ /blun po gang zhig 'di spong ba/ /de la mchog gi dngos grub med/ /ces brjod la sbyin no/ /de nas shes rab kyis 'di skad brjod par bya ste/ bshang dang gci ba bza' ba dang / /sha dang khu khrag de bzhin no/ /bu khyod ci dgar spro gyur tam/ /bud med rtag tu gus pa dang / /bha ga'i padmar 'o byed pa/ /bu khyod ci bzhed bden par smros//slob mas kyang 'di skad brjod par bya ste/ /khu khrag la sogs bza' ba dang / /bud med rnams la rtag gus pas/ /bha ga'i padmar 'o byed pa/ /lha mo ci phyir bdag mi spro/ /zhes brjod pa dang / beer yang shes rab kyis 'di skad brjod par bya ste/ e ma nga yi padma 'di/ /bde ba kun dang yang dag ldan/ /blun po gang zhig 'da' byed pa/ /de la mchog gi dngos grub med/ /bde chen rgyal po rang nyid ni/ /'di nyid du ni rtag tu gnas/ /bhañdza mo kṣa ho zhes bya'o/ /de'i 'og tu ji ltar bstan pa'i ka ra nas snyoms par 'jug par byas la bla ma'i man ngag gis de'i skad cig ma mtshon par bya'o/ /byang chub kyis 4sems phyung nas ro 'dzin gyis blang bar bya ste/ 'di ni shes rab 5ye shes kyi dbang bsgur ba'i cho ga'o// //dkyil 'khor cho ga ji lta bar6/ /ji bzhin du ni byas pa las/ /bsod nams gang zhig thob pa des/ /'gro kun rdo rje 'dzin gyur cig /slob dpon nag po pa'i zhal snga nas bla ma'i man ngag la brten te mdzad pa'i dpal gsang ba 18—705

'dus pa'i dkyil 'khor gyi cho ga rgya gar gyi mkhan po nag po pa'i zhal snga nas dang / bod kyi lo tsā ba chen po 'gos lhas btsas kyis bsgyur cing zhus pa spyodags so// //bsdur mchan/67/ ༄)mtshan ༄/ /rdo rje sems dpa' mchod pa'i cho ga—1 ༄go/ /rgya gar skad du/ badzra satwa pū dza bi byeḥdzee/ bod skad du / snyerdo rje sems dpa' mchod pa'i cho ga /dpal rdo rje sems dpa' la phyag 'tshal lo/ /ri bong 'dzin 'od ltar dkar reg bya rdo rje mas 'khyud sgu/ /mnyam med yon tan gter gyur sangs rgyas lnga yi gtsor gyur pa/ /ma rig mun pa'i tshogs kun ma lus kun nas bcom pa yis/ /phyag na rdo rje nam mkha'i mthar thug ji srid rgyal gyur cig /mdor bsdus rim las gsungs don rtogs dka' ba/ /byis pa rnams kyis rtogs par bya ba'i phyir/ /rdo rje sems mchod cho ga nus pa bzhin/ /bla ma'i lung las cho ga bzhin bshad bya/ /'dir rdo rje sems dpa' mchod pa'i cho ga la dbang ba'i rnal 'byor pas dang por mal nas langs nas snying gar zla ba'i dkyil 'khor la gnas pa'i hūṃ gi 'od zer gyis bdag nyid dri ma med par byas la/ oṃ āḥhūṃ badzra satwa zhes bya ba rjes 18—709

su dran pas sgo rnams sbyang ba la sogs pa dam pa'i spyod pa rjes su bskyang bar bya ba rnams byas la/ mchod pa'i yo byad rnams bsags nas mchod pa'i khang par zhugs la stan bde ba la gnas te rang gi lag mthil gnyis su a las byung ba'i zla ba'i dkyil 'khor gyi steng du hūṃ las byung ba'i rdo rje 'bar ba bsams la oṃ shubye dharma tā sidhe badzra hūṃ zhes brjod pas byin gyis brlab bo/ /de nas lkog ma'i phyogs su dzrīḥlas byung ba'i padma la hūṃ las gyur pa'i rdo rje bsams la/ badzra dzi hwa ste hūṃ zhes bya bas 1byin gyis brlabs 2te/ mchod yon gyi snod du me tog dang 'bru dang ldan pa'i chus bkang la/ oṃ āḥ bispyonta kṛta hūṃ zhes bya ba lan bdun bzlas pa mdun du bzhag nas lag pa thal mo sbyar te rdo rje 'dzin pa blos dmigs la/ phyag 'tshal bstod cing phyag 'tshal bstod/ /phyag 'tshal bstod de phyag 'tshal 'dud/ /gus pas khyed la bdag gsol 'debs/ /rdo rje sems dpar bdag sgrubs shig /ces brjod la/ oṃ swa bhā wa shudhaḥsarba dharmāḥ5 / swa bhā wa shurnyo3haṃ/ zhes bzlas nas chos thams cad stong pa nyid du mngon du byas te/ oṃ shu n+ya tā dzñā na badzra swa bhā wa ātma kophohaṃ —zhes bya ba lan gsum brjod la/ oṃ āḥtt+waṃ badzra satwa ma nu sma ra sa ma ye tiṣṭha e ṣa tt+waṃ dhā ra yā 7mi badzra satwa hi hi hi hi ti shehūṃ zhes brjod nee/ nas bdag nyid rdo rje sems dpa' zhal gcig phyag gnyis pa sgu mdog ston ka'i zla ba dngas pa ltar dkar zhing phyag na rdo rje dang dril bu bsnams pa ral pa'i thor tshugs can zhi zhing sgeg pa'i nyams dang ldan pa rang gi btsun mos mgul pa nas 'khyud pa sna tshogs padma dang zla ba'i dkyil 'khor gyi gdan la sems dpa'i skyil krung gis bzhugs par ༄ — bsgoms la/de'i spyi bor ni oṃ/ mgrin par ni āḥ/ snying gar ni hūṃ zhes bya ba'i yi ge 78—710

gsum dgod par bya'o/ /de nas oṃ sum̐ bha ni sum̐ bha hūṃ hūṃ phaṭa/ oṃ kṛṇḍa kṛṇḍi hūṃ hūṃ phaṭa/ oṃ gresnra pa ya kṛsnra pa ya hūṃ hūṃ phaṭa/ oṃ ā na ya ho bha ga bān bibyā 3 rā dza hūṃ hūṃ phaṭa/ ces bya ba dang / phyogs bcur se gol gtogs pas phyogs skyong ba rnams gnod mdzes kyis bkug la/ yang snying ga'i sa bon las spros pa'i bdud rtsi 'khyil pa'i phur bu sku stod khro bo'i gzugs can la 'og gi cha phur bu'i 3dbyibs can rnams spros te gnod mdzes kyis bkug pa'i bgegs 1rnams kyi spyi bor o gha gha ghā ta ya ghā ta ya sarba duṣṭṛ phaṭa tī la ya ṭā la ya 4sarba pā paṃ phaṭa/hūṃ hūṃ hūṃ badzra gī la ya badzra dha ra ādzñā pa ya ti sarba bispyo kā ya bāka tsitta badzra tī thul ya hūṃ phaṭa/ ces bya bas mi g.yo bar byas la/ oṃ badzra muṅga thur badzra tī la ya ā ko ṭa ya hūṃ phaṭa/ ces bya bas 'dis gerdo rje tho ba phyag na bsnams pa'i gnod mdzes kyis brdung bar 8bya'o/ /de nas phur bu'i 'od 'bar ba las 'og tu rdo rje'i sa gzhi steng du rdo rje'i dra ba/ phyogs kun du rdo rje'i ra ba/ phyi rol me ri 'bar bas bskor bar bsams la/ hūṃ bzlas pa'i lci ba la sogs pa dang / sngar bstan pa'i chus oṃ badzra re khe hūṃ zhes brjod cing mdun du maṇḍal bya'o—/ /maṇḍal byug pa'i dus su maṇḍal gyi phan yon kyang bzlas par bya ste/chu bcas lci ba sbyin pa steshe/ /skyang nul byas pa tshul khrims yin/ /grog ma sogs bsal bzod yin te/ /bya ba spro ba brtson 'grus so/ /skad cig de sems rtse gcig pa/ /bsam gtan yin te ri mo dag /snyoms pa shes rab yin par gsungs/ /maṇḍal byas pas pha rol phyin drug brnyes par 'gyur/ /lha mi khyad par can skye zla ltar gzi 'phags shing / /nad kun las grol gser gye mdog dang 'dra bar 'gyur/ /rgyal rigs 'bru dang gser sogs 'byor pas 18—7sde1

gang bar skyehūṃ/ /des na bde gshegs mchog gi khyim du lus las byagru/ /zhes bya ba'o/ /de nas lag pa bkrus te maṇḍal gyi dbus su lag pa bzhag la sa'i lha mo blos dmigs te gsol ba gdab par bya'o/ /skyob pa sangs rgyas thams cad kyi / /spyod pa'i tshul dang khyad par ni/ /sa dang pha rol phyin pa la/ /lha mo khyod ni dpang du gyur/ /shākya seng ge skyob pa yis— / /ji ltar bdud kyi stobs bcom pa/ /de bzhin bdag gis bdud las ni/ /rgyal bar byas te dkyil 'khor bri/ /oṃ me di — badzrī cebha ba badzra brnya hūṃ/ zhes bya bas byin gyis brlabs la yid kyis sam lag pa'i me tog gis 5 rim pa gsum dang ldan pa'i khang bu brtsegs pa bri'o/ /de nas rim pa dbus ma'i dbus su padma 'dab ma brgyad kyi lte ba la zla ba'i dkyil 'khor gyi steng du yi ge hūṃ bri'o/ /shar gyi cha'i padmar zla ba la oṃ lhor rin po che la swā/ nub tu padma la āḥbyang du sna tshogs rdo rje la hā/ me'i mtshams la sogs pa rnams su ni mtshan ma trede dag nyid dam zla ba la lo rmā paṃ tt+waṃ3/ rim pa gnyis pa'i me mtshams la sogs par gdan de dag nyid la ram̐ shaṃ gi re sna/ rim pa gsum pa snam bu'i shar la sogs pa'i ngos gnyis gnyis su gdan de dag nyid mo zlo'e༄// sgor oṃ saṃ/ nub tu oṃ hūṃ/ byang du oṃ saṃ ngo / /sgo rnams dang mtshams su nyi ma la gnas pa'i hūṃ bri'o/ /'og gi cha shar gyi sgo sngon du'ang hūṃ ngo tso/ /steng gi cha nub kyi sgo sngon du yang nyi ma la gnas pa'i hūṃ ngo / /de ltar sa bon rnams bris nas bgegs mthar byed kyi sngags bzlas pa'i chus bsang gtor byas te/ mchod pa la yang bsang gtor lan gsum byas nas sas bon rnams 'od 'bar ba dang bcas par bsgom mo/ /de nas oṃ badzra puste sdzahūṃ zhes bya ba'am/ yi ge 'bru gsum bzlas pas me tog 18—712

byen kyis brlab par bya'o/ /mchod pa'i rim pa ni 'di yin te/ oṃ hūṃ badzra satwa puṣpe pra tītstsha swā hā/ oṃ a nyudzi na dzika puṣpe pra tītstsha swā hā/ oṃ swā ratna j-ika — puṣpe pra tītstsha swā hā/ oṃ āḥ.ā ro dzaka bye puṣpe pra tītstsha swā hā/ oṃ hā pradzñā dhrika ④puṣpe pra tītstsha swā hā/ oṃ lo mo ha rā ti puṣpe pra tt+waṃtstsha swā hā/ oṃ saṃ dī ṣa ra thuti puṣpe pra tītstsha swā hā/ oṃ paṃ rā ga ra ti puṣpe pra tītstsha swā hā/ oṃ tt+waṃ badzra ra kyeti puṣpe pra tītstsha swā hā/ rim pa dang po'o/ /oṃ ram̐ rū 7pa badzra puṣpe pra tītstsha swā hā/oṃ shaṃ shapta badzra byepuṣpe pra tītstsha swā hā/ oṃ gi gandha 9badzra puṣpe pra tītstsha swā hā/ oṃ re ra zhe sa badzra puṣpe pra tītstsha swā hā/ oṃ paṃ sparsha badzra puṣpe pra tt+waṃtstsha swā hā/ rim pa gnyis pa'o/ /oṃ ༄ 1mi tri ya puṣpe pra tītstsha swā hā/ oṃ rghaṃ kṣi ti gasgo puṣpe pra tītstsha swā hā/ oṃ oṃ badzra pā ṇi puṣpe pra tītstsha swā hā/ oṃ oṃ kha garbha tso puṣpe pra tītstsha swā hā / oṃ oṃ lo ke shwa ra puṣpe pra tītstsha swā hā/ oṃ hūṃ mañdzu sto ṣa puṣpe pra tītstsha swā hā/oṃ oṃ sarba ṇi ba ra ni biske bi ni puhūṃ pra ṭītstsha swā hā/ oṃ saṃ sa manta bha dra puṣpe pra tītstsha swā hā/ oṃ hūṃ ya mānta kṛta puṣpe pra tītstsha swā hā/ oṃ hūṃ pradzñānta kṛta phyapuṣpe pra tītstsha swā hā/ oṃ hūṃ padmānta kṛta spupuṣpe pra ṭītstsha swā hā/ oṃ hūṃ bispyonta kṛta (— puṣpe pra tītstsha swā hā/ oṃ hūṃ a tsa la puṣpe pra tt+waṃtstsha swā hā/ oṃ hūṃ ṭakki rā dza puṣpe pra tītstsha swā hā / oṃ hūṃ nī la daṇḍa puṣpe pra ṭītstsha swā hā/ oṃ tt+waṃ ma hā ba la puṣpe pra treetstsha swā hā/oṃ tt+waṃ sumbha rā dza ༄ 5puṣpe pra ṣṭṛtstsha swā hā/ oṃ hūṃ uṭī ṣa tsakra warti puṣpe pra tītstsha swā hā/rim pa gsum pa'o/ /de ltar thams cad la sbyar bar bya ste/ khyad par du ghandha nyu— pra tītstsha swā hā/ dhū pa pra tītstsha swā hā/ dī pa pra tītstsha swā hā/ nee bi rya pra tītstsha swā hā/ zhes bya ba sbyar bar bya'o/ /de ltar mchod nas skad cig tsam gyis ye shes kyi dkyil 'khor bkug ste/ oṃ dzaḥhūṃ baṃ hoḥzhes bya ba'i sngags kyis ༄ 1ye 18—713

shes kyi dkyil 'khor spyan drangs la bstems te/ gnyis su med pa'i dkyil 'khor legs par bltas la/ oṃ badzra satwa arghaṃ pra tītstsha swā hā/ oṃ badzra satwa pa hye pra tītstsha swā hā/ oṃ badzra satwa añdza ma dzwa pra tītstsha swā hā/ de la arghaṃ dang zhal bsil ni snod nyid kyis dbul lo/ /zhabs bkru ba ni khu tshur gyi sor mo bgrol ba rol pa dang hūṃXbacas par dbul lo/ /yang zhal bsil me tog gam lag pas kyang dbul lo/ /de nas yang snga ma ltar rim pa bzhin du mchod la bskor ba lan gsum bya ste/ argha'i snod kyi 3/ chu las bsang gtor byas la kyethal mo sbyar te/dkon mchog gsum la bdag skyabs ④mchi/ /sdog pa thams cad so sor bshags / /'gro ba'i dge la rjes yi rang / /sangs rgyas byang chub yid kyis gzung de/ /zhes lan gsum brjod la phyag lan gsum bya ste bstod pa 'dis bstod par bya'o/ /mi bskyod rdo rje ye shes che/ /rdo rje dbyengs ni mkhas chen po / /rdo rje gsum mchog dkyil 'khor gsum/ /gsang ba'i dbyings shi la phyag 'tshal lo/ /rnam par snang mdzad rab tu dag /rdo rje zhi ba dga' ba che/ /rang bzhin gyis ni 'od gsal mchog /ston pa rdo rje phyag 'tshal bstod/ /rin chen rgyal po rab tu zab/ /rdo rje nam mkha' dri ma med/ /dngos nyid dag pas gos pa med/ /gsang ba'i sngagasung la phyag 'tshal lo/ /rdo rje mi 'chi 'dod chags che/ /mi rtog nam mkha' rdo rje 'dzin/ /'dod chags pha rol phyin brnyes pa/ /rdo rje gsung la phyag 'tshal lo/ /rdo rje dag pa gdon mi za/ /bsam pa thams cad yongs rdzogs pa/ /sangs rgyas ngo bo nyid las byung / /rdo rje sems dpa' phyag 'tshal lo/ /zhes pa'i tshigs su bcad pa lngas bstod la/yi ge gsum po ci nus kyis mi g.yeng bas bzlas brjod bya'o/ /de nas oṃ āḥ18—714

hūṃ baṃ hoḥnyuzhes bya ba 'dis ye shes kyi 'khor lo rang gi lus la bsdus la rim pa 'dis sku gsung thugs byin gyis brlab bo/ /de la spyi bor zla ba'i dkyil 'khor gyi steng du oṃ dkar po bsgoms la/ dpal ldan sangs rgyas sku 'dzin pa/ /rdo rje mi phyed gsum gyi dngos/ /deng bdag byin gyis brlab pa'i gnas/ /rdo rje skur ni mdzad du gsol/ /phyogs bcur bzhugs pa'i sangs rgyas rnams/ /rdo rje mi phyed gsum gyi /5dngos/ /deng bdag byin gyis brlab pa'i gnas/ /rdo rje skur ni mdzad du gsol/ /sangs rgyas rnams kyi sku gang yin/ /phung po lnga yis rab gang ba/ /sangs rgyas sku yi ngo bo yis/ /bdag kyang de dang 'drar gyur cig /oṃ sarba ta thā ga ta kā ya badzra swa bhā wa ātma ko3haṃ/ de'i rjes la mgrin par padma'i rshasteng du sdzadamar po bsgoms la/ chos kyi gsung lam dpal dang ldan/ /rdo rje mi phyed gsum gyi dngos/ /deng bdag byin gyis brlab pa'i gnas/ /rdo rje'i gsung du mdzad du gsol/ /phyogs bcur bzhugs pa'i sangs rgyas rnams/ /rdo rje mi phyed gsum gye dngos/ /deng bdag byin gyis brlab pa'i gnas/ /rdo rje gsung du mdzad du gsol/ /rdo rje chos kyi gsung gang yin/ /gsung de nges tshig phun sum tshogs/ /bdag gi tshig kyang de 'dra bar/ /chos 'dzin pa dang mtshungs par shog /oṃ sarba ta thā ga ta wā ka badzra swa bhā ba ātma kophohaṃ/ de nas snying gar zla ba'i dkyil 'khor la hūṃ sngon po bsgoms la/ rdo rje thugs 'dzin dpal dang ldan/ /rdo rje mi phyed gsum gyi dngos/ /deng bdag byin kyis brlab pa'i gnas/ /rdo rje thugs su mdzad du gsol/ /phyogs bcur thubazhugs pa'i sangs rgyas rnams/ /rdo rje mi phyed gsum gyi dngos/ /deng bdag byin gyis brlab pa'i gnas/ /rdo rje 18—715

thugs su mdzad du gsol/ /kun du bzang po'i thugs gang yin/ /gsang ba'i bdag po blo ldan pa/ /bdag gi sems kyang de 'dra bar/ /rdo rje 'dzin dang mtshungs par shog /oṃ sarba ta thā ga ta tsitta badzra swa bhā ba ātpa kophohaṃ/yang thams cad du lhag par mos par 5tebyas la/ oṃ sarba ta thā ga ta kā ya wāka tsitta badzra swa bhā wa ātpa kophohaṃ/ zhes brjod do/ /de ltar bdag nyid byin gyis brlabs nas—/ slar yang thu yi ge brgya pas brtan par bya ste/ oṃ badzra satwa sa ma ya/ ma nu pā la ya/ badzra satwa twe no pa tiṣṭha dṛ ḍho me bha wa/ su toṣyo me bha wa/ a nu rasto me bha wa/ su poṣyo me bha wa/ sarba sirnyimme pra yatstsha/sarba karma su tsa me tsitt+waṃ gre yaḥ3ku ru hūṃ/ ha ha ha ha hoḥ/ bha ga wān sarba ta thā ga ta badzra mā me muñtsa ④badzrī bha ba ma hā sa ma ya satwa āḥ/ de nas argha'i chus maṇḍal la bsang gtor lan gsum byas te yang chu gtor la maṇḍal gyi thog tu lag pa bzhag ste/ khyed kyis 5sems can don kun mdzad/ /rjes su mthun pa'i dngos grub gsol6/ /sangs rgyas yul du gshegs nas su/ /slar yang 'byon dzee par mdzad du gsol/ /muḥzhes bya bas gshegs su gsol la/ de nas me tog la sogs pa bsal te/ yang legs par byugs la me tog cig phul te bzod par mdzod cig ces brjod la langs te ji ltar dga' bar bya'o/ /thun mtshams gzhan la khyeyang de ltar byas te zla ba gcig gam lo phyed dam lo gcig tu cho ga des rdo rje sems dpa' mnyes par byas na rmyeji ltar 'dod pa'i dngos grub kyi 6mtshan ma 'byung bar 'gyur ro/ /de nas rgyud nas gsungs pa bzhin du bsgrub par bya'o/ /dus gsum rgyal ba'i rang bzhin kun gyi skyagatso/ /ye shes sku mchog rdo rje sems dpa' yi/ /mchod pa'i cho ga bdag gis byas pa des/ /18—716

kye〈〈pe 〉྾〈snar 〉〉kyi/714 ①〈〈pe〉〉〈〈snar 〉〉wadang / zhu〈〈pe 〉sko〈snar 〉nyakyis/ nee〈〈pe 〉྾〈snar 〉〉wal/ ④/〈〈pe 〉྾〈snar 〉〉bskyabs/༅〈〈pe 〉dze〈snar 〉〉kyi bzung / ⑥〈〈pe 〉྾〈snar 〉stanabyangs/ ⑦〈〈pe 〉྾〈snar 〉〉pa'i/715 ①〈〈pe 〉dze〈snar 〉〉waḥ/ ldu 〈〈pe 〉྾〈snar 〉〉gyis/ ①〈〈pe 〉྾〈snar 〉〉padma ma'i/ du〈〈pe 〉dze〈snar 〉garje/ phye〈〈pe 〉྾〈snar 〉ris/716 nyu〈〈pe 〉྾〈snar 〉〉3 ba/ ④〈〈pe 〉stan/ 〈〈snar 〉stanas/ zhu〈〈pe 〉〉〈〈snar 〉〉tsi haṃ thi yoḥ/ ④〈〈pe 〉྾〈snar 〉tothurdzo/phye〈〈pe 〉dze〈snar 〉〉kyi/ ⑥〈〈pe 〉྾〈snar 〉mtshul/ ⑦〈〈pe 〉〉〈〈snar 〉〉dgongs/ ⑧〈〈pe 〉〉〈〈snar 〉〉wal/spu〈〈pe 〉྾〈snar 〉stanas/ rtso〈〈pe 〉〉〈〈snar 〉〉kyis/ tso〈〈pe 〉〉kun gyis/ 〈〈snar 〉stagen gyis/717 ༅〈〈pe 〉྾〈snar 〉〉waslob dpon/ ②〈〈pe 〉྾〈snar 〉ri dang / zhu/〈〈pe 〉྾〈snar 〉〉ba'o/bsdur 'bras re'u migargyud/ (649)18wa 718

༄go/ /sangs rgyas thams cad 'dus pa'i sku/ /bla ma dam pa la btud de/ /de yi man ngag ji bzhin du/ /gtor ma'i cho ga bri bar bya/ /de la tshogs bsags pa dang / las bsgrub par 3bya ba dang / bar du gcod pa rnams zhi bar bya ba'i phyir gtor ma nar mar byed par 'dod pas srod kyi 1dus su sha lnga dang / bdud rtsi lnga'i ri lu dang ldan pa'i gtor mas snod mdzes par bkang ste/ sems can thams cad la snying rje chen po bskyed la/ de nas stong pa nyid du mos par bya ste/ de'i 'og tu hūṃ zhes brjod pas rdo rje'i sa gzhi dang /ra ba dang / dra ba dang / phyi rol du me lce 'bar ba dang / rnam par 'khrigs par bsams shing ④nang du rin po che'i khang pa nyams dga' ba bsam par bya'o/ /der bdag nyid skad cig tsam kyis lhag pa'i lhar bsgoms te pyerdo rje gsum dang bye / ye shes sems dpa' dang / cod pan gyi lha dran pas 18—719

bsrung 1bar bya'o/ /de nas rdo rje thal mo snying gar phye la gtor mar hūṃ āḥ.oṃ 3baṃ bsams te/ hūṃ chu ltar zhu bas kha dog phun sum tshogs pa dang / snyabye/zhu bas dri phun sum tshogs pa dang / oṃ zhu ba ro ④phun sum tshogs par bsam par bya'o / /de nas oṃ kyi 'od zer gyis ye shes kyi bdud rtsi bkug ste gnyis su med par byas la 'bru gsum brjod pas brtan par bya'o/ /de nas bdag gi snying ga'i 'od zer gyis sems can thams cad dam yi dwags kyi tshogs bkug ste/ de dag gi snying ga dang spyi bor lha dang bla ma rigs kyi bdag po bsgom par bya'o/ /de nas nang du bkug la thams cad kyi lce la hūṃ las rdo rje bskyed/ oṃ gyis nor bu bskyed la5/ oṃ a kā ro mu khaṃ sarba dharmā rde byu.ārya nutpanda tāta oṃ sdzahūṃ phaṭa swā hā/zhes brjod nas nor bu 'od zer gyis ljags kyi lce'u chung drangs pa bzhin du so sor thim pas thams cad gnyis med kyi ye shes dang ldan par bsams te/ yid la 7byung ba'i mchod pa'i tshogs kyis kyang mchod par bya'o/ /de nas mchod sbyin gyi shephyag rgya dang bcas la/ chos rnams gzugs brnyan lta bu ste/ /gsal zhing dag la rnyog pa byemed/ /gzung du med cing brjod du med/ /rgyu dang las las kun du byung / /ngo bo gnyis med gnas med par/ /de ltar chos rnams shes nas kyang / /sems can don ni mnyam med byos/ /'on kyang sangs rgyas rigs su skyesbyi/ /zhes bya ba la sogs pas chos bshad par bya'o/ /de nas oṃ āḥhūṃ/ yul phyogs 'di la sogs pa'i/ sarba kṣe tra pā la/ sarba rākṣa 11sa/ yakṣa/ udmanda/ a pasma ra/ sarba de ba/ sarba nā ga /sarba ya mum/ sarba ḍā ki n+ya/ sarba satwa/ sarba byu ta/ a ta ya/ i rda ba lo/ kṛṇḍi 5kṛṇḍa/ ma ma sarba sa pa ri wa rngur na sarba satwa nañtsa/ sarba pā 18—720

paṃ bhya ti/ bispyo/ shrīrnyi 1ku ru/ dha na dha na/ ā yu a rokṣa/ a ti puṣpe ku ru/ sarba pra ya rakṣa ku ru swā hā/ sarba siddhi ka ri/ shu pa tsitta ka ra/zhes brjod la/ gzhan yang / khyed rnams kun la gsol ba ni/ /bdag cag 'khor dang bcas pa dang/ /gnas kyi dbang phyug skye bor bcas/ /gdon nad la sogs zhi ba dang / /tshe dang longs spyod 'phel ba dang / /bkra shis phun sum tshogs pa dang / /gzhan yang ci 'dod lhun 'grub zushog /ces 'dod pa'i don la gsol ba gdab ste/ sems can thams cad sdig med cing / /sems can thams cad bde gyur cig /sangs rgyas nyid du 'grub byed pa'i/ /lam de nyid du zhugs nas kyang / /rnal 'byor brtul zhugs gnas la ni/ /da lta nyid du gnas par shog /ces pas dge ba yongs su bsngos la/ /oṃ āḥhūṃ muḥzhes pas gshegs su gsol/ /bdag drin bla ma'i rgyud dang ni/ /blo dman rnams la phan gdags phyir/ /bla ma dam pa'i man ngag bzhin/ /gtor ma'i cho ga bris pa yin/ /dpal ldan gsang 'dus gtor ma 'di / /lam la gnas dang 'bras myang 5gis/ /tshogs rdzogs snyug bsngal bsal ba'i phyir/ /slob dpon nag pos mdzad pa yin/ /rdzogs so// //18—721

bsdur mchan/719 nyu mtshan byang 'di 〈〈sde 〉྾〈co 〉〉ltar bkod cing / 〈〈pe 〉stanator ma'i cho ga slob dpon nag pos mdzad pa bzhugs so// zhu〈〈pe 〉〉〈〈snar 〉〉the/ ④〈〈pe 〉sko〈snar 〉nya)sa/ cu 〈〈pe 〉྾〈snar 〉〉bsam zhing / ge〈〈pe 〉〉〈〈snar 〉〉bsgom ste/ ⑥〈〈pe 〉྾〈snar 〉〉pa/72༷ hu)〈〈pe 〉྾〈snar 〉stanasung / lce〈〈pe 〉〉〈〈snar 〉〉sla skye/ ⑧〈〈pe 〉dze〈snar 〉snam/ ④〈〈pe 〉྾〈snar 〉〉bas/rgya〈〈snar 〉〉wal/ yi〈〈pe 〉sko〈snar 〉〉ni/ rtso 〈〈pe 〉྾〈snar 〉toras/ ④〈〈pe 〉྾〈snar 〉7)sa/ ⑨〈〈pe 〉〉〈〈snar 〉〉brnyog ma/ thon〈〈pe 〉྾〈snar 〉〉skyes/ ⑪〈〈pe 〉྾〈snar 〉〉pa la/ sarba rakṣa/ ⑫〈〈pe 〉྾〈snar 〉zo'i/8〈〈pe 〉dze〈snar 〉〉griṇḍi/ ④〈〈pe 〉྾〈snar 〉〉gro721 zhu 〈〈pe 〉〉be3 shrī ti/ 〈〈snar 〉〉barghaṃ māṃ ti/ zhu〈〈pe 〉dze〈snar 〉〉buṣṭi/ zhu〈〈pe 〉〉〈〈snar 〉〉rgyab/ ④〈〈pe 〉〉〈〈snar 〉toradis/ ge〈〈pe 〉྾〈snar 〉stesgong /bsdur 'azas re'u mig da/ (65༷)18wa 722

༄/ /rab tu gnas pa'i cho ga'i rim pa/tsho ༄spro/ /rgya gar skad du/ pra tiṣṭha bi bye kra ma/ bod skad du/rab tu gnas pa'i cho ga'i rim pa/ rje btsun spyan ras gzigs dbang phyug la phyag 'tshal lo/ /lhan cig skyes pa'i bde ba yi/ /bdud rtsi'i ros ni nges gang pa'i/ /rdo rje 'dzin la rab btud nas/ /rab gnas cho ga bshad par bya//bde gshegs rnams kyis sngar gsungs pa'i/ /sna tshogs lung gi 2gzhung dag tu/ /dkyil 'khor chen po dngha bkod sogs pa'i/ /rab gnas cho ga rgyas gsungs dang //rgyud rnams de dang de dag tu/ /rdo rje 'dzin gyi rgyas gsungs dang / /de bzhin grub pa'i slob dpon gyis/ /rab gnas gzhung dang mthun mdzad pa/ /de dag kun gyi gzhung bsdus te/ /nges pa'i tshig dang rnam dbye dang / /cho ga'i rim pa gsum du bstan/ /de la nges pa'i tshig gis ni/ pra kan 5sha ne na tiṣṭha zhes pa ste mchog tu 18—723

gyur pa dang / yun ring bas rab gnas zhes bya ste/ de la mchog tu gyur pa ni ye shes sems dpa'i bdag nyid du bsgrub pa la bya la༄1/ yun ring ba ni 'khor ba ji srid du bzhugs pa la bya'o/ /rnam par dbye ba la gnyis te/ gzhi rnam par dbye ba dang / sgrub thabs rnam par dbye ba'o/ /gzhi rnam par dbye ba ni gtsug lag khang dang /mchod rten dang / lha'i sku dang / ras bris la sogs pa dang rta babs dang / rdo rings 4dang / shing ljon pa dang / khron pa dang / chu mig la sogs pa sku'i bdag nyid du bya ba'i gzhi'o/ /bgrang phreng dang /'jig rten pa'i bstan bcos dang / 'jig rten las 'das pa'i glegs bam la sogs pa ni gsung gi bdag nyid du bya ba'i 5gzhi'o/ /rdo rje dang 'khor lo la sogs pa lha'i mtshan ma thams cad ni thugs kyi bdag nyid du bya ba'i gzhi'o/ /sgrub 6thabs rnam par dbye ba ni/ gtsug lag khang la sogs pa sgu'i gzhi gang yin pa de stong pa nyid du bsgoms la/ de las hūṃ/ rgyu 3las 'khor lo / de las sku rnam par snang mdzad du bsgrubs la/ rab tu gnas par bya'o//bgrang phreng dang glegs bam la sogs pa gsung gi gzhi ni stong pa nyid las gsung rdo rje chos su bsgrubs la rab tu gnas par bya'o/ /rdo rje la sogs pa thugs kyi gzhi ni thugs mi bskyod par bsgrubs la rab tu gnas par bya'o/ /cho ga'i rim pa bstan pa ni rgyas pa dang bsdus pa'o/ /de la rgyas pa ni 18—724

rab gnas bya ba'i slob dpon yang ji lta bu zhe na/ de nyid bcu yi tshul rig cing / /zab cing rgya che'i chos dag dang / /dkyil 'khor bri 1ba'i las la mkhas / /sbyin sreg las dang rab gnas rig /gsang sngags tshul gyis rim la gus/ /nyan thos spyod pa spong byed pa/ /mkhas pa zhi ba rig par ldan/ /khro ba chung zhing 'dod pa chung / /nga rgyal spangs shing dbang po dul— / /rtsa ba'i ltung ba srung byed cing / /sngags dang bsam gtan las la brtson/ /ser sna yi ni dri ma spangs/ /dam pa'i rigs las sgres pa ste/ /sems can rnams la rjes brtse ba/ /des ni rab gnas bya bar 'os/ /slob ma yang ji lta bu zhe na/dad dang ldan zhing gtong la dga'/ /bslab pa yi ni gnas tshul 'dzin/ /sgyu dang g.yo ni rnam par spangs/ /bla ma la gus rjes brtser ldan/ /dge ba'i chos la rab tu brtson/ /dam pa de ni slob mar gzung / /de nas rab gnas la sogs pa'i dam pa'i sgrub pa la 'jug par nabya/de nas rab tu gnas pa'i bsgrub 4pa la 'jug ste/ de yang bsnyen pa dang /lhag par gnas pa dang / rab tu gnas pa'o/ /de la bsnyen pa bya ba la/ /zla ba drug dang gza' bzhi dang / /rgyu skar bcu bzhi gang yin dang / /tshes grangs bdun gyi grangs nyid la/ /rgyal ba la sogs rab gnas bya/ /de bas na dus de dag la bsnyen pa bya ste/ de yang yid du 'ong ba'i gnas/ gtsug lag khang dang khang bzangs 5la sogs pa zug rngu'i nyes pa spangs la dri gtsang khang du byas la/ bla re dang / gdugs dang / ba dan dang / yol ba dang / rgyal mtshan dang / rnga yab la sogs pas brgyan la/ maṇḍal dang mchod pa dang / gtor ma gzhung bzhin byas te/ ye shes kyi dkyil 'khor 18—725

sprul la mchod pa dang bstod pa sngon du 'gro bas zla ba'am zla ba phyed la sogs par sngon du bsnyen pa bya'o/ /de nas rab gnas kyi dbang du dkyil 'khor bzhengs na—1/ sa'i cho ga sngon du song bas gzhung gang yin pa'i dkyil 'khor bya'o/ /de nas lhag par gnas pa bya ste2/ de la khrus sa'i stegs bu gru bzhi pa la dpangs kyekhru do ba/so phag la sogs pa la legs par brtsigs pa/ rdo thal kyis dkar por — byug go / /de nas rab gnas gang byed pa de phyogs gcig tu bzhugs la/ de'i 'og tu slob ma lhag par gnas pa dang / bum pa lhag par gnas pa bya'o/ /de nas mchod pa dang gtor ma dang khrus kyi yo byad la sogs pa kun tshogs par 5bshams la bdag nyid lha gang yin pa'i skur bsgoms la/ srung zhe ba'i 'khor lo yan chad gzhung bzhin du bsgoms te/ dang po rab gnas bya ba'i lha la khrus bya'o / /de yang sku gzugs yin na zhal shar phyogs su bstan la ras la sogs pa'i na bza' ser po gsol te/ oṃ badzra bsta tsuhūṃ zhes pas so/ /de nas hūṃ bzlas pa'i nyungs kar dang / oṃ bzlas pa'i chu lag pa g.yas g.yon gyis lan gsum bskor te/ gnyis ka mer bor te shis pa'i cho ga bya'o/ /de nas ba'i rnam lnga dang bdud rtsi lnga dang bcas pas/ oṃ sarba ta thā ga ta kā ya byebi sho dha nee swā hā/ zhes brjod cing drur ba'i 9pir gyis bsgu'o/ /de nas til mar dri zhim pas bsgos pa mkhar ba'i snod du bzhag ste/ oṃ hūṃ tram̐ tri khaṃ zhes brjod cing drur ba'i pir gyis khyab par byug go/ /de nas til mar gsal saba'i phyir shing shun dri zhim pa dang sbyar ba'i chus bkru'o/ /de nas dkar gsum mngar gsum sbyar ba'i chus 1 bkru'o/ /de nas skyu ru ra'i 'dag chal gyes bkru'o//18—726

de nas bum pa'i chus dbang bskur zhing bkru ste/ rol mo'i sgra dang / bkra shis kyi tshigs su bcad pa brjod cing bum pa'i chus bkru'o/ /de'i tshe nam mkha' la sangs rgyas dang byang chub sems dpa' rig pa'i tshogs dang bcas pa rnams kyis bdud rtsi'i chu rgyun gyi bum pas dbang bskur zhing bkru bar bsam mo /ji ltar bltams pa tsam gyis kyang / /de bzhin gshegs kun khrus gsol ba/ /lha yi chu ni dag pa yis/ /de bzhin bdag gis sku khrus gsol/ /oṃ sarba 1ta thā ga ta a bhi ṣe ka sa ma ya shri ye hūṃ swā hā/ zhes brjod cing bkru'o/ /de nas ras dmar pos sku la chags pa'i chu legs par phyi'o/ /'di ni khrus kyi cho ga'o/ /de nas tsandan dang gur kum la sogs pa'i dris lha'i thugs kar byug ste2/badzra gadhe a zhes pas so/ /de nas me tog dang / spos dang / mar me dang /bshos rnams rang rang gi sngags kyis phul la/ rdo rje dang bcas pa'i lag pa chu la reg pas thugs ka dang / mgur dang / spyi bo dang / dpral bar nye reg bya'o/ /de nas pus mo g.yas pa sa la btsugs te/ lag pa g.yas pas spos phor thogs te/ g.yon pas dril bu gsel zhing / lce hūṃ las rdo rje bsams la/ 'di skad ces snyan gsan dbab cing gsol ba gdab bo/ /hūṃ bcom ldan rdo rje che ge mo/ /rig pa'i rgyal po phyag 'tshal bstod/ /slob ma rnams la brtse ba dang / /khyed rnams la yang mchod pa'i phyir/ /mgon po thugs rje'i bdag nyid kyis/ /rab gnas nang par bgyid par 'tshal/ /gus pas bdag dang 'di la ni/ /bka' drin dag ni mdzad par rigs/ /sangs rgyas rnams ni bdag la dgongs/ /'jig rten mgon po brtse ba can/ /18—727

dgra bcom byang chub sems dpa' dang / /gang yang hūṃgasang sngags lha rnams dang / /lha dang 'jig rten skyong ba dang / /gang yang 'byung po mthu chen rnams / /bstan pa 'di la mngon dga' zhing / /byang chub sems dpa'i rten byung ba'i/ /rdo rje yi ni spyan ldan rnams/ /rdo rje 'chang chen che ge bdag /rig pa'i rgyal po 'di yis ni/ /rab gnas dag ni bgyid par 'tshal/ /de bas bdag dang slob ma la/ /thugs brtser ldan pas byin rlabs mdzod/ /sa ma ya st+waṃ a haṃ/ de skad lan gsum du brjod do/ /snyan gsan phab cing gsol ba btab pas phyogs bcu'i sangs rgyas dang byang chub sems dpa' thams cad mdun gyi 4nam mkha' la byon te dgongs par bsam mo/ /de nas rab gnas bya ba'i gzhi de stong pa nyid du bsgoms la de cho ga'i rim pas gang yin pa der bskyed pa'am/ yang na yig 'bru tsam las skad cig tsam las bskyed la snying ga'i sa bon gyis ye shes sems dpa' spyan drangs te/ nam mkha' la bzhugs pa la oṃ arghaṃ pra ṭītstsha zhes pas yon chab dbul/ oṃ ni ri ti 3khaṃ zhes pas zhabs bsil dbul/ oṃ sarpā tresho dha ne hūṃ zhes pas zhabs bsil dbul lo/ /de nas me tog nas sgra brnyan gyi bar du dbul lo/ /dzaḥhūṃ baṃ hoḥzhes pas dam tshig pa la bstems la/ yang mchod pa rnams rim par phul te/ lha gang yin pa de'i sngags ci nus kyis bzlas la/ mthar yi ge brgya pa muḥtso dang bcas pas gshegs su gsol te/ 'di ni sta gon la gnas pa'i cho ga'o/ /de nas nang par dkyil 'khor ram stegs bu'i gnas der mchod pa'i yo byad ci 'byor pa thams cad bshams la/ de nas bdag nyid lha gang yin par bsgoms te/ mchod pa byin gyis brlab shepa sngon du 'gro ba'i mchod pa yan 18—728

chad byas la/ de nas bgegs bsrung ba'i 'khor lo bsgoms te/ gzhal yas khang sprul pa la sogs pa gnas skabs dang sbyar la bya/ de nas gang rab gnas bya ba'i lha bskyed la/ de'i rjes la lag pa g.yas pa spos snod thogs la g.yon pa dril bu gsil zhing / pus mo g.yas pa sa la btsugs nas lce hūṃ las rdo rjer bsams te/ hūṃ bcom ldan zhes bya ba nas rlabs mdzod —1ces brjod nas/lha rnams bskul te/ sang ni zhes bya ba'i skabs su di ring zhes bya ba bcug la snyan gsan dbab bo/ /de nas ye shes sems dpa' snying ga'i sa bon gyi 2 'od zer gyis nam mkha' la spyan drangs nal yon chab la sogs pas mchod de/dzaḥhūṃ baṃ hoḥs sadagug gzhug byas te dbyer med par bstems la/ sngar gyi khrus kyi cho gas thukhrus bya ste/ de yang sku gzugs la ni dngos su khrus bya tsul/ras ris dang glegs bam la sogs pa la ni me long gi gzugs brnyan la khrus bya'o//de yang bcom ldan 'das de bzhin gshegs pa dgra bcom pa yang dag par rdzogs pa'i sangs rgyas rig pa dang zhabs su ldan pa/ bde bar gshegs pa/'jig rten mkhyen pa/ skyes bu 'dul ba'i kha los sgyur ba/ (lha dang mi rnams kyi ston pa de la yo byad thams cad dang ldan pa'i khrus 'di gsol lo/ /ri bo lta bur mdzes pa yi— / /yon tan dam pa'i rgyan ldan pa/ /mchod gnas rin chen 'di dag la/ /bdag gis khrus ni gsol bar bgyi/ /ma rig 'joms pa'i nyi ma ste/ /srid pa'i nad ni sel ba'i sman/ /dam chos rin chen 'di la ni/ /bdag gis khrus ni gsol bar gyi/ /bskal ba'i mtha' yi dngos 'joms pa/ /'jigs byed me yi cha byad can/ /mgon po snying rje'i stobs ldan la/ /bdag gis khrus ni gsol bar bgyi/ /mchog tu tshim zhing 18—729

skal bzang ba/ /dam pa'i bdud rtsi mdzes cha byad/ /che ge mo dpal rdo rje la//bdag gis khrus ni gsol bar bgyi/ /gdul bya'i sems can gang dag la/ /rgyal ba'i sprul sku mang po yi/ /cha byad lha yi rnam pa la/ /bdag gis ༄1khrus ni gsol bar bgyi/ /snying rje yis ni des gang rnams༄ / /rtag tu phan dang bde mdzad pa'i/ /mchog tu dul ba de dag la/ /bdag gis — khrus ni gsol bar bgyi / /sangs rgyas gzugs brnyan gnas dang ni/ /slob pa'i dge 'dun gnas kyi sa/ /gtsug lag khang dang gnas gzhan la/ /bdag gis khrus ni gsol bar bgyi/ /de nas yon chab la sogs pas mchod la/ oṃ badzra a bhā 5ra ṇa wa pu ṣa ṇi swā hā/ zhes pas rgyan ci 'byor pa dbul lo/ /de nas gang yin pa'i bstod pa 6bya'o/ /de nas 'di skad brjod do/ /gang bcom ldan 'das de bzhin gshegs pa dgra bcom pa yang dag par rdzogs pa'i sangs rgyas rig pa dang zhabs su ldan pa/ bde bar gshegs pa/ 'jig rten mkhyen pa/skyes bu 'dul ba'i kha los 7sgyur ba/ bla na med pa lha dang mi rnams kyi ston pa de rgyu dang 'bras bu phun sum tshogs pa gsung ba/ chos thams cad thugs su chud pa'i sangs rgyas bcom ldan 'das de bdag gis rab tu gnas par bgyi'o/ /gang bcom ldan 'das byang chub kyi phyogs sum cu rtsa bdun yang dag par rtogs shing mi dge ba bcu spangs pa/ mi 'jigs pa bzhi dang / ma 'dres pa'i chos gsum dang / dran pa nye bar gzhag pa dang / snying rje chen po la sogs pa rnams yang dag par rjes su rtogs pa/ ma lus pa'i bslab pa rgyas par byed pa'i chos rnams yang dag par rjes su rtogs pa bde bar gshegs pa sa/zhal du med pa'i yon tan gyi chos dang ldan pa'i sangs rgyas bcom ldan 'das 'di 18—730

bdag gis rab tu gnas par bgyi'o/ /gang bcom ldan 'das bla na med pa'i tshul khrims la sogs pa phung po lnga yang dag par rjes su rtogs pa/ cho 'phrul gsum dang / tshangs pa'i gnas bzhi dang / 'phags pa'i bden pa bzhi yang dag par rjes su rtogs pa/ phyin ci ma log pa'i shes bya dang / ye shes la dbang brnyes pas nyon mongs pa la sogs pa bdud bzhi spangs pa'i sangs rgyas bcom ldan 'das 'di bdag gis rab tu gnas par bya'o/ /gang bcom ldan 'das pha rol tu phyin pa bcu dang / dpag tu med pa'i bsod nams dang ye shes kyi tshogs dang ldan pa skyes bu chen po'i mtshan sum cu rtsa gnyis kyis brgyan zhing ༄1dpe byad bzang po brgyad cus spras pa/ sku lta bas chog mi shes pa/mthong na mi mthun pa med pa ste/ rigs so sor de'i sku gcig tu mthar thug pa thob 3pa/ 'gro ba thams cad kyi gnyen/ sangs rgyas bcom ldan 'das 'di bdag — gis rab tu gnas par bgyi'o/ /de nas gser gyi thur ma añdza nas byugs pas 4 spyan dbye ste/ oṃ tsakṣu tsakṣu sa manta tsakṣu bi sho dha na badzra swā hā/zhes bzlas shing dbye'o/ /de nas yang mchod pa'i khyad par kun gyis mchod de/dang por bum pas dbang bskur zhing khrus chab gsol/ de nas me tog dbul te/'di ni mchog gi me tog ste/ /chu las skyes dang thang las skyes/ /mchog tu gus pas dbul bar bgyi/ /ci bde bar ni bzhes su gsol/ /oṃ badzra puṣpe gehūṃ / 'di ni mchog gi bdug spos te/ /lhan cig skyes dang sbyar ba'i spos/ /mchog tu gus pas dbul bar bgyi/ /ci bde bar ni bzhes su gsol/ /oṃ badzra dhūspru hūṃ/ mar me 'di ni phyogs kun du/ /'bar te mun pa thams cad sel—/ /mi shes rab rib sel ba'i phyir/ /ci bde bar ni bzhes su gsol/ /18—731

oṃ badzra dī pe hūṃ/ 'di ni mchog gi dri yin te/ /tsandan gur gum la sogs pa//mchog tu dad pas bdag 'bul —(na/ /ci bde bar ni bzhes su gsol/ /oṃ badzra gandhe hūṃ/ 'di ni mchog gi lha bshos te/ /kha dog dri dang ror ldan pa'i/ /bza' dang bca' bar yang dag ldan/ /ci bde bar ni bzhes su gsol/ /oṃ badzra nai 2li te hūṃ/ de nas 'dod pa lnga'i longs spyod dbul te/ gzugs sgra dri ro reg ldan pa'i/ /mchog tu gyur pa'i zas mchog 'di/ /bdag gi dad pas dbul bar bgyi/ /ci bde bar ni bzhes su gsol/ /oṃ badzra di pya an ṭaṃ mā bye dhya na dzrī ṇa ṇi swā hā/ de nas rab gnas kyi gzhi gang yin pa'i gnas skabs dang sbyar la/ lha khang dang mchod rten la sogs pa ni rnam par snang mdzad du sprul la rgyu zhes pas lha khang dang mchod rten du gyur par byas la/glegs bam la ni yum mam/ rdo rje chos su byas pa de a zhes pas yi ge'i rnam par gyur te/ yi ge de'i sgo nas 'khor ba'i mtha'i bar du 'gro ba'i don byed par bsam mo/ /de nas bdud rtsi 'khyel ba'i sngags bzlas shing g.yas pas/rdo rje bzung ste sku la sogs pa'i dbu dang sked pa zhabs su lan gsum gsum bskor te/ sku'i sum cha'i tshad kyi stegs bu'i khri la ya yo med par ci mdzes su bzhugs te/ oṃ su pra tiṣṭha badzre swā hā/ zhes pas brtan par bzhugs su gsol lo/ /de nas gnas pa'i lha de dag byin che zhing bkra shis pa dang yun ring du gnas par bya ba'i phyir chos skyong la gtor ma byin la gsol ba gdab/khyad par du ma hā kā la la gtor ma byin la/ deng nas bzung phyaste khyod kyis nga'i bka' dran par gyis la/ gnas dang bcas pa 'di ji srid pa'i bar du srung zhing mgon dang skyabs mdzod cig par dbang bskur zhing rab tu gnas par 78—732

bya'o / /de nas rgyas pa'i sbyin sreg tsā ru dang bcas pa bya'o/ /de nas bden pa'i byin rlabs ju1brjod de/ oṃ sangs rgyas dang chos dang dge 'dun gyi bden pa dang / rig sasngags dang / gsang sngags dang / gzungs sngags dang /snying po dang phyag rgya dang / rig pa'i lha thams cad kyi bka' bden pa dang /rten cing 'brel par 'byung ba bsam gyis mi khyab pa'i bden pa dang / bden pa'i byin rlabs kyis gebade bar gshegs pa'i sku gsung thugs kyi rten 5'di zhes bya ba mchod pa dang / bstod pa dang / bzlas pa la sogs pa'i sgo nas rab tu gnas par bya bas/ bde bar gshegs pa'i sku gsung thugs kyi ngo bo 'di dus 'di nas bzung nas 'khor ba ma stongs kyi bar du bdag dang yon bdag dang sems can thams cad kyi phyag gi gnas mchod pa'i rten/ bsod nams bsags 3pa'i dpal mgon du gyur te/ zhal dro byin che 'gro ba skyobs 8pa'i mthu sbyin dang ldan nas/ bdag dang sems can thams cad tshe dang /stobs dang / mdog dang / bde ba dang / longs spyod dang / dbang phyug dang / rigs dang / gzugs dang / dpal bzang po dpag tu med pa dang ldan par gyur cig /ngan 'gro las thar te bde ba'i go 'phang thob par gyur cig /longs spyod kyi mchog thob pa dang sems can thams cad kyi dpal mgon du gyur cig /lus dang sems kyi sbug bsngal dang / yid mi bde ba las nges par grol bar gyur cig /bsam pa thams cad phun sum tshogs shing byang chub sems la mchog tu gzhol par gyur cig /'dod chags dang / zhe sdang dang / gti mug dang / nga rgyal dang / dregs pa dang / phrag dog dang / ser sna la sogs pa nyon mongs pa dang nye ba'i nyon mongs pa rnam par 78—733

spangs par gyur cig /nyan thos dang rang sangs rgyas dang bla na med pa'i byang chub kyi 'bras bu thob cing myur du mi gnas pa'i 1mya ngan las 'das pa'i go 'phang thob par gyur cig /de nas bskor ba'i tshigs su bcad pa la sogs pa'i mdo 'don zhing bskor ba byas la phyag bya'o/ /de phyin chad bsod nams kyi rten btsugs pa'o/ /de nas slob ma'i dge ba spel ba'i phyir slob dpon gyis yon blang bar bya'o/ /khyod kyis ji ltar gsol ba btab pa yi/ /rab gnas gzhung las 'byung ba bzhin/ /brtse ba'i sems kyis yang dag byas/ /de bas ci 'byor pas mchod gyisas/ /de nas slob mas ma chags pa'i sems kyis ci 'byor ba bla ma la dbul zhing mchod pa byas te/ phyag byas la bskor ba bya'o/ /de ni cho ga rgyas par bstan pa'o/ /cho ga mdor bsnyus pa ni bsnyen pa sngon du song bas lhag par gnas pa ma byas par nyi ma gcig la khrus la sogs pa kun rdzogs par snga ma ltar rab tu gnas par bya'o/ /rab gnas kyi ched du dkyil 'khor bri na rab gnas gang byed pa'i lha des gtso bo bya'o/ /lha khang la sogs pa ni rnam par snang mdzad kyis bya'o/ /'tshe ba'i don gyis rnal 'byor 5pho mo'i bgrang phreng la sogs pa ni sngags kyi yi ge 'bru gsum tsam gyis brlabs la sbyin no/ /gal te rab gnas ma byas pa'i skyon ni/ rigs dang mi ldan skyes bu la/ /mi rnams kun gyis mchod mi byed/ /de bzhin rab gnas ma byas pa'i/ /sgu gsung thugs kyi rten dag la / /phyag 'tshal mchod pa 'bras bu med/ /sngags dang bral bas thal ba la//sbyin sreg byas bzhin 'bras bu med/ /de bas sku gsung thugs kyi rten/ /18—73/

bzhengs nas ring por gzhag 1mi bya/ /dpal dang 'byor pa nyams 'gyur bas/ /de bas myur du rab gnas bya/ /bde gshegs bla ma'i bka' dang lung / /mdo rgyas kun gyi gzhung bsdus pa/ /byis pas tshegs 2med rtogs bya'i phyir/ /gsal ba tsam zhig bris pa yin/ /rab tu gnas pa'i cho ga'i rim pa slob dpon nag po pas mdzad pa rdzogs so// //—de nyid dang 'gos lhas btsas kyis 5bsgyur ba'o// // 6bsdur mchan/723 1mtshan byang 'di chos tshan 'di'i mtshan bod skad du smos nga/ ltar bkod cing / 〈〈pe 〉〉ngab tu gnas pa'i cho ga slob dpon nag pos mdzad pa bzhugs so// 2〈〈pe 〉〉〈〈snar 〉〉gis/ —〈〈pe 〉〉〈〈snar 〉dpor/ 4〈〈pe 〉〉〈〈snar 〉〉gyis / 5〈〈pe 〉〉〈〈snar 〉〉rko/724 1〈〈pe 〉〉〈〈snar 〉7bya la/ 〈〈pe 〉〉〈〈snar 〉7pa ra/ 〈〈pe 〉〉〈〈snar 〉'as/ 4〈〈pe 〉〉〈〈snar 〉〉reng /3〈〈bee 〉〉〈〈snar 〉snga sa pa'i/ 6〈〈pe 〉〉〈〈snar 〉〉sgrubs/ 〈〈pe 〉〉〈〈snar 〉〉hūṃ rgyu/725 1〈〈pe 〉〉〈〈snar 〉torabri/ 2〈〈pe 〉〉〈〈snar 〉toradul/ 〈〈pe 〉〉〈〈snar 〉ra pa/ra/ 4〈〈pe 〉〉〈〈snar 〉〉sgrub/5〈〈pe 〉〉〈〈snar 〉〉〈〈co 〉thazang /726 1〈〈snar 〉donas/ (〈〈pe 〉〉〈〈snar 〉snga sa te/ 〈〈pe 〉〉〈〈snar 〉rnamangs/ —〈〈pe 〉〉〈〈snar 〉dpo/ 5〈〈pe 〉〉〈〈snar 〉〉gipar/ 3〈〈pe 〉〉〈〈snar 〉7srung / 7〈〈pe 〉〉〈〈snar 〉〉bast+ra/ 〈〈pe 〉〉〈〈snar 〉〉〉/ 9〈〈pe〉〉〈〈snar 〉〉durba'i/ rka 〈〈pe 〉〉〈〈snar 〉〉'khar/ 〈〈pe 〉〉〈〈snar 〉〉durba'i/ 〈〈pe 〉〉〈〈snar 〉snga sal/— 〈〈snar 〉〉byur/727 1〈〈pe 〉〉〈〈snar 〉gisarbha/ —spru〈〈pe 〉〉〈〈snar 〉〉kar byugs te/ 〈〈pe 〉〉〈〈snar 〉snga sa/ 4〈〈pe 〉〉〈〈snar 〉〉rjer bsaskyab / 728 rta〈〈pe 〉〉〈〈snar 〉sngagang / 〈〈pe 〉〉〈〈snar 〉stanapa'/ 〈〈pe 〉〉〈〈snar 〉ra rlabs/ —〈〈pe 〉〉〈〈snar 〉〉gyis/5〈〈pe〉〉〈〈snar 〉7ti/ 〈〈pe 〉〉〈〈snar 〉mind+ra/ 7〈〈pe 〉〉〈〈snar 〉〉giḥ/ 〈〈snar 〉tharlabs/729 1〈〈pe 〉〉〈〈snar 〉〉byen brlabs mdzad/ 2〈〈pe 〉〉〈〈snar 〉〉gyis/ 〈〈pe 〉〉〈〈sna ra 〉〉drang / 4〈〈pe 〉〉〈〈snar 〉〉nga// 5〈〈pe 〉〉〈〈snar 〉〉toḥ/ 6〈〈pe 〉〉〈〈snar 〉sngag 7〈〈snar 〉snga sa/ 8〈〈pe 〉〉〈〈snar 〉〉lo/78—735
