sems dpa' khyod la 'dud/ /ces don yod pa'i sgo nas bstod ①pa'o/ /da ni nye bar bsdu ba gsungs pa ni sangs rgyas kyis bstod ces bya ba la sogs pa'o/ /de nas te de ma thag tu mgon po gcig pu bzhugs par gyur ces 'brel to/ /ci zhig nas mnyam na gsungs pa'i phyir ni byed par gyur pa'i sangs rgyas rnams kyis bdag nyid la bstod nas so sangs rgyas nye bar mtshon pa'i don to/ /lha mo rnams kyang ②ngo bo zhes rig par bya'o/ /'khor lo zhes bya ba ni lha mo'i 'khor lo'o—/ /sngar gyi tshul dang mnyes mdzad do/ /zhes bya ba rjes su chags par bya zhing de rnams la mchog tu gsang ba ji lta ba bzhin du bshad nas rang gi lus kyi 'khor lor dkyil 'khor pa'i 'khor lo rnams phung po la sogs pa'i ④rang bzhin gyis bsdus nas bzhugs par gyur pa yin no/ /bsdus pa'i rim pa dang / rdo rje bzlas pa'i rim pa ni sngar bstan te/ bde ba chen po ni sems kyi rang bzhin yin pa'i phyir de lta na bde ba chen po gcig pu bzhugs par 'gyur zhes bya ba'i sgra 'dir sems rnam par dag pa'i rim pa zur gyis ston pa yin no/ /de nas rang byin gyis brlab pa'i rim pa gsum bstan dudon gsungs pa ni/ de ltar zhes bya ba la sogs pa'o/ /de ltar zhes bya ba brjod ma thag pa'i tshul gyis rnal 'byor glubazhi byed de/ rnal 'byor bzhi sgrub par byed pa'i rnal 'byor pa ste sgrub pa pos bstan ④pa dang rgyu bar gyur pa'i 'jig rten hūṃ yig snying po can zhes pa ⑦yi ge hūṃ gi snying po de rgyur sgegyur pa 'di la yod pas ⑨hūṃ yig snying po can no//bsams nas zhes bya ba la snying gar zhes bya ba ni khong nas dbyung bar bya ba'o/ /da 'gro ba de dag kyang des bskyed rdo rje sems dpar zhes bya bar ⑩yi ge hūṃ des rdo rje sems dpa'i rang bzhin du yongs su gyur par bltas nas/ bdag nyid 18—1574

kyang 'od gsal las yul tsam gyis langs nas/ des blos zhes bya ba la brjod ma thag pa'i rang bzhin kyis dran pa dang shes bzhin ldan par ro/ /ji bzhin zhes bya ba ni nye bar bstan pa ①bzhin du spyod lam rnam pa bzhi po rnams kyis ③rnam par rgyu bar bya'o/ /'dir don ni 'di ltar dgongs pa yin te/ rnal 'byor ①pa bzhi dang ldan pa'i rnal 'byor pas snying ga na gnas pa'i 'jig rten la yi ge hūṃ ni sa bon las rdo rje sems dpa'i rang bzhin du yongs su gyur pa bltas te/ bdag nyid kyang stong pa nyid kyi ting nge 'dzin las langs par rtogs par byas nas bar chad med par de'i yid kyis ④gnas par bya'o zhes gnas par bya'o/ /rnal 'byor gzhan gyis skabs 'cha' ba gsungs pa ni/sngags pa zhes bya ba la sogs pa ste go sla'o/ /ji ltar bsgom snyam na gsungs pa niske/ mtho gang tsam ni zhes bya ba la sogs pa'o/ /yi ge hūṃ khya/mdog dkar po rnam par bsams nas de las yongs su gyur pas zla ba'i dkyil 'khor bsgom par bya'o/ /de'i dbus su yi ge oṃ dkar po bltas te/ de las bdud rtsi babs par bsgom par bya'o zhes bya ba ni tshigs su bcad pa'i don to/ /rdo rje sbyor ba 'di yis ni/ /zhes bya ba la sogs pas ni phan yon brjod pa ste/ de yang go bar sla'o/ /nang gi bdag nyid can gyi sbyin sreg bstan pa'i phyir gsungs pa ni/ de ltar zhes bya ba la sogs pa'o/ /sbyang ba la sogs pa ji ltar bya snyam na yi ge hūṃ gis zhes bya ba la sogs pa gsungs so/ /yi ge hūṃ gi duzhes bya ba ni hūṃ las yongs su gyur pa'i rdo rjes so/ /sbyang bya zhing zhe na ni/'bar ma dang spos ④ma dag gis dag par byas pa'o/ /a yig gi ⑧ni zhes bya ba ni—/ a yig las yongs su gyur pa'i padma'i snod ces par gyur pas sad par 18—1575

byas te/ padma'i ①snod du chud pa zin ②la sogs pa rnams sngon gyi dam tshig gi ①rjes su rtogs par bya'o zhes bya ba'i don to/ /rjoji ltar yang bar bya zhe ⑤na/de'i phyir brjod pa ni/ oṃ gyis mnan nas zhes bya ba la sogs pa'o/ /yi ge oṃ gyis mnan pa zhes bya ba des mtshan pa'o/ /de la rim pa ni 'di yin te/nam mkha' la yi ge hūṃ yongs su gyur pa'i rdo rje de'i 'og tu yi ge a las yongs su gyur pa'i pad snod de'i dbus su ni yi ge oṃ gyis mtshan pa'i dam tshig gi rdzas rnams—/ rdo rje dang padma sprad pa las me 'bar te/ des rdzas rnam par spros de dhibatsos pas zhu bar byas nas de bzhin gshegs pa thams cad kyi rang bzhin yang dag par ston par byed pa'i ye shes kyi ⑦nyi ma'i 'od zer gyi ye shes kyi sa bon la de'i 'od zer rnams kyis de bzhin gshegs pa thams cad kyi ye shes kyi bdud rtsi drangs nas dngos po de rnams dang lhan cig gcig tu byas nas yi ge gsum gyis byin kyis brlabs nas zhes bya ba ni kha zas yongs su sbyang ba'o/ /mgrin pa sbyang ba phyagasungs pa ni/ dung zhes bya ba ni yi ge oṃ dkar po las yongs su gyur pa'i dung dkar po'o/ /hri yig las byung ba zhes bya ba ni hriḥdamar po las byung ba'o/ /padma ni padma dmar po'o/ /yi ge hūṃ ni nag po'o/ /rdo rje che ni rdo rje rtse lnga pa mdog sngon po'o/ /a yig ni mdog dmar po ste/mgrin pa sbyong ba'o/ /lha rnams tshim par byed pa gsungs pa ni/ snying gar 'brug sgra zhes bya ba la sogs pa gsungs pa'o/ /'brug sgra zhes bya ba ni 'brug sgra'i sgra dang chos mthun pa'i phyir te/ yi ge hūṃ me lce gcig gsum dang ldan pa'o//sgom pa'i yi ge hūṃ de las me lce 'bar bar bya'o/ /der ni kha zas sbyin sreg bya zhes bya ba ni/ de bzhin gshegs pa thams cad kyi bdag nyid can yi ge hūṃ der 18—1576

kha zas de yongs su sbyangs pa'i ①dam tshig rdzas rnams sbyin sreg bya ste sreg blugs bya'o/ /de ltar gyur na lus kyi dkyil 'khor pa'i lha rnams yang dag par tshim par byas par gyur te/ gang gi phyir 'di ni nang gi sbyin sreg yin pa de'i phyir ro/ /da ni rim pa ji lta ba bzhin du lte ba dang mgrin pa dang snying ga dang gsang ①ba na gnas pa/ rlung dang me dang chu dang dbang chen gyi dkyil 'khor rnams kyi bya ba gsungs pa ni/ rlung gis zhes bya ba la sogs pa ste rlung ni rlung gi dkyil 'khor te/ des me de me'i dkyil 'khor yang bar bya zhing me'i dkyil 'khor de mched ④par bya'o/ /mched ⑤par byed pa ni skems par byed pa'o/ /dbang chen gyi ni dkyil 'khor zhes bya ba ni sa'i dkyil 'khor ro/ /gnas ni bzhi rjoste de nyid kyi phyir/ gang du sreg ⑦rdzas zhugs gyur pa/ /zhes gsungs so//bza' ba dang btung ④ba ji snyed zhugs gyur pa zhes bya ba ni bza' ba dang btung spu/ba zhugs pa de dag thams cad 'ju ba yin no/ /gang gis snyam pa la brjod pa ni chu yis yin zhes bya ba ste/ srul bar byed pa'i chus rul bar byas pa na de dag 'ju ba'i ⑫phyir zhes dgongs pa'o/ /sgrub pa pos gdon mi za bar bya ba'i las gsungs pa ni/ kha'i padma'i zhes bya ba la sogs pa'o/ /kha sbyor byed pa'i sbyor ba yis/ /zhes bya ba ni bshang lam gyi padma btsum pa sngon du btang bas 'og dang steng gi rlung bkag pas so/ /de'i de ma thag tu bshang lam padma nas te/bshang lam gyi sgo nas byung ste zhes bya ba'i phyir ston nas thal ba'i mthar ni zas zhu ba'i de ma thag tu ⑪ni zhes bya ba mthar thug par gyur pa bshad pa'i gnas skabs su gyur pa rnam par bltas ⑫te shes par bya'o/ /des cir 'gyur snyam pa la brjod pa ni dga' ba med cing zhes bya ba la sogs pa ste go bar sla'o/ /18—1577

dga' ba la sogs pa nye bar 'tshe ba dang bral ba'i sgrub pa pos tshe 'di nyid la bcom ldan 'das yun ring por bsgoms pa na mngon du byed par 'gyur ro snyam du dgongs pa'o/ /bdag gi spyod yul du gyur pa'i don 'di skye bo ①thams cad dang thun mong du gyur cig snyam du smon par byed pa ni/ rdo rje phreng ba dpal rta mchog gis dzeezhes bya ba la sogs pa ste 1'di yang go bar sla'o/ /rdo rje 'dzin pa'i sgrub thabs bsdus rim ni/ /bshad pas bsod nams thob pa gang yin des④—/ /bdag lus la gnas bsdus pa'i rim pa ni/ /'gro ba ji srid lus kun la 'jug shog /bsdus pa'i rim pa'i dka' 'grel slob dpon sgeg pa'i rdo rjes mdzad pa rdzogs so// //bal po'i dge bsnyen su'o 'di ⑪ta dang dge slong lo tsā ba blo ldan shes rab kyis bsgyur ba'o// //⑥18—1578
bsdur 'bras re'u migargyud/ (665) 18—1583

༄7/ /rgya gar skad du/ shrarnya pra la nā ma sta ba④/ bod skad du/dad pa smra ba zhes bya ba'i bstod pa/ bcom ldan 'das dpal rdo rje sems dpa' la phyag 'tshal lo/ /nyes pa'i dri ma ma lus bsal/ /yongs dag yon tan tshogs brnyes pa/ /rgyal ba kun gnas khyod nyid zhabs/ /padma gnyis la phyag 'tshal lo/ /srid pa'i sdug bsngal bsal dka'i ①me/ /tsha ba nye bar zhi mdzad cing / /bsod nams tshogs ni ma lus pas/ /thugs ni yongs su rgyas mdzad pa/ /khyod kyi yon tan zag med rnams/ /byang chub sems dpa' mchog gi phul/ /'dod chags la sogs dbang gyur kyang / /bdag 'dra'i spyod yul ga la lags/ /'gro ba'i snang ba gzhir gyur pa/ /nyi ma sprin dang bral ba la/ /me khyer nyon mongs dag gis ni/ /snang ba bgyid lta ci zhig 'tshal—/ /de lta mod kyi ngag gi tshogs/ /dman pas kyang ni stod ④bgyid pa/ /18—1584

bdag gis cung zhig gang smras de/ /mgon la dad pas drangs pa lags/ /lta ①bas mi ngoms yid 'ong zhing / /mchog tu sems dpa' stsol ④mdzad pa/ /srog dang bral ba'i ngo bo nyid/ /thugs rje'i bdag nyid can phyag 'tshal/ /rab zhi bdud rtsi 'dzag pa'i sku/ /su zhig la ni zhi mi bgyid/ /srid pa'i sred pas gdungs pa rnams/ /bcom ldan khyed kyis rtag zhi mdzad/ /yid 'ong mtsho ①las byung ba yirjo/ /bdud rtsi dkar po dang 'dra zhing / /rtag tu de nyid dpal gyis ni/ /mtshan mo'i yon tan dag gis brgyan/ /sgogs pa'i byang chub padma yis/ /sems can bung ba tshim mdzad pa/ /khyed mthong na ni rtag pa ru/ /dga' mchog su zhig skye mi 'gyur/ /spyod la mngon dad yid 'ong ba'i/bde la gnas pa'i sems can la/ /lha yul bud med bzhin gyi mdangs/ /zla 'dra 'dod chags bde bskyed ⑤dang / /mngon 'dod 'bras bus kun ster ba'i/ /dpag bsam shing gis rnam brgyan zhing / /yid 'ong thams cad rnyed sla ba'i/ /dga' ba'i tshal la'ang chags mi 'gyur/ /mchog tu sems dpa' skyed mdzad cing / /lta ngan rab rib stug po ni/ /shin tu legs par 'joms gyur pa'irjo//bar snang las ⑦ni rtags shar ba/ /bdag nyid chen po gang gis mthong /des ni gzhan dag lta mi 'gyur/ /lus can khams gsum 'brog dgon ni/ /chen por rtag tu 'khyams gyur cing / /rtag tu lam mchog las nyams la/ /khyed lam ⑧mngon sum ston pa mdzad/ /sems can kyi ni padma'i tshal/ /dam chos 'od zer dra ba yis/ /sad mdzad nyin mor gyur pas na/ /sngon med nyi ma khyod lags so/ /rab dga'i rgya mtsho las byung ba'i/ /bdud rtsi gnyis pa khyod lags te/ /rtag tu bdud rtsi'i gnas brnyes pas/ /'go ba nyam thag 18—1585

sel mdzad pa/ /nyon mongs thams cad spangs pa yis①/ /dgra bcom go 'phang thob pa gang / /khyed kyi yon tan ma 'tshal bas/ /de yang mkhas pa ma lags so/ /glog 'gyu lta bur 'byung ba yi/ /srog ni sdug bsngal byed byed pas//skad cig gis 'jig 'khor ba na/ /snying po khyed sku dran pa lags/ /rgyal sras khyed kyi bsam gtan gyis/ /bdud rtsis rtag tu tshim byed pa'i/ /yid la srid pa'i sdug bsngal ni/ /ma lus brjed de gnas pa lags/ /sku gsung thugs spro 'od zer gyis/ /'jig rten khams ni tshad med pa'i/ /gti mug gi ni mun bsal ba/ /khyed kyis skad cig gcig gis mdzad/ /rang gi ngo bo'i bdud rtsi che/ /skal ldan bde ba btang nas ni/ /rnam rtog bag chags shas che nas1/ /'khrul bas 'khor bar gyur pa la/ /chos dbyings ngo bo nyid lags kyang / /'jig rten mi shes bsal ba'i phyir/ /kun rdzob rnam pa'i sku yis ni/ /bzhugs kyi yang dag nyid kyis min/ /thugs rje'i bdud rtsi btung mchog gis/ /tshim mdzad bde ba rab stsol zhing dzee/ /rtag tu nyams ni sna tshogs pa'i/ /sangs rgyas rol mos gar mdzad do/ /gnyis par 'khrul ④pa las zlog phyir/ /shes rab thabs ni gnyis med mdzad/ /kun du rmongs pa bsal ba'i ⑤phyir/ /shes rab mchog gi rjo'od rab gsal/ /rnam thar gsum gyi bde brnyes ⑦pas/ /zhal gsum yid du 'ong ba'ang mnga'/ /sbyin sogs pha rol phyin pa drug /legs par brnyes pas phyag drug mnga'/ /shes rab rnon po'i ngo bo bas/ /phyag gnyis dkyil 'khor mchog sbyin ④mdzad/ /bsam pa thams cad rdzogs mdzad pas/ /rin chen mchog ni phyag na bsnams/ /mgon po khyod kyi thugs rje yis/ /rtag tu rdo rje padmar ston/ /bde ba'i 18—1586

thabs kyis ①de thob ces/ /de nyid dga' bdag can la ston/ /yon tan 'byor ba yongs rdzogs pas/ /rgyan rnams kun gyis brgyan pa lags/ /dka' ba las ni zlog mdzad pas/ /sems dpa'i skyil krung bde bas bzhugs/ /dngos po'i tshogs ni dbyer med pas/ /khyed bzhugs pa la nges snang ste/ /sku ni rang bzhin dri ma med/ /sna tshogs gzugs su rnam par ston/ /gdul bya sna tshogs sems can don/ /rnam pa gcig gis 'grub pa nizhu/ /sna tshogs rigs kyi dbye ba yis/ /thugs rje'i gter chen khyed rab mdzes/ /bsam bya khyed las gzhan ma mchis/ /bsam gtan mchog kyang khyed lags pas/ /ma rig mtshan mo'i mun rum ①na/ /dpag med 'od ldan ston zla khyed/ /srid pa nyid la zhugs gyur kyang / /srid pa med pa nyid du mdzad/ /srid pa srid med par zhen pas/ /'jig rten nyid dang 'dra bar mdzad/ /sems can kun la phan dgyes kyang / /sems can nyer dmigs nyid mi mnga'/ /sgyu ma lta bur gnas mdzad kyang / /khyed la sgyu ma mnga' ma lags/ /chags sogs dri mas ma gos par/ /sems can chags pa dbang du mdzad/ /khyod ni rang bzhin cher zhi yang / /bdud rnams 'joms par ④mdzad la dgyes/ /rang rig nyams su stong pa yis/ /nyon mongs bag chags bcas las rgyal/ /srid dang thar pa'i ro ltar bas/ /ro gcig nyid du khyed kyis mdzad/ /gang zhig dag pa'i sems kyis ni/ /khyed ni rtag tu sgom byed pa/ /des ni 'gro ba rmi lam dang / /dri za'i grong khyer lta bur mthong / /des na rnam rtog tshogs kyis ni/ /dri ma rnam par dang bubar 'gyur/ /rnam pa kun du skye ba ni/ /rgyu ni nye bar gcod par bgyid bu/ /'go ba'i sdug bsngal las zlog ste/ /slar yang smon 18—1587

lam stobs kyis ni/ /sna tshogs tshul gyis rnam gnas shing / /'go ba sdug bsngal ldan rnams skyabs①/ /thugs rje'i byin gyis rgyud brlan pas/ /dngos po med las rgyab kyis phyogs/ /bde gshegs sras po ji bzhed pa'i/ /tshul ni rnam pa du mas bzhugs/ /gzhan dag stong pa rtogs ⑤bya'i phyir/ /rang rig nyams ni ston par brtson/ /ngal bso'i gnas ni mchog brnyes nas/ /rtag tu bde bas zhugs ①par mdzad/ /khyed ni mthong ba tsam kyis kyang / /bzhin ras shin tu dang ba dang / /spu g.yo mchi mar bcas pa dang / /lus ni sems med lta bu nyid/ /nges pa kho nar 'byung gyur na/ /gtso bo khyed tshul mi g.yo ba/ /blo yi mig gis mthong ba dag /de yi bde ba smos ci 'tshal/ /ji ltar khyed kyi rnam pa kun/ /mthong ba las ni bder gyur pa/ /de ltar skad cig tsam mthong las/ /bde bar gyur pa yod ma lags/ /kun bdag dbang phyug byed pa dang / /ngas sprul skyes bu mchog dang ni/ /tshangs pa mchog gi rang bzhin dag /'du shes kun dang rnam bral zhes/ /thar pa las ni phyin ci log /nga rgyal lam gyi rjes 'gro rnams/ /khyed kyi rang bzhin ma 'tshal bas/ /srid pa gsum gyi lam na 'khor/ /srid pa'i sa bon nga rgyal zhes/ /yang dag gsung ba spyod kyi gsung / /nga rgyal yod na slar yang ni/ /de las las dang skye bar 'gyur—/ /bdag nga zhes bya dang bral zhing / /gzung ⑦dang 'dzin pa rnam spangs pa/ /spyod kyi ngo bor 'dzin shes na/ /rang bzhin gyis ni yang dag snang / / dang ba bsgom dzeepa la dga' bas/ /rtag tu skad cig tsam gyis snyeg du//ngan rtog rab rib kyis 'thum pasadzee/ /rmi lam na yang khyed mi mthong / /zla ba mar ngo'i mun rum na/ /dmus long dag gis nor bu bzang / /'od 18—1588

tshogs shin tu dri ma med①/ /lag par gnas kyang mi mthong ltar/ /de bzhin rmongs pa sna tshogs pa'i/ /rnam par zhen pas khyed mi mthong / /bde ba kun gyi gter gyur pa/ /rmongs pa'i blo yis mthong ba dang / /'od dang ldan pas mchog gyur pa/ /khyod ni rtag tu mthong mi 'gyur/ /ye shes snang ba gsal ba yis/ /dri med mdangs ldan khyod mthong 'gyur/ /gdul bya'i skye bo sna tshogs la/ /thugs rjes yid ni drangs gyur pa/ /de bzhin gshegs pa rnams kyis ni/ /khyed ni tshogs mchog ②dag tu bstan/ /gnas dang skye dang 'gag las 'das/ /spros pa rnams dang nyer bral bas/ /bcom ldan khyod ni bstod pa min/ /khyed ni stong las gzhan ma lags/ /khyod kyi sku ni 'ja' 'dra zhing //sgyu ma lta bu byung gyur pa/ /kun rdzob tu ni de bsngags kyi1/ /dam pa'i don du yod ma yin/ /khyed ni dngos min dngos med min/ /gnyis ka ma yin gos pa med/ /yod dang med par spyod pa yis/ /rtog ge'i spyod yul dag las 'das / /shes rab dam pa la dgyes pas/ /mchog tu zhi ba'i bdud rtsi can④/ /'gyur ba med pa'i ngo bo nyid/ /zhi ba'i sku la phyag 'tshal lo/ /rtag tu kun gyi bdud rtsi rig /kun mkhyen bde bar gshegs pa'i bdag /dpal mchog dang por ⑤phyag 'tshal 'dud/ /phyag 'tshal phyag 'tshal khyed phyag 'tshal/ /kun rdzob tu ni tha snyad kyis⑥ / /mkha' dang mnyam pa khyod bstod ④kyis/ /rnam rtog bral ba khyod la ni/ /bdag 'dras bstod ⑤pa byed mi rigs/ /sems can mang po la byams shing / /thugs rjes thugs ni drangs spugyur la/ /byis pa nyes smra lta bu la/ /gtso bo khyod ni bzod par mdzod/ /de ltar thub dbang gtso la bstod⑪/ /bsod nams bdag gis gang bsags pa/ /18—1589

des ni sems can rang rig pa'i/ /bde ba khyed dang 'dra bar shog /dad pa smra ba zhes bya ba'i bstod pa rdzogs so// //rgya gar gyi mkhan po pradzñā shrī ①gupta dang / sgra bsgyur gyi lo tsā ba bande rin chen bzang pos bsgyur cing zhus te gtan la phab pa'o ②bskur mchan/15/4 ①mtshan byang 'di chos tshan 'di'i mtshan bod skad du smos pa ltar bkod cing / 〈〈pe 〉snga〈snar 〉rad pa sru ba zhes bya ba'i bstod pa bzhugs so// 1〈〈pe 〉sko〈snar 〉〉spyo pra khā pa stas/ ⑪〈〈pe 〉sko〈snar 〉stana'i/④〈〈pe 〉sko〈snar 〉7stod/15/5 ①〈〈pe 〉〉〈〈snar 〉rilta/ ②〈〈pe 〉〉〈'ar 〉mirtsol/ ①〈〈pe 〉sko〈snar 〉〉tsho/ rjo〈〈pe 〉sko' ra 〉stand/⑤〈〈pe 〉〉skyed/ 〈〈snar 〉〉skyes/ ⑥〈〈pe 〉sko〈snar 〉skoragyur ba'i/ ⑦⑪ 〈〈pe 〉〉〈〈snar 〉sngal/1586 ①〈〈pe 〉〉〈〈snar 〉tha/ ①〈〈pe 〉snga〈snar 〉tha/ ①〈〈pe 〉snga'ar 〉sgrol cing / ④〈〈pe 〉sko〈snar 〉maraphrul/⑤ 〈〈pe 〉sko〈snar 〉7'i mun bsal/ rjo〈〈snar 〉rgas/ ⑦〈〈pe 〉sko〈snar 〉ṅkas/ ⑧〈〈pe 〉sko〈snar 〉thadzin/1587 sti〈〈pe 〉sko〈snar 〉7)/ thu〈〈pe 〉〉〈〈snar 〉'a 'grub pa'i/ ①〈〈pe 〉sko〈snar 〉〉dun/ pya〈'a ra 〉mi/ ⑤〈〈pe〉〉〈〈snar 〉rams par bral/ bu〈〈pe 〉sko〈snar 〉thagyis/1588 ①〈〈pe 〉sko〈snar 〉stan/ sne〈〈pe 〉sko〈snar 〉lkeg ①〈〈pe 〉sko'ar 〉mizhugs/ rjo〈〈pe 〉sko'ar 〉thazung /⑤〈〈pe 〉〉〈〈snar 〉rad pa sgom/ ⑥ 〈〈pe 〉sko〈snar 〉thagyis snyed/ ⑦〈〈pe 〉sko〈snar 〉thatho bas/1589 ①〈〈pe 〉〉〈〈snar 〉༅da pa/ pya〈〈pe 〉〉〈〈snar 〉rdza tshogs/ ①〈〈pe 〉sko〈snar 〉8 sngags kyang / rjo〈〈pe 〉sko'ar 〉〉ni| rjo〈〈pe 〉snga'ar 〉la/ 0〈〈pe 〉sko'ar 〉tha/ ⑦⑧〈〈pe 〉snga'ar 〉skod/ ⑨〈〈pe 〉sko'ar 〉〉drang / ⑩〈〈pe 〉sko〈snar 〉skod/159༷ 1〈〈pe 〉〉〈〈snar 〉sngag bu〈〈pe 〉〉 maṅga lo/ 〈〈snar 〉〉 sarba maṅgā lo// bkra shis// dge'o// //e ka sritstsha //18—1590
bsdur 'bras re'u migargyud/ (666)18wa 1591

deb bco brgyad pa/krung go'i bod kyi shes rig zhib 'jug lte gnas kyi bka' bstan dpe sdur khang gis dpe sdur dang dpe sgrig zhus/krung go'i bod kyi shes rig dpe skrun khang gis bskrun/zhin hwa dpe tshong khang pe cin 'grem spel khang gis bkrams/bka' bstan dpe sdur khang gi glog rdul rtsis 'khor khang gis par gzhi bsgrigs/krung go'i glog brnyan dpe sgrun khang par khang gis dpar btab/spyi lo 997lo'i 8par par gzhi dang po bsgrigs/— lo 997lo'i 8par par zengs dang po btab/dpar grangs/ 2 byed ci2sa—80057—26 —2 32
